news_mentions.headline: Vikings won't commit to Kirk Cousins starting vs. Packers, but QB eager to play for Minnesota again
news_mentions.description: Minnesota coach Kevin O'Connell didn't commit to newly acquired Kirk Cousins starting on Sunday in Green Bay. But we all know it's the goal, if not the plan.
news_mentions.body_text: kirk cousins is back in minnesota and already making a difference for one the packers have adjusted their planning for sunday s meeting at lambeau field with the full expectation cousins will start for the vikings five days after being traded north from las vegas he ll be starting packers coach matt lafleur told reporters wednesday i m fairly confident of that while the turnaround is quick lafleur is justified in expecting cousins to start the quarterback is uniquely familiar with kevin o connell s vikings offense from their time spent together from 2022 23 including a 13 4 finish in 2022 cousins has also demonstrated he still has the capabilities required of an effective starting quarterback and he s walking into a situation so dire that the 6 2 vikings essentially have to play him on a short week against a divisional rival in a hotly contested nfc north unsurprisingly o connell didn t commit to cousins starting on sunday in green bay but we all know it s the goal if not the plan it s still too early to commit wholeheartedly to what the plan on sunday looks like o connell said wednesday but i will say we re excited about the opportunity of spending every moment we can between now and then to get him comfortable and allow him to play for us this sunday that s what we re working towards but also want to be fair to kirk and make sure he feels good about it going to lambeau field the setting of lambeau field has its own meaning to cousins and it isn t necessarily the good kind lambeau is where cousins played his final snap as a viking in 2023 and where he suffered a season ending achilles injury which also limited his effectiveness in his next stop atlanta in 2024 sending him down a winding road that included backup duties with the falcons in 2025 before joining the raiders as a bridge starter in 2026 knowing where that s where i was carted off i had thoughts of is this my last game is this my last game as a viking cousins said wednesday in his return to minnesota going back there wearing purple and gold it has meaning but you have to make it have meaning with the way you play cousins is back in minneapolis where he said wednesday his kids were eager to move with him in what amounts to somewhat of a homecoming it s also where vikings fans are hoping he can play savior to a season that carries great promise but also a clear anchor in the form of an anemic offense most recently led by carson wentz that elicited boos from the home crowd in monday night s loss to buffalo it s great to have him back in the building o connell said you feel his energy right away cousins arrives with plenty of experience a deep understanding of the offense in which he ll be operating and a familiarity with minnesota s top weapon receiver justin jefferson who has had plenty of reason to feel frustrated with how this season is going for the vikings when possessing the ball monday night stands as a perfect example jefferson was targeted 11 times and caught just three of those passes for 58 yards a total that accounted for nearly 1 3 of minnesota s offensive production on the night when jefferson and cousins last played a full season together the receiver posted the best season of his career 128 catches 1 809 yards and eight receiving touchdowns he finished with a first team all pro selection nfl offensive player of the year honors and even attracted some votes for nfl mvp it s fair to expect jefferson to be both ecstatic about cousins return and to expect plenty of targets going forward for me with justin it s play to play cousins said of jefferson play in play out you re going where reads take you you don t go chasing things but you also understand the player that he is you go where the reads take you and he tends to make you right when throwing the ball in his direction in the short term the vikings have acquired a theoretical solution to their season long problem after following his former vikings offensive coordinator klint kubiak to las vegas cousins has found another familiar home in o connell and minnesota and the hope is the combination will revive this offense and turn the vikings a team with a super bowl caliber defense into the title contender they believe they can be similar to klint kevin knows me cousins said kevin knows what i do well kevin knows what i don t do well kevin knows what i can handle kevin knows what i can t handle i think that helps not just that he knows your strengths but that he knows your weaknesses and as a result he s gonna try to protect you i think the fact that he knows me well the good about me and the bad about me i think should help us whether o connell is willing to confirm it as of wednesday the vikings will proceed forward with cousins as qb1 kyler murray their previous chosen solution for their quarterback conundrum is expected to be cousins backup whenever he s healthy enough to suit up and just maybe the great ill of the 2026 season a legendary defense being wasted by an inferior offense might finally be remedied

news_mentions.headline: NFL trade grades: Evaluating every deal made ahead of the 2026 deadline
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Kevin Patra grades every trade made since the start of the 2026 regular season until Tuesday's trade deadline.
news_mentions.body_text: the 2026 nfl trade deadline has come and gone nfl com s kevin patra breaks down every trade made since the start of the regular season downs gets his trade looks to bolster chiefs date of trade nov 10 kansas city receives wr josh downs 2027 seventh round draft pick grade b indianapolis receives 2027 fourth round draft pick 2027 fifth round draft pick grade b the chiefs needed wide receiver aid with zero wideouts hitting the 300 yard mark yet this season a 37 year old travis kelce still leads k c pass catchers no offense to the future hall of famer but that shouldn t happen rashee rice is a roller coaster and xavier worthy is inefficient to put it nicely and dealing with a hamstring injury tyquan thornton was their most explosive receiver until he suffered a gruesome dislocation a title contender couldn t continue with their bb style passing offense in comes downs who is better than his numbers 33 receptions for 354 yards touchdown this year suggest he can create separation out of the slot and provide run after catch the switch from daniel jones to patrick mahomes could unlock downs ability even more he should slide right in as a slot weapon for the chiefs and give mahomes a third down target when downs gets hot he s liable to gobble up catches in bunches it s been a frustrating season in indy for the receiver and a fresh start could boost his production heading into free agency it s not a game changing move but downs brings upside to a passing offense that lacks any mid range threat two mid round picks isn t nothing for a potential rental but it s the going rate for no 2 receivers seattle paid the same price for rashid shaheed last year depending on how the rest of the season goes the chiefs could re sign downs in the offseason or he could be a potential comp pick candidate in free agency the colts fire sale ended with the disgruntled receiver who wanted out moving both downs and keenan allen leaves indy with an ultra thin wr room picking up a fourth and fifth rounder for a player who wanted out is a fine haul however this season s roster gutting underscores the danger of trading away first round picks as the colts did last season the colts former 2027 choice is destined to be a top 10 selection with top pick potential eek jets fans have to love these moves falcons ravens swap o linemen date of trade nov 10 baltimore receives olryan neuzil grade c atlanta receives ol andrew vorhees 2028 conditional sixth round draft pick grade c are we just arranging deck chairs on two sinking ships it feels like the falcons knew they weren t going to pay to keep neuzil this offseason and with a ton of cap space to spend we already know they aren t planning on getting any compensatory picks so that sixth rounder coming back feels like their gambit to recoup a draft pick after losing their starting center neuzil was serviceable but in a league that can t seem to find centers he is probably going to find a decent payday on the open market atlanta will now test drive corey levin at center while getting a look at vorhees also a free agent to be for the balance of the season it s tough to see clear logic here from the ravens unless this is simply a play at a comp pick if neuzil finds cash in free agency if this trade is because the cam jurgens trade already looks like it s in trouble then well baltimore has bigger problems i guess when your quarterback situation is as bad as the ravens this season continuing to take swings at upgrading the offensive line isn t terrible broncos nab lb from division rival date of trade nov 10 denver receives lb daiyan henley grade b los angeles receives 2027 fourth round draft pick 2028 fifth round draft pick grade b denver didn t have a glaring need at linebacker but the glut of missed tackles has been a major sore spot for sean payton s squad justin strnad has missed 11 tackles with a run missed tackle rate of 33 3 highest among all lbs minimum 100 run snaps while alex singleton has missed 10 for a 13 9 rate henley enters with just three missed tackles 8 3 the linebacker has struggled some in coverage this season but was stellar earlier in his career in better surroundings henley upgrades the second level coverage and should help improve the tackling it will be interesting to see how vance joseph deploys his trio of linebackers well at least the chargers did something i guess getting a couple of mid round picks back for an off ball linebacker who was set to be a free agent isn t horrific it s not exactly worthy of pomp and circumstance for an 0 8 disaster of a club either i don t care that they traded in division this isn t a qb we re talking about making the broncos slightly better this year doesn t hurt l a much taking away their draft picks could help in the long run in a vacuum this trade is fine with a season on fire it s wild the chargers didn t sell more vikings solve qb problems with deal for cousins date of trade nov 10 minnesota receives qb kirk cousins grade a las vegas receives 2027 third round draft pick grade b the vikings finally got a professional quarterback after two years of living in the seventh circle of hell cousins brings everything the vikings were missing with kyler murray and carson wentz under center this season cousins can throw on time properly reads defense knows how to get the ball to justin jefferson and he doesn t miss throws by 17 feet in short he can run the offense the last time we saw cousins in kevin o connell s attack he was scorching cousins earned a pro bowl spot in 2022 and was on pace for nearly 5 000 yards in 2023 before a midseason achilles change the entire trajectory the injury sent cousins on a nomadic journey to atlanta and then las vegas but he never wanted to leave minnesota in the first place the vikings initially found gold in 2024 with sam darnold replacing cousins but the j j mccarthy gambit blew up in their face and they ve been on a qb carousel since the vikings had to make a qb move after murray and wentz led an anemic offense that has wasted an epic brian flores defense this season and has left jefferson seething on the sideline sitting at 6 2 minnesota was staring at the real possibility of watching the season slip away because they couldn t complete passes consistently enough a 38 year old cousins isn t perfect but he has played well this season and had a rebuilding raiders squad playing watchable ball given his familiarity with minnesota s offense it s a smash move for the new vikings front office it s one they needed to make frankly given how pinned into a corner they were it s a stroke of brilliance that they didn t have to pay more no first or second round pick for a qb who could completely turn around your season and push you to the playoffs yes please his contract situation on a one year deal is palatable as well if for some reason it doesn t work out good on the front office for standing firm on not giving up the farm for an aging qb the main reason the grade isn t higher is that the vikings put themselves in this position in the first place with their dysfunctional decisions including miscalculating the kyler murray situation i initially graded the raiders higher but i m somewhat surprised they couldn t squeeze more out of a desperate vikings team vegas feels like they blinked here i can t blame them too much though as good a story as they were early this season and as watchable as cousins made them they weren t going to be legit competitors in the afc eventually fernando mendoza would take over vegas probably would have preferred that the no 1 overall pick s first game wasn t against the seattle seahawks defense but it s sink or swim time picking up a third rounder to start mendoza s reign a few weeks earlier than planned is solid work holding out and getting nothing only to bench cousins a few weeks later made little sense the raiders played this entire qb situation well from the start this offseason they let their rookie who was learning a very different way of playing the position under klint kubiak sit for the first half of the season and learn under a professional qb the club competed won a few games and showed some promise for the future inevitably they would turn to mendoza the future is now in vegas bills land much needed safety help date of trade nov 10 buffalo he can copy the success he had with the george pickens trade pushing off the long term talks until down the road it s a needle threading but one that could work if porter plays well dallas could extend him in the offseason use the franchise tag on the cb or let him walk and recoup a potential third round compensatory pick in 2028 possibly moving down one round in 28 and giving up a sixth rounder for a potential pro bowl player in a year when you re all in is a stellar move if porter delivers 14 games of high level play it s worth it of course if porter gets hurt or implodes this all goes for naught however if he continues on this track it is a short term win for the cowboys the long term question can be shelved i don t fault the steelers for not wanting to pay porter top cb money if he were seeking a 30 million type deal in line with christian gonzalez or devon witherspoon i would have balked too jpj is good he s not at that level trading him away relieved pittsburgh of that problem the issue i have is that it appears steelers gm omar khan either overplayed his hand or didn t anticipate porter s gumption when it came to a new deal if khan had never planned to meet the corner s contract demands he should have made a move in the spring or early summer a player of porter s caliber is worth more than a second round pick two drafts down the road the timing of the impasse reduced the compensation now the steelers are without a top corner and find themselves thin and young at the position not a good combo if things spiral in pittsburgh it s fair to wonder if khan will even be around to make that second round pick in 2028 the gm took over in 2022 and received early praise for fleecing the bears in the chase claypool trade that brought back a second rounder that pick became porter khan has now moved him for pennies on the dollar add in a string of so so drafts the pickens trade and other questionable moves and the seat in pittsburgh could get hot for khan if the steelers flounder giants trade for mccarthy after dart injury date of trade sept 28 new york receives qb j j mccarthy grade c minnesota receives 2027 fifth round draft pick grade c minnesota signaled its intent to move on from the former no 10 overall pick by inking kyler murray and bringing back carson wentz in the offseason mccarthy got a slim shot at the starting job during training camp but he couldn t even fend off wentz for the primary backup role a former first rounder turned clipboard holder is a bad look all around had another club made an offer of substance before the season i believe the vikings would have moved on then given mccarthy s rough preseason however it s no surprise it took an injury to a starting qb to move the needle a fifth rounder isn t nothing and the vikings save a few pennies however the reality is they turned a first fourth and late round pick swap into 10 starts and a future fifth rounder that math isn t mathing mccarthy s poor play and injury history left the vikings with no good options for a team in win now mode minnesota didn t have time to let the 23 year old develop on his terms moving on makes sense but the vikings can t get a high grade for the compensation new york took a shot that in a new setting and in an offense keyed on the ground attack john harbaugh and his staff can do what kevin o connell couldn t i don t hate the price for a former first round quarterback who even the stingiest draft graders pegged as a day 2 selection teams use fifth rounders and later as qb dart throws all the time the giants lack of 2027 picks is of concern but they can deal with that later with jaxson dart out for the regular season after knee surgery the giants needed to make some sort of move jameis winston has shown he can hold the fort for a spell but it s a serious question if harbaugh will give the boom or bust passer enough leash for a 15 game run bringing in mccarthy at least gives the giants another alternative if winston crumbles at this stage there aren t a whole lot of other options i m not optimistic that mccarthy can turn his career around but for a fifth round pick it s worth a shot for new york

news_mentions.headline: NFL trade deadline winners, losers: Vikings find QB, Jags go all-in, Jonathan Taylor stranded
news_mentions.body_text: the nfl 39 s trade deadline came and went with six deals unfolding tuesday those transactions brought this year 39 s total of in season trades to 18 a slight dip from last year 39 s 22 moves some teams bolstered their immediate outlook and enter the second half of the season with genuine playoff optimism others shifted focus toward the future stockpiling assets to reshape their rosters in the coming offseason a third group however watched opportunities pass them by destined to either suffer from their own inaction or the aggressiveness of their rivals here 39 s a look at some of the biggest winners and losers from the 2026 nfl trade deadline winners jacksonville jaguars jaguars brass approached the deadline determined to acquire defensive playmakers they emerged with massive defensive lineman jordan davis from the philadelphia eagles pro bowl safety jessie bates from the atlanta falcons and defensive tackle davon godchaux from the new orleans saints some questioned the price jacksonville paid for davis a 2027 first round pick and a 2029 second round selection but the jaguars believe they have a special team that additions like davis can elevate into legitimate super bowl contenders minnesota vikings the vikings have a championship caliber defense their offense however has fallen flat with kyler murray delivering subpar results and carson wentz proving disastrous now the vikings welcome back kirk cousins who posted a 50 37 1 record with two playoff appearances and three pro bowl nods during his first stint in minnesota from 2018 to 2023 all pro wide receiver justin jefferson goes from exasperated to optimistic as the signal caller who has thrown him 28 touchdowns returns if cousins can elevate an offense that ranked among the league 39 s worst despite boasting skill position talent minnesota could mount a super bowl charge chicago bears general manager ryan poles and coach ben johnson entered the season with a potent offense and an impactful defense landing defensive tackle jeffery simmons adds a difference maker to that unit and opens the door for all kinds of creativity under coordinator dennis allen philadelphia eagles general manager howie roseman began his wheeling and dealing last month nbsp by nbsp trading nbsp center cam jurgens to the baltimore ravens for a 2027 fifth round pick and a 2028 second round pick this week roseman couldn 39 t pass up the haul he received from the jaguars for davis the eagles now have 10 picks in the 2027 nfl draft highlighted by two first rounders a second a third a fourth three fifths a sixth and a seventh their 2028 haul features two firsts and seconds as well as philadelphia 39 s standard picks in rounds three through seven in 2029 they have eight selections a first rounder two seconds and one selection in each of the remaining rounds baltimore ravens the october acquisition of jurgens from the eagles met a need then last week baltimore filled a gaping hole at quarterback by trading for quarterback jacoby brissett they 39 re hoping the 11 year veteran can keep them afloat in case lamar jackson returns from thumb surgery in time for a late season playoff run kansas city chiefs wide receiver has ranked among the chiefs 39 weaknesses so former indianapolis colt josh downs should help improve that unit the fourth year man has 33 catches for 354 yards and a touchdown this season his best season came in 2024 when he had 72 catches for 803 yards and five touchdowns indianapolis colts owner carlie irsay gordon saw the writing on the wall and began dismantling this year 39 s team after firing general manager chris ballard she then directed the stockpiling of resources for a rebuild between the trades of guard quenton nelson seattle seahawks defensive tackle deforest buckner and wide receiver keenan allen san francisco 49ers and downs chiefs the colts added a third two fourths two fifths and a sixth for players on expiring deals san francisco 49ers the 49ers were already championship contenders but they used the trade window to fortify areas of weakness first they bolstered their defensive front by acquiring buckner from the colts last week they called indianapolis again in recent days orchestrating a deal for allen to join an injury ravaged wide receiver room fernando mendoza the no 1 pick in the 2026 nfl draft waited patiently as cousins led the las vegas raiders 4 5 to a more competitive start than many anticipated but with the vikings in desperate need of competent quarterback play the raiders couldn 39 t pass up a 2027 third round pick for the 38 year old las vegas now turns to mendoza for the second half of the season and beyond in one relief appearance mendoza completed six of eight passes for 48 yards he 39 ll aim to apply all of the lessons gained from watching cousins while attempting to keep the raiders 39 season alive losers nfc north foes despite the vikings 39 ferocious defense putrid quarterback play left the door open for the bears detroit lions and green bay packers to contend for division supremacy now that minnesota has reunited with cousins jefferson wide receiver jordan addison and tight end t j hockenson should go back to delivering game changing performances the run game should improve too the road to the nfc north crown just got more difficult los angeles chargers the winless chargers had a chance to unload veterans with expiring deals instead their only move was trading 26 year old linebacker daiyan henley to the denver broncos for a 2027 fourth round pick and a 2028 fifth round selection khalil mack could have helped a team in the postseason hunt not only did los angeles forfeit the chance to acquire draft capital but the 35 year old pass rusher also lost out on playing for a contender jonathan taylor amid another lost colts season it looked as though the team 39 s workhorse back would join a club with championship aspirations however indianapolis stood pat since none of the suitors were willing to meet its steep asking price though he 39 s been one of the most productive backs since entering the nfl in 2020 taylor has played in one playoff game 2020 over his seven year career kyler murray the former no 1 overall pick hoped a change of scenery and guidance from offensive minded coach kevin o 39 connell would rejuvenate his career murray 39 s starting quarterback tenure lasted just six games with injuries and an inability to adapt to o 39 connell 39 s system leading to poor production now murray will back up cousins who gives minnesota a pro bowl caliber quarterback and hope for a super bowl push washington commanders hope is fading fast for the 2 5 1 commanders and general manager adam peters opted against making any trades part of the problem was that washington had few bargaining chips after season ending injuries to wide receiver terry mclaurin and defensive tackle daron payne this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Bills-Vikings on 'Monday Night Football': What We Learned from Buffalo's 23-6 win over Minnesota
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Bobby Kownack breaks down the Bills' victory over the Vikings on Monday night.
news_mentions.body_text: allen weathers minnesota s blitz for win the league s no 1 scoring offense faced off against the no 1 scoring defense on monday night and for most of the first half the defense won soundly vikings defensive coordinator brian flores did his thing sending blitzers screaming toward josh allen with reckless abandon to great success through buffalo s first six drives which netted the bills 63 yards three points and an interception allen went 4 of 9 for 31 yards an interception and a 13 9 passer rating against the blitz he was pressured on seven of those dropbacks facing a blitz and sacked thrice and at times seemed capable only of chucking it deep in the face of a relentless rush but as time went on the bills began to get to the vikings both through a shorter hitting offense and perhaps mentally as buffalo erased any good minnesota s defense did by dominating its outclassed offense the bills gutted out an eight play 80 yard drive on their seventh possession allen finished it by dancing around for 6 07 seconds per next gen stats before heaving a 25 yard touchdown strike to a wide open keleki latu the tight end s first target of the season and first score of his career in a sense that s exactly how the bills won they waited out and wore out the vikings defense during a grueling night winning the time of possession battle 42 32 to 17 28 james cook jumped from 33 yards on 15 carries at halftime to 107 yards and a score on 31 totes by game s end while allen added 112 yards on his 11 second half throws after managing only 122 over his first 20 the vikings defense didn t do much wrong they just couldn t do everything right all night without a semblance of help on the other side wentz disaster class wastes flores masterclass kyler murray s hamstring injury opened up the possibility that carson wentz might step up in prime time and prove himself a more effective quarterback for minnesota s offense which had struggled to find much traction under the two time pro bowler he did the exact opposite of that ridding vikings fans of any notion that there was a qb on the bench who represented a better option facing the 30th ranked defense against the pass wentz delivered a miserable performance he missed pass catchers short high and wide he threw one interception deep to t j hockenson where only bills linebacker dorian williams could catch it and another one directly to lb terrel bernard while trying to hit justin jefferson he went 3 of 8 on short throws 0 9 yards air yards and 3 of 13 on anything deeper than that finishing 8 of 25 overall for 81 yards and an 8 9 passer rating the lowest by any qb to attempt at least 25 passes in a game since sam darnold s 3 6 passer rating during his 2019 seeing ghosts outing per nfl research despite all that minnesota s tremendous defense kept it to a one possession game until 6 17 remained a two play first quarter sequence perhaps most accurately represents how brutally wentz offset his team s defensive efforts byron murphy made a stellar interception playing center field on a josh allen end zone prayer to kill buffalo s second drive he even returned it to midfield to put wentz and co on the doorstep of field goal range instead on the very next snap wentz carelessly whipped a wide receiver screen to jefferson that went both backward and too high jefferson couldn t corral it and the bills recovered the fumble to get the ball right back that set the tone for a most disappointing day the qb position has been a massive problem for the vikings in 2026 they overcame it in their first six games but an inept offense has now cost them two straight they must fix it either in house or before the trade deadline before it s too late arrow pointing up for buffalo s defense it s been a rare occurrence this season but the bills d won them the game they completely overwhelmed minnesota and while it s fair to point to the vikings ranking 29th in yards entering week 9 it s nevertheless impressive to hold them to their fewest yards of the season even with an offense that had struggled to play its part opposite the league s best defense the vikings hadn t yet failed to eclipse 200 yards in a game they only hit 178 against the bills and that s counting a 52 yard drive led by third stringer max brosmer with the result already decided for all of the talk about minnesota s pass rush buffalo actually had a better pressure percentage against carson wentz 42 3 than the vikings did on josh allen 37 1 and did so despite blitzing on only 11 5 of wentz dropbacks antithetical to the aggressive much hyped vikes defensive approach and with better results as allen and co took time to find holes to exploit the bills defense poked them in minnesota s offensive game plan all night they allowed only nine first downs limited the vikings to five or fewer plays on 10 separate possessions and didn t give up a third down conversion buffalo s defense had allowed 28 5 points per game heading into the week 7 bye the obvious achilles heel for a team with serious super bowl aspirations the bills have now allowed 16 combined points in two games after the bye those outings were against undrafted rookie joe fagnano and wentz but this is where the foundation for a turnaround begins the confidence is building now is the time to put it to use against tougher opponents down the road bills sitting pretty in afc east the good news buffalo just rattled off its fourth straight victory besting its previous season high of a three game winning streak that began the campaign if you re waiting for the bad news there is none the rest of the afc east lost in week 9 the dolphins are now 1 7 and the jets are 2 7 six and 5 5 games back of the bills respectively which feels insurmountable given the quality of the teams and although the patriots 5 4 currently hold the head to head tiebreaker thanks to handing the bills their only loss in week 4 new england is staring at a three game deficit in the loss column with some massive issues to work through the bills still have a tough stretch ahead on the schedule playing the chiefs pats packers bears and broncos in weeks 12 16 but they also have four games remaining against the lowly jets and fins looking beyond the division history also appears to be on their side monday night marked the fifth matchup between teams tied for the nfl s best record in a november game or later over the last 15 seasons the winner of those games went on to play in the super bowl in three of four instances can the bills become the fourth such squad they re 7 1 for the first time since 1993 the last time they reached the game s biggest stage vikings head start on rest of division disappears minnesota entered week 8 as the lone unbeaten team remaining in the league after dropping two straight while the rest of the division went a collective 6 0 kevin o connell s bunch exits week 9 having officially fallen to third place in the nfc north it s only a hypothetical at this point but should the vikings fail to stop the bleeding against the packers at lambeau field this coming sunday they will plummet from the top to the bottom of the division in the span of 14 days that s how brutal the nfc north is it s currently the only division with every team sitting above 500 the sky isn t falling minnesota is a healthy 6 2 but there are problems for as incredible as the vikings defense is their offense is among the worst in the nfl their quarterback room is currently comprised of an injured underperforming kyler murray a turnover prone carson wentz who looked lost versus buffalo and max brosmer considering their next two games come on the road against the packers 6 3 and 49ers 7 1 the vikes must turn it back on soon the cushion they had is officially gone next gen stats insight for bills vikings via nfl pro josh allen was blitzed on 68 6 of his dropbacks the highest blitz rate he has faced in his career he completed 9 of 11 passes for 126 yards and a touchdown against four or fewer pass rushers nfl research the nfc north is a combined 20 4 in non division games the best such record by any division through week 9 of a season in over 40 years two of those four losses have come against the bills

news_mentions.headline: NFC North training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bears, Lions, Packers, Vikings
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top NFC North training camp storylines to monitor for the Chicago Bears, Detroit Lions, Green Bay Packers and Minnesota Vikings.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the chicago bears detroit lions green bay packers and minnesota vikings catch up on each nfc north team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below chicago bears detroit lions green bay packers minnesota vikings three key storylines 1 can caleb find consistency we could discuss the bears offense taking another leap forward in ben johnson s second season we could consider the burgeoning potential of luther burden alongside rome odunze or ponder who will win the primary wr3 duties we could chatter about how much higher tight end colston loveland could fly or how johnson will use his diverse te room none of that really strikes a chord without caleb williams taking his game to new heights the former no 1 pick showed what the highs can look like in year 1 under johnson the explosive jaw dropping plays were plentiful and the qb led a trove of comebacks now he must flatten out some of the lulls the drive stalling misfires and become a more potent every snap quarterback keep the extraordinary peaks and raise the floor and williams will be in the thick of the mvp discussion the madden nfl 27 cover athlete heads into year 3 with heightened expectations if he meets them there is no telling how far the bears can go 2 defensive uncertainty from front to back questions on defense will hover over training camp the bears did precious little to upgrade a wanting front four the club added a few rotational interior defenders but is counting significantly on bounce back campaigns from grady jarrett and gervon dexter montez sweat still doesn t have a proven pass rusher on the opposite side austin booker showed signs down the stretch last year but can he take his game to another level is there enough down the line will shemar turner be healthy following last october s acl tear the questions up front are echoed on the back end where the bears are replacing both starting safeties coby bryant and cam lewis are solid but can they produce as many turnovers as the previous crew the key is first round pick dillon thieneman will the rookie be ready to thrive in dennis allen s scheme by week 1 3 two questions on the offensive line ozzy trapilo s patellar tendon injury in the wild card round means the bears can t count on the left tackle for at least the beginning of the season veteran braxton jones is penciled into the starting lineup but he will have to win the battle with jedrick wills and theo benedet to earn the week 1 assignment the position is one to keep an eye on the rest of the o line profiles as one of the better units in the nfl but if the left side becomes leaky it could be a cascading problem also i m going to keep tabs on the center spot the bears replaced drew dalman who abruptly retired this offseason with garrett bradbury as the presumptive starter however second round rookie logan jones could push the veteran for the starting gig during camp back to top three key storylines 1 offensive line overhaul the lions offensive line collapsed last season swiftly going from asset to liability detroit attacked the unit flipping penei sewell to left tackle drafting blake miller to man the right edge signing center cade mays and adding veteran depth at each spot how the line shakes out will be the main storyline to track during camp is sewell s transition going smoothly is miller a plug and play rookie or does he need time to adjust the key will be young guards christian mahogany and tate ratledge who struggled with consistency in 2025 will the duo improve or could they get pushed out of the starting lineup if the lions don t get better blocking in 2026 the explosive potential will be squandered 2 this is gibbs backfield sonic is now the featured character in detroit the offseason trade of david montgomery calcified the reality that jahmyr gibbs bell cow era is full go gibbs began to take over the majority of the backfield touches last season and his reps should continue to grow the lions likely won t want the dual threat back to creep to the 300 carry threshold but barring injury he ll blast past his career high of 250 totes gibbs should also see his role in the passing game continue to rise after posting a career best 77 catches for 616 yards and five touchdowns in 2025 gibbs combination of shiftiness speed and ability to make hay between and outside the tackles makes him a dynamic threat the lions want to ensure that threat stays on the field as much as possible he profiles for a christian mccaffrey type workload and should be in the offensive player of the year discussion by the end of the season with the expected rise in reps gibbs extension is also one we ve been waiting to see this offseason the lions have gotten in front of extensions in recent years so everyone expects a top of the rb market contract for gibbs to come barreling down the pike 3 can detroit return to health detroit has significant injuries to track at the onset of camp tight end sam laporta is the name to watch on offense but the defense has greater concerns brian branch suffered a late season achilles tear and while the lions haven t put a hard timeline on the safety s recovery it will be a surprise if he s good to go to open the season the bigger question is whether given the type of injury he sustained branch will be his normal buzzing self at all this season then there is kerby joseph whose knee injury limited him to just six games last season the lions have given few tangible updates on the safety s status while taking a wait and see approach without certainty from either starter the lions secondary sits in a precarious spot couple that with the release of cb terrion arnold and detroit could be relying once again on filler and journeymen in the defensive backfield back to top three key storylines 1 who rushes the passer until micah returns after tearing up his knee last december micah parsons is set to start camp on the physically unable to perform list and in all likelihood he ll start the season on pup wiping out his first four games there is always the chance parsons gets back earlier but given how he spoke about his timetable last month i expect him and the club to play it safe sans the dynamic pass rusher for the opening gambit there are significant questions up front in green bay the offseason trade of rashan gary made sense for the club but his absence further highlights a shallow edge group the packers need former first round pick lukas van ness to finally find his footing how he looks early in camp could tell us if green bay needs to add another veteran fourth round rookie dani dennis sutton also could have some say in that plan until parsons returns this might be a mix and match crew van ness is the key to whether the pack can survive the early portion of the calendar 2 jacobs uncertainty looms large josh jacobs situation continues to hover over the franchise after he was arrested in may at this stage it s unclear how local authorities will handle the situation in turn we don t know whether the league will take disciplinary action jacobs was on the field with his team last month and if things remain unchanged he should be there for camp if any action is taken against jacobs it could have a significant impact on the on field product in green bay jacobs is the workhorse and engine of the ground attack if he s unavailable or gets injured during the season matt lafleur s offense could be in some trouble next up are former undrafted free agent chris brooks a third down back and marshawn lloyd who has been unable to stay healthy the packers believe lloyd finally has turned a corner but until we see it in action that s a projection we can t assume we need to see the third year back produce during camp and into the preseason while staying healthy in the process 3 pass catching puzzle solved the pass catching unit in green bay is also something i m intrigued by the packers watched romeo doubs leave in free agency and traded dontayvion wicks then they inked jayden reed and christian watson to extensions those two and 2025 first rounder matthew golden comprise the top receiving trio with a clearer rotation at wr i believe the three can each thrive golden is the one to watch after he finished an uneven rookie campaign with a productive effort four catches for 84 yards and a score in the packers wild card weekend loss at chicago there are some depth questions particularly given the crew s injury history so that battle among reserves will be worth tracking tucker kraft s health is another piece to keep an eye on despite tearing his acl last november the pivotal playmaker is aiming to be ready for week 1 could he return with a new contract as well back to top three key storylines 1 kyler vs j j competition or coronation vikings coach kevin o connell continues to insist he s running a legitimate quarterback competition he keeps having to say it because frankly not many believe that j j mccarthy has a shot to keep kyler murray out of the starting lineup perhaps we ll be stunned but every indicator suggests it s murray s job to lose the former no 1 overall pick enters with proven ability while mccarthy has struggled when on the field and had issues staying healthy murray could open up the offense and his propensity to force feed his top targets could be a harbinger of a justin jefferson bounce back this competition in whatever form that takes will be tracked daily come camp within that context i m interested in how murray fits into koc s system and whether his mobility adds an element we haven t seen much of in minnesota over the past few years 2 next men up on the edge the trade of jonathan greenard took a chunk out of the defense not only because greenard was a proven disruptor but also due to the fact that the vikings now aren t very flush at the position dallas turner whom the club is counting on to have a full breakout in year 3 and andrew van ginkel sit atop the edge rusher corps but bo richter chaz chambliss and tyler batty are the next three players up on the depth chart they ve combined for one career sack chambliss defensive lineman tyrion ingram dawkins has also taken some reps on the edge the vikings could look to add another veteran rusher during camp or early in the season we trust brian flores defense but a coach who generally relies on vets who understand his system will be asking a lot out of youngsters how rookies caleb banks domonique orange jakobe thomas and charles demmings make the transition will have a significant say in the vikings outcome this season 3 one last dance with hitman we expected to have a resolution one way or the other on harrison smith s future surprisingly the situation still lingers will he return for another go or will he officially retire the club has made it clear they d welcome a return and didn t add a veteran to take smith s place jakobe thomas a third round pick was the only significant addition the club made to the safety crew given how much flores relies on the versatility of his safeties a return by smith would have a significant impact if he decides to retire jay ward theo jackson and thomas will battle for reps keep an eye on thomas and charles demmings in camp and preseason each could play key roles in 2026 back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Commanders, Cowboys, Eagles, Giants
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Dallas Cowboys, New York Giants, Philadelphia Eagles and Washington Commanders.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles and washington commanders catch up on each nfc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles washington commanders three key storylines 1 summer bliss with pickens and no drama in oxnard aside from some contract squabbles with george pickens and brandon aubrey that were tame by cowboys standards this has been a drama free offseason for dallas will that change during training camp in oxnard california it s been a breath of fresh air that s even drawn applause from one of the greatest cowboys ever nfl all time leading rusher emmitt smith with dallas locked in on snapping a two year playoff drought the on field focus bodes well avoiding major storylines might well be the biggest development of the summer for the boys july 28 looms large for the team as it s when players are set to report to camp and owner jerry jones traditionally addresses the media in a lengthy news conference the cowboys have been transparent about not negotiating an extension with pickens who has signed his franchise tag and stated he doesn t intend to hold out we ll see just how copacetic everything remains when camp kicks off 2 downs arrives with plenty of hype ohio state safety caleb downs was viewed as a top line talent in this year s draft the cowboys getting him at no 11 overall was a major boon since joining the team downs has garnered rave reviews the highest defensive selection for the franchise since morris claiborne at no 6 in 2012 downs fills a massive db need for dallas and could prove to be a steal how he looks when the pads are on will be must see viewing for the fans at camp and a pivotal point in the cowboys defensive reconstruction downs isn t the cowboys only 2026 first round selection though picked 23rd overall malachi lawrence is a pass rusher who some felt went earlier than he should ve he has plenty of upside though and the cowboys have plenty of pass rushing needs to fill after mustering just 35 sacks in 2025 tied for 22nd in the league 3 a whole new world on defense dallas defense was a sieve in 2025 finishing dead last in points allowed and 30th in total d perhaps it wasn t too surprising considering the cowboys traded away micah parsons just before the season arrived nonetheless the disastrous results led to matt eberflus ousting young whippersnapper christian parker has taken over as defensive coordinator and garnered plenty of positive buzz he ll helm a defense that has undergone a colossal facelift in the offseason in addition to a pair of first rounders added to the mix dallas has signed safeties jalen thompson and p j locke along with cornerback cobie durant whilst trading for pass rusher rashan gary and linebacker dee winters dallas also has a full season ahead with pro bowler quinnen williams after he too was acquired via trade last season 2025 third round corner shavon revel played just seven games as a rookie rallying from an acl tear in college with downs likely to start from the get go lawrence and a host of other defensive draft picks have replenished the depth the turnover on this side of the ball is staggering but a fresh coat was needed after such a trying 2025 how the finished product ultimately looks will begin to take shape at camp for as ballyhooed as the dak prescott led offense has been the cowboys 2021 23 run of playoff appearances came with an offense and a defense ranked in the top seven in scoring back to top three key storylines 1 can giants get healthy stay healthy in camp harbaugh john harbaugh after 18 years with the ravens has arrived in gotham with plenty of fanfare but his team has already dealt with an alarming amount of injury exits rookie cornerback thaddeus dixon wide receiver special teamer gunner olszewski and defensive lineman roy robertson harris each stunningly suffered a torn achilles during organized team activities robertson harris injury is especially problematic considering the team traded away standout defensive tackle dexter lawrence abdul carter sprained his ankle in june while top receivers malik nabers knee and darius slayton core muscle surgery and second year running back cam skattebo ankle are on the mend as well monitoring the availability of nabers and skattebo for week 1 will carry on through the summer even though the latter has deemed himself a sure bet for the opener with harbaugh reputed to run tough practices the giants healing up and emerging unscathed is paramount 2 this is dart s team now at the start of last season jaxson dart waited his turn behind russell wilson after eventually getting handed the starting reins the first round pick weathered a debut campaign that saw him deal with injuries scrutiny for his devil may care scrambling and the firing of head coach brian daboll daboll and interim head coach mike kafka took turns navigating dart s first season now it s up to matt nagy to shepherd dart s growth the floor for dart is staying healthy the ceiling is what the big blue faithful are most excited about dart s development as a franchise signal caller is arguably the most important factor for the 2026 giants hype and hope have early expiration dates in the nfl so dart s second season is already a pivotal one after the qb showed plenty of potential 24 total touchdowns in his career opening campaign 3 big blue youth movement taking shape over the past two drafts the giants have stockpiled four first round picks carter dart lb arvell reese and ol francis mauigoa rookie wr malachi fields and first year cb colton hood a pair of day 2 picks in april figure to be big contributors though there is sterling veteran talent such as lt andrew thomas and olb brian burns the giants are a young squad looking to lay a winning foundation in the first year under harbaugh high draft spots and hype can provide anticipation but seeing the youngsters round into form this summer will be crucial for 2026 and beyond back to top three key storylines 1 hurts newest offensive scheme sean mannion is the latest offensive coordinator for the eagles and jalen hurts who truly found offensive bliss in 2022 his second and final season with shane steichen since then hurts has had a different offensive coordinator in each season even with kellen moore during a super bowl winning 2024 campaign philadelphia s passing game ebbed and flowed while running back saquon barkley largely fueled the offense drama was more prevalent last season than offensive chemistry as the passing game ranked 23rd in yards and the sputtering running attack diminished from the previous season s dominance hurts had a career best 25 touchdown passes but snapped a four season streak of double digit rushing scores finishing with eight last year s offense was far too predictable and stagnated on a seemingly weekly basis held to 20 points or less in 10 games including a dismal 23 19 playoff loss to the 49ers with o line guru jeff stoutland no longer coaching a group that was really the heartbeat of both of the eagles super bowl squads under nick sirianni the offense is undergoing more change than the annual alterations everyone s accustomed to a j brown is gone traded to the patriots in an offseason storyline that lingered for months all eyes are on hurts whose past accomplishments don t seem to hold too much weight with a feisty fanbase that believes its strong roster should be vying for lombardi trophies every year 2 new look wide receivers after four seasons two super bowl appearances and one lombardi trophy a j brown has departed philadelphia while brown s disharmony commanded the headlines he topped 1 000 yards receiving in each of his four years with the team devonta smith is now the unquestioned top target but gm howie roseman restocked the wr room with a trade for dontayvion wicks the signing of veteran speedster marquise brown and in the most exciting move the first round selection of makai lemon don t sleep on second round tight end eli stowers either the john mackey award winner from vanderbilt could line up all over the field as a 6 foot 4 matchup nightmare dallas goedert is back likely for one final season and smith one of the more underrated wideouts around adds to the familiarity overall though there is a freshness to the group that will need to come together in the summer but could liven up an all too often static offense from a season ago 3 what becomes of carter jalen carter seems to be on the brink of becoming perhaps the league s elite defensive tackle hence he s seeking a seismic extension which has led to trade speculation how it all plays out is sure to be headline fodder and it wouldn t feel right to be without some melodrama in philly furthermore defensive coordinator vic fangio is back and losing carter would be a magnificent blow a potential boon will be the additions of cornerback tariq woolen and pass rusher jonathan greenard no matter the pedigree not all players fit into fangio s scheme see bryce huff jalen ramsey jevon holland etc woolen is a physically gifted cover man who made his share of questionable plays with the seahawks it will be interesting seeing how the newbies fit into fangio s scheme but the prevailing matter at hand for the defense is carter s future back to top three key storylines 1 plenty on daniels plate there s a lot to accomplish for jayden daniels this summer following a disastrous 2025 season the commanders sputtered and the 2024 ap offensive rookie of the year missed 10 games due to injuries going just 2 5 in the games he played how daniels looks and feels after sustaining a sprained knee strained hamstring and dislocated left elbow is tops on the agenda he also needs to get acclimated to david blough s offense which will see daniels taking snaps under center far more now that his former assistant qb coach is his offensive coordinator after two seasons with kliff kingsbury in that role daniels is also in the latest season of netflix s quarterback series all eyes and a heap of responsibility will be on daniels how he bounces back and how well he adapts to a new offense could be the story of the commanders season 2 how does overhauled defense look when you fall from being everyone s nfc championship game darling to a 5 12 struggle bus you can run out of fingers to point the commanders put a massive under construction sign in front of a defense that finished dead last in yards allowed they used the no 7 overall pick on ohio state linebacker sonny styles an athletic marvel who will draw plenty of hype as a preseason defensive rookie of the year candidate general manager adam peters opened the check book before turning in the card to get styles too washington broke the bank to sign pass rusher odafe oweh while adding plenty more veteran starters elsewhere nickel amik robertson safety nick cross pass rusher k 39 lavon chaisson linebacker leo chenal and defensive tackle tim settle the commanders added veteran depth as well binging on free agents isn t always a winning formula of course how quickly new defensive coordinator daronte jones and washington s cast of fresh faces get on the same page will be crucial in camp 3 all set at skill spots daniels injuries were a giant issue in 2025 but not surrounding the blossoming franchise qb with enough talent at the skill spots also loomed large looking at the offensive roster on paper it s difficult to feel the commanders have remedied those ills terry mclaurin who dealt with a contract kerfuffle last year as well as ankle quad and pelvic injuries will hopefully be back to his pro bowl self with a full camp and good health however the team s wr corps hasn t added much to get overjoyed about dyami brown and van jefferson were signed in free agency while treylon burks and luke mccaffrey are both back none of those four reached 30 receptions or 400 yards in 2025 rookie third rounder antonio williams figures to jump right into the mix and will likely need to be a big contributor quickly elsewhere jacory croskey merritt should be the lead back after an 805 yard rookie campaign but he was hardly a consistent producer in year 1 the most notable additions are former titans tight end chigoziem okonkwo who should be a breakout candidate after three straight 50 catch seasons with tennessee and ex buccaneers running back rachaad white with blough s promotion to oc familiarity remains but this offensive roster is certainly a candidate for a veteran add or two in the weeks before the regular season commences back to top

news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc north catch up on the minnesota vikings offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 20 rookies july 22 veterans location tco 16 at 1 p m et week 3 at tennessee titans friday aug 22 at 8 p m et cbs 2025 schedule note the vikings will be the first team in nfl history to play a game in multiple international countries in the same season week 4 in ireland and week 5 in england nfl research what you need to know 1 it s all about j j mccarthy in minnesota the second year quarterback will be under the microscope as he takes over an offense that rejuvenated sam darnold s career last season the vikings decided not to buffer mccarthy with a veteran backup after daniel jones opted to sign with indianapolis apologies to the sam howell stans but he s not a threat to mccarthy the former first round pick inherited the porsche of offenses which has made almost every driver look good kevin o connell is a proven qb whisperer so the assumption is that mccarthy should have little trouble keeping things afloat with justin jefferson jordan addison t j hockenson and a remade offensive line the vikes offer weapons to aid the young signal caller minnesota is a 14 win club that on paper improved entering 2025 the loudest question is mccarthy and whether he can keep the engine humming after missing all of 2024 it s not hyperbole to suggest that mccarthy is the pendulum that could swing the course of the entire nfc north 2 the top camp battle in minnesota comes in the secondary heretofore the vikings have yet to add a veteran to the mix who could push for a starting gig next to byron murphy it feels as though the club could be waiting to see how mekhi blackmon bounces back after missing the entire 2024 season due to an acl tear isaiah rodgers blackmon and jeff okudah are in line to battle for the cb2 role elsewhere in the vikings secondary the club didn t replace no 3 safety camryn bynum who left for indianapolis this offseason defensive coordinator brian flores used three safeties liberally last season if he does so again would he trust the likes of theo jackson in that role could a veteran be added closer to the season 3 will the interior offensive line upgrades pay off the internal pressure proved to be sam darnold s undoing last year general manager kwesi adofo mensah set out to fix the issue signing veterans ryan kelly and will fries from indy then he drafted guard donovan jackson in the first round in theory the moves should solidify a leaky interior however kelly and fries are both coming off injury plagued seasons those concerns are coupled with star left tackle christian darrisaw coming off a season ending knee injury the offseason overhaul is excellent from a starter s perspective but there are questions among the second string crew should injuries strike again
