news_mentions.headline: NFL QB rankings, Week 10: Joe Burrow climbs to No. 1; Caleb Williams slides
news_mentions.description: Who joins Joe Burrow as a riser in Nick Shook's QB rankings at midseason? Check out the updated pecking order, 1-32, heading into Week 10.
news_mentions.body_text: notes up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 9 qb index stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl tier 1 it s time we insert joe burrow into the mvp conversation he s an outrageously efficient and daring quarterback who is powering one of the most explosive offenses in the nfl if the bengals mount a deep playoff run he ll be the face of it he might also become the face of the league s quarterbacks the one spot drop is no knock on josh allen whose ability to win in the margins enabled buffalo to leave minneapolis with a major victory on monday night allen did the special things he usually does to help the bills survive the brian flores defense and should be proud of the performance even if it wasn t his most statistically impressive game of the season no quarterback in the nfl is currently more in sync with his receivers than jordan love it makes sense green bay has asked him to carry the offense all season long that s bad for opponents because the additional reps have helped love settle into a rhythm that makes for appointment viewing each week christian watson s career best pace isn t happening by accident the texans were able to enjoy a spectacular c j stroud performance in week 9 he s produced plenty of them this season and could find himself in the mvp conversation if houston can turn around its season brock purdy has thrown three interceptions in his last two games but his positive contributions vastly outweigh the negative he s becoming an entertaining quarterback when operating out of structure like when he scrambled for a touchdown largely because the raiders apparently decided they d rather prevent a pass than tackle him purdy happily took that gift and will have yet another new receiver trade acquisition keenan allen to learn this week trevor lawrence started last thursday night on a heater throwing a beautiful seam ball to parker washington for a touchdown lawrence didn t need to do much else for the jaguars to cruise to victory he s in command of the offense and should be expected to remain in this tier for the foreseeable future as part of one of the nfl s best squads next gen stats insights via nfl pro c j stroud completed 10 of 16 passes between 10 and 19 yards downfield for 254 yards five touchdowns and an interception in week 9 against the chargers it s the only game in which a quarterback has thrown five touchdowns targeting the intermediate level since at least 2016 and the third most yards recorded by a quarterback on such throws in that span tier 2 detroit s win in miami was ugly and made for an unexpectedly difficult outing for jared goff who had a hard time finding open windows against miami s scrappy defense he threw an interception on a play in which his arm was hit as he released the ball narrowly missed being responsible for an earlier turnover and threw for just 170 yards in the low scoring triumph i m not ready to say he s developing a turnover issue he had not thrown a pick prior to week 8 but as head coach dan campbell intimated at halftime on sunday the lions need to get going offensively what happens when you throw four interceptions in a prime time game you fall a tier in the qb index that s what caleb williams did on sunday night struggling against tampa bay s relentless blitzes it s not all on him chicago s running game has largely disappeared of late but after looking superhuman at times in 2026 williams was very mortal on sunday patrick mahomes on the other hand might actually be superhuman a gruesome hit to his throwing arm sent every chiefs fan into panic mode but somehow mahomes shook it off and calmly led the chiefs to a runaway win by completing 23 of 31 passes for 242 yards and two touchdowns against the jets he s also welcoming slot receiver josh downs via trade this week i m eager to see how downs improves kansas city s passing attack the cowboys escaped indianapolis with a win in a weird game that saw dak prescott do what he does best air it out his 335 yard two touchdown performance was crucial to dallas winning efforts they ll need that and more against san francisco this week matthew stafford isn t playing anywhere near the caliber of his mvp 2025 season and still makes a head scratching throw or two per game he s just not as sharp as he s been in the past but he s also a primary reason the rams have stacked a few wins i worry about how he ll fare without the injured puka nacua going forward though next gen stats insights via nfl pro dak prescott completed 8 of 11 passes against man coverage for a season high 181 yards and two touchdowns in week 9 against the colts prescott connected with ceedee lamb on four passes for 95 yards and a touchdown against man coverage the fourth most yards the duo has recorded against man in a single game prescott completed 13 of 23 passes for 154 yards against zone coverage in the game tier 3 drake maye has a turnover problem again spending sunday throwing a couple of meatball subs to packers defenders and burying his team he s trusting his arm too much at times and looks uncomfortable in other instances but he s also playing without a couple of top pass catching options it s been an up and down year for maye no doubt bryce young the most volatile member of the qb index in 2026 is back on the rise after entering a flow state that powered a panthers comeback against the broncos he nearly positioned carolina to take an eight point second half lead before fate had different ideas young threw a wacky interception that was more a result of the defensive play made and the spheroid that is a football than a mistake by young the turnover stopped the panthers momentum in its tracks though young did his best to throw them back into the game in the fourth quarter but fumbled away their last chance ending a roller coaster of a day that fits his season kirk cousins swan song with the raiders wasn t quite as bad as the final stat line suggested yes he threw three interceptions and yes he appeared to lack the arm strength to complete a couple of highly ambitious attempts but he also played well enough to help the raiders momentarily climb back into a chaotic affair versus the niners now that he s a viking he s moving back to minneapolis with expectations of becoming a hero for the dreadful minnesota offense raiders fans will remember him as the capable veteran who guided the offense admirably in the first nine weeks under head coach klint kubiak geno smith helped the jets battle with the chiefs for a half on sunday before succumbing to steve spagnuolo s defense which feels appropriate given how gang green s season is going can cam ward build on his excellent week 8 showing following tennessee s bye will aaron rodgers be needed to power the steelers offense beyond a few key completions each week the second half should answer both of these questions for us next gen stats insights via nfl pro bryce young completed 28 of 39 passes for 276 yards with three touchdowns and an interception in week 9 against the broncos young went 13 of 14 for 152 yards and a touchdown on throws targeting in breaking routes young has thrown for 1 127 yards on in breaking routes this season the most among all quarterbacks tier 4 the buccaneers finally needed baker mayfield to throw the ball on sunday night a responsibility he embraced by launching a beautiful strike to tez johnson as part of tampa bay s comeback efforts unfortunately mayfield also threw two interceptions illustrating how his return from injury hasn t exactly been the smoothest experience tyler shough represented one half of a low output afternoon in the superdome on sunday until desperation set in against cleveland shough rediscovered his clutch gene at the perfect time and dropped a collection of dimes on the likes of chris olave and juwan johnson in the saints overtime win i ll be tracking him closely to see how he continues to develop a rapport with rookie jordyn tyson jayden daniels still makes plays that remind us of why he became an instant star as a rookie but he s also struggling with game management he doesn t seem to understand that he can t afford to throw the ball in the middle of the field with mere seconds remaining in a comeback effort and his offensive line didn t make matters any easier for him against a rams front that finally enjoyed the combined efforts of myles garrett three sacks and aaron donald bo nix is crawling yes crawling back toward where he was last season on sunday he included a few rollouts and throws across his body he fired a dart to courtland sutton for a first quarter score and calmly led two fourth quarter touchdown drives in the broncos road win over the panthers i want to believe it s a sign of better things to come but it sure feels like i ve been asked to watch grass grow michael penix s good doesn t outweigh his bad results right now an unfortunate reality for a quarterback whose successes have led me to believe he could grow into a star next gen stats insights via nfl pro tyler shough completed all three of his downfield attempts in the first half for 99 yards against the browns he doubled his downfield attempts to six in the second half and added two more in overtime completing two of those eight for 48 yards and a touchdown to clinch the win shough also recorded 51 rushing yards on 10 rushes including five scrambles for a career high 41 yards tier 5 drew lock s second start of the season ended in another win but he s dealing with elbow and oblique injuries leaving the seahawks qb situation in a somewhat tenuous state even though he s expected to play in week 10 it s not the best sign when j j mccarthy s exit and jameis winston s insertion into the game provides the giants with the spark they need to win i d like to chalk it up to the matchup with the eagles but i ll withhold harsher judgment on mccarthy for now nobody remembers the beginning when the ending is gripping but i refuse to allow a desperate final few minutes to occlude the fact that shedeur sanders was ineffective through the first three quarters of his start on sunday it was bad enough to wonder if backup dillon gabriel might be the better option until cleveland had no choice but to ask sanders to chuck it deep i ll credit sanders for hitting a few key passes in the final few minutes and overtime but those who believe that performance should inspire a quarterback controversy are simply clickbaiting gardner minshew s magic ran out in seattle on sunday he couldn t get anything going nor could the cardinals finish off a must have goal to go situation in the fourth quarter minshew might be out for the season with the elbow injury he suffered in the game setting up rookie carson beck s first start daniel jones made enough plays to help the colts climb back into sunday s contest against the cowboys he also ended indianapolis chances with yet another turnover next gen stats insights via nfl pro shedeur sanders completed three of his six downfield attempts for 154 yards and a touchdown against the saints with all six attempts occurring in the second half and overtime sanders fourth quarter deep pass to jerry jeudy set up a field goal attempt that sent the game to overtime sanders added 55 5 win probability on downfield attempts a career high mark tier 6 justin herbert ended his streak after going two games without a touchdown pass but he threw yet another interception against the texans malik willis best throw was wiped out on sunday by a holding penalty on rookie tight end will kacmarek it was a rough day for the quarterback who threw an interception and suffered a core muscle injury that landed him on injured reserve joe milton scrambled more often than i expected against the giants but largely looked like the inexperienced quarterback i expected to see joe fagnano s first start commanded attention on thursday night but he was no match for the jaguars defense baltimore s quick trade for jacoby brissett said everything we needed to know about the undrafted rookie like baltimore s move for brissett minnesota s trade for kirk cousins was entirely expected because of how poorly carson wentz played on monday night at one point in the second half he couldn t even complete simple passes on slants and out routes hopefully cousins can save this unit because wentz certainly wasn t up to the challenge next gen stats insights via nfl pro justin herbert completed 2 of 11 downfield passes 10 air yards for 66 yards and an interception in week 9 against the texans the fewest yards he has recorded on such throws in a game this season his 18 2 completion percentage on downfield passes is the second lowest of his career and he has now thrown an interception on a downfield pass in every game this season

news_mentions.headline: Mike Tomlin: 'I haven't given one iota of thought' about return to coaching
news_mentions.body_text: former pittsburgh steelers coach mike tomlin is only halfway through his first season as an analyst for nbc 39 s 34 sunday night football 34 but already speculation has swirled about his future asked during a conference call on wednesday if he 39 d entertain opportunities to return to the nfl as a coach tomlin said he hasn 39 t yet considered the possibility 34 i haven 39 t given one iota of thought about coaching 34 tomlin said 34 i 39 m sure that some of that is going to come up in the not too distant future but i 39 ll cross that bridge when i come to it i 39 m really excited about my new role and working to get better each and every week 34 tomlin spent 19 seasons as the head coach of the steelers after stepping down he joined 34 football night in america 34 as an analyst 34 i 39 ve been enjoying the challenge of the new work 34 tomlin said 34 i 39 ve got a great team i 39 m having a lot of fun with my coworkers it 39 s awesome to be as close to the game as i am and observe the game from a global perspective i think when you 39 re coaching you block out a lot of the peripheral things during the course of a season it 39 s been fun absorbing it from a football lover 39 s perspective 34 i 39 m thoroughly enjoying it but it 39 s also fun to be challenged i 39 m something of a novice obviously i 39 m hyper focused on getting better each and every week in terms of delivering information and delivering it in an informational and entertaining way 34 on sunday tomlin will be part of a broadcast featuring his former team for the first time when the steelers visit the cincinnati bengals tomlin has stayed in contact with many of his players particularly longtime veterans like cameron heyward and t j watt 34 i look forward to it because of the relationships 34 tomlin said 34 but i 39 m capable of compartmentalizing and getting hyper focused on the job but it certainly will be fun to see some guys i 39 ve got good relationships with and there will certainly be a lot of that but they have a job to do i have a job to do i 39 m sure everyone is going to be focused on the task at hand 34 this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Bengals' Zac Taylor uncomfortable discussing nixed Arnold Ebiketie trade: 'It was on our end'
news_mentions.description: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor served as a proxy for director of player personnel Duke Tobin on Wednesday as he did his best to explain what went wrong in a trade with the Eagles on Tuesday falling through.
news_mentions.body_text: tuesday s trade deadline included a flurry of deals and one that fell apart the latter occurred between the cincinnati bengals and philadelphia eagles who reportedly had agreed to a trade that would send edge rusher arnold ebiketie to the bengals in exchange for a 2027 sixth round pick the proposed deal later fell through due to the team s compensatory picks formula the bengals would have lost a third round comp draft pick granted after trey hendrickson left in free agency for baltimore during this past offseason if the trade had been completed how the bengals arrived at this realization likely won t be revealed for some time but with wednesday s media availability came the guarantee somebody would be asked about the called off trade that somebody was head coach zac taylor who was also speaking on behalf of director of player personnel duke tobin duke was very explicit with me when he came and spoke to me about how he wanted this portrayed taylor began via espn i m not comfortable doing it but i m going to do what he asked we did make an effort to put some depth in there in place of the injured cashius howell as we got into it obviously it was going to be a little more costly than we initially anticipated he s really apologetic about it and wants to make clear that philly was a great trade partner it was on our end cincinnati s decision to back out of the trade prevented it from giving up sixth and third round picks for ebiketie who was a compensatory free agent signed by the eagles this offseason it also inspired plenty of speculation as to how such a deal reached that stage before draft capital catastrophe occurred i didn t even ask the question taylor said it doesn t really matter to me it probably took three minutes of my day yesterday away from watching tape got a lot of faith in how the front office operates and we ll just move forward with it this isn t the first time a proposed trade has fallen through for unusual reasons at the 2017 trade deadline an agreed upon deal between the browns and bengals to send quarterback a j mccarron to cleveland fell through because cleveland didn t file its paperwork before the 4 p m et deadline this one merely prevented the bengals from adding some depth while howell deals with a wrist injury in the grand scheme it likely won t matter much but when tobin has his next news conference it s safe to expect he ll be asked about it with tuesday s nixed trade off the table the bengals stood pat at the deadline choosing to proceed with their roster as currently constructed as the deadline drifted into the past taylor had one message left to deliver full steam and full confidence ahead certainly have a ton of confidence in our front office and how they do things taylor said they ve given us the players that have allowed us to be 6 2 right now and playing at such a high level we ll put that behind us and move forward and just get excited for this game on sunday and our locker room is in a great place right now

news_mentions.headline: Vikings won't commit to Kirk Cousins starting vs. Packers, but QB eager to play for Minnesota again
news_mentions.description: Minnesota coach Kevin O'Connell didn't commit to newly acquired Kirk Cousins starting on Sunday in Green Bay. But we all know it's the goal, if not the plan.
news_mentions.body_text: kirk cousins is back in minnesota and already making a difference for one the packers have adjusted their planning for sunday s meeting at lambeau field with the full expectation cousins will start for the vikings five days after being traded north from las vegas he ll be starting packers coach matt lafleur told reporters wednesday i m fairly confident of that while the turnaround is quick lafleur is justified in expecting cousins to start the quarterback is uniquely familiar with kevin o connell s vikings offense from their time spent together from 2022 23 including a 13 4 finish in 2022 cousins has also demonstrated he still has the capabilities required of an effective starting quarterback and he s walking into a situation so dire that the 6 2 vikings essentially have to play him on a short week against a divisional rival in a hotly contested nfc north unsurprisingly o connell didn t commit to cousins starting on sunday in green bay but we all know it s the goal if not the plan it s still too early to commit wholeheartedly to what the plan on sunday looks like o connell said wednesday but i will say we re excited about the opportunity of spending every moment we can between now and then to get him comfortable and allow him to play for us this sunday that s what we re working towards but also want to be fair to kirk and make sure he feels good about it going to lambeau field the setting of lambeau field has its own meaning to cousins and it isn t necessarily the good kind lambeau is where cousins played his final snap as a viking in 2023 and where he suffered a season ending achilles injury which also limited his effectiveness in his next stop atlanta in 2024 sending him down a winding road that included backup duties with the falcons in 2025 before joining the raiders as a bridge starter in 2026 knowing where that s where i was carted off i had thoughts of is this my last game is this my last game as a viking cousins said wednesday in his return to minnesota going back there wearing purple and gold it has meaning but you have to make it have meaning with the way you play cousins is back in minneapolis where he said wednesday his kids were eager to move with him in what amounts to somewhat of a homecoming it s also where vikings fans are hoping he can play savior to a season that carries great promise but also a clear anchor in the form of an anemic offense most recently led by carson wentz that elicited boos from the home crowd in monday night s loss to buffalo it s great to have him back in the building o connell said you feel his energy right away cousins arrives with plenty of experience a deep understanding of the offense in which he ll be operating and a familiarity with minnesota s top weapon receiver justin jefferson who has had plenty of reason to feel frustrated with how this season is going for the vikings when possessing the ball monday night stands as a perfect example jefferson was targeted 11 times and caught just three of those passes for 58 yards a total that accounted for nearly 1 3 of minnesota s offensive production on the night when jefferson and cousins last played a full season together the receiver posted the best season of his career 128 catches 1 809 yards and eight receiving touchdowns he finished with a first team all pro selection nfl offensive player of the year honors and even attracted some votes for nfl mvp it s fair to expect jefferson to be both ecstatic about cousins return and to expect plenty of targets going forward for me with justin it s play to play cousins said of jefferson play in play out you re going where reads take you you don t go chasing things but you also understand the player that he is you go where the reads take you and he tends to make you right when throwing the ball in his direction in the short term the vikings have acquired a theoretical solution to their season long problem after following his former vikings offensive coordinator klint kubiak to las vegas cousins has found another familiar home in o connell and minnesota and the hope is the combination will revive this offense and turn the vikings a team with a super bowl caliber defense into the title contender they believe they can be similar to klint kevin knows me cousins said kevin knows what i do well kevin knows what i don t do well kevin knows what i can handle kevin knows what i can t handle i think that helps not just that he knows your strengths but that he knows your weaknesses and as a result he s gonna try to protect you i think the fact that he knows me well the good about me and the bad about me i think should help us whether o connell is willing to confirm it as of wednesday the vikings will proceed forward with cousins as qb1 kyler murray their previous chosen solution for their quarterback conundrum is expected to be cousins backup whenever he s healthy enough to suit up and just maybe the great ill of the 2026 season a legendary defense being wasted by an inferior offense might finally be remedied

news_mentions.headline: NFL trade grades: Evaluating every deal made ahead of the 2026 deadline
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Kevin Patra grades every trade made since the start of the 2026 regular season until Tuesday's trade deadline.
news_mentions.body_text: the 2026 nfl trade deadline has come and gone nfl com s kevin patra breaks down every trade made since the start of the regular season downs gets his trade looks to bolster chiefs date of trade nov 10 kansas city receives wr josh downs 2027 seventh round draft pick grade b indianapolis receives 2027 fourth round draft pick 2027 fifth round draft pick grade b the chiefs needed wide receiver aid with zero wideouts hitting the 300 yard mark yet this season a 37 year old travis kelce still leads k c pass catchers no offense to the future hall of famer but that shouldn t happen rashee rice is a roller coaster and xavier worthy is inefficient to put it nicely and dealing with a hamstring injury tyquan thornton was their most explosive receiver until he suffered a gruesome dislocation a title contender couldn t continue with their bb style passing offense in comes downs who is better than his numbers 33 receptions for 354 yards touchdown this year suggest he can create separation out of the slot and provide run after catch the switch from daniel jones to patrick mahomes could unlock downs ability even more he should slide right in as a slot weapon for the chiefs and give mahomes a third down target when downs gets hot he s liable to gobble up catches in bunches it s been a frustrating season in indy for the receiver and a fresh start could boost his production heading into free agency it s not a game changing move but downs brings upside to a passing offense that lacks any mid range threat two mid round picks isn t nothing for a potential rental but it s the going rate for no 2 receivers seattle paid the same price for rashid shaheed last year depending on how the rest of the season goes the chiefs could re sign downs in the offseason or he could be a potential comp pick candidate in free agency the colts fire sale ended with the disgruntled receiver who wanted out moving both downs and keenan allen leaves indy with an ultra thin wr room picking up a fourth and fifth rounder for a player who wanted out is a fine haul however this season s roster gutting underscores the danger of trading away first round picks as the colts did last season the colts former 2027 choice is destined to be a top 10 selection with top pick potential eek jets fans have to love these moves falcons ravens swap o linemen date of trade nov 10 baltimore the no 4 overall pick on harrison in 2024 monti ossenfort still gets docked for whiffing on a prime selection i understand why the texans would take a swing on harrison like most of the league they probably gave the ohio state product a very high pre draft grade reuniting him with former buckeyes teammate c j stroud could bring out the best in the wideout the texans have struggled mightily to move the ball when nico collins has been injured and given collins history and the hard hits he takes he s not guaranteed to make it through the rest of the season without missing time after laying an egg for four weeks the 1 4 texans don t have any more wiggle room harrison s contract isn t onerous giving houston some insurance if tank dell never returns to form or jayden higgins is delayed next year coming off a season ending injury in the short term this trade is somewhat duplicative of the much cheaper deal in which it acquired kayshon boutte it s more costly but gives the club more control of the future mostly i don t love the price tag for a player who hasn t been who we thought he was for it to make sense to give up a day 2 pick the texans need harrison to finally break out after two mediocre seasons perhaps in improved surroundings and on a team that clearly wants him with a qb he knows and trusts harrison can blossom frankly i probably like many scouts can t figure out the disconnect between a player who looked as polished and well rounded as harrison did at osu and the one we ve seen lope about for two plus years the question is whether you believe the scouting or the two separate coaching staffs who haven t found much use for him the texans are betting on their scouting eagles send pro bowl ol to ravens date of trade oct 7 baltimore receives c cam jurgens 2027 seventh round draft pick grade b philadelphia receives 2027 fifth round draft pick 2028 second round draft pick grade a we should start with the obvious the two time pro bowler was available for a reason especially after the same offensive line saw a future hall of famer lane johnson retire the day prior jurgens is currently a pro bowler in name only after battling through a back injury in 2024 to help the eagles net a super bowl ring jurgens has not been the same player he struggled through last season and has been a liability through four games this year his pass blocking has never been otherworldly but it s particularly crumbled after he was asked to move to left guard the past three weeks blame the previous injuries or the ill fit in the eagles new blocking scheme but jurgens has been borderline unplayable the past few weeks drew kendall played better than jurgens at center in sean mannion s scheme so a move back wasn t in the cards it got so bad that nick sirianni was fending off questions about potentially benching the guard instead philly shipped him out of town we know that howie roseman doesn t care what year he gets his picks famously saying a first round pick is a first round pick regarding the a j brown trade this offseason when philly netted a 28 first however we can dock him ever so slightly for delayed satisfaction otherwise getting a second rounder for a struggling player who was not a fit is a home run in the short term the eagles offensive line is in flux with willie lampkin in line to take over at guard the hope is that landon dickerson returns to form when he eventually comes off injured reserve the trade is jarring coming right after johnson s retirement but getting a significant draft pick back for a player who was on the verge of being benched makes sense philly is now loaded in the 2028 draft with two firsts and two seconds even acknowledging jurgens significant struggles the play makes sense for the ravens the plans to replace tyler linderbaum who signed with the raiders in free agency this summer were wobbly from the start the ones they rode with danny pinter jovaughn gwyn and ethan pocic have all landed on injured reserve counting on pocic coming off injury was always a gamble the ravens crapped out instead of sticking with rookie olaivavega ioane out of position at center baltimore will take a roll of the dice that jurgens can get back to form it s not a terrible gamble and it s conceivable the 27 year old can bounce back with a return to center in a different scheme jurgens contract which has him under team control through 2029 for relatively cheap is also desirable for baltimore injury is always part of the equation and jurgens enters his time in baltimore in the league s concussion protocol nfl network s mike garafolo reported if he s healthy and returns to form this will be an excellent move for baltimore if he continues to struggle or misses a ton of time it will be the latest swing and miss in trying to replace linderbaum porter drama ends in trade to dallas date of trade oct 1 dallas receives cb joey porter grade a pittsburgh receives 2027 sixth round draft pick 2028 second round draft pick grade c the cowboys desperately needed corner help for a defense that has floundered despite the offseason upgrades i ll credit jerry jones for not sitting on his hands instead doing what we have been asking general managers to do for years be bold make moves and don t overvalue your own picks during a season we won t know if the trade pays off in the long term but the cowboys certainly improved in 2026 at his peak porter is a physical cover man who can be sticky on the outside and mirror top receivers he ll slide well into christian parker s scheme allowing dallas to play man coverage on the outside with more physicality than in the first three weeks sure he racks up some penalties but so do most cbs you ll live with the trade off for a corner with jpj s skill set that dallas didn t have to give up a premier pick until 2028 also improved its grade assuming that porter plays the cowboys get a top shelf cb for a relatively cheap up front cost jones seems to be hoping he can copy the success he had with the george pickens trade pushing off the long term talks until down the road it s a needle threading but one that could work if porter plays well dallas could extend him in the offseason use the franchise tag on the cb or let him walk and recoup a potential third round compensatory pick in 2028 possibly moving down one round in 28 and giving up a sixth rounder for a potential pro bowl player in a year when you re all in is a stellar move if porter delivers 14 games of high level play it s worth it of course if porter gets hurt or implodes this all goes for naught however if he continues on this track it is a short term win for the cowboys the long term question can be shelved i don t fault the steelers for not wanting to pay porter top cb money if he were seeking a 30 million type deal in line with christian gonzalez or devon witherspoon i would have balked too jpj is good he s not at that level trading him away relieved pittsburgh of that problem the issue i have is that it appears steelers gm omar khan either overplayed his hand or didn t anticipate porter s gumption when it came to a new deal if khan had never planned to meet the corner s contract demands he should have made a move in the spring or early summer a player of porter s caliber is worth more than a second round pick two drafts down the road the timing of the impasse reduced the compensation now the steelers are without a top corner and find themselves thin and young at the position not a good combo if things spiral in pittsburgh it s fair to wonder if khan will even be around to make that second round pick in 2028 the gm took over in 2022 and received early praise for fleecing the bears in the chase claypool trade that brought back a second rounder that pick became porter khan has now moved him for pennies on the dollar add in a string of so so drafts the pickens trade and other questionable moves and the seat in pittsburgh could get hot for khan if the steelers flounder giants trade for mccarthy after dart injury date of trade sept 28 new york receives qb j j mccarthy grade c minnesota receives 2027 fifth round draft pick grade c minnesota signaled its intent to move on from the former no 10 overall pick by inking kyler murray and bringing back carson wentz in the offseason mccarthy got a slim shot at the starting job during training camp but he couldn t even fend off wentz for the primary backup role a former first rounder turned clipboard holder is a bad look all around had another club made an offer of substance before the season i believe the vikings would have moved on then given mccarthy s rough preseason however it s no surprise it took an injury to a starting qb to move the needle a fifth rounder isn t nothing and the vikings save a few pennies however the reality is they turned a first fourth and late round pick swap into 10 starts and a future fifth rounder that math isn t mathing mccarthy s poor play and injury history left the vikings with no good options for a team in win now mode minnesota didn t have time to let the 23 year old develop on his terms moving on makes sense but the vikings can t get a high grade for the compensation new york took a shot that in a new setting and in an offense keyed on the ground attack john harbaugh and his staff can do what kevin o connell couldn t i don t hate the price for a former first round quarterback who even the stingiest draft graders pegged as a day 2 selection teams use fifth rounders and later as qb dart throws all the time the giants lack of 2027 picks is of concern but they can deal with that later with jaxson dart out for the regular season after knee surgery the giants needed to make some sort of move jameis winston has shown he can hold the fort for a spell but it s a serious question if harbaugh will give the boom or bust passer enough leash for a 15 game run bringing in mccarthy at least gives the giants another alternative if winston crumbles at this stage there aren t a whole lot of other options i m not optimistic that mccarthy can turn his career around but for a fifth round pick it s worth a shot for new york

news_mentions.headline: NFL trade deadline winners, losers: Vikings find QB, Jags go all-in, Jonathan Taylor stranded
news_mentions.body_text: the nfl 39 s trade deadline came and went with six deals unfolding tuesday those transactions brought this year 39 s total of in season trades to 18 a slight dip from last year 39 s 22 moves some teams bolstered their immediate outlook and enter the second half of the season with genuine playoff optimism others shifted focus toward the future stockpiling assets to reshape their rosters in the coming offseason a third group however watched opportunities pass them by destined to either suffer from their own inaction or the aggressiveness of their rivals here 39 s a look at some of the biggest winners and losers from the 2026 nfl trade deadline winners jacksonville jaguars jaguars brass approached the deadline determined to acquire defensive playmakers they emerged with massive defensive lineman jordan davis from the philadelphia eagles pro bowl safety jessie bates from the atlanta falcons and defensive tackle davon godchaux from the new orleans saints some questioned the price jacksonville paid for davis a 2027 first round pick and a 2029 second round selection but the jaguars believe they have a special team that additions like davis can elevate into legitimate super bowl contenders minnesota vikings the vikings have a championship caliber defense their offense however has fallen flat with kyler murray delivering subpar results and carson wentz proving disastrous now the vikings welcome back kirk cousins who posted a 50 37 1 record with two playoff appearances and three pro bowl nods during his first stint in minnesota from 2018 to 2023 all pro wide receiver justin jefferson goes from exasperated to optimistic as the signal caller who has thrown him 28 touchdowns returns if cousins can elevate an offense that ranked among the league 39 s worst despite boasting skill position talent minnesota could mount a super bowl charge chicago bears general manager ryan poles and coach ben johnson entered the season with a potent offense and an impactful defense landing defensive tackle jeffery simmons adds a difference maker to that unit and opens the door for all kinds of creativity under coordinator dennis allen philadelphia eagles general manager howie roseman began his wheeling and dealing last month nbsp by nbsp trading nbsp center cam jurgens to the baltimore ravens for a 2027 fifth round pick and a 2028 second round pick this week roseman couldn 39 t pass up the haul he received from the jaguars for davis the eagles now have 10 picks in the 2027 nfl draft highlighted by two first rounders a second a third a fourth three fifths a sixth and a seventh their 2028 haul features two firsts and seconds as well as philadelphia 39 s standard picks in rounds three through seven in 2029 they have eight selections a first rounder two seconds and one selection in each of the remaining rounds baltimore ravens the october acquisition of jurgens from the eagles met a need then last week baltimore filled a gaping hole at quarterback by trading for quarterback jacoby brissett they 39 re hoping the 11 year veteran can keep them afloat in case lamar jackson returns from thumb surgery in time for a late season playoff run kansas city chiefs wide receiver has ranked among the chiefs 39 weaknesses so former indianapolis colt josh downs should help improve that unit the fourth year man has 33 catches for 354 yards and a touchdown this season his best season came in 2024 when he had 72 catches for 803 yards and five touchdowns indianapolis colts owner carlie irsay gordon saw the writing on the wall and began dismantling this year 39 s team after firing general manager chris ballard she then directed the stockpiling of resources for a rebuild between the trades of guard quenton nelson seattle seahawks defensive tackle deforest buckner and wide receiver keenan allen san francisco 49ers and downs chiefs the colts added a third two fourths two fifths and a sixth for players on expiring deals san francisco 49ers the 49ers were already championship contenders but they used the trade window to fortify areas of weakness first they bolstered their defensive front by acquiring buckner from the colts last week they called indianapolis again in recent days orchestrating a deal for allen to join an injury ravaged wide receiver room fernando mendoza the no 1 pick in the 2026 nfl draft waited patiently as cousins led the las vegas raiders 4 5 to a more competitive start than many anticipated but with the vikings in desperate need of competent quarterback play the raiders couldn 39 t pass up a 2027 third round pick for the 38 year old las vegas now turns to mendoza for the second half of the season and beyond in one relief appearance mendoza completed six of eight passes for 48 yards he 39 ll aim to apply all of the lessons gained from watching cousins while attempting to keep the raiders 39 season alive losers nfc north foes despite the vikings 39 ferocious defense putrid quarterback play left the door open for the bears detroit lions and green bay packers to contend for division supremacy now that minnesota has reunited with cousins jefferson wide receiver jordan addison and tight end t j hockenson should go back to delivering game changing performances the run game should improve too the road to the nfc north crown just got more difficult los angeles chargers the winless chargers had a chance to unload veterans with expiring deals instead their only move was trading 26 year old linebacker daiyan henley to the denver broncos for a 2027 fourth round pick and a 2028 fifth round selection khalil mack could have helped a team in the postseason hunt not only did los angeles forfeit the chance to acquire draft capital but the 35 year old pass rusher also lost out on playing for a contender jonathan taylor amid another lost colts season it looked as though the team 39 s workhorse back would join a club with championship aspirations however indianapolis stood pat since none of the suitors were willing to meet its steep asking price though he 39 s been one of the most productive backs since entering the nfl in 2020 taylor has played in one playoff game 2020 over his seven year career kyler murray the former no 1 overall pick hoped a change of scenery and guidance from offensive minded coach kevin o 39 connell would rejuvenate his career murray 39 s starting quarterback tenure lasted just six games with injuries and an inability to adapt to o 39 connell 39 s system leading to poor production now murray will back up cousins who gives minnesota a pro bowl caliber quarterback and hope for a super bowl push washington commanders hope is fading fast for the 2 5 1 commanders and general manager adam peters opted against making any trades part of the problem was that washington had few bargaining chips after season ending injuries to wide receiver terry mclaurin and defensive tackle daron payne this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Week 10 NFL MVP tracker: Bengals' Joe Burrow leads race at midpoint of 2026 season
news_mentions.description: We've reached the midway point of the 2026 NFL season and with it comes a No. 1 in Kevin Patra's weekly MVP tracker. Who surpasses Josh Allen at the top?
news_mentions.body_text: we ve passed the halfway mark of the 2026 campaign and quarterbacks have officially fully taken over the mvp discussion we ve seen some ridiculously high level quarterback play recently from joe burrow dicing up defenses like a top chef on deadline to jordan love dive bombing opponents into oblivion this week i wanted to do something different with our mvp tracker we re going to highlight one play that illustrates why each qb is an mvp candidate sidenote before y all get madonline it s not necessarily the qb s best play of the season beyond that being wholly subjective i wanted to highlight traits that were indicative of their otherworldly play now let s get to the rankings mvp rankings note up down arrows below reflect movement from the week 9 edition next in line seahawks wr jaxon smith njigba bears qb caleb williams lions rb jahmyr gibbs chiefs rb kenneth walker lions qb jared goff voting for the 2026 nfl channel midseason awards is open viewers can scan the qr code displayed daily on nfl channel to access the voting page and make their selections

news_mentions.headline: Texans QB C.J. Stroud, Packers QB Jordan Love highlight Players of the Week
news_mentions.description: Green Bay quarterback Jordan Love and Houston signal-caller C.J. Stroud shined in Week 9 and earned top offensive accolades on Wednesday.
news_mentions.body_text: who were the nfl s top stars in week 9 each wednesday the league unveils its weekly honor roll see who the players of the week are below afc offensive player of the week stroud was a force on sunday lighting up the chargers during the texans runaway 44 22 victory the 2023 first rounder matched a career high set in his rookie campaign with five touchdown passes as he completed 21 of 35 throws 60 for 384 yards one interception and a 125 5 rating stroud earned his fifth career afc offensive player of the week with his first coming the first time he threw for five scores back in week 9 2023 nfc offensive player of the week love was outstanding in the packers 45 27 rout of the patriots rising into the mvp conversation love completed 79 3 of his 29 passes for 372 yards and three touchdowns he had four total tds adding a rushing score as well afc defensive player of the week the seven time pro bowler and now four time afc defensive player of the week awoke from a relatively quiet season with a stellar sunday in the chiefs 35 12 thumping of the jets jones posted four tackles two tackles for loss a pass breakup and two sacks prior to week 9 jones had half a sack on the season nfc defensive player of the week the no 5 overall pick in the 2026 nfl draft has been bestowed with his first accolade in what could be a first season filled with awards the ap nfl defensive rookie of the year contender piled up 12 tackles three sacks and a forced fumble as his giants delivered a 19 11 win sunday against the host eagles afc special teams player of the week owner of the two longest kicks in nfl history little didn t need to break out his big boot in thursday s win over the ravens however he braved the rainy elements to stack up 15 points in the 33 10 win little was perfect on seven kicks ending his busy night with three extra points in three tries and four field goals 36 yards 45 47 33 in just as many attempts this is little s second afc special teams player of the week honor his first was also in week 9 coming last year when he converted the longest field goal in league chronicle nfc special teams player of the week on an off day of sorts for the lions bates was perfectly efficient scoring 13 points in detroit s 19 9 win over the dolphins on sunday bates made his single extra point try and was good on each of his four field goal attempts

news_mentions.headline: Rex Ryan turns himself in after alleged Nashville hit-and-run injured 2 pedestrians, police say
news_mentions.description: Former NFL coach Rex Ryan turned himself in Wednesday for allegedly hitting pedestrians with his car in Nashville and leaving the scene, police said.
news_mentions.body_text: nashville tenn former nfl coach rex ryan turned himself in wednesday for allegedly hitting pedestrians with his car in nashville and leaving the scene police said two pedestrians had the right of way crossing a main street in downtown nashville s popular tourist area last week when ryan allegedly turned at a red light running over the victims feet nashville police said wednesday they suffered minor injuries police said ryan an espn football analyst was on the network sunday for the nfl pregame show and monday for a morning show both of which are taped in new york ryan showed up at nashville s downtown detention center early wednesday according to the davidson county sheriff s office he was later released ryan was charged with two counts of leaving the scene of an accident two counts of failure to give information or render aid and two counts of failure to obey a traffic control signal according to court records all are misdemeanors online records did not identify an attorney for ryan a phone number believed to be ryan s had an automatic outgoing message and a message could not be left a judicial commissioner set ryan s bond at 6 000 but he qualified for pretrial release which means he was released on non financial conditions ryan is scheduled to appear in court next month ryan is a former head coach of the buffalo bills and new york jets leading the jets to the afc championship game in consecutive years after the 2009 and 2010 seasons while with the jets ryan became one of the team s and the nfl s most popular figures especially during his first few seasons as coach because of his brash colorful approach in news conferences that became must watch tv he has not coached since being fired by the bills with one game left in the 2016 season though he has since expressed an interest in coaching and interviewed in 2025 for the jets head coaching vacancy when aaron glenn was hired his father the late buddy ryan was an nfl coaching legend who famously coordinated the 1985 chicago bears defense that was one of the best in history seth ryan one of rex ryan s two sons is currently in his first season as the jets passing game coordinator ryan is best known now for his work at espn as one of the analysts on the network s nfl pregame show we are aware and are in touch with rex espn said in a statement wednesday news_mentions.headline: Cam Skattebo reacts to Giants not trading for Jonathan Taylor: 'They know what I can do'
news_mentions.description: The Giants didn’t trade for Colts running back Jonathan Taylor by Tuesday's deadline, leaving Cam Skattebo, slated to return Thursday against the Commanders, as the lead back.
news_mentions.body_text: the new york giants didn t trade for indianapolis colts running back jonathan taylor by tuesday s deadline leaving cam skattebo slated to return thursday against the washington commanders as the lead back asked about big blue s lack of a move at running back skattebo reiterated his confidence you ve seen what i can do he said tuesday via nj com when i come out and i m ready to play football i can be one of the most dangerous backs in the league simple as that skattebo added that he understands why the giants poked around on taylor but the second year pro said that he s still growing as he enters his 16th nfl contest i would be skeptical too if my running back was going for 60 yards a game and not really exploding out he said but i m still getting comfortable man this is like my 13th game in the league i m not even through a full football season yet i m still learning how to play football in this league you obviously can see i m getting more comfortable as i play the game the last time we saw skattebo on the field in week 7 he generated a career best 124 rushing yards his bruising style is tough to tackle when he gets going but the engine doesn t always start and he s had bad injury luck he missed week 9 due to a hamstring injury when the giants last faced the commanders in week 5 skattebo had 59 rushing yards on 13 carries but lost an overtime fumble that cost big blue a potential victory i ve been that guy he said obviously we had that one week hiccup where i got in trouble and got benched against the saints that was it i came back that next week and handled business they know what i m capable of they know what i can do the giants running game is certainly better with skattebo blasting through holes to keep their place atop the nfc east they need the second year back to stay on the field

news_mentions.headline: Jaguars GM James Gladstone doesn't view trades as going 'all-in'
news_mentions.description: The Jacksonville Jaguars shipped out a host of draft picks to upgrade their defense ahead of Tuesday's trade deadline.
news_mentions.body_text: the jacksonville jaguars spent significant draft capital upgrading their defense ahead of tuesday s trade deadline general manager james gladstone shipped 2027 first and second rounders a 2028 fifth and sixth round pick conditional and a 2029 second round pick for safety jessie bates nose tackle jordan davis and defensive tackle davon godchaux outside duval the perception is that gladstone pushed all his chips into the center of the table going all in on the jags having a legit shot at a super bowl on tuesday the gm rejected that notion yeah i think the idea that this is an all in move isn t necessarily how i characterize it gladstone said i characterize it as getting better as a football team and prioritizing getting better as a football team i look forward to seeing it all come to life and being a part of bringing it to life here this week and beyond but really that s the intent behind any decision that we make is what s in the best interest of this team in particular and the organization as a whole moving forward there is no sugarcoating that the jags paid a hefty price for a safety and two interior defenders however those were jacksonville s biggest weaknesses after injuries hit the defense credit gladstone for being fearless in giving his team a chance to chase a ring sitting on his hands wouldn t have done much good in 2026 having spent time on les snead s staff in los angeles gladstone has a unique view of the proverbial eff them picks mantra that the rams have embraced for the jags gm it s more of a cute phrase than how l a actually operates i know the idea of eff them picks has kind of taken a hold and it s a headline it s really not the approach or the process he said as you think back to my experience in los angeles over the time that i was there from the 2017 draft to the 2024 draft we were able to have the third most selections in the nfl across all 32 teams but there was a narrative around eff them picks tied to us it s in the volume of picks that s important and it ties back to how we operated in free agency this past spring not signing external free agents is an important piece when you have internal free agents signing elsewhere that can earn you a compensatory pick thus supplementing the loss of any other draft selection that you may choose to use outside the three days that exist in april to make a selection it s a very symbiotic process that encompasses a lot of layers to it but it s certainly not eff them picks while that s been characterized as the approach it s not necessarily we actually value picks we don t always use them on the three days that exist in april isn t that a breath of fresh air yes draft picks are extremely valuable particularly with rookie contract ceilings however using those picks not just on one weekend in the spring is a strategy gms with guts can exploit in a league that far too often hoards those selections in the fall then trades them willy nilly come the spring the balance of when exactly to buy and when to hoard is a difficult skill to master and one far too many gms don t even attempt to grasp gladstone certainly took a couple gambles if the davis trade blows up he ll have egg on his face however it s undeniable that jacksonville is better today than it was on sunday if the jags have a parade in duval in february no one will be crying about how those draft picks were spent

news_mentions.headline: Dolphins place QB Malik Willis (groin) on injured reserve; Kyle McCord in line for first start
news_mentions.description: Miami Dolphins quarterback Malik Willis was placed on injured reserve Tuesday due to a groin injury. With Willis shelved, second-year QB Kyle McCord will fill in, beginning Sunday on the road against the Indianapolis Colts.
news_mentions.body_text: a noticeable problem for malik willis in a week 9 loss will be an obstacle for the miami dolphins for at least the next four weeks willis was placed on injured reserve tuesday due to a groin injury with willis shelved second year quarterback kyle mccord will fill in beginning sunday on the road against the indianapolis colts the 27 year old willis regarded as one of the best running quarterbacks in the nfl was noticeably hobbled in his team s week 9 defeat to the detroit lions a free agent signing after renewing his career and promise under the tutelage of matt lafleur with the green bay packers willis has shepherded a rebuilding fins squad to mixed results the dolphins are 1 7 and he s completed 58 2 of his passes for 174 5 yards per game six touchdowns six interceptions and rushed for 232 yards and three scores so far this season willis and punter bradley pinion 1 for 1 are the only miami players to have thrown passes that will almost certainly change sunday when mccord is poised to make his first nfl start mccord 24 was a 2025 sixth round choice of the philadelphia eagles who was traded to the packers and like willis received good reviews from his time with lafleur that led to green bay turning around and trading him this offseason to miami for a sixth round pick with miami realistically out of the playoff race some silver lining exists in mccord getting his chance to show what he can do going forward brady cook who filled in as a starter for the new york jets last season is currently on miami s practice squad he ll likely be elevated to be the backup willis will miss games at the colts at the buffalo bills versus the new york jets and at the denver broncos from weeks 10 13 he ll be eligible to return for his team s dec 13 home game against the chicago bears

news_mentions.headline: Chiefs acquire Colts WR Josh Downs ahead of trade deadline
news_mentions.description: The Chiefs are acquiring Josh Downs and a 2027 seventh-round pick from the Colts in exchange for a 2027 fourth-round selection and a 2027 fifth-rounder, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported on Tuesday.
news_mentions.body_text: josh downs wish has been granted and a need has been answered in kansas city the chiefs are acquiring the slot receiver in a trade with the colts nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported kansas city is sending fourth and fifth round picks in the 2027 draft to indianapolis in the deal while receiving a 2027 seventh round pick in exchange per rapoport and schefter indianapolis announced the trade shortly after downs becomes the fourth player traded by the colts prior to tuesday s deadline joining the likes of guard quenton nelson defensive tackle deforest buckner and fellow receiver keenan allen who was traded to san francisco earlier tuesday i am beyond grateful and blessed for my time in indy downs wrote on social media following news of the trade nothing but love for the shoe a third round pick out of north carolina in 2023 downs became a reliable secondary receiving option in indianapolis pairing with michael pittman and eventually alec pierce to form a quality pass catching tandem for the colts despite instability under center he posted a career high 803 receiving yards and five touchdowns in 14 games in 2024 but watched indianapolis trade pittman to pittsburgh and hand pierce the lucrative extension downs desired over the offseason leaving downs in an awkward spot entering a contract year that contract year became a nightmare for the colts prompting downs to request a trade following two deals that shipped nelson to seattle and buckner to san francisco indianapolis didn t initially adhere to his request and coach shane steichen convinced downs to continue participating following the receiver s ask to be dealt but after two games played the colts decided it was time to maximize whatever return was available for the receiver especially as free agency loomed in early 2027 downs heads to kansas city to join a receiver room that is headlined by rashee rice who returned from injury in week 8 and helped improve kansas city s passing attack but is short at the position following xavier worthy s hamstring injury suffered in the chiefs week 9 win over the new york jets and if we re being honest the chiefs have long needed help at receiver making them a likely candidate to swing a deal for a receiver even before worthy s latest injury with downs now in the mix patrick mahomes will have another option to turn to as he surveys the field indianapolis meanwhile concludes a remarkably active trade window in which they dealt four players but held onto the most recognizable one running back jonathan taylor when the colts fired general manager chris ballard and sent out expiring mainstays like nelson and buckner it was clear the organization was willing to engage in a fire sale in order to jump start a rebuild as a star runner at nearly 28 years old taylor was seen as the most valuable asset in such a teardown and was understandably attracting plenty of interest from rb needy contenders despite these market forces encouraging a blockbuster trade when the 4 p m et deadline passed on tuesday taylor remained a colt indianapolis will finish 2026 with taylor remaining at the center of its offense and perhaps entertain a trade following the conclusion of the current campaign

news_mentions.headline: Vikings trade for Raiders QB Kirk Cousins on deadline day
news_mentions.description: The Vikings are acquiring Kirk Cousins from the Las Vegas Raiders, NFL Network Insiders Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported on Tuesday.
news_mentions.body_text: minnesota has its new and old quarterback the vikings are acquiring kirk cousins from the las vegas raiders in exchange for a 2027 third round draft pick nfl network insiders ian rapoport and mike garafolo and espn s adam schefter reported on tuesday minnesota has since announced the trade the swap also begins the fernando mendoza era for the raiders as the 2026 nfl draft s no 1 overall pick will now take over as the team s starter raiders general manager john spytek told reporters that he didn t expect to trade cousins and didn t make calls to shop him before minnesota reached out tuesday morning this was a hard decision spytek said of moving cousins per team reporter paul gutierrez but we felt like we made the best decision for the raiders going forward the trade brings cousins 38 back to the club he played for from 2018 to 2023 and reunites him with head coach kevin o connell who was in charge for cousins final two years as a viking cousins first season under o connell was one of his finest as a pro as he threw for 4 547 yards 29 touchdowns and 14 interceptions while going 13 4 in 2022 minnesota will desperately be hoping for more of the same from cousins after its qb situation disintegrated to a point that it was threatening to tank the team s season despite the vikings boasting the top scoring defense in the league a relentless pressure machine that batters opponents and keeps them off the scoreboard the offense has been a travesty that unit ranks 27th in points 31st in yards and 31st in passing the vikings have scored 16 points or less in five of their eight games including the last three it hasn t mattered if kyler murray or carson wentz was under center and j j mccarthy drafted to take over for cousins in 2024 flunked out of o connell s quarterback school and was traded to the giants on sept 28 thus cousins returns to replace his replacement the four time pro bowler has played remarkably well for las vegas this season more than just a placeholder for mendoza he s thrown for 2 340 yards 20 touchdowns and eight interceptions while leading the raiders to a 4 5 record a much better spot than most would have predicted and on the playoff bubble midway through the season mendoza now takes over for the silver and black hoping to keep them competitive down the stretch and prove himself worthy of being the top pick in the 2026 draft a heisman trophy winner and national champion at indiana mendoza has made one prior appearance this season entering a blowout loss to the patriots and throwing for 48 yards on 6 of 8 passing he s shown us he s ready not only physically but mentally spytek said after officially naming mendoza as las vegas starter beginning with sunday s upcoming game versus a seahawks squad sporting a stingy defense raiders head coach klint kubiak added i anticipate it being a transition we re going to find out together the future is now for the raiders while a blast from the past returns to the vikings hoping to rescue an offense in dire need of saving if cousins proves ready to play in week 10 he ll face off against the packers at lambeau field just as he did in has last game with the vikings back in 2023

news_mentions.headline: Colts trade WR Keenan Allen to 49ers for 2027 sixth-round pick
news_mentions.description: The San Francisco 49ers are acquiring veteran wide receiver Keenan Allen from the Indianapolis Colts in exchange for a 2027 sixth-round draft pick, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported on Tuesday.
news_mentions.body_text: the san francisco 49ers have added another veteran for their ailing wide receiver room the niners acquired keenan allen from the colts in exchange for a 2027 sixth round pick indianapolis announced tuesday ahead of the trade deadline nfl network and espn first reported the news allen signed in indy in august to help a banged up receiver corps now he s being shipped west to aid another the first of two wideouts indy dealt on tuesday as josh downs was later sent to kansas city in eight games this season allen has generated 40 catches for 351 yards and a touchdown the longtime los angeles chargers star who earned six pro bowls in l a isn t as steady as he once was but the 34 year old still knows how to run a route and can be counted on for third downs allen has become something of a nomad in the past few years after his pro bowl 2023 season he was traded to chicago for a fourth round pick he then returned to l a in 2025 this year deep into the summer he latched onto shane steichen s squad in 14 seasons allen has generated 12 402 yards on 1 095 catches with 71 tds he might not be the allen of old but he brings reliability to a decimated 49ers wr room still without mike evans rib achilles and deebo samuel hamstring jordan watkins was brock purdy s top target last week and the niners have been seeing significant snaps from demarcus robinson brandin cooks and jacob cowing the addition of allen gives the 49ers the nfl s active leader in wr receptions allen the nfl s active leader in wr receiving yards evans 13 472 yards the nfl s active leader in rb receptions receiving yards and receiving tds christian mccaffrey 662 catches for 5 660 yards and 37 tds and the second ranked active te in receiving touchdowns george kittle 57 behind only travis kelce 84 per nfl research

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Bengals call off trade for Eagles' Arnold Ebiketie over compensatory pick formula
news_mentions.description: An agreed-upon trade between the Bengals and Eagles that would have sent pass rusher Arnold Ebiketie to Bengals was called off by Cincinnati over comp picks, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported on Tuesday
news_mentions.body_text: there is a first time for everything in the nfl an agreed upon trade between the bengals and eagles that would have sent pass rusher arnold ebiketie to cincinnati was called off by the bengals due to the team s compensatory picks formula nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported on tuesday the trade was scuttled it seems by a post on x from over the cap s compensatory picks guru nick korte multiple outlets reported that the bengals were set to acquire ebiketie from the eagles for a 2027 sixth round pick analysis was written grades were given the world was ready to move on to the next deal ahead of today s 4 p m et deadline then korte fired off this post essentially by acquiring ebiketie the bengals would have negated a compensatory third round pick in 2027 they were in line to earn from losing trey hendrickson to the baltimore ravens in free agency since ebiketie was a compensatory formula signing for the eagles trading that contract would cancel out a pick for the acquiring team the math on the trade went from the bengals sending a sixth round pick for a backup edge rusher to losing a sixth and a third round pick that would have been disastrous for cincinnati not long after korte s post which had many bengals fans freaking out cincinnati reportedly backed out on the trade nfl network insider mike garafolo reported that the eagles weren t thrilled after the trade was called off but because it was agreed to and not official there is nothing philadelphia general manager howie roseman can do about it and that is how a contract analyst helped save the bengals a third round draft pick they should thank korte by hiring him someone should
