news_mentions.headline: NFC North training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bears, Lions, Packers, Vikings
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top NFC North training camp storylines to monitor for the Chicago Bears, Detroit Lions, Green Bay Packers and Minnesota Vikings.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the chicago bears detroit lions green bay packers and minnesota vikings catch up on each nfc north team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below chicago bears detroit lions green bay packers minnesota vikings three key storylines 1 can caleb find consistency we could discuss the bears offense taking another leap forward in ben johnson s second season we could consider the burgeoning potential of luther burden alongside rome odunze or ponder who will win the primary wr3 duties we could chatter about how much higher tight end colston loveland could fly or how johnson will use his diverse te room none of that really strikes a chord without caleb williams taking his game to new heights the former no 1 pick showed what the highs can look like in year 1 under johnson the explosive jaw dropping plays were plentiful and the qb led a trove of comebacks now he must flatten out some of the lulls the drive stalling misfires and become a more potent every snap quarterback keep the extraordinary peaks and raise the floor and williams will be in the thick of the mvp discussion the madden nfl 27 cover athlete heads into year 3 with heightened expectations if he meets them there is no telling how far the bears can go 2 defensive uncertainty from front to back questions on defense will hover over training camp the bears did precious little to upgrade a wanting front four the club added a few rotational interior defenders but is counting significantly on bounce back campaigns from grady jarrett and gervon dexter montez sweat still doesn t have a proven pass rusher on the opposite side austin booker showed signs down the stretch last year but can he take his game to another level is there enough down the line will shemar turner be healthy following last october s acl tear the questions up front are echoed on the back end where the bears are replacing both starting safeties coby bryant and cam lewis are solid but can they produce as many turnovers as the previous crew the key is first round pick dillon thieneman will the rookie be ready to thrive in dennis allen s scheme by week 1 3 two questions on the offensive line ozzy trapilo s patellar tendon injury in the wild card round means the bears can t count on the left tackle for at least the beginning of the season veteran braxton jones is penciled into the starting lineup but he will have to win the battle with jedrick wills and theo benedet to earn the week 1 assignment the position is one to keep an eye on the rest of the o line profiles as one of the better units in the nfl but if the left side becomes leaky it could be a cascading problem also i m going to keep tabs on the center spot the bears replaced drew dalman who abruptly retired this offseason with garrett bradbury as the presumptive starter however second round rookie logan jones could push the veteran for the starting gig during camp back to top three key storylines 1 offensive line overhaul the lions offensive line collapsed last season swiftly going from asset to liability detroit attacked the unit flipping penei sewell to left tackle drafting blake miller to man the right edge signing center cade mays and adding veteran depth at each spot how the line shakes out will be the main storyline to track during camp is sewell s transition going smoothly is miller a plug and play rookie or does he need time to adjust the key will be young guards christian mahogany and tate ratledge who struggled with consistency in 2025 will the duo improve or could they get pushed out of the starting lineup if the lions don t get better blocking in 2026 the explosive potential will be squandered 2 this is gibbs backfield sonic is now the featured character in detroit the offseason trade of david montgomery calcified the reality that jahmyr gibbs bell cow era is full go gibbs began to take over the majority of the backfield touches last season and his reps should continue to grow the lions likely won t want the dual threat back to creep to the 300 carry threshold but barring injury he ll blast past his career high of 250 totes gibbs should also see his role in the passing game continue to rise after posting a career best 77 catches for 616 yards and five touchdowns in 2025 gibbs combination of shiftiness speed and ability to make hay between and outside the tackles makes him a dynamic threat the lions want to ensure that threat stays on the field as much as possible he profiles for a christian mccaffrey type workload and should be in the offensive player of the year discussion by the end of the season with the expected rise in reps gibbs extension is also one we ve been waiting to see this offseason the lions have gotten in front of extensions in recent years so everyone expects a top of the rb market contract for gibbs to come barreling down the pike 3 can detroit return to health detroit has significant injuries to track at the onset of camp tight end sam laporta is the name to watch on offense but the defense has greater concerns brian branch suffered a late season achilles tear and while the lions haven t put a hard timeline on the safety s recovery it will be a surprise if he s good to go to open the season the bigger question is whether given the type of injury he sustained branch will be his normal buzzing self at all this season then there is kerby joseph whose knee injury limited him to just six games last season the lions have given few tangible updates on the safety s status while taking a wait and see approach without certainty from either starter the lions secondary sits in a precarious spot couple that with the release of cb terrion arnold and detroit could be relying once again on filler and journeymen in the defensive backfield back to top three key storylines 1 who rushes the passer until micah returns after tearing up his knee last december micah parsons is set to start camp on the physically unable to perform list and in all likelihood he ll start the season on pup wiping out his first four games there is always the chance parsons gets back earlier but given how he spoke about his timetable last month i expect him and the club to play it safe sans the dynamic pass rusher for the opening gambit there are significant questions up front in green bay the offseason trade of rashan gary made sense for the club but his absence further highlights a shallow edge group the packers need former first round pick lukas van ness to finally find his footing how he looks early in camp could tell us if green bay needs to add another veteran fourth round rookie dani dennis sutton also could have some say in that plan until parsons returns this might be a mix and match crew van ness is the key to whether the pack can survive the early portion of the calendar 2 jacobs uncertainty looms large josh jacobs situation continues to hover over the franchise after he was arrested in may at this stage it s unclear how local authorities will handle the situation in turn we don t know whether the league will take disciplinary action jacobs was on the field with his team last month and if things remain unchanged he should be there for camp if any action is taken against jacobs it could have a significant impact on the on field product in green bay jacobs is the workhorse and engine of the ground attack if he s unavailable or gets injured during the season matt lafleur s offense could be in some trouble next up are former undrafted free agent chris brooks a third down back and marshawn lloyd who has been unable to stay healthy the packers believe lloyd finally has turned a corner but until we see it in action that s a projection we can t assume we need to see the third year back produce during camp and into the preseason while staying healthy in the process 3 pass catching puzzle solved the pass catching unit in green bay is also something i m intrigued by the packers watched romeo doubs leave in free agency and traded dontayvion wicks then they inked jayden reed and christian watson to extensions those two and 2025 first rounder matthew golden comprise the top receiving trio with a clearer rotation at wr i believe the three can each thrive golden is the one to watch after he finished an uneven rookie campaign with a productive effort four catches for 84 yards and a score in the packers wild card weekend loss at chicago there are some depth questions particularly given the crew s injury history so that battle among reserves will be worth tracking tucker kraft s health is another piece to keep an eye on despite tearing his acl last november the pivotal playmaker is aiming to be ready for week 1 could he return with a new contract as well back to top three key storylines 1 kyler vs j j competition or coronation vikings coach kevin o connell continues to insist he s running a legitimate quarterback competition he keeps having to say it because frankly not many believe that j j mccarthy has a shot to keep kyler murray out of the starting lineup perhaps we ll be stunned but every indicator suggests it s murray s job to lose the former no 1 overall pick enters with proven ability while mccarthy has struggled when on the field and had issues staying healthy murray could open up the offense and his propensity to force feed his top targets could be a harbinger of a justin jefferson bounce back this competition in whatever form that takes will be tracked daily come camp within that context i m interested in how murray fits into koc s system and whether his mobility adds an element we haven t seen much of in minnesota over the past few years 2 next men up on the edge the trade of jonathan greenard took a chunk out of the defense not only because greenard was a proven disruptor but also due to the fact that the vikings now aren t very flush at the position dallas turner whom the club is counting on to have a full breakout in year 3 and andrew van ginkel sit atop the edge rusher corps but bo richter chaz chambliss and tyler batty are the next three players up on the depth chart they ve combined for one career sack chambliss defensive lineman tyrion ingram dawkins has also taken some reps on the edge the vikings could look to add another veteran rusher during camp or early in the season we trust brian flores defense but a coach who generally relies on vets who understand his system will be asking a lot out of youngsters how rookies caleb banks domonique orange jakobe thomas and charles demmings make the transition will have a significant say in the vikings outcome this season 3 one last dance with hitman we expected to have a resolution one way or the other on harrison smith s future surprisingly the situation still lingers will he return for another go or will he officially retire the club has made it clear they d welcome a return and didn t add a veteran to take smith s place jakobe thomas a third round pick was the only significant addition the club made to the safety crew given how much flores relies on the versatility of his safeties a return by smith would have a significant impact if he decides to retire jay ward theo jackson and thomas will battle for reps keep an eye on thomas and charles demmings in camp and preseason each could play key roles in 2026 back to top

news_mentions.headline: AFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Colts, Jaguars, Texans, Titans
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top AFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Houston Texans, Indianapolis Colts, Jacksonville Jaguars and Tennessee Titans.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars and tennessee titans catch up on each afc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars tennessee titans three key storylines 1 another o line overhaul the most glaring weakness of the 2025 texans will take center stage during training camp as houston once again undergoes an offensive line revamp demeco ryans crew re upped right guard ed ingram and left tackle aireontae ersery showed glimpses of promise during his up and down rookie campaign the texans drafted center guard keylan rutledge in the first round they inked guard wyatt teller and right tackle braden smith both solid veterans when healthy in free agency veteran trent brown and 2024 second rounder blake fisher will battle for reps and or the swing tackle gig and evan brown and fourth round rookie febechi nwaiwu provide depth inside on paper it s a significantly improved group from the one that got bowled over a year ago however we ve said that before paper can get shredded just like last year s o line in houston how the crew shakes out will be the key to camp and how the texans season unfolds 2 can stroud offense get back on track tied to the first point is the play of c j stroud who has seen his production dip the past two seasons after a sensational rookie campaign in 2023 stroud s collapse reached a low with his ghastly performance see four interceptions 42 6 completion rate in the playoff loss to the new england patriots stroud has been scattershot behind a woeful offensive line at times last year he trusted his blocking so little that even when he had time he d rush decisions and make panicked throws the qb s play has been so incongruous to the poise and calm he displayed as a rookie that it s maddening for the offense to get back in gear and stop wasting a championship worthy defense stroud must be more consistent in the pocket an improved offensive line will certainly help but the qb must raise all boats even when the situation isn t perfect getting better run production with the import of david montgomery should improve the offensive efficiency monty rarely gets stuffed for negative gains solving a problem we saw far too often from houston s ground game a year ago he should keep the offense in better down and distances one other key player to track during camp is receiver tank dell who has been out since late in the 2024 season due to a severe knee injury the difference in stroud s production with and without dell in the lineup is stark what sort of shape will the receiver be in after so much time away and can he stay healthy 3 rich defense gets richer can the most ferocious defense in the league actually be better in 2026 edge monsters will anderson and danielle hunter are still in their primes derek stingley kamari lassiter jalen pitre and calen bullock form a lockdown backend and azeez al shaair still patrols the middle the texans upgraded a safety spot with veteran reed blankenship after shuffling through others at the position second round pick kayden mcdonald could play a significant role out of the gate alongside sheldon rankins and tommy togiai in the middle of the d line if mcdonald turns out to be a steal this defense will have zero weaknesses back to top three key storylines 1 how will jones look in return from injury daniel jones progress is the no 1 topic in indianapolis entering camp the colts predictably held the starter out of team drills during offseason workouts but expect him to be full go sometime during camp the focus will be on how many reps he can take and how he looks indy was a wonder early last season when jones was on his game making plays and looking at home in shane steichen s offense it fell apart when the qb got hurt the colts put all their eggs in the basket of jones returning healthy this offseason achilles injuries however can be a slog to return from yes jones is younger than kirk cousins but we saw how long it took for the latter to return to anything close to what he was before such an injury and cousins never relied on his mobility like jones does if jones is stuck in the pocket or struggles to push off the injured leg leading to limp passes will the colts offense wither how he looks early in camp won t say everything but it will give a strong indication of what to expect for the first quarter of the season in concert the colts will conduct a backup qb competition between anthony richardson and riley leonard barring richardson s trade request being granted of course given jones injury history the winner could see reps this season 2 overall roster health health is the main storyline throughout the colts roster from jones to alec pierce on offense to key defenders like deforest buckner and sauce gardner on defense buckner is one to track on d the colts have no replacement for the star dt who underwent neck surgery last winter he could be ready for week 1 but at this point it remains an unknown he was noncommittal when asked this offseason given how much of the summer months are filled with players dismissing injury and assuming they ll be ready it s a red flag when a veteran is evasive if buckner misses the start of the season or sees his play dip it could be devastating for indy s defense how much he participates in camp if at all will be closely tracked there isn t the same concern with gardner who missed significant time last season with a lingering calf injury but the star s status is worth keeping an eye on we also aren t sure what charvarius ward will look like after deciding against retiring following last year s concussion issues outside of injury questions what will the pass rush look like is laiatu latu ready to make a leap how much does arden key still have left is jt tuimoloau ready for a bigger role do the colts need to bring in another veteran edge 3 taylor s future in indy outside of health concerns hovering over colts camp the future of jonathan taylor is an interesting question the 27 year old running back is in the final year of his contract the situation is far less contentious than the last time he sought a new pact which saw him conduct a hold in until he got paid when asked about his contract this summer taylor was cordial about the state of affairs but made it known he d like to continue getting paid in indy could the situation turn sour again will the rb decide to ratchet things up if no extension comes before camp perhaps he s waiting for bijan robinson and jahmyr gibbs to reset the market again before making his next play we saw the offense s struggles when jones was out as defenses could sell out to stop jt it wasn t pretty if taylor is going to be asked to keep carrying a hefty load with little aid he might want commensurate compensation into the future back to top three key storylines 1 backfield shakeup when travis etienne signed in new orleans it opened up a swath of carries bhayshul tuten who has impressed this offseason is expected to have a hefty role but it s still unclear how big that part might be as free agent addition chris rodriguez was unable to participate in offseason workouts following a surgical procedure on his left foot the veteran is expected to be good to go for training camp which will give us a better idea of how liam coen might divvy up his rb reps last year etienne took the overwhelming majority of carries 260 to tuten s 83 will coen slice up the pie more or ride tuten at least to start the season a lot might have to do with rodriguez s health 2 what will hunter s role be when it was reported that the jags planned for the former no 2 overall pick to be a primary corner and part time receiver travis hunter didn t seem to take too kindly to that plan we won t know the truth until hunter is on the field for a significant amount of time how much he participates early in camp and where that participation takes place will indicate the club s intentions if the second year dual threat player is the lockdown corner most believe he s capable of being and continues to make plays at receiver the jags could have trouble taking him off the gridiron the rest of the offensive playmakers could have some say in how much time hunter sees at wr after a disappointing second season brian thomas has received glowing reviews this offseason parker washington soared to close last season and jakobi meyers remains a consistent professional if btj gets back on track there could be less of a reason to use hunter in a ton of offensive sets 3 lloyd s replacement the jags saw devin lloyd leave in free agency and didn t replace his production in anthony campanile s defense via free agency or early in the draft the decision puts 2023 fourth rounder ventrell miller in line to take over the role next to foye oluokun miller showed spunk this offseason but won t be handed the starting gig 2025 undrafted lb branson combs and 2026 seventh rounder parker hughes could have a shot to push miller for the starting gig if no one comes to the forefront the jags d could be in a rough spot lloyd shined last year under campanile who unleashed the linebacker s athleticism in a second team all pro campaign lacking playmaking in the middle would highlight some of the questions up front where there wasn t always consistent pressure from the front four back to top three key storylines 1 cam ward cam ward cam ward when discussing critical elements for the 2026 tennessee titans point nos 1 through 50 could all be about cam ward that s how vital his development is to any success in nashville robert saleh brings a professional coach to the head chair and did well to import brian daboll to nurture the young quarterback perhaps daboll wasn t meant for the head coaching gig in new york but he s proven he can help grow a qb josh allen daniel jones and jaxson dart all improved under daboll ward offers enticing upside while his accuracy came and went last year when he was in a groove the titans qb showcased a laser arm and the ability to find the range deep he needs to calibrate his short to mid area throws at times but the alluring positives pop off the page he doesn t need to live in the acrobatic athletic plays but they can add an indefensible element to tennessee s offense improving his mental processing particularly against man coverage where he struggled is one of the early steps ward has to make this season the titans must see significant strides forward from their qb in year 2 after the club improved his surroundings 2 better receiving corps in attempting to make life easier for ward tennessee upgraded the wr room first they inked wan 39 dale robinson from new york the slot maven excelled in daboll s offense and can help teach a young wideout room the ropes robinson is coming off a 1 014 yard season and generated a career high 11 yards per catch in 2025 the veteran will be particularly helpful to ward on third downs when he can win from the slot and make himself available to the quarterback then the titans used the no 4 overall pick on ohio state wr carnell tate who provides a vertical threat and heady playmaking tate s ability to make catches in close knit areas will be a boon for his new qb second year wrs elic ayomanor and chimere dike both showed glimmers of promise during their rookie campaigns if they take a step forward this could be an enticing group the lingering question is what role calvin ridley will play the veteran struggled on the field and missed the bulk of the season due to injury in seven tilts he had just 303 yards on 17 catches with zero tds his 11 1 drop rate last season was fifth worst in the nfl minimum 25 targets per next gen stats the titans eschewed cutting ridley believing he can still aid ward and the offense what that role is will be determined during camp 3 will improved d on paper translate to field the titans sported a woeful defense last season with saleh taking over the club the unit was completely revamped on paper it s much improved but how will all the new pieces mesh i love adding a penetrating john franklin myers next to all world dt jeffery simmons however is there enough on the edges jermaine johnson had his best years under saleh but hasn t been a consistent force first round rookie keldric faulk boasts talent but will he be a day 1 difference maker will second round rookie linebacker anthony hill immediately step into the middle of the defense next to the underrated cedric gray the secondary was horrendous last season tennessee responded by signing cordale flott alontae taylor and joshua williams all have had moments in their careers when they ve been stellar but there is also a reason each was available namely inconsistency i trust saleh to know how he wants his d to run and to get the most out of his players there is no question this crew is significantly improved on paper but questions remain particularly with all the free agent veteran additions back to top

news_mentions.headline: Detroit Lions training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Kevin Patra provides a refresher on the Detroit Lions' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc north catch up on the detroit lions offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 16 rookies july 19 veterans location detroit lions training facility allen park michigan fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule pro football hall of fame game vs los angeles chargers thursday july 31 at 8 p m et nbc week 1 at atlanta falcons friday aug 8 at 7 p m et week 2 vs miami dolphins saturday aug 16 at 1 p m et week 3 vs houston texans saturday aug 23 at 1 p m et 2025 schedule note the lions have 11 games against 2024 playoff teams tied with the eagles for most in the nfl nfl research what you need to know 1 who will replace frank ragnow the abrupt retirement of the star center tossed a massive question mark into the lions den presumably the club hoped to get one more year out of the stalwart pivot who played through an assortment of injuries throughout his career that would have allowed rookie tate ratledge to get his feet wet at guard before transitioning to center in 2026 much the same way ragnow started his career now things are turned topsy turvy is the second round rookie ready to start under center like 30 other second round picks he remains unsigned as camp approaches which could toss another kink into the lions plans can veteran graham glasgow return to center for the start of the season the 32 year old struggled last season at guard and hasn t consistently played center since the end of the 2022 campaign fifth round rookie miles frazier could also play a key role this season particularly if injuries strike with second year guard christian mahogany already slated to take over for guard kevin zeitler who left in free agency the lions could be uber young in the middle of the offensive line in front of jared goff a strength of the 2024 squad the offensive line has big questions heading into training camp 2 coming off a 15 2 season and back to back nfc north championships the lions are replacing both coordinators who left for head coaching jobs dan campbell knew he could trust ben johnson and aaron glenn to pull the right plays and build a reliable game plan week in and week out now he ll have to construct that same trust with new offensive coordinator john morton and defensive coordinator kelvin sheppard working under glenn since he became an nfl coach in 2021 sheppard was a natural choice to step into the dc role however he s green as a play caller and there will be questions about how he handles in game adjustments glenn kept a defense decimated by injuries afloat last season until the playoffs how would sheppard fare if similar devastation occurs likewise morton enters with big shoes to fill the lions offense was a dual threat nightmare for defenses and johnson was a master at setting up defenses to fail will morton who doesn t have a ton of play calling experience continue that with a trove of offensive weapons or could we see a step back from detroit s offense morton s familiarity with goff is a benefit but questions remain as to how he ll tweak the scheme like potentially splitting out wide jahmyr gibbs more often it s difficult to imagine the lions getting better management from their coordinators than they had a year ago any step back could be a detriment in a tough division training camp will give us our first real taste of how the new coordinators plan to change things or not in 2025 3 aidan hutchinson has been cleared from last year s devastating injury given the timeline it s not a surprise that the pass rusher is raring to go but it will be good to see him live during camp how he attacks those first few days of practice and recovers from them will give a good indication as to whether he can get back to the defensive player of the year trajectory he was on pre injury or whether we should curtail our expectations hutchinson s health isn t the only one to track in detroit alim mcneill is expected to miss the early part of the season but how much remains to be seen how does marcus davenport look after yet another injury shortened season there are questions at edge rusher in detroit so the health of the front four is particularly notable at this early stage

news_mentions.headline: NFL QB rankings, Week 10: Joe Burrow climbs to No. 1; Caleb Williams slides
news_mentions.description: Who joins Joe Burrow as a riser in Nick Shook's QB rankings at midseason? Check out the updated pecking order, 1-32, heading into Week 10.
news_mentions.body_text: notes up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 9 qb index stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl tier 1 it s time we insert joe burrow into the mvp conversation he s an outrageously efficient and daring quarterback who is powering one of the most explosive offenses in the nfl if the bengals mount a deep playoff run he ll be the face of it he might also become the face of the league s quarterbacks the one spot drop is no knock on josh allen whose ability to win in the margins enabled buffalo to leave minneapolis with a major victory on monday night allen did the special things he usually does to help the bills survive the brian flores defense and should be proud of the performance even if it wasn t his most statistically impressive game of the season no quarterback in the nfl is currently more in sync with his receivers than jordan love it makes sense green bay has asked him to carry the offense all season long that s bad for opponents because the additional reps have helped love settle into a rhythm that makes for appointment viewing each week christian watson s career best pace isn t happening by accident the texans were able to enjoy a spectacular c j stroud performance in week 9 he s produced plenty of them this season and could find himself in the mvp conversation if houston can turn around its season brock purdy has thrown three interceptions in his last two games but his positive contributions vastly outweigh the negative he s becoming an entertaining quarterback when operating out of structure like when he scrambled for a touchdown largely because the raiders apparently decided they d rather prevent a pass than tackle him purdy happily took that gift and will have yet another new receiver trade acquisition keenan allen to learn this week trevor lawrence started last thursday night on a heater throwing a beautiful seam ball to parker washington for a touchdown lawrence didn t need to do much else for the jaguars to cruise to victory he s in command of the offense and should be expected to remain in this tier for the foreseeable future as part of one of the nfl s best squads next gen stats insights via nfl pro c j stroud completed 10 of 16 passes between 10 and 19 yards downfield for 254 yards five touchdowns and an interception in week 9 against the chargers it s the only game in which a quarterback has thrown five touchdowns targeting the intermediate level since at least 2016 and the third most yards recorded by a quarterback on such throws in that span tier 2 detroit s win in miami was ugly and made for an unexpectedly difficult outing for jared goff who had a hard time finding open windows against miami s scrappy defense he threw an interception on a play in which his arm was hit as he released the ball narrowly missed being responsible for an earlier turnover and threw for just 170 yards in the low scoring triumph i m not ready to say he s developing a turnover issue he had not thrown a pick prior to week 8 but as head coach dan campbell intimated at halftime on sunday the lions need to get going offensively what happens when you throw four interceptions in a prime time game you fall a tier in the qb index that s what caleb williams did on sunday night struggling against tampa bay s relentless blitzes it s not all on him chicago s running game has largely disappeared of late but after looking superhuman at times in 2026 williams was very mortal on sunday patrick mahomes on the other hand might actually be superhuman a gruesome hit to his throwing arm sent every chiefs fan into panic mode but somehow mahomes shook it off and calmly led the chiefs to a runaway win by completing 23 of 31 passes for 242 yards and two touchdowns against the jets he s also welcoming slot receiver josh downs via trade this week i m eager to see how downs improves kansas city s passing attack the cowboys escaped indianapolis with a win in a weird game that saw dak prescott do what he does best air it out his 335 yard two touchdown performance was crucial to dallas winning efforts they ll need that and more against san francisco this week matthew stafford isn t playing anywhere near the caliber of his mvp 2025 season and still makes a head scratching throw or two per game he s just not as sharp as he s been in the past but he s also a primary reason the rams have stacked a few wins i worry about how he ll fare without the injured puka nacua going forward though next gen stats insights via nfl pro dak prescott completed 8 of 11 passes against man coverage for a season high 181 yards and two touchdowns in week 9 against the colts prescott connected with ceedee lamb on four passes for 95 yards and a touchdown against man coverage the fourth most yards the duo has recorded against man in a single game prescott completed 13 of 23 passes for 154 yards against zone coverage in the game tier 3 drake maye has a turnover problem again spending sunday throwing a couple of meatball subs to packers defenders and burying his team he s trusting his arm too much at times and looks uncomfortable in other instances but he s also playing without a couple of top pass catching options it s been an up and down year for maye no doubt bryce young the most volatile member of the qb index in 2026 is back on the rise after entering a flow state that powered a panthers comeback against the broncos he nearly positioned carolina to take an eight point second half lead before fate had different ideas young threw a wacky interception that was more a result of the defensive play made and the spheroid that is a football than a mistake by young the turnover stopped the panthers momentum in its tracks though young did his best to throw them back into the game in the fourth quarter but fumbled away their last chance ending a roller coaster of a day that fits his season kirk cousins swan song with the raiders wasn t quite as bad as the final stat line suggested yes he threw three interceptions and yes he appeared to lack the arm strength to complete a couple of highly ambitious attempts but he also played well enough to help the raiders momentarily climb back into a chaotic affair versus the niners now that he s a viking he s moving back to minneapolis with expectations of becoming a hero for the dreadful minnesota offense raiders fans will remember him as the capable veteran who guided the offense admirably in the first nine weeks under head coach klint kubiak geno smith helped the jets battle with the chiefs for a half on sunday before succumbing to steve spagnuolo s defense which feels appropriate given how gang green s season is going can cam ward build on his excellent week 8 showing following tennessee s bye will aaron rodgers be needed to power the steelers offense beyond a few key completions each week the second half should answer both of these questions for us next gen stats insights via nfl pro bryce young completed 28 of 39 passes for 276 yards with three touchdowns and an interception in week 9 against the broncos young went 13 of 14 for 152 yards and a touchdown on throws targeting in breaking routes young has thrown for 1 127 yards on in breaking routes this season the most among all quarterbacks tier 4 the buccaneers finally needed baker mayfield to throw the ball on sunday night a responsibility he embraced by launching a beautiful strike to tez johnson as part of tampa bay s comeback efforts unfortunately mayfield also threw two interceptions illustrating how his return from injury hasn t exactly been the smoothest experience tyler shough represented one half of a low output afternoon in the superdome on sunday until desperation set in against cleveland shough rediscovered his clutch gene at the perfect time and dropped a collection of dimes on the likes of chris olave and juwan johnson in the saints overtime win i ll be tracking him closely to see how he continues to develop a rapport with rookie jordyn tyson jayden daniels still makes plays that remind us of why he became an instant star as a rookie but he s also struggling with game management he doesn t seem to understand that he can t afford to throw the ball in the middle of the field with mere seconds remaining in a comeback effort and his offensive line didn t make matters any easier for him against a rams front that finally enjoyed the combined efforts of myles garrett three sacks and aaron donald bo nix is crawling yes crawling back toward where he was last season on sunday he included a few rollouts and throws across his body he fired a dart to courtland sutton for a first quarter score and calmly led two fourth quarter touchdown drives in the broncos road win over the panthers i want to believe it s a sign of better things to come but it sure feels like i ve been asked to watch grass grow michael penix s good doesn t outweigh his bad results right now an unfortunate reality for a quarterback whose successes have led me to believe he could grow into a star next gen stats insights via nfl pro tyler shough completed all three of his downfield attempts in the first half for 99 yards against the browns he doubled his downfield attempts to six in the second half and added two more in overtime completing two of those eight for 48 yards and a touchdown to clinch the win shough also recorded 51 rushing yards on 10 rushes including five scrambles for a career high 41 yards tier 5 drew lock s second start of the season ended in another win but he s dealing with elbow and oblique injuries leaving the seahawks qb situation in a somewhat tenuous state even though he s expected to play in week 10 it s not the best sign when j j mccarthy s exit and jameis winston s insertion into the game provides the giants with the spark they need to win i d like to chalk it up to the matchup with the eagles but i ll withhold harsher judgment on mccarthy for now nobody remembers the beginning when the ending is gripping but i refuse to allow a desperate final few minutes to occlude the fact that shedeur sanders was ineffective through the first three quarters of his start on sunday it was bad enough to wonder if backup dillon gabriel might be the better option until cleveland had no choice but to ask sanders to chuck it deep i ll credit sanders for hitting a few key passes in the final few minutes and overtime but those who believe that performance should inspire a quarterback controversy are simply clickbaiting gardner minshew s magic ran out in seattle on sunday he couldn t get anything going nor could the cardinals finish off a must have goal to go situation in the fourth quarter minshew might be out for the season with the elbow injury he suffered in the game setting up rookie carson beck s first start daniel jones made enough plays to help the colts climb back into sunday s contest against the cowboys he also ended indianapolis chances with yet another turnover next gen stats insights via nfl pro shedeur sanders completed three of his six downfield attempts for 154 yards and a touchdown against the saints with all six attempts occurring in the second half and overtime sanders fourth quarter deep pass to jerry jeudy set up a field goal attempt that sent the game to overtime sanders added 55 5 win probability on downfield attempts a career high mark tier 6 justin herbert ended his streak after going two games without a touchdown pass but he threw yet another interception against the texans malik willis best throw was wiped out on sunday by a holding penalty on rookie tight end will kacmarek it was a rough day for the quarterback who threw an interception and suffered a core muscle injury that landed him on injured reserve joe milton scrambled more often than i expected against the giants but largely looked like the inexperienced quarterback i expected to see joe fagnano s first start commanded attention on thursday night but he was no match for the jaguars defense baltimore s quick trade for jacoby brissett said everything we needed to know about the undrafted rookie like baltimore s move for brissett minnesota s trade for kirk cousins was entirely expected because of how poorly carson wentz played on monday night at one point in the second half he couldn t even complete simple passes on slants and out routes hopefully cousins can save this unit because wentz certainly wasn t up to the challenge next gen stats insights via nfl pro justin herbert completed 2 of 11 downfield passes 10 air yards for 66 yards and an interception in week 9 against the texans the fewest yards he has recorded on such throws in a game this season his 18 2 completion percentage on downfield passes is the second lowest of his career and he has now thrown an interception on a downfield pass in every game this season

news_mentions.headline: Bengals' Zac Taylor uncomfortable discussing nixed Arnold Ebiketie trade: 'It was on our end'
news_mentions.description: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor served as a proxy for director of player personnel Duke Tobin on Wednesday as he did his best to explain what went wrong in a trade with the Eagles on Tuesday falling through.
news_mentions.body_text: tuesday s trade deadline included a flurry of deals and one that fell apart the latter occurred between the cincinnati bengals and philadelphia eagles who reportedly had agreed to a trade that would send edge rusher arnold ebiketie to the bengals in exchange for a 2027 sixth round pick the proposed deal later fell through due to the team s compensatory picks formula the bengals would have lost a third round comp draft pick granted after trey hendrickson left in free agency for baltimore during this past offseason if the trade had been completed how the bengals arrived at this realization likely won t be revealed for some time but with wednesday s media availability came the guarantee somebody would be asked about the called off trade that somebody was head coach zac taylor who was also speaking on behalf of director of player personnel duke tobin duke was very explicit with me when he came and spoke to me about how he wanted this portrayed taylor began via espn i m not comfortable doing it but i m going to do what he asked we did make an effort to put some depth in there in place of the injured cashius howell as we got into it obviously it was going to be a little more costly than we initially anticipated he s really apologetic about it and wants to make clear that philly was a great trade partner it was on our end cincinnati s decision to back out of the trade prevented it from giving up sixth and third round picks for ebiketie who was a compensatory free agent signed by the eagles this offseason it also inspired plenty of speculation as to how such a deal reached that stage before draft capital catastrophe occurred i didn t even ask the question taylor said it doesn t really matter to me it probably took three minutes of my day yesterday away from watching tape got a lot of faith in how the front office operates and we ll just move forward with it this isn t the first time a proposed trade has fallen through for unusual reasons at the 2017 trade deadline an agreed upon deal between the browns and bengals to send quarterback a j mccarron to cleveland fell through because cleveland didn t file its paperwork before the 4 p m et deadline this one merely prevented the bengals from adding some depth while howell deals with a wrist injury in the grand scheme it likely won t matter much but when tobin has his next news conference it s safe to expect he ll be asked about it with tuesday s nixed trade off the table the bengals stood pat at the deadline choosing to proceed with their roster as currently constructed as the deadline drifted into the past taylor had one message left to deliver full steam and full confidence ahead certainly have a ton of confidence in our front office and how they do things taylor said they ve given us the players that have allowed us to be 6 2 right now and playing at such a high level we ll put that behind us and move forward and just get excited for this game on sunday and our locker room is in a great place right now

news_mentions.headline: NFL trade grades: Evaluating every deal made ahead of the 2026 deadline
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Kevin Patra grades every trade made since the start of the 2026 regular season until Tuesday's trade deadline.
news_mentions.body_text: the 2026 nfl trade deadline has come and gone nfl com s kevin patra breaks down every trade made since the start of the regular season downs gets his trade looks to bolster chiefs date of trade nov 10 kansas city receives wr josh downs 2027 seventh round draft pick grade b indianapolis receives 2027 fourth round draft pick 2027 fifth round draft pick grade b the chiefs needed wide receiver aid with zero wideouts hitting the 300 yard mark yet this season a 37 year old travis kelce still leads k c pass catchers no offense to the future hall of famer but that shouldn t happen rashee rice is a roller coaster and xavier worthy is inefficient to put it nicely and dealing with a hamstring injury tyquan thornton was their most explosive receiver until he suffered a gruesome dislocation a title contender couldn t continue with their bb style passing offense in comes downs who is better than his numbers 33 receptions for 354 yards touchdown this year suggest he can create separation out of the slot and provide run after catch the switch from daniel jones to patrick mahomes could unlock downs ability even more he should slide right in as a slot weapon for the chiefs and give mahomes a third down target when downs gets hot he s liable to gobble up catches in bunches it s been a frustrating season in indy for the receiver and a fresh start could boost his production heading into free agency it s not a game changing move but downs brings upside to a passing offense that lacks any mid range threat two mid round picks isn t nothing for a potential rental moment the texans upped their bid to a second in 2027 they pounced i don t fault arizona for moving on right now in four games in 2026 harrison caught five passes on 13 targets for 85 yards and one touchdown that s like a half of one game for the upper echelon of wrs harrison has generated 0 6 yards per route run this year the third lowest among players with at least 100 routes per next gen stats basically harrison has been doing little more than a cardio workout on sundays getting a second rounder is solid work the grade isn t higher because the same brass that acquired that asset used the no 4 overall pick on harrison in 2024 monti ossenfort still gets docked for whiffing on a prime selection i understand why the texans would take a swing on harrison like most of the league they probably gave the ohio state product a very high pre draft grade reuniting him with former buckeyes teammate c j stroud could bring out the best in the wideout the texans have struggled mightily to move the ball when nico collins has been injured and given collins history and the hard hits he takes he s not guaranteed to make it through the rest of the season without missing time after laying an egg for four weeks the 1 4 texans don t have any more wiggle room harrison s contract isn t onerous giving houston some insurance if tank dell never returns to form or jayden higgins is delayed next year coming off a season ending injury in the short term this trade is somewhat duplicative of the much cheaper deal in which it acquired kayshon boutte it s more costly but gives the club more control of the future mostly i don t love the price tag for a player who hasn t been who we thought he was for it to make sense to give up a day 2 pick the texans need harrison to finally break out after two mediocre seasons perhaps in improved surroundings and on a team that clearly wants him with a qb he knows and trusts harrison can blossom frankly i probably like many scouts can t figure out the disconnect between a player who looked as polished and well rounded as harrison did at osu and the one we ve seen lope about for two plus years the question is whether you believe the scouting or the two separate coaching staffs who haven t found much use for him the texans are betting on their scouting eagles send pro bowl ol to ravens date of trade oct 7 baltimore receives c cam jurgens 2027 seventh round draft pick grade b philadelphia receives 2027 fifth round draft pick 2028 second round draft pick grade a we should start with the obvious the two time pro bowler was available for a reason especially after the same offensive line saw a future hall of famer lane johnson retire the day prior jurgens is currently a pro bowler in name only after battling through a back injury in 2024 to help the eagles net a super bowl ring jurgens has not been the same player he struggled through last season and has been a liability through four games this year his pass blocking has never been otherworldly but it s particularly crumbled after he was asked to move to left guard the past three weeks blame the previous injuries or the ill fit in the eagles new blocking scheme but jurgens has been borderline unplayable the past few weeks drew kendall played better than jurgens at center in sean mannion s scheme so a move back wasn t in the cards it got so bad that nick sirianni was fending off questions about potentially benching the guard instead philly shipped him out of town we know that howie roseman doesn t care what year he gets his picks famously saying a first round pick is a first round pick regarding the a j brown trade this offseason when philly netted a 28 first however we can dock him ever so slightly for delayed satisfaction otherwise getting a second rounder for a struggling player who was not a fit is a home run in the short term the eagles offensive line is in flux with willie lampkin in line to take over at guard the hope is that landon dickerson returns to form when he eventually comes off injured reserve the trade is jarring coming right after johnson s retirement but getting a significant draft pick back for a player who was on the verge of being benched makes sense philly is now loaded in the 2028 draft with two firsts and two seconds even acknowledging jurgens significant struggles the play makes sense for the ravens the plans to replace tyler linderbaum who signed with the raiders in free agency this summer were wobbly from the start the ones they rode with danny pinter jovaughn gwyn and ethan pocic have all landed on injured reserve counting on pocic coming off injury was always a gamble the ravens crapped out instead of sticking with rookie olaivavega ioane out of position at center baltimore will take a roll of the dice that jurgens can get back to form it s not a terrible gamble and it s conceivable the 27 year old can bounce back with a return to center in a different scheme jurgens contract which has him under team control through 2029 for relatively cheap is also desirable for baltimore injury is always part of the equation and jurgens enters his time in baltimore in the league s concussion protocol nfl network s mike garafolo reported if he s healthy and returns to form this will be an excellent move for baltimore if he continues to struggle or misses a ton of time it will be the latest swing and miss in trying to replace linderbaum porter drama ends in trade to dallas date of trade oct 1 dallas receives cb joey porter grade a pittsburgh receives 2027 sixth round draft pick 2028 second round draft pick grade c the cowboys desperately needed corner help for a defense that has floundered despite the offseason upgrades i ll credit jerry jones for not sitting on his hands instead doing what we have been asking general managers to do for years be bold make moves and don t overvalue your own picks during a season we won t know if the trade pays off in the long term but the cowboys certainly improved in 2026 at his peak porter is a physical cover man who can be sticky on the outside and mirror top receivers he ll slide well into christian parker s scheme allowing dallas to play man coverage on the outside with more physicality than in the first three weeks sure he racks up some penalties but so do most cbs you ll live with the trade off for a corner with jpj s skill set that dallas didn t have to give up a premier pick until 2028 also improved its grade assuming that porter plays the cowboys get a top shelf cb for a relatively cheap up front cost jones seems to be hoping he can copy the success he had with the george pickens trade pushing off the long term talks until down the road it s a needle threading but one that could work if porter plays well dallas could extend him in the offseason use the franchise tag on the cb or let him walk and recoup a potential third round compensatory pick in 2028 possibly moving down one round in 28 and giving up a sixth rounder for a potential pro bowl player in a year when you re all in is a stellar move if porter delivers 14 games of high level play it s worth it of course if porter gets hurt or implodes this all goes for naught however if he continues on this track it is a short term win for the cowboys the long term question can be shelved i don t fault the steelers for not wanting to pay porter top cb money if he were seeking a 30 million type deal in line with christian gonzalez or devon witherspoon i would have balked too jpj is good he s not at that level trading him away relieved pittsburgh of that problem the issue i have is that it appears steelers gm omar khan either overplayed his hand or didn t anticipate porter s gumption when it came to a new deal if khan had never planned to meet the corner s contract demands he should have made a move in the spring or early summer a player of porter s caliber is worth more than a second round pick two drafts down the road the timing of the impasse reduced the compensation now the steelers are without a top corner and find themselves thin and young at the position not a good combo if things spiral in pittsburgh it s fair to wonder if khan will even be around to make that second round pick in 2028 the gm took over in 2022 and received early praise for fleecing the bears in the chase claypool trade that brought back a second rounder that pick became porter khan has now moved him for pennies on the dollar add in a string of so so drafts the pickens trade and other questionable moves and the seat in pittsburgh could get hot for khan if the steelers flounder giants trade for mccarthy after dart injury date of trade sept 28 new york receives qb j j mccarthy grade c minnesota receives 2027 fifth round draft pick grade c minnesota signaled its intent to move on from the former no 10 overall pick by inking kyler murray and bringing back carson wentz in the offseason mccarthy got a slim shot at the starting job during training camp but he couldn t even fend off wentz for the primary backup role a former first rounder turned clipboard holder is a bad look all around had another club made an offer of substance before the season i believe the vikings would have moved on then given mccarthy s rough preseason however it s no surprise it took an injury to a starting qb to move the needle a fifth rounder isn t nothing and the vikings save a few pennies however the reality is they turned a first fourth and late round pick swap into 10 starts and a future fifth rounder that math isn t mathing mccarthy s poor play and injury history left the vikings with no good options for a team in win now mode minnesota didn t have time to let the 23 year old develop on his terms moving on makes sense but the vikings can t get a high grade for the compensation new york took a shot that in a new setting and in an offense keyed on the ground attack john harbaugh and his staff can do what kevin o connell couldn t i don t hate the price for a former first round quarterback who even the stingiest draft graders pegged as a day 2 selection teams use fifth rounders and later as qb dart throws all the time the giants lack of 2027 picks is of concern but they can deal with that later with jaxson dart out for the regular season after knee surgery the giants needed to make some sort of move jameis winston has shown he can hold the fort for a spell but it s a serious question if harbaugh will give the boom or bust passer enough leash for a 15 game run bringing in mccarthy at least gives the giants another alternative if winston crumbles at this stage there aren t a whole lot of other options i m not optimistic that mccarthy can turn his career around but for a fifth round pick it s worth a shot for new york

news_mentions.headline: Week 10 NFL MVP tracker: Bengals' Joe Burrow leads race at midpoint of 2026 season
news_mentions.description: We've reached the midway point of the 2026 NFL season and with it comes a No. 1 in Kevin Patra's weekly MVP tracker. Who surpasses Josh Allen at the top?
news_mentions.body_text: we ve passed the halfway mark of the 2026 campaign and quarterbacks have officially fully taken over the mvp discussion we ve seen some ridiculously high level quarterback play recently from joe burrow dicing up defenses like a top chef on deadline to jordan love dive bombing opponents into oblivion this week i wanted to do something different with our mvp tracker we re going to highlight one play that illustrates why each qb is an mvp candidate sidenote before y all get madonline it s not necessarily the qb s best play of the season beyond that being wholly subjective i wanted to highlight traits that were indicative of their otherworldly play now let s get to the rankings mvp rankings note up down arrows below reflect movement from the week 9 edition next in line seahawks wr jaxon smith njigba bears qb caleb williams lions rb jahmyr gibbs chiefs rb kenneth walker lions qb jared goff voting for the 2026 nfl channel midseason awards is open viewers can scan the qr code displayed daily on nfl channel to access the voting page and make their selections

news_mentions.headline: Texans QB C.J. Stroud, Packers QB Jordan Love highlight Players of the Week
news_mentions.description: Green Bay quarterback Jordan Love and Houston signal-caller C.J. Stroud shined in Week 9 and earned top offensive accolades on Wednesday.
news_mentions.body_text: who were the nfl s top stars in week 9 each wednesday the league unveils its weekly honor roll see who the players of the week are below afc offensive player of the week stroud was a force on sunday lighting up the chargers during the texans runaway 44 22 victory the 2023 first rounder matched a career high set in his rookie campaign with five touchdown passes as he completed 21 of 35 throws 60 for 384 yards one interception and a 125 5 rating stroud earned his fifth career afc offensive player of the week with his first coming the first time he threw for five scores back in week 9 2023 nfc offensive player of the week love was outstanding in the packers 45 27 rout of the patriots rising into the mvp conversation love completed 79 3 of his 29 passes for 372 yards and three touchdowns he had four total tds adding a rushing score as well afc defensive player of the week the seven time pro bowler and now four time afc defensive player of the week awoke from a relatively quiet season with a stellar sunday in the chiefs 35 12 thumping of the jets jones posted four tackles two tackles for loss a pass breakup and two sacks prior to week 9 jones had half a sack on the season nfc defensive player of the week the no 5 overall pick in the 2026 nfl draft has been bestowed with his first accolade in what could be a first season filled with awards the ap nfl defensive rookie of the year contender piled up 12 tackles three sacks and a forced fumble as his giants delivered a 19 11 win sunday against the host eagles afc special teams player of the week owner of the two longest kicks in nfl history little didn t need to break out his big boot in thursday s win over the ravens however he braved the rainy elements to stack up 15 points in the 33 10 win little was perfect on seven kicks ending his busy night with three extra points in three tries and four field goals 36 yards 45 47 33 in just as many attempts this is little s second afc special teams player of the week honor his first was also in week 9 coming last year when he converted the longest field goal in league chronicle nfc special teams player of the week on an off day of sorts for the lions bates was perfectly efficient scoring 13 points in detroit s 19 9 win over the dolphins on sunday bates made his single extra point try and was good on each of his four field goal attempts

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Cardinals' Gardner Minshew likely needs season-ending elbow surgery; Carson Beck in line to start
news_mentions.description: Cardinals quarterback Gardner Minshew is seeking additional medical opinions to confirm that he will likely need season-ending surgery on a torn UCL in his throwing arm, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported.
news_mentions.body_text: round and round the arizona cardinals quarterback carousel goes gardner minshew is seeking additional medical opinions to confirm that he will need season ending surgery on a torn ucl in his throwing arm nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported minshew appeared to suffer the injury on a strip sack by dante fowler in the closing moments of the second quarter during sunday s 17 3 loss to the seattle seahawks he stayed in to finish out the game with 166 yards on 21 of 30 passing should minshew require surgery that puts him on the bench for the duration of the 2026 campaign third round rookie carson beck would be in line to start in week 10 against the los angeles rams and moving forward arizona also signed veteran josh johnson off the cincinnati bengals practice squad per schefter though two undrafted rookies have logged starts this season the tampa bay buccaneers jalon daniels and baltimore ravens joe fagnano beck would become the first signal caller from the 2026 draft class to make a start ahead of first rounders fernando mendoza las vegas raiders and ty simpson rams minshew s injury continues a period of constant change in arizona the cardinals completed a trade sending jacoby brissett the team s starter for the first eight games to the baltimore ravens on friday three days later they could be on to qb no 3 though it is a certainly an unorthodox path to giving the rookie a shot arizona currently sits at the bottom of the nfc west with a 3 6 record so it s beneficial at this point to see what the club has in beck who threw for 11 725 yards 88 touchdowns and 32 interceptions in a long college career that included five seasons at georgia and a final one with miami florida he appeared only in the pro football hall of fame game during the preseason due to injuries hampering him thereafter but he did shine in the one outing going 15 of 19 for 188 yards and a touchdown his next test will be far tougher perhaps the most unfriendly way one could be welcomed to the nfl with no 1 wide receiver michael wilson out for the rest of the season due to a neck injury beck will make his debut against the terrifying defensive line duo of aaron donald and myles garrett the latter of whom returned from injured reserve in week 9 with a three sack statement how he performs against l a and throughout the second half of the season could play a major factor in arizona s future qb plans

news_mentions.headline: Rams WR Puka Nacua likely to be placed on injured reserve with turf toe, sprained MCL and PCL
news_mentions.description: Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua is likely to be placed on injured reserve after suffering a turf toe injury and spraining his MCL and PCL in Sunday's 20-13 win over the Commanders, head coach Sean McVay said Monday.
news_mentions.body_text: the rams have lost another star to injury wide receiver puka nacua is likely to be placed on injured reserve after suffering a turf toe injury and spraining his mcl and pcl in sunday s 20 13 win over the commanders head coach sean mcvay said monday i m bummed for puka mcvay said i feel for him i feel for all of our players that are getting these kinds of injuries it s challenging but it s an opportunity for us to adjust and adapt the game s gonna be played but you feel for the players first and foremost nacua a two time pro bowler has 70 receptions for 715 yards and four touchdowns in seven games this season in the outing against washington he was targeted 19 times with 150 yards and a score on 14 catches this marks the latest in a lengthy list of ailments for nacua this season as he was affected by psoas soreness throughout training camp and sat weeks 2 and 3 due to a hip injury but the turf toe and knee sprain will lead to his longest absence yet nacua is set to join fellow star wideout davante adams hamstring on ir leaving the rams with a wr corps of tutu atwell konata mumpfield jordan whittington and cj daniels plus a tight end group of tyler higbee colby parkinson and davis allen that is frequently used in the passing attack it remains to be seen when tight end terrance ferguson might rejoin that group the most athletic with perhaps the highest ceiling of los angeles tight ends he initially was expected to come off ir for week 9 after recovering from an ankle injury only to hurt his hamstring during friday s practice though l a has dealt with the absence of many big names on both sides of the ball nacua missing extended time will prove especially detrimental to a rams offense that hasn t clicked at all times in 2026 over the past two games matthew stafford has thrown for 385 yards two touchdowns and two interceptions hardly looking like the mvp quarterback he was in 2025 and lacking other difference making pass catchers becoming laser focused on nacua to keep things moving nacua saw a 48 target share in week 8 against the chargers and a 44 2 share on sunday meaning the rams will have to compensate for nearly half of their recent passing offense now gone should nacua go on ir as mcvay expressed is likely he will miss the next four games plus a bye week against the cardinals packers chiefs and 49ers before being eligible to return in week 15 against the cowboys

With training camps in full swing across the NFL, Kevin Patra spotlights the most interesting developments for all 32 teams.
