news_mentions.headline: NFL QB rankings, Week 10: Joe Burrow climbs to No. 1; Caleb Williams slides
news_mentions.description: Who joins Joe Burrow as a riser in Nick Shook's QB rankings at midseason? Check out the updated pecking order, 1-32, heading into Week 10.
news_mentions.body_text: notes up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 9 qb index stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl tier 1 it s time we insert joe burrow into the mvp conversation he s an outrageously efficient and daring quarterback who is powering one of the most explosive offenses in the nfl if the bengals mount a deep playoff run he ll be the face of it he might also become the face of the league s quarterbacks the one spot drop is no knock on josh allen whose ability to win in the margins enabled buffalo to leave minneapolis with a major victory on monday night allen did the special things he usually does to help the bills survive the brian flores defense and should be proud of the performance even if it wasn t his most statistically impressive game of the season no quarterback in the nfl is currently more in sync with his receivers than jordan love it makes sense green bay has asked him to carry the offense all season long that s bad for opponents because the additional reps have helped love settle into a rhythm that makes for appointment viewing each week christian watson s career best pace isn t happening by accident the texans were able to enjoy a spectacular c j stroud performance in week 9 he s produced plenty of them this season and could find himself in the mvp conversation if houston can turn around its season brock purdy has thrown three interceptions in his last two games but his positive contributions vastly outweigh the negative he s becoming an entertaining quarterback when operating out of structure like when he scrambled for a touchdown largely because the raiders apparently decided they d rather prevent a pass than tackle him purdy happily took that gift and will have yet another new receiver trade acquisition keenan allen to learn this week trevor lawrence started last thursday night on a heater throwing a beautiful seam ball to parker washington for a touchdown lawrence didn t need to do much else for the jaguars to cruise to victory he s in command of the offense and should be expected to remain in this tier for the foreseeable future as part of one of the nfl s best squads next gen stats insights via nfl pro c j stroud completed 10 of 16 passes between 10 and 19 yards downfield for 254 yards five touchdowns and an interception in week 9 against the chargers it s the only game in which a quarterback has thrown five touchdowns targeting the intermediate level since at least 2016 and the third most yards recorded by a quarterback on such throws in that span tier 2 detroit s win in miami was ugly and made for an unexpectedly difficult outing for jared goff who had a hard time finding open windows against miami s scrappy defense he threw an interception on a play in which his arm was hit as he released the ball narrowly missed being responsible for an earlier turnover and threw for just 170 yards in the low scoring triumph i m not ready to say he s developing a turnover issue he had not thrown a pick prior to week 8 but as head coach dan campbell intimated at halftime on sunday the lions need to get going offensively what happens when you throw four interceptions in a prime time game you fall a tier in the qb index that s what caleb williams did on sunday night struggling against tampa bay s relentless blitzes it s not all on him chicago s running game has largely disappeared of late but after looking superhuman at times in 2026 williams was very mortal on sunday patrick mahomes on the other hand might actually be superhuman a gruesome hit to his throwing arm sent every chiefs fan into panic mode but somehow mahomes shook it off and calmly led the chiefs to a runaway win by completing 23 of 31 passes for 242 yards and two touchdowns against the jets he s also welcoming slot receiver josh downs via trade this week i m eager to see how downs improves kansas city s passing attack the cowboys escaped indianapolis with a win in a weird game that saw dak prescott do what he does best air it out his 335 yard two touchdown performance was crucial to dallas winning efforts they ll need that and more against san francisco this week matthew stafford isn t playing anywhere near the caliber of his mvp 2025 season and still makes a head scratching throw or two per game he s just not as sharp as he s been in the past but he s also a primary reason the rams have stacked a few wins i worry about how he ll fare without the injured puka nacua going forward though next gen stats insights via nfl pro dak prescott completed 8 of 11 passes against man coverage for a season high 181 yards and two touchdowns in week 9 against the colts prescott connected with ceedee lamb on four passes for 95 yards and a touchdown against man coverage the fourth most yards the duo has recorded against man in a single game prescott completed 13 of 23 passes for 154 yards against zone coverage in the game tier 3 drake maye has a turnover problem again spending sunday throwing a couple of meatball subs to packers defenders and burying his team he s trusting his arm too much at times and looks uncomfortable in other instances but he s also playing without a couple of top pass catching options it s been an up and down year for maye no doubt bryce young the most volatile member of the qb index in 2026 is back on the rise after entering a flow state that powered a panthers comeback against the broncos he nearly positioned carolina to take an eight point second half lead before fate had different ideas young threw a wacky interception that was more a result of the defensive play made and the spheroid that is a football than a mistake by young the turnover stopped the panthers momentum in its tracks though young did his best to throw them back into the game in the fourth quarter but fumbled away their last chance ending a roller coaster of a day that fits his season kirk cousins swan song with the raiders wasn t quite as bad as the final stat line suggested yes he threw three interceptions and yes he appeared to lack the arm strength to complete a couple of highly ambitious attempts but he also played well enough to help the raiders momentarily climb back into a chaotic affair versus the niners now that he s a viking he s moving back to minneapolis with expectations of becoming a hero for the dreadful minnesota offense raiders fans will remember him as the capable veteran who guided the offense admirably in the first nine weeks under head coach klint kubiak geno smith helped the jets battle with the chiefs for a half on sunday before succumbing to steve spagnuolo s defense which feels appropriate given how gang green s season is going can cam ward build on his excellent week 8 showing following tennessee s bye will aaron rodgers be needed to power the steelers offense beyond a few key completions each week the second half should answer both of these questions for us next gen stats insights via nfl pro bryce young completed 28 of 39 passes for 276 yards with three touchdowns and an interception in week 9 against the broncos young went 13 of 14 for 152 yards and a touchdown on throws targeting in breaking routes young has thrown for 1 127 yards on in breaking routes this season the most among all quarterbacks tier 4 the buccaneers finally needed baker mayfield to throw the ball on sunday night a responsibility he embraced by launching a beautiful strike to tez johnson as part of tampa bay s comeback efforts unfortunately mayfield also threw two interceptions illustrating how his return from injury hasn t exactly been the smoothest experience tyler shough represented one half of a low output afternoon in the superdome on sunday until desperation set in against cleveland shough rediscovered his clutch gene at the perfect time and dropped a collection of dimes on the likes of chris olave and juwan johnson in the saints overtime win i ll be tracking him closely to see how he continues to develop a rapport with rookie jordyn tyson jayden daniels still makes plays that remind us of why he became an instant star as a rookie but he s also struggling with game management he doesn t seem to understand that he can t afford to throw the ball in the middle of the field with mere seconds remaining in a comeback effort and his offensive line didn t make matters any easier for him against a rams front that finally enjoyed the combined efforts of myles garrett three sacks and aaron donald bo nix is crawling yes crawling back toward where he was last season on sunday he included a few rollouts and throws across his body he fired a dart to courtland sutton for a first quarter score and calmly led two fourth quarter touchdown drives in the broncos road win over the panthers i want to believe it s a sign of better things to come but it sure feels like i ve been asked to watch grass grow michael penix s good doesn t outweigh his bad results right now an unfortunate reality for a quarterback whose successes have led me to believe he could grow into a star next gen stats insights via nfl pro tyler shough completed all three of his downfield attempts in the first half for 99 yards against the browns he doubled his downfield attempts to six in the second half and added two more in overtime completing two of those eight for 48 yards and a touchdown to clinch the win shough also recorded 51 rushing yards on 10 rushes including five scrambles for a career high 41 yards tier 5 drew lock s second start of the season ended in another win but he s dealing with elbow and oblique injuries leaving the seahawks qb situation in a somewhat tenuous state even though he s expected to play in week 10 it s not the best sign when j j mccarthy s exit and jameis winston s insertion into the game provides the giants with the spark they need to win i d like to chalk it up to the matchup with the eagles but i ll withhold harsher judgment on mccarthy for now nobody remembers the beginning when the ending is gripping but i refuse to allow a desperate final few minutes to occlude the fact that shedeur sanders was ineffective through the first three quarters of his start on sunday it was bad enough to wonder if backup dillon gabriel might be the better option until cleveland had no choice but to ask sanders to chuck it deep i ll credit sanders for hitting a few key passes in the final few minutes and overtime but those who believe that performance should inspire a quarterback controversy are simply clickbaiting gardner minshew s magic ran out in seattle on sunday he couldn t get anything going nor could the cardinals finish off a must have goal to go situation in the fourth quarter minshew might be out for the season with the elbow injury he suffered in the game setting up rookie carson beck s first start daniel jones made enough plays to help the colts climb back into sunday s contest against the cowboys he also ended indianapolis chances with yet another turnover next gen stats insights via nfl pro shedeur sanders completed three of his six downfield attempts for 154 yards and a touchdown against the saints with all six attempts occurring in the second half and overtime sanders fourth quarter deep pass to jerry jeudy set up a field goal attempt that sent the game to overtime sanders added 55 5 win probability on downfield attempts a career high mark tier 6 justin herbert ended his streak after going two games without a touchdown pass but he threw yet another interception against the texans malik willis best throw was wiped out on sunday by a holding penalty on rookie tight end will kacmarek it was a rough day for the quarterback who threw an interception and suffered a core muscle injury that landed him on injured reserve joe milton scrambled more often than i expected against the giants but largely looked like the inexperienced quarterback i expected to see joe fagnano s first start commanded attention on thursday night but he was no match for the jaguars defense baltimore s quick trade for jacoby brissett said everything we needed to know about the undrafted rookie like baltimore s move for brissett minnesota s trade for kirk cousins was entirely expected because of how poorly carson wentz played on monday night at one point in the second half he couldn t even complete simple passes on slants and out routes hopefully cousins can save this unit because wentz certainly wasn t up to the challenge next gen stats insights via nfl pro justin herbert completed 2 of 11 downfield passes 10 air yards for 66 yards and an interception in week 9 against the texans the fewest yards he has recorded on such throws in a game this season his 18 2 completion percentage on downfield passes is the second lowest of his career and he has now thrown an interception on a downfield pass in every game this season

news_mentions.headline: NFL trade grades: Evaluating every deal made ahead of the 2026 deadline
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Kevin Patra grades every trade made since the start of the 2026 regular season until Tuesday's trade deadline.
news_mentions.body_text: the 2026 nfl trade deadline has come and gone nfl com s kevin patra breaks down every trade made since the start of the regular season downs gets his trade looks to bolster chiefs date of trade nov 10 kansas city receives wr josh downs 2027 seventh round draft pick grade b indianapolis receives 2027 fourth round draft pick 2027 fifth round draft pick grade b the chiefs needed wide receiver aid with zero wideouts hitting the 300 yard mark yet this season a 37 year old travis kelce still leads k c pass catchers no offense to the future hall of famer but that shouldn t happen rashee rice is a roller coaster and xavier worthy is inefficient to put it nicely and dealing with a hamstring injury tyquan thornton was their most explosive receiver until he suffered a gruesome dislocation a title contender couldn t continue with their bb style passing offense in comes downs who is better than his numbers 33 receptions for 354 yards touchdown this year suggest he can create separation out of the slot and provide run after catch the switch from daniel jones to patrick mahomes could unlock downs ability even more he should slide right in as a slot weapon for the chiefs and give mahomes a third down target when downs gets hot he s liable to gobble up catches in bunches it s been a frustrating season in indy for the receiver and a fresh start could boost his production heading into free agency it s not a game changing move but downs brings upside to a passing offense that lacks any mid range threat two mid round picks isn t nothing for a potential rental but it s the going rate for no 2 receivers seattle paid the same price for rashid shaheed last year depending on how the rest of the season goes the chiefs could re sign downs in the offseason or he moment the texans upped their bid to a second in 2027 they pounced i don t fault arizona for moving on right now in four games in 2026 harrison caught five passes on 13 targets for 85 yards and one touchdown that s like a half of one game for the upper echelon of wrs harrison has generated 0 6 yards per route run this year the third lowest among players with at least 100 routes per next gen stats basically harrison has been doing little more than a cardio workout on sundays getting a second rounder is solid work the grade isn t higher because the same brass that acquired that asset used the no 4 overall pick on harrison in 2024 monti ossenfort still gets docked for whiffing on a prime selection i understand why the texans would take a swing on harrison like most of the league they probably gave the ohio state product a very high pre draft grade reuniting him with former buckeyes teammate c j stroud could bring out the best in the wideout the texans have struggled mightily to move the ball when nico collins has been injured and given collins history and the hard hits he takes he s not guaranteed to make it through the rest of the season without missing time after laying an egg for four weeks the 1 4 texans don t have any more wiggle room harrison s contract isn t onerous giving houston some insurance if tank dell never returns to form or jayden higgins is delayed next year coming off a season ending injury in the short term this trade is somewhat duplicative of the much cheaper deal in which it acquired kayshon boutte it s more costly but gives the club more control of the future mostly i don t love the price tag for a player who hasn t been who we thought he was for it to make sense to give up a day 2 pick the texans need harrison to finally break out after two mediocre seasons perhaps in improved surroundings and on a team that clearly wants him with a qb he knows and trusts harrison can blossom frankly i probably like many scouts can t figure out the disconnect between a player who looked as polished and well rounded as harrison did at osu and the one we ve seen lope about for two plus years the question is whether you believe the scouting or the two separate coaching staffs who haven t found much use for him the texans are betting on their scouting eagles send pro bowl ol to ravens date of trade oct 7 baltimore receives c cam jurgens 2027 seventh round draft pick grade b philadelphia receives 2027 fifth round draft pick 2028 second round draft pick grade a we should start with the obvious the two time pro bowler was available for a reason especially after the same offensive line saw a future hall of famer lane johnson retire the day prior jurgens is currently a pro bowler in name only after battling through a back injury in 2024 to help the eagles net a super bowl ring jurgens has not been the same player he struggled through last season and has been a liability through four games this year his pass blocking has never been otherworldly but it s particularly crumbled after he was asked to move to left guard the past three weeks blame the previous injuries or the ill fit in the eagles new blocking scheme but jurgens has been borderline unplayable the past few weeks drew kendall played better than jurgens at center in sean mannion s scheme so a move back wasn t in the cards it got so bad that nick sirianni was fending off questions about potentially benching the guard instead philly shipped him out of town we know that howie roseman doesn t care what year he gets his picks famously saying a first round pick is a first round pick regarding the a j brown trade this offseason when philly netted a 28 first however we can dock him ever so slightly for delayed satisfaction otherwise getting a second rounder for a struggling player who was not a fit is a home run in the short term the eagles offensive line is in flux with willie lampkin in line to take over at guard the hope is that landon dickerson returns to form when he eventually comes off injured reserve the trade is jarring coming right after johnson s retirement but getting a significant draft pick back for a player who was on the verge of being benched makes sense philly is now loaded in the 2028 draft with two firsts and two seconds even acknowledging jurgens significant struggles the play makes sense for the ravens the plans to replace tyler linderbaum who signed with the raiders in free agency this summer were wobbly from the start the ones they rode with danny pinter jovaughn gwyn and ethan pocic have all landed on injured reserve counting on pocic coming off injury was always a gamble the ravens crapped out instead of sticking with rookie olaivavega ioane out of position at center baltimore will take a roll of the dice that jurgens can get back to form it s not a terrible gamble and it s conceivable the 27 year old can bounce back with a return to center in a different scheme jurgens contract which has him under team control through 2029 for relatively cheap is also desirable for baltimore injury is always part of the equation and jurgens enters his time in baltimore in the league s concussion protocol nfl network s mike garafolo reported if he s healthy and returns to form this will be an excellent move for baltimore if he continues to struggle or misses a ton of time it will be the latest swing and miss in trying to replace linderbaum porter drama ends in trade to dallas date of trade oct 1 dallas receives cb joey porter grade a pittsburgh receives 2027 sixth round draft pick 2028 second round draft pick grade c the cowboys desperately needed corner help for a defense that has floundered despite the offseason upgrades i ll credit jerry jones for not sitting on his hands instead doing what we have been asking general managers to do for years be bold make moves and don t overvalue your own picks during a season we won t know if the trade pays off in the long term but the cowboys certainly improved in 2026 at his peak porter is a physical cover man who can be sticky on the outside and mirror top receivers he ll slide well into christian parker s scheme allowing dallas to play man coverage on the outside with more physicality than in the first three weeks sure he racks up some penalties but so do most cbs you ll live with the trade off for a corner with jpj s skill set that dallas didn t have to give up a premier pick until 2028 also improved its grade assuming that porter plays the cowboys get a top shelf cb for a relatively cheap up front cost jones seems to be hoping he can copy the success he had with the george pickens trade pushing off the long term talks until down the road it s a needle threading but one that could work if porter plays well dallas could extend him in the offseason use the franchise tag on the cb or let him walk and recoup a potential third round compensatory pick in 2028 possibly moving down one round in 28 and giving up a sixth rounder for a potential pro bowl player in a year when you re all in is a stellar move if porter delivers 14 games of high level play it s worth it of course if porter gets hurt or implodes this all goes for naught however if he continues on this track it is a short term win for the cowboys the long term question can be shelved i don t fault the steelers for not wanting to pay porter top cb money if he were seeking a 30 million type deal in line with christian gonzalez or devon witherspoon i would have balked too jpj is good he s not at that level trading him away relieved pittsburgh of that problem the issue i have is that it appears steelers gm omar khan either overplayed his hand or didn t anticipate porter s gumption when it came to a new deal if khan had never planned to meet the corner s contract demands he should have made a move in the spring or early summer a player of porter s caliber is worth more than a second round pick two drafts down the road the timing of the impasse reduced the compensation now the steelers are without a top corner and find themselves thin and young at the position not a good combo if things spiral in pittsburgh it s fair to wonder if khan will even be around to make that second round pick in 2028 the gm took over in 2022 and received early praise for fleecing the bears in the chase claypool trade that brought back a second rounder that pick became porter khan has now moved him for pennies on the dollar add in a string of so so drafts the pickens trade and other questionable moves and the seat in pittsburgh could get hot for khan if the steelers flounder giants trade for mccarthy after dart injury date of trade sept 28 new york receives qb j j mccarthy grade c minnesota receives 2027 fifth round draft pick grade c minnesota signaled its intent to move on from the former no 10 overall pick by inking kyler murray and bringing back carson wentz in the offseason mccarthy got a slim shot at the starting job during training camp but he couldn t even fend off wentz for the primary backup role a former first rounder turned clipboard holder is a bad look all around had another club made an offer of substance before the season i believe the vikings would have moved on then given mccarthy s rough preseason however it s no surprise it took an injury to a starting qb to move the needle a fifth rounder isn t nothing and the vikings save a few pennies however the reality is they turned a first fourth and late round pick swap into 10 starts and a future fifth rounder that math isn t mathing mccarthy s poor play and injury history left the vikings with no good options for a team in win now mode minnesota didn t have time to let the 23 year old develop on his terms moving on makes sense but the vikings can t get a high grade for the compensation new york took a shot that in a new setting and in an offense keyed on the ground attack john harbaugh and his staff can do what kevin o connell couldn t i don t hate the price for a former first round quarterback who even the stingiest draft graders pegged as a day 2 selection teams use fifth rounders and later as qb dart throws all the time the giants lack of 2027 picks is of concern but they can deal with that later with jaxson dart out for the regular season after knee surgery the giants needed to make some sort of move jameis winston has shown he can hold the fort for a spell but it s a serious question if harbaugh will give the boom or bust passer enough leash for a 15 game run bringing in mccarthy at least gives the giants another alternative if winston crumbles at this stage there aren t a whole lot of other options i m not optimistic that mccarthy can turn his career around but for a fifth round pick it s worth a shot for new york

news_mentions.headline: NFL trade deadline winners, losers: Vikings find QB, Jags go all-in, Jonathan Taylor stranded
news_mentions.body_text: the nfl 39 s trade deadline came and went with six deals unfolding tuesday those transactions brought this year 39 s total of in season trades to 18 a slight dip from last year 39 s 22 moves some teams bolstered their immediate outlook and enter the second half of the season with genuine playoff optimism others shifted focus toward the future stockpiling assets to reshape their rosters in the coming offseason a third group however watched opportunities pass them by destined to either suffer from their own inaction or the aggressiveness of their rivals here 39 s a look at some of the biggest winners and losers from the 2026 nfl trade deadline winners jacksonville jaguars jaguars brass approached the deadline determined to acquire defensive playmakers they emerged with massive defensive lineman jordan davis from the philadelphia eagles pro bowl safety jessie bates from the atlanta falcons and defensive tackle davon godchaux from the new orleans saints some questioned the price jacksonville paid for davis a 2027 first round pick and a 2029 second round selection but the jaguars believe they have a special team that additions like davis can elevate into legitimate super bowl contenders minnesota vikings the vikings have a championship caliber defense their offense however has fallen flat with kyler murray delivering subpar results and carson wentz proving disastrous now the vikings welcome back kirk cousins who posted a 50 37 1 record with two playoff appearances and three pro bowl nods during his first stint in minnesota from 2018 to 2023 all pro wide receiver justin jefferson goes from exasperated to optimistic as the signal caller who has thrown him 28 touchdowns returns if cousins can elevate an offense that ranked among the league 39 s worst despite boasting skill position talent minnesota could mount a super bowl charge chicago bears general manager ryan poles and coach ben johnson entered the season with a potent offense and an impactful defense landing defensive tackle jeffery simmons adds a difference maker to that unit and opens the door for all kinds of creativity under coordinator dennis allen philadelphia eagles general manager howie roseman began his wheeling and dealing last month nbsp by nbsp trading nbsp center cam jurgens to the baltimore ravens for a 2027 fifth round pick and a 2028 second round pick this week roseman couldn 39 t pass up the haul he received from the jaguars for davis the eagles now have 10 picks in the 2027 nfl draft highlighted by two first rounders a second a third a fourth three fifths a sixth and a seventh their 2028 haul features two firsts and seconds as well as philadelphia 39 s standard picks in rounds three through seven in 2029 they have eight selections a first rounder two seconds and one selection in each of the remaining rounds baltimore ravens the october acquisition of jurgens from the eagles met a need then last week baltimore filled a gaping hole at quarterback by trading for quarterback jacoby brissett they 39 re hoping the 11 year veteran can keep them afloat in case lamar jackson returns from thumb surgery in time for a late season playoff run kansas city chiefs wide receiver has ranked among the chiefs 39 weaknesses so former indianapolis colt josh downs should help improve that unit the fourth year man has 33 catches for 354 yards and a touchdown this season his best season came in 2024 when he had 72 catches for 803 yards and five touchdowns indianapolis colts owner carlie irsay gordon saw the writing on the wall and began dismantling this year 39 s team after firing general manager chris ballard she then directed the stockpiling of resources for a rebuild between the trades of guard quenton nelson seattle seahawks defensive tackle deforest buckner and wide receiver keenan allen san francisco 49ers and downs chiefs the colts added a third two fourths two fifths and a sixth for players on expiring deals san francisco 49ers the 49ers were already championship contenders but they used the trade window to fortify areas of weakness first they bolstered their defensive front by acquiring buckner from the colts last week they called indianapolis again in recent days orchestrating a deal for allen to join an injury ravaged wide receiver room fernando mendoza the no 1 pick in the 2026 nfl draft waited patiently as cousins led the las vegas raiders 4 5 to a more competitive start than many anticipated but with the vikings in desperate need of competent quarterback play the raiders couldn 39 t pass up a 2027 third round pick for the 38 year old las vegas now turns to mendoza for the second half of the season and beyond in one relief appearance mendoza completed six of eight passes for 48 yards he 39 ll aim to apply all of the lessons gained from watching cousins while attempting to keep the raiders 39 season alive losers nfc north foes despite the vikings 39 ferocious defense putrid quarterback play left the door open for the bears detroit lions and green bay packers to contend for division supremacy now that minnesota has reunited with cousins jefferson wide receiver jordan addison and tight end t j hockenson should go back to delivering game changing performances the run game should improve too the road to the nfc north crown just got more difficult los angeles chargers the winless chargers had a chance to unload veterans with expiring deals instead their only move was trading 26 year old linebacker daiyan henley to the denver broncos for a 2027 fourth round pick and a 2028 fifth round selection khalil mack could have helped a team in the postseason hunt not only did los angeles forfeit the chance to acquire draft capital but the 35 year old pass rusher also lost out on playing for a contender jonathan taylor amid another lost colts season it looked as though the team 39 s workhorse back would join a club with championship aspirations however indianapolis stood pat since none of the suitors were willing to meet its steep asking price though he 39 s been one of the most productive backs since entering the nfl in 2020 taylor has played in one playoff game 2020 over his seven year career kyler murray the former no 1 overall pick hoped a change of scenery and guidance from offensive minded coach kevin o 39 connell would rejuvenate his career murray 39 s starting quarterback tenure lasted just six games with injuries and an inability to adapt to o 39 connell 39 s system leading to poor production now murray will back up cousins who gives minnesota a pro bowl caliber quarterback and hope for a super bowl push washington commanders hope is fading fast for the 2 5 1 commanders and general manager adam peters opted against making any trades part of the problem was that washington had few bargaining chips after season ending injuries to wide receiver terry mclaurin and defensive tackle daron payne this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Chiefs acquire Colts WR Josh Downs ahead of trade deadline
news_mentions.description: The Chiefs are acquiring Josh Downs and a 2027 seventh-round pick from the Colts in exchange for a 2027 fourth-round selection and a 2027 fifth-rounder, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported on Tuesday.
news_mentions.body_text: josh downs wish has been granted and a need has been answered in kansas city the chiefs are acquiring the slot receiver in a trade with the colts nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported kansas city is sending fourth and fifth round picks in the 2027 draft to indianapolis in the deal while receiving a 2027 seventh round pick in exchange per rapoport and schefter indianapolis announced the trade shortly after downs becomes the fourth player traded by the colts prior to tuesday s deadline joining the likes of guard quenton nelson defensive tackle deforest buckner and fellow receiver keenan allen who was traded to san francisco earlier tuesday i am beyond grateful and blessed for my time in indy downs wrote on social media following news of the trade nothing but love for the shoe a third round pick out of north carolina in 2023 downs became a reliable secondary receiving option in indianapolis pairing with michael pittman and eventually alec pierce to form a quality pass catching tandem for the colts despite instability under center he posted a career high 803 receiving yards and five touchdowns in 14 games in 2024 but watched indianapolis trade pittman to pittsburgh and hand pierce the lucrative extension downs desired over the offseason leaving downs in an awkward spot entering a contract year that contract year became a nightmare for the colts prompting downs to request a trade following two deals that shipped nelson to seattle and buckner to san francisco indianapolis didn t initially adhere to his request and coach shane steichen convinced downs to continue participating following the receiver s ask to be dealt but after two games played the colts decided it was time to maximize whatever return was available for the receiver especially as free agency loomed in early 2027 downs heads to kansas city to join a receiver room that is headlined by rashee rice who returned from injury in week 8 and helped improve kansas city s passing attack but is short at the position following xavier worthy s hamstring injury suffered in the chiefs week 9 win over the new york jets and if we re being honest the chiefs have long needed help at receiver making them a likely candidate to swing a deal for a receiver even before worthy s latest injury with downs now in the mix patrick mahomes will have another option to turn to as he surveys the field indianapolis meanwhile concludes a remarkably active trade window in which they dealt four players but held onto the most recognizable one running back jonathan taylor when the colts fired general manager chris ballard and sent out expiring mainstays like nelson and buckner it was clear the organization was willing to engage in a fire sale in order to jump start a rebuild as a star runner at nearly 28 years old taylor was seen as the most valuable asset in such a teardown and was understandably attracting plenty of interest from rb needy contenders despite these market forces encouraging a blockbuster trade when the 4 p m et deadline passed on tuesday taylor remained a colt indianapolis will finish 2026 with taylor remaining at the center of its offense and perhaps entertain a trade following the conclusion of the current campaign

news_mentions.headline: Colts trade WR Keenan Allen to 49ers for 2027 sixth-round pick
news_mentions.description: The San Francisco 49ers are acquiring veteran wide receiver Keenan Allen from the Indianapolis Colts in exchange for a 2027 sixth-round draft pick, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported on Tuesday.
news_mentions.body_text: the san francisco 49ers have added another veteran for their ailing wide receiver room the niners acquired keenan allen from the colts in exchange for a 2027 sixth round pick indianapolis announced tuesday ahead of the trade deadline nfl network and espn first reported the news allen signed in indy in august to help a banged up receiver corps now he s being shipped west to aid another the first of two wideouts indy dealt on tuesday as josh downs was later sent to kansas city in eight games this season allen has generated 40 catches for 351 yards and a touchdown the longtime los angeles chargers star who earned six pro bowls in l a isn t as steady as he once was but the 34 year old still knows how to run a route and can be counted on for third downs allen has become something of a nomad in the past few years after his pro bowl 2023 season he was traded to chicago for a fourth round pick he then returned to l a in 2025 this year deep into the summer he latched onto shane steichen s squad in 14 seasons allen has generated 12 402 yards on 1 095 catches with 71 tds he might not be the allen of old but he brings reliability to a decimated 49ers wr room still without mike evans rib achilles and deebo samuel hamstring jordan watkins was brock purdy s top target last week and the niners have been seeing significant snaps from demarcus robinson brandin cooks and jacob cowing the addition of allen gives the 49ers the nfl s active leader in wr receptions allen the nfl s active leader in wr receiving yards evans 13 472 yards the nfl s active leader in rb receptions receiving yards and receiving tds christian mccaffrey 662 catches for 5 660 yards and 37 tds and the second ranked active te in receiving touchdowns george kittle 57 behind only travis kelce 84 per nfl research

news_mentions.headline: Bills-Vikings on 'Monday Night Football': What We Learned from Buffalo's 23-6 win over Minnesota
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Bobby Kownack breaks down the Bills' victory over the Vikings on Monday night.
news_mentions.body_text: allen weathers minnesota s blitz for win the league s no 1 scoring offense faced off against the no 1 scoring defense on monday night and for most of the first half the defense won soundly vikings defensive coordinator brian flores did his thing sending blitzers screaming toward josh allen with reckless abandon to great success through buffalo s first six drives which netted the bills 63 yards three points and an interception allen went 4 of 9 for 31 yards an interception and a 13 9 passer rating against the blitz he was pressured on seven of those dropbacks facing a blitz and sacked thrice and at times seemed capable only of chucking it deep in the face of a relentless rush but as time went on the bills began to get to the vikings both through a shorter hitting offense and perhaps mentally as buffalo erased any good minnesota s defense did by dominating its outclassed offense the bills gutted out an eight play 80 yard drive on their seventh possession allen finished it by dancing around for 6 07 seconds per next gen stats before heaving a 25 yard touchdown strike to a wide open keleki latu the tight end s first target of the season and first score of his career in a sense that s exactly how the bills won they waited out and wore out the vikings defense during a grueling night winning the time of possession battle 42 32 to 17 28 james cook jumped from 33 yards on 15 carries at halftime to 107 yards and a score on 31 totes by game s end while allen added 112 yards on his 11 second half throws after managing only 122 over his first 20 the vikings defense didn t do much wrong they just couldn t do everything right all night without a semblance of help on the other side wentz disaster class wastes flores masterclass kyler murray s hamstring injury opened up the possibility that carson wentz might step up in prime time and prove himself a more effective quarterback for minnesota s offense which had struggled to find much traction under the two time pro bowler he did the exact opposite of that ridding vikings fans of any notion that there was a qb on the bench who represented a better option facing the 30th ranked defense against the pass wentz delivered a miserable performance he missed pass catchers short high and wide he threw one interception deep to t j hockenson where only bills linebacker dorian williams could catch it and another one directly to lb terrel bernard while trying to hit justin jefferson he went 3 of 8 on short throws 0 9 yards air yards and 3 of 13 on anything deeper than that finishing 8 of 25 overall for 81 yards and an 8 9 passer rating the lowest by any qb to attempt at least 25 passes in a game since sam darnold s 3 6 passer rating during his 2019 seeing ghosts outing per nfl research despite all that minnesota s tremendous defense kept it to a one possession game until 6 17 remained a two play first quarter sequence perhaps most accurately represents how brutally wentz offset his team s defensive efforts byron murphy made a stellar interception playing center field on a josh allen end zone prayer to kill buffalo s second drive he even returned it to midfield to put wentz and co on the doorstep of field goal range instead on the very next snap wentz carelessly whipped a wide receiver screen to jefferson that went both backward and too high jefferson couldn t corral it and the bills recovered the fumble to get the ball right back that set the tone for a most disappointing day the qb position has been a massive problem for the vikings in 2026 they overcame it in their first six games but an inept offense has now cost them two straight they must fix it either in house or before the trade deadline before it s too late arrow pointing up for buffalo s defense it s been a rare occurrence this season but the bills d won them the game they completely overwhelmed minnesota and while it s fair to point to the vikings ranking 29th in yards entering week 9 it s nevertheless impressive to hold them to their fewest yards of the season even with an offense that had struggled to play its part opposite the league s best defense the vikings hadn t yet failed to eclipse 200 yards in a game they only hit 178 against the bills and that s counting a 52 yard drive led by third stringer max brosmer with the result already decided for all of the talk about minnesota s pass rush buffalo actually had a better pressure percentage against carson wentz 42 3 than the vikings did on josh allen 37 1 and did so despite blitzing on only 11 5 of wentz dropbacks antithetical to the aggressive much hyped vikes defensive approach and with better results as allen and co took time to find holes to exploit the bills defense poked them in minnesota s offensive game plan all night they allowed only nine first downs limited the vikings to five or fewer plays on 10 separate possessions and didn t give up a third down conversion buffalo s defense had allowed 28 5 points per game heading into the week 7 bye the obvious achilles heel for a team with serious super bowl aspirations the bills have now allowed 16 combined points in two games after the bye those outings were against undrafted rookie joe fagnano and wentz but this is where the foundation for a turnaround begins the confidence is building now is the time to put it to use against tougher opponents down the road bills sitting pretty in afc east the good news buffalo just rattled off its fourth straight victory besting its previous season high of a three game winning streak that began the campaign if you re waiting for the bad news there is none the rest of the afc east lost in week 9 the dolphins are now 1 7 and the jets are 2 7 six and 5 5 games back of the bills respectively which feels insurmountable given the quality of the teams and although the patriots 5 4 currently hold the head to head tiebreaker thanks to handing the bills their only loss in week 4 new england is staring at a three game deficit in the loss column with some massive issues to work through the bills still have a tough stretch ahead on the schedule playing the chiefs pats packers bears and broncos in weeks 12 16 but they also have four games remaining against the lowly jets and fins looking beyond the division history also appears to be on their side monday night marked the fifth matchup between teams tied for the nfl s best record in a november game or later over the last 15 seasons the winner of those games went on to play in the super bowl in three of four instances can the bills become the fourth such squad they re 7 1 for the first time since 1993 the last time they reached the game s biggest stage vikings head start on rest of division disappears minnesota entered week 8 as the lone unbeaten team remaining in the league after dropping two straight while the rest of the division went a collective 6 0 kevin o connell s bunch exits week 9 having officially fallen to third place in the nfc north it s only a hypothetical at this point but should the vikings fail to stop the bleeding against the packers at lambeau field this coming sunday they will plummet from the top to the bottom of the division in the span of 14 days that s how brutal the nfc north is it s currently the only division with every team sitting above 500 the sky isn t falling minnesota is a healthy 6 2 but there are problems for as incredible as the vikings defense is their offense is among the worst in the nfl their quarterback room is currently comprised of an injured underperforming kyler murray a turnover prone carson wentz who looked lost versus buffalo and max brosmer considering their next two games come on the road against the packers 6 3 and 49ers 7 1 the vikes must turn it back on soon the cushion they had is officially gone next gen stats insight for bills vikings via nfl pro josh allen was blitzed on 68 6 of his dropbacks the highest blitz rate he has faced in his career he completed 9 of 11 passes for 126 yards and a touchdown against four or fewer pass rushers nfl research the nfc north is a combined 20 4 in non division games the best such record by any division through week 9 of a season in over 40 years two of those four losses have come against the bills

news_mentions.description: Here are the injuries and news developments we're monitoring around the league on this Week 8 Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: here are the injuries and news developments we re monitoring around the league on this week 8 sunday arizona cardinals quarterback gardner minshew replaced jacoby brissettin the second half of sunday s win over dallas brissett was 10 of 23 for 119 yards and an interception at the time of his benching with arizona trailing 17 3 running back jeremiyah love ankle left early and did not return running back bam knight concussion and wide receiver kendrick bourne ankle were ruled out baltimore ravens quarterback lamar jackson right thumb was ruled out from sunday s game against buffalo jackson needs surgery on his injured thumb and will be placed on injured reserve coach jesse minter said after the game qb tyler huntley was also ruled out and suffered what is thought baltimore chicago bears linebackers coach richard smith will not travel with the team to seattle for monday s game against the seahawks due to a health issue the team announced assistant linebackers evaluated for a neck injury suffered in the second half of sunday s win over minnesota the team announced campbell is resting and will remain in the hospital on sunday night for continued evaluation news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles and washington commanders catch up on each nfc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles washington commanders three key storylines 1 summer bliss with pickens and no drama in oxnard aside from some contract squabbles with george pickens and brandon aubrey that were tame by cowboys standards this has been a drama free offseason for dallas will that change during training camp in oxnard california it s been a breath of fresh air that s even drawn applause from one of the greatest cowboys ever nfl all time leading rusher emmitt smith with dallas locked in on snapping a two year playoff drought the on field focus bodes well avoiding major storylines might well be the biggest development of the summer for the boys july 28 looms large for the team as it s when players are set to report to camp and owner jerry jones traditionally addresses the media in a lengthy news conference the cowboys have been transparent about not negotiating an extension with pickens who has signed his franchise tag and stated he doesn t intend to hold out we ll see just how copacetic everything remains when camp kicks off 2 downs arrives with plenty of hype ohio state safety caleb downs was viewed as a top line talent in this year s draft the cowboys getting him at no 11 overall was a major boon since joining the team downs has garnered rave reviews the highest defensive selection for the franchise since morris claiborne at no 6 in 2012 downs fills a massive db need for dallas and could prove to be a steal how he looks when the pads are on will be must see viewing for the fans at camp and a pivotal point in the cowboys defensive reconstruction downs isn t the cowboys only 2026 first round selection though picked 23rd overall malachi lawrence is a pass rusher who some felt went earlier than he should ve he has plenty of upside though and the cowboys have plenty of pass rushing needs to fill after mustering just 35 sacks in 2025 tied for 22nd in the league 3 a whole new world on defense dallas defense was a sieve in 2025 finishing dead last in points allowed and 30th in total d perhaps it wasn t too surprising considering the cowboys traded away micah parsons just before the season arrived nonetheless the disastrous results led to matt eberflus ousting young whippersnapper christian parker has taken over as defensive coordinator and garnered plenty of positive buzz he ll helm a defense that has undergone a colossal facelift in the offseason in addition to a pair of first rounders added to the mix dallas has signed safeties jalen thompson and p j locke along with cornerback cobie durant whilst trading for pass rusher rashan gary and linebacker dee winters dallas also has a full season ahead with pro bowler quinnen williams after he too was acquired via trade last season 2025 third round corner shavon revel played just seven games as a rookie rallying from an acl tear in college with downs likely to start from the get go lawrence and a host of other defensive draft picks have replenished the depth the turnover on this side of the ball is staggering but a fresh coat was needed after such a trying 2025 how the finished product ultimately looks will begin to take shape at camp for as ballyhooed as the dak prescott led offense has been the cowboys 2021 23 run of playoff appearances came with an offense and a defense ranked in the top seven in scoring back to top three key storylines 1 can giants get healthy stay healthy in camp harbaugh john harbaugh after 18 years with the ravens has arrived in gotham with plenty of fanfare but his team has already dealt with an alarming amount of injury exits rookie cornerback thaddeus dixon wide receiver special teamer gunner olszewski and defensive lineman roy robertson harris each stunningly suffered a torn achilles during organized team activities robertson harris injury is especially problematic considering the team traded away standout defensive tackle dexter lawrence abdul carter sprained his ankle in june while top receivers malik nabers knee and darius slayton core muscle surgery and second year running back cam skattebo ankle are on the mend as well monitoring the availability of nabers and skattebo for week 1 will carry on through the summer even though the latter has deemed himself a sure bet for the opener with harbaugh reputed to run tough practices the giants healing up and emerging unscathed is paramount 2 this is dart s team now at the start of last season jaxson dart waited his turn behind russell wilson after eventually getting handed the starting reins the first round pick weathered a debut campaign that saw him deal with injuries scrutiny for his devil may care scrambling and the firing of head coach brian daboll daboll and interim head coach mike kafka took turns navigating dart s first season now it s up to matt nagy to shepherd dart s growth the floor for dart is staying healthy the ceiling is what the big blue faithful are most excited about dart s development as a franchise signal caller is arguably the most important factor for the 2026 giants hype and hope have early expiration dates in the nfl so dart s second season is already a pivotal one after the qb showed plenty of potential 24 total touchdowns in his career opening campaign 3 big blue youth movement taking shape over the past two drafts the giants have stockpiled four first round picks carter dart lb arvell reese and ol francis mauigoa rookie wr malachi fields and first year cb colton hood a pair of day 2 picks in april figure to be big contributors though there is sterling veteran talent such as lt andrew thomas and olb brian burns the giants are a young squad looking to lay a winning foundation in the first year under harbaugh high draft spots and hype can provide anticipation but seeing the youngsters round into form this summer will be crucial for 2026 and beyond back to top three key storylines 1 hurts newest offensive scheme sean mannion is the latest offensive coordinator for the eagles and jalen hurts who truly found offensive bliss in 2022 his second and final season with shane steichen since then hurts has had a different offensive coordinator in each season even with kellen moore during a super bowl winning 2024 campaign philadelphia s passing game ebbed and flowed while running back saquon barkley largely fueled the offense drama was more prevalent last season than offensive chemistry as the passing game ranked 23rd in yards and the sputtering running attack diminished from the previous season s dominance hurts had a career best 25 touchdown passes but snapped a four season streak of double digit rushing scores finishing with eight last year s offense was far too predictable and stagnated on a seemingly weekly basis held to 20 points or less in 10 games including a dismal 23 19 playoff loss to the 49ers with o line guru jeff stoutland no longer coaching a group that was really the heartbeat of both of the eagles super bowl squads under nick sirianni the offense is undergoing more change than the annual alterations everyone s accustomed to a j brown is gone traded to the patriots in an offseason storyline that lingered for months all eyes are on hurts whose past accomplishments don t seem to hold too much weight with a feisty fanbase that believes its strong roster should be vying for lombardi trophies every year 2 new look wide receivers after four seasons two super bowl appearances and one lombardi trophy a j brown has departed philadelphia while brown s disharmony commanded the headlines he topped 1 000 yards receiving in each of his four years with the team devonta smith is now the unquestioned top target but gm howie roseman restocked the wr room with a trade for dontayvion wicks the signing of veteran speedster marquise brown and in the most exciting move the first round selection of makai lemon don t sleep on second round tight end eli stowers either the john mackey award winner from vanderbilt could line up all over the field as a 6 foot 4 matchup nightmare dallas goedert is back likely for one final season and smith one of the more underrated wideouts around adds to the familiarity overall though there is a freshness to the group that will need to come together in the summer but could liven up an all too often static offense from a season ago 3 what becomes of carter jalen carter seems to be on the brink of becoming perhaps the league s elite defensive tackle hence he s seeking a seismic extension which has led to trade speculation how it all plays out is sure to be headline fodder and it wouldn t feel right to be without some melodrama in philly furthermore defensive coordinator vic fangio is back and losing carter would be a magnificent blow a potential boon will be the additions of cornerback tariq woolen and pass rusher jonathan greenard no matter the pedigree not all players fit into fangio s scheme see bryce huff jalen ramsey jevon holland etc woolen is a physically gifted cover man who made his share of questionable plays with the seahawks it will be interesting seeing how the newbies fit into fangio s scheme but the prevailing matter at hand for the defense is carter s future back to top three key storylines 1 plenty on daniels plate there s a lot to accomplish for jayden daniels this summer following a disastrous 2025 season the commanders sputtered and the 2024 ap offensive rookie of the year missed 10 games due to injuries going just 2 5 in the games he played how daniels looks and feels after sustaining a sprained knee strained hamstring and dislocated left elbow is tops on the agenda he also needs to get acclimated to david blough s offense which will see daniels taking snaps under center far more now that his former assistant qb coach is his offensive coordinator after two seasons with kliff kingsbury in that role daniels is also in the latest season of netflix s quarterback series all eyes and a heap of responsibility will be on daniels how he bounces back and how well he adapts to a new offense could be the story of the commanders season 2 how does overhauled defense look when you fall from being everyone s nfc championship game darling to a 5 12 struggle bus you can run out of fingers to point the commanders put a massive under construction sign in front of a defense that finished dead last in yards allowed they used the no 7 overall pick on ohio state linebacker sonny styles an athletic marvel who will draw plenty of hype as a preseason defensive rookie of the year candidate general manager adam peters opened the check book before turning in the card to get styles too washington broke the bank to sign pass rusher odafe oweh while adding plenty more veteran starters elsewhere nickel amik robertson safety nick cross pass rusher k 39 lavon chaisson linebacker leo chenal and defensive tackle tim settle the commanders added veteran depth as well binging on free agents isn t always a winning formula of course how quickly new defensive coordinator daronte jones and washington s cast of fresh faces get on the same page will be crucial in camp 3 all set at skill spots daniels injuries were a giant issue in 2025 but not surrounding the blossoming franchise qb with enough talent at the skill spots also loomed large looking at the offensive roster on paper it s difficult to feel the commanders have remedied those ills terry mclaurin who dealt with a contract kerfuffle last year as well as ankle quad and pelvic injuries will hopefully be back to his pro bowl self with a full camp and good health however the team s wr corps hasn t added much to get overjoyed about dyami brown and van jefferson were signed in free agency while treylon burks and luke mccaffrey are both back none of those four reached 30 receptions or 400 yards in 2025 rookie third rounder antonio williams figures to jump right into the mix and will likely need to be a big contributor quickly elsewhere jacory croskey merritt should be the lead back after an 805 yard rookie campaign but he was hardly a consistent producer in year 1 the most notable additions are former titans tight end chigoziem okonkwo who should be a breakout candidate after three straight 50 catch seasons with tennessee and ex buccaneers running back rachaad white with blough s promotion to oc familiarity remains but this offensive roster is certainly a candidate for a veteran add or two in the weeks before the regular season commences back to top

news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top AFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Houston Texans, Indianapolis Colts, Jacksonville Jaguars and Tennessee Titans.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars and tennessee titans catch up on each afc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars tennessee titans three key storylines 1 another o line overhaul the most glaring weakness of the 2025 texans will take center stage during training camp as houston once again undergoes an offensive line revamp demeco ryans crew re upped right guard ed ingram and left tackle aireontae ersery showed glimpses of promise during his up and down rookie campaign the texans drafted center guard keylan rutledge in the first round they inked guard wyatt teller and right tackle braden smith both solid veterans when healthy in free agency veteran trent brown and 2024 second rounder blake fisher will battle for reps and or the swing tackle gig and evan brown and fourth round rookie febechi nwaiwu provide depth inside on paper it s a significantly improved group from the one that got bowled over a year ago however we ve said that before paper can get shredded just like last year s o line in houston how the crew shakes out will be the key to camp and how the texans season unfolds 2 can stroud offense get back on track tied to the first point is the play of c j stroud who has seen his production dip the past two seasons after a sensational rookie campaign in 2023 stroud s collapse reached a low with his ghastly performance see four interceptions 42 6 completion rate in the playoff loss to the new england patriots stroud has been scattershot behind a woeful offensive line at times last year he trusted his blocking so little that even when he had time he d rush decisions and make panicked throws the qb s play has been so incongruous to the poise and calm he displayed as a rookie that it s maddening for the offense to get back in gear and stop wasting a championship worthy defense stroud must be more consistent in the pocket an improved offensive line will certainly help but the qb must raise all boats even when the situation isn t perfect getting better run production with the import of david montgomery should improve the offensive efficiency monty rarely gets stuffed for negative gains solving a problem we saw far too often from houston s ground game a year ago he should keep the offense in better down and distances one other key player to track during camp is receiver tank dell who has been out since late in the 2024 season due to a severe knee injury the difference in stroud s production with and without dell in the lineup is stark what sort of shape will the receiver be in after so much time away and can he stay healthy 3 rich defense gets richer can the most ferocious defense in the league actually be better in 2026 edge monsters will anderson and danielle hunter are still in their primes derek stingley kamari lassiter jalen pitre and calen bullock form a lockdown backend and azeez al shaair still patrols the middle the texans upgraded a safety spot with veteran reed blankenship after shuffling through others at the position second round pick kayden mcdonald could play a significant role out of the gate alongside sheldon rankins and tommy togiai in the middle of the d line if mcdonald turns out to be a steal this defense will have zero weaknesses back to top three key storylines 1 how will jones look in return from injury daniel jones progress is the no 1 topic in indianapolis entering camp the colts predictably held the starter out of team drills during offseason workouts but expect him to be full go sometime during camp the focus will be on how many reps he can take and how he looks indy was a wonder early last season when jones was on his game making plays and looking at home in shane steichen s offense it fell apart when the qb got hurt the colts put all their eggs in the basket of jones returning healthy this offseason achilles injuries however can be a slog to return from yes jones is younger than kirk cousins but we saw how long it took for the latter to return to anything close to what he was before such an injury and cousins never relied on his mobility like jones does if jones is stuck in the pocket or struggles to push off the injured leg leading to limp passes will the colts offense wither how he looks early in camp won t say everything but it will give a strong indication of what to expect for the first quarter of the season in concert the colts will conduct a backup qb competition between anthony richardson and riley leonard barring richardson s trade request being granted of course given jones injury history the winner could see reps this season 2 overall roster health health is the main storyline throughout the colts roster from jones to alec pierce on offense to key defenders like deforest buckner and sauce gardner on defense buckner is one to track on d the colts have no replacement for the star dt who underwent neck surgery last winter he could be ready for week 1 but at this point it remains an unknown he was noncommittal when asked this offseason given how much of the summer months are filled with players dismissing injury and assuming they ll be ready it s a red flag when a veteran is evasive if buckner misses the start of the season or sees his play dip it could be devastating for indy s defense how much he participates in camp if at all will be closely tracked there isn t the same concern with gardner who missed significant time last season with a lingering calf injury but the star s status is worth keeping an eye on we also aren t sure what charvarius ward will look like after deciding against retiring following last year s concussion issues outside of injury questions what will the pass rush look like is laiatu latu ready to make a leap how much does arden key still have left is jt tuimoloau ready for a bigger role do the colts need to bring in another veteran edge 3 taylor s future in indy outside of health concerns hovering over colts camp the future of jonathan taylor is an interesting question the 27 year old running back is in the final year of his contract the situation is far less contentious than the last time he sought a new pact which saw him conduct a hold in until he got paid when asked about his contract this summer taylor was cordial about the state of affairs but made it known he d like to continue getting paid in indy could the situation turn sour again will the rb decide to ratchet things up if no extension comes before camp perhaps he s waiting for bijan robinson and jahmyr gibbs to reset the market again before making his next play we saw the offense s struggles when jones was out as defenses could sell out to stop jt it wasn t pretty if taylor is going to be asked to keep carrying a hefty load with little aid he might want commensurate compensation into the future back to top three key storylines 1 backfield shakeup when travis etienne signed in new orleans it opened up a swath of carries bhayshul tuten who has impressed this offseason is expected to have a hefty role but it s still unclear how big that part might be as free agent addition chris rodriguez was unable to participate in offseason workouts following a surgical procedure on his left foot the veteran is expected to be good to go for training camp which will give us a better idea of how liam coen might divvy up his rb reps last year etienne took the overwhelming majority of carries 260 to tuten s 83 will coen slice up the pie more or ride tuten at least to start the season a lot might have to do with rodriguez s health 2 what will hunter s role be when it was reported that the jags planned for the former no 2 overall pick to be a primary corner and part time receiver travis hunter didn t seem to take too kindly to that plan we won t know the truth until hunter is on the field for a significant amount of time how much he participates early in camp and where that participation takes place will indicate the club s intentions if the second year dual threat player is the lockdown corner most believe he s capable of being and continues to make plays at receiver the jags could have trouble taking him off the gridiron the rest of the offensive playmakers could have some say in how much time hunter sees at wr after a disappointing second season brian thomas has received glowing reviews this offseason parker washington soared to close last season and jakobi meyers remains a consistent professional if btj gets back on track there could be less of a reason to use hunter in a ton of offensive sets 3 lloyd s replacement the jags saw devin lloyd leave in free agency and didn t replace his production in anthony campanile s defense via free agency or early in the draft the decision puts 2023 fourth rounder ventrell miller in line to take over the role next to foye oluokun miller showed spunk this offseason but won t be handed the starting gig 2025 undrafted lb branson combs and 2026 seventh rounder parker hughes could have a shot to push miller for the starting gig if no one comes to the forefront the jags d could be in a rough spot lloyd shined last year under campanile who unleashed the linebacker s athleticism in a second team all pro campaign lacking playmaking in the middle would highlight some of the questions up front where there wasn t always consistent pressure from the front four back to top three key storylines 1 cam ward cam ward cam ward when discussing critical elements for the 2026 tennessee titans point nos 1 through 50 could all be about cam ward that s how vital his development is to any success in nashville robert saleh brings a professional coach to the head chair and did well to import brian daboll to nurture the young quarterback perhaps daboll wasn t meant for the head coaching gig in new york but he s proven he can help grow a qb josh allen daniel jones and jaxson dart all improved under daboll ward offers enticing upside while his accuracy came and went last year when he was in a groove the titans qb showcased a laser arm and the ability to find the range deep he needs to calibrate his short to mid area throws at times but the alluring positives pop off the page he doesn t need to live in the acrobatic athletic plays but they can add an indefensible element to tennessee s offense improving his mental processing particularly against man coverage where he struggled is one of the early steps ward has to make this season the titans must see significant strides forward from their qb in year 2 after the club improved his surroundings 2 better receiving corps in attempting to make life easier for ward tennessee upgraded the wr room first they inked wan 39 dale robinson from new york the slot maven excelled in daboll s offense and can help teach a young wideout room the ropes robinson is coming off a 1 014 yard season and generated a career high 11 yards per catch in 2025 the veteran will be particularly helpful to ward on third downs when he can win from the slot and make himself available to the quarterback then the titans used the no 4 overall pick on ohio state wr carnell tate who provides a vertical threat and heady playmaking tate s ability to make catches in close knit areas will be a boon for his new qb second year wrs elic ayomanor and chimere dike both showed glimmers of promise during their rookie campaigns if they take a step forward this could be an enticing group the lingering question is what role calvin ridley will play the veteran struggled on the field and missed the bulk of the season due to injury in seven tilts he had just 303 yards on 17 catches with zero tds his 11 1 drop rate last season was fifth worst in the nfl minimum 25 targets per next gen stats the titans eschewed cutting ridley believing he can still aid ward and the offense what that role is will be determined during camp 3 will improved d on paper translate to field the titans sported a woeful defense last season with saleh taking over the club the unit was completely revamped on paper it s much improved but how will all the new pieces mesh i love adding a penetrating john franklin myers next to all world dt jeffery simmons however is there enough on the edges jermaine johnson had his best years under saleh but hasn t been a consistent force first round rookie keldric faulk boasts talent but will he be a day 1 difference maker will second round rookie linebacker anthony hill immediately step into the middle of the defense next to the underrated cedric gray the secondary was horrendous last season tennessee responded by signing cordale flott alontae taylor and joshua williams all have had moments in their careers when they ve been stellar but there is also a reason each was available namely inconsistency i trust saleh to know how he wants his d to run and to get the most out of his players there is no question this crew is significantly improved on paper but questions remain particularly with all the free agent veteran additions back to top

material_news_signals.headline: Chiefs acquire Colts WR Josh Downs ahead of trade deadline
material_news_signals.description: The Chiefs are acquiring Josh Downs and a 2027 seventh-round pick from the Colts in exchange for a 2027 fourth-round selection and a 2027 fifth-rounder, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported on Tuesday.
material_news_signals.body_text: josh downs wish has been granted and a need has been answered in kansas city the chiefs are acquiring the slot receiver in a trade with the colts nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported kansas city is sending fourth and fifth round picks in the 2027 draft to indianapolis in the deal while receiving a 2027 seventh round pick in exchange per rapoport and schefter indianapolis announced the trade shortly after downs becomes the fourth player traded by the colts prior to tuesday s deadline joining the likes of guard quenton nelson defensive tackle deforest buckner and fellow receiver keenan allen who was traded to san francisco earlier tuesday i am beyond grateful and blessed for my time in indy downs wrote on social media following news of the trade nothing but love for the shoe a third round pick out of north carolina in 2023 downs became a reliable secondary receiving option in indianapolis pairing with michael pittman and eventually alec pierce to form a quality pass catching tandem for the colts despite instability under center he posted a career high 803 receiving yards and five touchdowns in 14 games in 2024 but watched indianapolis trade pittman to pittsburgh and hand pierce the lucrative extension downs desired over the offseason leaving downs in an awkward spot entering a contract year that contract year became a nightmare for the colts prompting downs to request a trade following two deals that shipped nelson to seattle and buckner to san francisco indianapolis didn t initially adhere to his request and coach shane steichen convinced downs to continue participating following the receiver s ask to be dealt but after two games played the colts decided it was time to maximize whatever return was available for the receiver especially as free agency loomed in early 2027 downs heads to kansas city to join a receiver room that is headlined by rashee rice who returned from injury in week 8 and helped improve kansas city s passing attack but is short at the position following xavier worthy s hamstring injury suffered in the chiefs week 9 win over the new york jets and if we re being honest the chiefs have long needed help at receiver making them a likely candidate to swing a deal for a receiver even before worthy s latest injury with downs now in the mix patrick mahomes will have another option to turn to as he surveys the field indianapolis meanwhile concludes a remarkably active trade window in which they dealt four players but held onto the most recognizable one running back jonathan taylor when the colts fired general manager chris ballard and sent out expiring mainstays like nelson and buckner it was clear the organization was willing to engage in a fire sale in order to jump start a rebuild as a star runner at nearly 28 years old taylor was seen as the most valuable asset in such a teardown and was understandably attracting plenty of interest from rb needy contenders despite these market forces encouraging a blockbuster trade when the 4 p m et deadline passed on tuesday taylor remained a colt indianapolis will finish 2026 with taylor remaining at the center of its offense and perhaps entertain a trade following the conclusion of the current campaign
