news_mentions.body_text: week 9 wasn t the same thrill ride that week 8 was but it did provide us with some insight as we clear the halfway point of the regular season the cincinnati bengals own one of the most explosive offenses in the nfl the green bay packers can and will win by relying heavily on the passing game and a defense that is blossoming at the perfect time and the los angeles chargers remain a directionless outfit have we begun to witness some much needed separation between contenders and pretenders could the houston texans use week 9 as a launch pad we better rank these teams before the answers arrive note up down arrows below reflect movement from the week 9 edition of the power rankings

news_mentions.headline: NFL trade grades: Evaluating every deal made ahead of the 2026 deadline
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Kevin Patra grades every trade made since the start of the 2026 regular season until Tuesday's trade deadline.
news_mentions.body_text: the 2026 nfl trade deadline has come and gone nfl com s kevin patra breaks down every trade made since the start of the regular season downs gets his trade looks to bolster chiefs date of trade nov 10 kansas city receives wr josh downs 2027 seventh round draft pick grade b indianapolis receives 2027 fourth round draft pick 2027 fifth round draft pick grade b the chiefs needed wide receiver aid with zero wideouts hitting the 300 yard mark yet this season a 37 year old travis kelce still leads k c pass catchers no offense to the future hall of famer but that shouldn t happen rashee rice is a roller coaster and xavier worthy is inefficient to put it nicely and dealing with a hamstring injury tyquan thornton was their most explosive receiver until he suffered a gruesome dislocation a title contender couldn t continue with their bb style passing offense in comes downs who is better than his numbers 33 receptions for 354 yards touchdown this year suggest he can create separation out of the slot and provide run after catch the switch from daniel jones to patrick mahomes could unlock downs ability even more he should slide right in as a slot weapon for the chiefs and give mahomes a third down target when downs gets hot he s liable to gobble up catches in bunches it s been a frustrating season in indy for the receiver and a fresh start could boost his production heading into free agency it s not a game changing move but downs brings upside to a passing offense that lacks any mid range threat two mid round picks isn t nothing for a potential rental but it s the going rate for no 2 receivers seattle paid the same price for rashid shaheed last year depending on how the rest of the season goes the chiefs could re sign downs in the offseason or he could be a potential comp pick candidate in free agency the colts fire sale ended with the disgruntled receiver who wanted out moving both downs and keenan allen leaves indy with an ultra thin wr room picking up a fourth and fifth rounder for a player who wanted out is a fine haul however this season s roster gutting underscores the danger of trading away first round picks as the colts did last season the colts former 2027 choice is destined to be a top 10 selection with top pick potential eek jets fans have to love these moves falcons ravens swap o linemen date of trade nov 10 baltimore receives olryan neuzil grade c atlanta receives ol andrew vorhees 2028 conditional sixth round draft pick grade c are we just arranging deck chairs on two sinking ships it feels like the falcons knew they weren t going to pay to keep neuzil this offseason and with a ton of cap space to spend we already know they aren t planning on getting any compensatory picks so that sixth rounder coming back feels like their gambit to recoup a draft pick after losing their starting center neuzil was serviceable but in a league that can t seem to find centers he is probably going to find a decent payday on the open market atlanta will now test drive corey levin at center while getting a look at vorhees also a free agent to be for the balance of the season it s tough to see clear logic here from the ravens unless this is simply a play at a comp pick if neuzil finds cash in free agency if this trade is because the cam jurgens trade already looks like it s in trouble then well baltimore has bigger problems i guess when your quarterback situation is as bad as the ravens this season continuing to take swings at upgrading the offensive line isn t terrible broncos nab lb from division rival date of trade nov 10 denver receives lb daiyan henley grade b los angeles receives 2027 fourth round draft pick 2028 fifth round draft pick grade b denver didn t have a glaring need at linebacker but the glut of missed tackles has been a major sore spot for sean payton s squad justin strnad has missed 11 tackles with a run missed tackle rate of 33 3 highest among all lbs minimum 100 run snaps while alex singleton has missed 10 for a 13 9 rate henley enters with just three missed tackles 8 3 the linebacker has struggled some in coverage this season but was stellar earlier in his career in better surroundings henley upgrades the second level coverage and should help improve the tackling it will be interesting to see how vance joseph deploys his trio of linebackers well at least the chargers did something i guess getting a couple of mid round picks back for an off ball linebacker who was set to be a free agent isn t horrific it s not exactly worthy of pomp and circumstance for an 0 8 disaster of a club either i don t care that they traded in division this isn t a qb we re talking about making the broncos slightly better this year doesn t hurt l a much taking away their draft picks could help in the long run in a vacuum this trade is fine with a season on fire it s wild the chargers didn t sell more vikings solve qb problems with deal for cousins date of trade nov 10 minnesota receives qb kirk cousins grade a las vegas receives 2027 third round draft pick grade b the vikings finally got a professional quarterback after two years of living in the seventh circle of hell cousins brings everything the vikings were missing with kyler murray and carson wentz under center this season cousins can throw on time properly reads defense knows how to get the ball to justin jefferson and he doesn t miss throws by 17 feet in short he can run the offense the last time we saw cousins in kevin o connell s attack he was scorching cousins earned a pro bowl spot in 2022 and was on pace for nearly 5 000 yards in 2023 before a midseason achilles change the entire trajectory the injury sent cousins on a nomadic journey to atlanta and then las vegas but he never wanted to leave minnesota in the first place the vikings initially found gold in 2024 with sam darnold replacing cousins but the j j mccarthy gambit blew up in their face and they ve been on a qb carousel since the vikings had to make a qb move after murray and wentz led an anemic offense that has wasted an epic brian flores defense this season and has left jefferson seething on the sideline sitting at 6 2 minnesota was staring at the real possibility of watching the season slip away because they couldn t complete passes consistently enough a 38 year old cousins isn t perfect but he has played well this season and had a rebuilding raiders squad playing watchable ball given his familiarity with minnesota s offense it s a smash move for the new vikings front office it s one they needed to make frankly given how pinned into a corner they were it s a stroke of brilliance that they didn t have to pay more no first or second round pick for a qb who could completely turn around your season and push you to the playoffs yes please his contract situation on a one year deal is palatable as well if for some reason it doesn t work out good on the front office for standing firm on not giving up the farm for an aging qb the main reason the grade isn t higher is that the vikings put themselves in this position in the first place with their dysfunctional decisions including miscalculating the kyler murray situation i initially graded the raiders higher but i m somewhat surprised they couldn t squeeze more out of a desperate vikings team vegas feels like they blinked here i can t blame them too much though as good a story as they were early this season and as watchable as cousins made them they weren t going to be legit competitors in the afc eventually fernando mendoza would take over vegas probably would have preferred that the no 1 overall pick s first game wasn t against the seattle seahawks defense but it s sink or swim time picking up a third rounder to start mendoza s reign a few weeks earlier than planned is solid work holding out and getting nothing only to bench cousins a few weeks later made little sense the raiders played this entire qb situation well from the start this offseason they let their rookie who was learning a very different way of playing the position under klint kubiak sit for the first half of the season and learn under a professional qb the club competed won a few games and showed some promise for the future inevitably they would turn to mendoza the future is now in vegas bills land much needed safety help date of trade nov 10 buffalo receives s amani hooker 2027 fifth round draft pick grade a tennessee receives 2027 second round draft pick grade b the bills needed safety help after the chauncey gardner johnson gambit didn t pay off they swiped an excellent starter for a solid price of moving down three rounds in the draft hooker is a ballhawk who should immediately upgrade the bills back end where damar hamlin has struggled next to cole bishop hooker is tied for the nfl lead with five interceptions in 2026 and has 17 for his career the roving safety also has 468 career tackles 45 passes defended and five forced fumbles in eight seasons with the titans safety was a clear need for jim leonhard s defense which entered monday night s win against the minnesota vikings ranked 30th in passing yards allowed slowing a limp carson wentz didn t change buffalo s need i love the fit buffalo can now become much more multi faceted on the back end with hooker s arrival the price wasn t exorbitant for a player still under contract for two additional years with no guaranteed money yes giving up a day 2 pick is tough but assuming it s at the back of round 2 while the titans pick is at the front of round 5 it s not that far of a fall to get a potential difference maker come january the titans didn t plan on trading hooker but the chance to get another top 64 draft pick was too much for a rebuilding squad to pass up with the bears first rounder from the jeffery simmons swap and the bills second the titans now have four potential sea changing selections come the spring it stings to lose two veteran stalwarts midseason but a veteran like hooker might not have been around once the titans turn things around anyway sliding up to the top of the draft can help speed up the process 49ers add pass catcher date of trade nov 10 san francisco receives wr keenan allen grade b indianapolis receives 2027 sixth round draft pick grade b the 49ers landed help for their battered wr room with mike evans deebo samuel de zhaun stribling christian kirk and ricky pearsall dealing with ailments season ending or otherwise it s been an injury plagued unit in the bay area samuel might practice this week and evans hopefully will come back at some point stribling could return next month but the 49ers couldn t sit around jordan watkins was impressive in sunday s win over the raiders but the rest of the crew demarcus robinson brandin cooks and jacob cowing were being asked to play above their current stature allen enters to smooth things out until reinforcements return and hopefully buoy things if injuries continue to strike the 34 year old brings savvy and can still make himself available on third downs where he thrived during his six pro bowl seasons with the los angeles chargers however he s aged much like you d expect from a receiver in his mid 30s his separation figure has dipped to 2 4 yards this season per next gen stats his lowest since 2016 the hope is that in kyle shanahan s offense he can find rejuvenation but this move is more about stemming the tide biding their time until evans returns and building depth than acquiring a game changer a sixth round selection for a pick poor squad isn t nothing but sitting with the nfc s no 1 seed they needed to give brock purdy some help it makes sense for the rebuilding colts to get a sixth round pick for a 34 year old who is not in their long term plans shane steichen s receiver corps looks ugly right now but stockpiling for the future is more important than the next eight games jags beef up interior d line date of trade nov 9 jacksonville receives dt jordan davis grade c philadelphia receives 2027 first round draft pick 2029 second round draft pick grade a on monday morning gm james gladstone had a big protein full breakfast then he had a light midday snack finally he sat down for a tomahawk steak dinner hold the sides the jags massive move for nose tackle jordan davis comes with huge risk for the gm who took the f them picks mantle from his former boss les snead and sped away if it works out and davis plays a pivotal role in the jags bringing a lombardi to duval no one will give a hoot how much it costs if it backfires davis struggles and jacksonville bows out early it will be a tough pill to swallow i was semi critical of the bears willingness to part ways with a hefty price tag for jeffery simmons that looks like a bargain in comparison to this move simmons is a game wrecker davis is a solid run stuffer with a little bit of push the pocket ability he s not in simmons stratosphere he s not even in quinnen williams realm who went for a similar package last year by most accounts davis was a good soldier and leader in philly but he s also been one of its more disappointing players this season and an epitome of the roller coaster defense when he and jalen carter were on they were a force unfortunately the effort wasn t always there davis has been a good run defender for his career but his 13 5 run stop rate this season ranks 14th among dts with a minimum of 100 run plays defended behind teammate moro ojomo i should add with a 1 8 run stuff percentage t 58th last year before he got paid was his best season with a 16 5 run stop rate fourth among dts with a run stuff rate of 4 3 behind that of davon hamilton whom he s essentially been brought in to replace there is the risk for the jags it feels like a knee jerk reaction to hamilton s injury led to a massive overpay davis can be a good player stuff the middle and can provide a little more pop for a nose tackle in the passing game however a first round pick and a future second we know dts have been scarce in this market but paying that much for a run defender is a lot but what do i know maybe dc anthony campanile sees something in davis that he can unlock maybe the jags really just believe that stuffing the run and eating up blockers so they can get to third and long is worth that investment maybe next to josh hines allen and travon walker we ll get a better version maybe davis having heard all the negative chatter about how the jags overpaid for him will be motivated and bring a wrecking ball attitude to duval and storm his way through the postseason on a mission for me that s a lot of maybes to hang a first and second rounder on the jags are undoubtedly better today than they were yesterday davis fills a void left on the defense gladstone was fearless in filling the holes for that he deserves credit but going all in only works if it pays off with hardware i m not sure howie roseman wanted to move davis after just paying him but when you get a desperate trade partner offering the moon sometimes you just take their cash and hightail it out of there this feels akin to the reaction when the raiders initially got two first round picks from the ravens for maxx crosby before the trade was scuttled given the eagles were losers of seven straight games it makes sense for roseman to cash out on this season and keep stacking chips for the future hey he doesn t even have to wait an extra year on this first rounder the eagles coffers are now stocked with two first rounders in 2027 two first rounders and two second rounders in 2028 and two second rounders in 2029 giddyup jaguars go all in with trade for veteran safety date of trade nov 9 jacksonville receives s jessie bates grade b atlanta receives 2027 second round draft pick 2028 fifth round draft pick grade a the jags went all in following the season ending elbow injury to eric murray the back end of anthony campanile s defense needed aid like a heat seeking missile jessie bates comes flying into duval i absolutely love the fit in jacksonville bates is a ballhawk who fits into this scheme next to antonio johnson like a glove the 29 year old plays the back end with aplomb rarely getting out of position and has the range to make up ground he s also a speeding bullet when he reads the run or a quick screen when he arrives he can dish out punishment and attacks the ball three forced fumbles this season the price is high for a player slated for free agency it s high enough that i wonder despite next year s cap concerns whether jags general manager james gladstone has eyes on signing bates to an extension similar to last year s trade for jakobi meyers which helped stabilize the receiver room for the 2025 playoff run at worst bates walks in the offseason and the cap strapped jags get a fourth or fifth round compensatory pick given the market for veteran safeties ahead of the trade deadline the cost for a playmaker like bates probably increased credit gladstone for not shying away from improving his team the jags are in a win now mode they have a window to not just re capture the afc south and become a cute national story they can make a legit super bowl run with this squad the offense is clicking under liam coen and the defense has been stingy injuries to murray and dt davon hamilton threatened to limit the defense s upside jacksonville needed to make a move to ensure that didn t happen my grade reflects that guts yes the price is high for a shot at a ring worth it i m crediting the falcons for seeing the truth just because they re a half game back from the top of the division in a grotesque nfc south they re still in last place even a run to the postseason doesn t make them championship contenders that s just a recipe for a later draft pick i m not suggesting the falcons should go into full on tank mode but it s a good sign that the current front office understands that getting a second round pick and a fifth rounder in 2028 for a free agent safety who turns 30 in february is excellent business atl isn t a safety away from contending for a lombardi he s worth more to teams like the jags bills or bengals the falcons also couldn t count on a comp pick coming back their way if they let the season play out and watched bates walk with the most cap space next year atlanta is expected to be heavily involved in free agency which would have negated any compensatory selection trading bates for the balance of the season not only ensures they get picks but the reward is much better than any comp pick dealing bates hurts the falcons chances of taking the division down the stretch but it sets them up better to be actual contenders later jaguars make second deal for defensive help date of trade nov 9 jacksonville receives dt davon godchaux grade b new orleans receives 2028 conditional sixth round draft pick grade b the jags are replacing a davon with a davon after the season ending injury to stud dt davon hamilton jacksonville needed help in the middle of its defense snagging davon godchaux from the saints helps fill that void the jags run d which exited week 8 no 1 against the run with hamilton in the lineup slipped while allowing a season high 172 rush yards to the ravens last thursday night perhaps that was simply a product of the third string qb opponent and one massive 65 yard run but the jaguars weren t about to sit around and find out godchaux a former dolphin and patriot has spent 10 years in the league as a run stuffer in 2024 his last year in new england he finished third among dts in run stops 48 before signing with the saints in eight games in 2026 he has generated 15 tackles nine run stops and one stuff it s not a home run move like the acquisition of jessie bates but adding a veteran body in the middle of the defense for a relatively low cost fills a need for jacksonville the jags don t currently have a 2027 sixth round pick still they are unofficially projected to acquire a couple of sixth round compensatory picks per over the cap one of which would then go to new orleans comp picks can t be traded until they re officially awarded in the offseason under the reported terms of the trade jacksonville gm james gladstone headed toward the trade deadline aiming to upgrade safety and defensive tackle he s now done both the jags clearly are all in on making a january push for new orleans godchaux was set to be a free agent after the season so getting a draft pick is solid even an eventual day 3 selection moving the veteran should open up reps for second round pick christian miller who was a healthy scratch on sunday the saints now need the rookie to step up like the falcons the saints were smart to know there is little reason to keep a soon to be 32 year old around for the rest of a campaign when you have three wins halfway through the season even if you re still in the division race snagging a pick is the smart move detroit deals for defensive back date of trade nov 9 detroit receives s andre cisco grade c new york receives 2028 sixth round draft pick grade c the lions added a safety to help fortify the back end of the defense a day before the deadline a former third round pick by jacksonville cisco started 47 games over four seasons with the jags snagging eight ints 1 5 sacks and 154 tackles he signed a one year deal in new york in 2025 and started five games before suffering a torn pec that ended his season the 26 year old re signed with the jets and has started four games this season including a week 3 loss in detroit where he sacked jared goff cisco mostly played a supporting role for the jets this season and has seen his time on defense plummet after week 3 he played zero defensive snaps in sunday s loss in kansas city malachi moore took over in three safety sets making cico expendable a 2028 sixth rounder for a player not in your plans is better than nothing but no one is getting star grades for this bland swap the veteran brings experience to a lions secondary that recently got brian branch back and is still hoping kerby joseph can return from a knee injury that cut short his 2025 season it s not a splash play for brad holmes but it gives detroit another body to throw at the situation for a secondary that has cycled through defenders this season ravens add journeyman qb after jackson huntley injured date of trade nov 6 baltimore receives qb jacoby brissett 2027 fifth round draft pick grade b arizona receives 2027 fourth round draft pick 2028 seventh round draft pick grade b sometimes even in the nfl trades make too much sense not to happen when the ravens lost both lamar jackson and tyler huntley to injury all eyes turned to jacoby brissett whom the arizona cardinals had just benched days later we get a trade baltimore had to make a move jesse minters squad found itself floating up the creek without either paddle forced to steer with a soup spoon it would have been unfair to joe fagnano and the rest of the team to ride the undrafted rookie the rest of the way as we saw thursday night fagnano is simply outmatched right now the free agent options offered little better enter brissett the 33 year old journeyman joins his seventh team in seven seasons he should be able to get up to speed quickly having his former qb coach israel woolfork in baltimore makes the transition easier after sitting out the offseason in an effort to get a reworked contract brissett struggled to fit into mike lafleur s offense he s been a bottom quarter passer this season ranking 18th of 23 qbs in epa per dropback at 0 11 min 200 attempts his stats are down across the board from last season when he finished with 3 366 yards a 23 8 td int ratio a 94 1 passer rating and a 0 05 epa per dropback there is a reason brissett has bounced around there is also a reason he keeps winding up a starter brissett s not the ideal franchise setter but he s a solid addition to a floundering ravens squad that has lost four straight games the hope is that he fits in declan doyle s offense better and gets back to the distributing ways we saw last season the price is about right for a player who was benched the ravens don t currently own any non compensatory fifth or sixth round picks in 2027 so a middle round swap with a 2028 final round sweetener was about as best as they could do it s not great to spend assets to solve a problem on a sinking ship but baltimore couldn t move forward with what it had on the slim chance brissett turns things around and pushes the ravens to the playoffs it was worth the small price the cardinals paid a couple million dollars to move on from their third string qb for a day 3 draft swap and a 2028 dart throw it s not significant capital but it s better than nothing i wonder if they might have received more by waiting until monday to see if another club minnesota jumped into the fray but arizona couldn t let the deadline pass without moving the veteran it was clear brissett was done in the desert after sunday s comeback win from gardner minshew the presence of the mania inducing veteran along with rookie carson beck made brissett superfluous in hindsight arizona probably should have moved on from brissett in the offseason while he was seeking a pay bump i understand why they didn t but he was always going to be a stopgap having two bridges to some unknown land is hardly good asset usage in that view i can t give the cards a rave review but getting even a minor upgrade in the draft is positive and if the ravens continue to spiral even with brissett that fourth rounder could be better bears trade two first rounders for all pro dt date of trade oct 29 chicago receives dt jeffery simmons 2028 fifth round draft pick grade b tennessee receives 2027 first round draft pick 2027 fourth round draft pick 2028 first round draft pick grade a ryan poles finally upgraded the defensive line since may i ve been writing that the bears lack of action along the line whether adding a dt or pass rusher was head scratching the interior was particularly troubling as the bears have been counting on 33 year old grady jarrett and journeymen kentavius street neville gallimore and james lynch coordinator dennis allen has made it work but an upgrade was warranted before the operation collapsed poles never one to sit on his hands made a massive splash simmons is the type of game changing talent who could flip a playoff game in chicago s favor already an nfc favorite to make a postseason run the 5 2 bears have made a move that puts them squarely in the running to hoist a lombardi a beast among beasts simmons leads all defensive tackles with 28 quarterback pressures and is tied for second with four sacks notably he s racked up that production on a titans team that has been behind a lot this season imagine the numbers he d put up in game scripts that force more passes from the offense we re about to find out the 29 year old isn t just a get up the field fly wildly at the quarterback defensive tackle either no no no simmons is a wrecking ball to whatever unfortunate soul might be clutching the pigskin when he s on the warpath in addition to owning the most qb pressures among dts he also is tied for second with 21 run stops and tied for third with seven run stuffs per next gen stats there has been some chatter that his play has waned this season in tennessee i don t buy it if you haven t seen the man with the red armband manically flying around the field in tennessee this season you haven t been watching simmons has been every bit as good as any interior defender this season in the chicago spotlight he could push his way into the dpoy conversation the move could tip the balance of the nfc north and the entire conference in the bears favor that s how good simmons is from a pure player addition standpoint it s a home run for poles the issue is the compensation two first round picks and a fourth rounder is a massive haul it s also notable that the fifth round pick the bears got back with simmons is in 2028 not 2027 two first rounders for a non quarterback is a huge cost i understand why poles was willing to do it with most of his key players on rookie contracts now it was the time to strike however after he pays all those guys including quarterback caleb williams he ll need good players on cheap rookie deals to keep things rolling recent non quarterbacks traded for multiple first round picks include edge rusher micah parsons cornerback sauce gardner offensive tackle laremy tunsil safety jamal adams and edge khalil mack to chicago in 2018 that s a mixed bag of results if i m being kind and some outright cringey mistakes including gardner last year a d lineman isn t a cb but it s still a hefty price for anyone who doesn t sling the oblong the bears doing this twice is notable mack didn t bring the bears a super bowl two playoff appearances however the situation feels different this time chicago has a clear franchise difference maker at quarterback the other recent comparable trade was the dallas cowboys sending a first and second rounder for interior defensive lineman quinnen williams at the deadline last season i should note that simmons is older than every single player i mentioned above was at the time of their trade how the dt ages will factor into what this trade looks like three years from now if there was a parade in downtown chicago before then the locals won t care about the cost of two firsts this was a no brainer for the titans two firsts for a non qb for a team that isn t one player away from contending in a heartbeat simmons was a leader and the squad s pulse but when you have that kind of offer you have to pull the trigger tennessee isn t a jeffery simmons away from being a perennial contender his next few years would have been spent withering away during yet another rebuild and he d have lost trade value it s going to stink for the rest of the locker room this year as robert saleh s team figures to continue struggling however that would be the case with or without simmons until second year qb cam ward morphs into a consistent difference maker not just a sometimes player the titans won t take a step forward if that doesn t happen tennessee will need all the first round picks it can get to find the next guy and give him the best chance to succeed colts part with another pro bowler get pick from 49ers date of trade oct 27 san francisco receives dl deforest buckner grade a indianapolis receives 2027 fourth round draft pick grade b we didn t have to wait long to find out how others in the nfc west would react to the seahawks splash move for quenton nelson hours later the 49ers bolstered their defensive interior by bringing back buckner whom they traded to indy in 2020 the reunion was telegraphed for weeks buckner clearly fed up with the mounting losses in indianapolis began voicing his displeasure couple that with the 49ers need along the defensive line and the move made almost too much sense the niners have the cap space to cover the remainder of buckner s contract assuming it s not adjusted and are all in after their first loss of the season buckner has 47 0 sacks since 2020 tied for second among defensive tackles behind only chris jones 55 122 qb hits 420 tackles and 312 qb pressures the big man can still be a people mover on the interior however the 32 year old is showing some signs of a slide he generated four sacks in 10 games in 2025 his fewest since 2017 his pass rush percentages are also down a tick from the past couple of years he s generated an 8 3 qb pressure rate through seven games buckner was at 10 3 in 2025 and 11 7 in 2024 similarly his run stop rates have dipped as well going from 15 7 in 2024 to 15 6 in 2025 to 12 4 in 2026 is it age or can we just chalk the dips up to playing in a struggling defense for a losing team regardless of whether he s on the downturn buckner represents an upgrade in the middle of the 49ers battered defensive line paired with osa odighizuwa the niners now have two players who can push the pocket if buckner also boosts the interior run d probably the 49ers weakest spot at this point it will be a clear win for the niners the cost might be a tad much for an 11 year pro on the back nine of his career who could be a short term rental but a fourth rounder isn t exorbitant by any stretch it s the type of move a team like the 49ers in a super bowl window should make i ll reward aggression with day 3 draft picks when it nets a good player who can make a difference in a playoff run buckner was probably the most obvious asset the colts had that was going to be moved he was in the final year of his contract clearly unhappy and any compensatory pick they could have received back would have been at most a fifth rounder in 2028 due to how long he s been in the league if he even signs a deal big enough to qualify in 2027 getting a fourth rounder in 2027 out of that is a win for indy the colts need as many lotto tickets as possible for the next general manager i d expect ed dodds to listen to offers on any of his pending free agents and potentially others under contract beyond 2027 the only real issue with the oct 27 deal is that as with nelson the colts might have gotten more for buckner possibly a late round sweetener by shopping him around for another two weeks even with that qualification i still like the return indy got in this swap seahawks acquire eight time pro bowl guard from colts date of trade oct 27 seattle receives g quenton nelson grade a indianapolis receives 2027 third round draft pick 2028 fifth round draft pick grade b the seahawks had some sneaky issues along the offensive line despite entering the season with the same five that helped win a super bowl while the run game concerns have mostly been pinned on the running backs the blocking has struggled to open holes on 184 rb carries the seahawks have just 92 yards before contact this season per next gen stats and they ve been stuffed 37 times that s not the type of offense mike macdonald wants to employ yes getting zach charbonnet and jadarian price back healthy could have helped but general manager john schneider went to cure the root cause nelson is an eight time pro bowl guard who is still playing at a hall of fame level the 30 year old can open holes in the run game is a weapon as a puller and is superior as a pass protector in eight seasons in indy he allowed no more than eight qb hits in a single season per pff the seahawks just added the nfl s most complete guard how will the rest of the nfc west respond the addition will immediately help sam darnold keeping the qb clean will go a long way toward negating some of the wayward interceptions adding nelson also aids whoever lines up at left tackle where starter charles cross is expected to miss a week or two with a high ankle sprain importing the left guard will bump second year player grey zabel to right guard where he played in college and where seattle has had trouble for a while anthony bradford struggled even during the super bowl run the price for seattle is excellent given that it s expected to get a slew of compensatory picks in 2027 nelson being on an expiring deal also helps if he leaves for a big deal the seahawks would be in line for another comp pick in 2028 we ve seen schneider re sign players acquired in season as well leonard williams and rashid shaheed so it s not guaranteed to be a rental for the seahawks either it s not every day you can snag a future hall of famer to fill a significant hole without giving up a pick in the top two rounds i was somewhat surprised indy couldn t get a second round pick back given the overwhelming need across the league along the offensive line but we know that gms are stingier in season then become drunken sailors on draft day so maybe i shouldn t be so amazed i can t blame the colts for moving any and all assets to recoup chris ballard s mistakes but i wonder if they d have gotten more by waiting until closer to the deadline without a first round pick which right now would be in the top 10 and a roster riddled with holes the next general manager needs as much ammo as possible stripping down the roster will only make the sauce gardner trade sting even more given nelson s status as a pending free agent the colts could have waited and let him walk in free agency but the compensation would have been a third round pick max in 2028 this trade allows them to get the pick a year earlier and adds a fifth round sweetener trading away their best player two weeks before the trade deadline suggests a teardown is in play indy should be very active over the next fortnight and you can bet any gm with a need is going to put in a call to colts interim gm ed dodds cards deal former no 4 pick to texans date of trade oct 12 houston receives wr marvin harrison 2027 sixth round draft pick grade c arizona receives 2027 second round draft pick 2027 seventh round draft pick grade b when the trade details came through i assumed it was a typo that the texans shipped a 2027 second round pick for a player who was clearly out of the rotation in arizona my brain rationalized it as a 2028 second rounder or a 2027 fourth rounder nope the texans paid a premium pick in the upcoming draft for a shot at revitalizing harrison s career the cards reportedly had made it known they were holding out for a second round pick the moment the texans upped their bid to a second in 2027 they pounced i don t fault arizona for moving on right now in four games in 2026 harrison caught five passes on 13 targets for 85 yards and one touchdown that s like a half of one game for the upper echelon of wrs harrison has generated 0 6 yards per route run this year the third lowest among players with at least 100 routes per next gen stats basically harrison has been doing little more than a cardio workout on sundays getting a second rounder is solid work the grade isn t higher because the same brass that acquired that asset used the no 4 overall pick on harrison in 2024 monti ossenfort still gets docked for whiffing on a prime selection i understand why the texans would take a swing on harrison like most of the league they probably gave the ohio state product a very high pre draft grade reuniting him with former buckeyes teammate c j stroud could bring out the best in the wideout the texans have struggled mightily to move the ball when nico collins has been injured and given collins history and the hard hits he takes he s not guaranteed to make it through the rest of the season without missing time after laying an egg for four weeks the 1 4 texans don t have any more wiggle room harrison s contract isn t onerous giving houston some insurance if tank dell never returns to form or jayden higgins is delayed next year coming off a season ending injury in the short term this trade is somewhat duplicative of the much cheaper deal in which it acquired kayshon boutte it s more costly but gives the club more control of the future mostly i don t love the price tag for a player who hasn t been who we thought he was for it to make sense to give up a day 2 pick the texans need harrison to finally break out after two mediocre seasons perhaps in improved surroundings and on a team that clearly wants him with a qb he knows and trusts harrison can blossom frankly i probably like many scouts can t figure out the disconnect between a player who looked as polished and well rounded as harrison did at osu and the one we ve seen lope about for two plus years the question is whether you believe the scouting or the two separate coaching staffs who haven t found much use for him the texans are betting on their scouting eagles send pro bowl ol to ravens date of trade oct 7 baltimore receives c cam jurgens 2027 seventh round draft pick grade b philadelphia receives 2027 fifth round draft pick 2028 second round draft pick grade a we should start with the obvious the two time pro bowler was available for a reason especially after the same offensive line saw a future hall of famer lane johnson retire the day prior jurgens is currently a pro bowler in name only after battling through a back injury in 2024 to help the eagles net a super bowl ring jurgens has not been the same player he struggled through last season and has been a liability through four games this year his pass blocking has never been otherworldly but it s particularly crumbled after he was asked to move to left guard the past three weeks blame the previous injuries or the ill fit in the eagles new blocking scheme but jurgens has been borderline unplayable the past few weeks drew kendall played better than jurgens at center in sean mannion s scheme so a move back wasn t in the cards it got so bad that nick sirianni was fending off questions about potentially benching the guard instead philly shipped him out of town we know that howie roseman doesn t care what year he gets his picks famously saying a first round pick is a first round pick regarding the a j brown trade this offseason when philly netted a 28 first however we can dock him ever so slightly for delayed satisfaction otherwise getting a second rounder for a struggling player who was not a fit is a home run in the short term the eagles offensive line is in flux with willie lampkin in line to take over at guard the hope is that landon dickerson returns to form when he eventually comes off injured reserve the trade is jarring coming right after johnson s retirement but getting a significant draft pick back for a player who was on the verge of being benched makes sense philly is now loaded in the 2028 draft with two firsts and two seconds even acknowledging jurgens significant struggles the play makes sense for the ravens the plans to replace tyler linderbaum who signed with the raiders in free agency this summer were wobbly from the start the ones they rode with danny pinter jovaughn gwyn and ethan pocic have all landed on injured reserve counting on pocic coming off injury was always a gamble the ravens crapped out instead of sticking with rookie olaivavega ioane out of position at center baltimore will take a roll of the dice that jurgens can get back to form it s not a terrible gamble and it s conceivable the 27 year old can bounce back with a return to center in a different scheme jurgens contract which has him under team control through 2029 for relatively cheap is also desirable for baltimore injury is always part of the equation and jurgens enters his time in baltimore in the league s concussion protocol nfl network s mike garafolo reported if he s healthy and returns to form this will be an excellent move for baltimore if he continues to struggle or misses a ton of time it will be the latest swing and miss in trying to replace linderbaum porter drama ends in trade to dallas date of trade oct 1 dallas receives cb joey porter grade a pittsburgh receives 2027 sixth round draft pick 2028 second round draft pick grade c the cowboys desperately needed corner help for a defense that has floundered despite the offseason upgrades i ll credit jerry jones for not sitting on his hands instead doing what we have been asking general managers to do for years be bold make moves and don t overvalue your own picks during a season we won t know if the trade pays off in the long term but the cowboys certainly improved in 2026 at his peak porter is a physical cover man who can be sticky on the outside and mirror top receivers he ll slide well into christian parker s scheme allowing dallas to play man coverage on the outside with more physicality than in the first three weeks sure he racks up some penalties but so do most cbs you ll live with the trade off for a corner with jpj s skill set that dallas didn t have to give up a premier pick until 2028 also improved its grade assuming that porter plays the cowboys get a top shelf cb for a relatively cheap up front cost jones seems to be hoping he can copy the success he had with the george pickens trade pushing off the long term talks until down the road it s a needle threading but one that could work if porter plays well dallas could extend him in the offseason use the franchise tag on the cb or let him walk and recoup a potential third round compensatory pick in 2028 possibly moving down one round in 28 and giving up a sixth rounder for a potential pro bowl player in a year when you re all in is a stellar move if porter delivers 14 games of high level play it s worth it of course if porter gets hurt or implodes this all goes for naught however if he continues on this track it is a short term win for the cowboys the long term question can be shelved i don t fault the steelers for not wanting to pay porter top cb money if he were seeking a 30 million type deal in line with christian gonzalez or devon witherspoon i would have balked too jpj is good he s not at that level trading him away relieved pittsburgh of that problem the issue i have is that it appears steelers gm omar khan either overplayed his hand or didn t anticipate porter s gumption when it came to a new deal if khan had never planned to meet the corner s contract demands he should have made a move in the spring or early summer a player of porter s caliber is worth more than a second round pick two drafts down the road the timing of the impasse reduced the compensation now the steelers are without a top corner and find themselves thin and young at the position not a good combo if things spiral in pittsburgh it s fair to wonder if khan will even be around to make that second round pick in 2028 the gm took over in 2022 and received early praise for fleecing the bears in the chase claypool trade that brought back a second rounder that pick became porter khan has now moved him for pennies on the dollar add in a string of so so drafts the pickens trade and other questionable moves and the seat in pittsburgh could get hot for khan if the steelers flounder giants trade for mccarthy after dart injury date of trade sept 28 new york receives qb j j mccarthy grade c minnesota receives 2027 fifth round draft pick grade c minnesota signaled its intent to move on from the former no 10 overall pick by inking kyler murray and bringing back carson wentz in the offseason mccarthy got a slim shot at the starting job during training camp but he couldn t even fend off wentz for the primary backup role a former first rounder turned clipboard holder is a bad look all around had another club made an offer of substance before the season i believe the vikings would have moved on then given mccarthy s rough preseason however it s no surprise it took an injury to a starting qb to move the needle a fifth rounder isn t nothing and the vikings save a few pennies however the reality is they turned a first fourth and late round pick swap into 10 starts and a future fifth rounder that math isn t mathing mccarthy s poor play and injury history left the vikings with no good options for a team in win now mode minnesota didn t have time to let the 23 year old develop on his terms moving on makes sense but the vikings can t get a high grade for the compensation new york took a shot that in a new setting and in an offense keyed on the ground attack john harbaugh and his staff can do what kevin o connell couldn t i don t hate the price for a former first round quarterback who even the stingiest draft graders pegged as a day 2 selection teams use fifth rounders and later as qb dart throws all the time the giants lack of 2027 picks is of concern but they can deal with that later with jaxson dart out for the regular season after knee surgery the giants needed to make some sort of move jameis winston has shown he can hold the fort for a spell but it s a serious question if harbaugh will give the boom or bust passer enough leash for a 15 game run bringing in mccarthy at least gives the giants another alternative if winston crumbles at this stage there aren t a whole lot of other options i m not optimistic that mccarthy can turn his career around but for a fifth round pick it s worth a shot for new york

news_mentions.headline: Chiefs acquire Colts WR Josh Downs ahead of trade deadline
news_mentions.description: The Chiefs are acquiring Josh Downs and a 2027 seventh-round pick from the Colts in exchange for a 2027 fourth-round selection and a 2027 fifth-rounder, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported on Tuesday.
news_mentions.body_text: josh downs wish has been granted and a need has been answered in kansas city the chiefs are acquiring the slot receiver in a trade with the colts nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported kansas city is sending fourth and fifth round picks in the 2027 draft to indianapolis in the deal while receiving a 2027 seventh round pick in exchange per rapoport and schefter indianapolis announced the trade shortly after downs becomes the fourth player traded by the colts prior to tuesday s deadline joining the likes of guard quenton nelson defensive tackle deforest buckner and fellow receiver keenan allen who was traded to san francisco earlier tuesday i am beyond grateful and blessed for my time in indy downs wrote on social media following news of the trade nothing but love for the shoe a third round pick out of north carolina in 2023 downs became a reliable secondary receiving option in indianapolis pairing with michael pittman and eventually alec pierce to form a quality pass catching tandem for the colts despite instability under center he posted a career high 803 receiving yards and five touchdowns in 14 games in 2024 but watched indianapolis trade pittman to pittsburgh and hand pierce the lucrative extension downs desired over the offseason leaving downs in an awkward spot entering a contract year that contract year became a nightmare for the colts prompting downs to request a trade following two deals that shipped nelson to seattle and buckner to san francisco indianapolis didn t initially adhere to his request and coach shane steichen convinced downs to continue participating following the receiver s ask to be dealt but after two games played the colts decided it was time to maximize whatever return was available for the receiver especially as free agency loomed in early 2027 downs heads to kansas city to join a receiver room that is headlined by rashee rice who returned from injury in week 8 and helped improve kansas city s passing attack but is short at the position following xavier worthy s hamstring injury suffered in the chiefs week 9 win over the new york jets and if we re being honest the chiefs have long needed help at receiver making them a likely candidate to swing a deal for a receiver even before worthy s latest injury with downs now in the mix patrick mahomes will have another option to turn to as he surveys the field indianapolis meanwhile concludes a remarkably active trade window in which they dealt four players but held onto the most recognizable one running back jonathan taylor when the colts fired general manager chris ballard and sent out expiring mainstays like nelson and buckner it was clear the organization was willing to engage in a fire sale in order to jump start a rebuild as a star runner at nearly 28 years old taylor was seen as the most valuable asset in such a teardown and was understandably attracting plenty of interest from rb needy contenders despite these market forces encouraging a blockbuster trade when the 4 p m et deadline passed on tuesday taylor remained a colt indianapolis will finish 2026 with taylor remaining at the center of its offense and perhaps entertain a trade following the conclusion of the current campaign

news_mentions.headline: AFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Broncos, Chargers, Chiefs, Raiders
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Bobby Kownack breaks down the top AFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Denver Broncos, Kansas City Chiefs, Las Vegas Raiders and Los Angeles Chargers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams bobby kownack has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders and los angeles chargers catch up on each afc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders los angeles chargers three key storylines 1 nix s health receiving corps bo nix should be full go for training camp after suffering a broken ankle in last season s divisional round win but every step in the process bears watching when someone this important to a franchise is returning from injury once nix is out there eyes will also be glued to his pass catching group denver gifted its qb with a second no 1 wideout by trading for jaylen waddle to pair with courtland sutton and camp should provide the first hints as to whether the broncos will employ them as a 1a 1b combo or settle into a more defined pecking order plus can anyone from a proven supporting cast of troy franklin marvin mims and pat bryant emerge as the clear third option 2 denver has a new play caller reaching the doorstep of the super bowl didn t prevent sean payton from enacting sizable changes to the offensive staff he fired offensive coordinator joe lombardi two days after denver s afc title game loss and bumped davis webb up to replace him a month later payton publicly transferred play calling duties to the 31 year old former quarterback it s been a meteoric rise for webb who entered the coaching ranks as payton s qbs coach in 2023 webb has been learning under payton since then so nothing will be unrecognizable but nix still will need to get used to a new voice in his helmet any improvement for a 14th ranked scoring offense on a team that already won 14 games last season would be massive in the afc race 3 broncos are largely running it back roster wise the 2026 broncos are the personification of if it ain t broke don t fix it they took the big swing for waddle but barely signed any outside free agents denver instead focused on retaining talent losing defensive lineman john franklin myers and releasing linebacker dre greenlaw but basically keeping the band together even in the draft the club didn t make a pick until the third round apart from working waddle into the mix with webb now calling the shots the broncos can hit the ground running while many other contenders must start off with finding chemistry that s huge considering how unfriendly the first month and a half of denver s schedule appears at chiefs vs jaguars vs rams at 49ers at chargers and vs seahawks back to top three key storylines 1 when will mahomes be fully healthy patrick mahomes said during the offseason program that he s in a good spot in his acl lcl recovery and hopes to play in week 1 while andy reid told reporters the quarterback should be able to do some things at the start of training camp so how much will mahomes take on when the chiefs report and how quickly will he ramp up activity those questions don t have answers at the moment the chiefs hopes of returning to contention in 2026 and beyond rely heavily on the two time most valuable player so they ll be smart with him justin fields now on his fourth team in as many years could be one of the league s most intensely scrutinized backups as mahomes return timeline takes shape 2 kansas city s cb room begins anew again the chiefs have a habit of maximizing young cornerbacks talent and moving on before the bill comes due most recently they traded two time all pro trent mcduffie and let jaylen watson walk in free agency with both cover men going to the rams kansas city will call on 2025 third rounder nohl williams and mansoor delane this year s no 6 overall pick to fill the void fourth round rookie jadon canady should also be in competition for playing time with free agent signees kader kohou and l 39 jarius sneed the latter of whom returns to kansas city a couple of years after the team traded him to tennessee defensive coordinator steve spagnuolo s track record which includes three straight top six defenses in points allowed suggests things will work out just fine 3 bieniemy s back kansas city s offensive coordinator position has been devalued for years overshadowed by the prowess of patrick mahomes and andy reid perhaps it shouldn t have been during eric bieniemy s five years as the team s oc from 2018 through 2022 the chiefs never finished worse than sixth in the league in points or yards twice tallied the most points and three times amassed the most yards in the last three years without bieniemy the chiefs have ranked at average 17th in scoring and 15th in yardage there were obviously other factors in the decline such as tyreek hill exiting in a trade and travis kelce aging out of his prime but bieniemy returning still bodes well back to top three key storylines 1 mendoza s first camp the future of the raiders now rests on no 1 pick fernando mendoza s shoulders even if he isn t destined to start right away new head coach klint kubiak has communicated that his ideal scenario is to avoid putting a rookie under center in week 1 and by signing veteran kirk cousins las vegas essentially ensured mendoza s starting debut will come via choice rather than need still mendoza is coming off a perfect 16 0 season in which he took home the heisman trophy and led indiana to a national championship he s going to show up for the competition and all the buzz at raiders camp will revolve around him when he does 2 who steps up at wr las vegas has some starry names on offense quarterback fernando mendoza running back ashton jeanty and tight end brock bowers at wide receiver though there s work to do tre tucker was easily the team s most trustworthy wideout last year but he doesn t really profile as a wr1 jack bech and dont 39 e thornton 2025 second and fourth round picks respectively are looking to rebound from underwhelming rookie seasons free agent addition jalen nailor has a chance to show staying power in a larger role after flashing promise with 858 yards and 10 tds on 57 catches over the past two years with the vikings those are likely las vegas top four in some order but there s still a lot to shake out during the preseason 3 crosby s defense 2 0 in the four days between the raiders agreeing to send maxx crosby to the ravens and baltimore backing out of the trade las vegas spent a whole lot of dough rebuilding its defense for what was supposed to be the post crosby era now thanks to the blockbuster deal falling apart crosby is very much a part of the present the five time pro bowler returned to possibly the most talented unit the raiders have had during his career the linebacking corps has been rebuilt with nakobe dean and quay walker taron johnson brings more legitimacy to the cornerback room and kwity paye is set to line up on the edge opposite crosby reason for excitement in sin city extends far beyond the team s top picked qb back to top three key storylines 1 mcdaniel effect it was time for a change after the chargers scored 15 combined points in their last two wild card exits jim harbaugh fired offensive coordinator greg roman a longtime collaborator and replaced him with mike mcdaniel to hopefully supercharge the offense as the former dolphins coach did in his first couple years with miami mcdaniel s arrival as a quarterback whisperer is good news for justin herbert who already plays at a pro bowl level but the impact of his high octane system should be felt everywhere from the promising tight end trio of oronde gadsden david njoku and charlie kolar to omarion hampton in the backfield 2 fingers crossed for l a s o line los angeles offensive line should be a strength of the team in 2026 after disaster struck last season left tackle rashawn slater suffered a season ending patellar tendon tear in august while right tackle joe alt played just six games before requiring season ending ankle surgery herbert took a career high 54 sacks behind a patchwork offensive line leading the league with 268 pressures taken and a 43 3 pressure rate slater and alt are back but they ll also be joined on the line by free agent signings tyler biadasz and cole strange as well as second round rookie jake slaughter assuming the group stays healthy herbert should be well protected first though the bolts blockers have to jell together as a unit in august 3 chargers hope they have an edge rushing duo to build around the offseason didn t bring any sweeping changes for the chargers defense dalvin tomlinson 32 was their most notable signing to bulk up the interior and they lost a few pass rushers odafe oweh and da 39 shawn hand but largely maintained the status quo los angeles did however spend a first round pick on akheem mesidor the acc sack leader in 2025 with 12 5 there s enough pass rushing depth that mesidor won t have to take on too much too soon more importantly he has some stellar mentors in tuli tuipulotu who was sixth in the nfl last season with 13 sacks and nine time pro bowler khalil mack the hope is for a seamless transition from mack to mesidor alongside tuipulotu as the leaders of the l a edge rush back to top

news_mentions.description: With the start of NFL training camps just around the corner, Grant Gordon provides a refresher on the Arizona Cardinals' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc west catch up on the arizona cardinals offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 22 rookies and veterans location state farm stadium glendale ariz fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs kansas city chiefs 8 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 at denver broncos 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 vs las vegas raiders 4 30 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note arizona plays san francisco and seattle in back to back weeks twice weeks 3 4 weeks 10 11 but doesn t play los angeles the reigning nfc west champion until week 14 and then again in week 18 nfl research what you need to know 1 beneficiaries of two first round draft picks in 2024 the cardinals were left wanting much more from marvin harrison and darius robinson in total harrison s 62 receptions for 885 yards and eight touchdowns as a rookie are pretty solid but many thought the no 4 overall selection would be a superstar out of the gate harrison and quarterback kyler murray furthering their chemistry could well be the team s prevailing storyline this season and that will get going in earnest during camp robinson picked 23 slots after harrison last year played in just six games because of a calf injury this will be a pivotal camp for him especially amid a revamped defensive front one that will offer him veterans to learn from and new faces to compete against for snaps 2 one of the easiest players in the nfl to root for calais campbell 38 returning to the team he began his illustrious career with in 2008 is more than just a feel great story campbell s leadership is just as important an addition as his talent to a club looking for its first winning season since 2021 this is a pivotal season for the monti ossenfort jonathan gannon regime and campbell pass rusher josh sweat and defensive tackle dalvin tomlinson should add some veteran moxie to a team lacking it outside of star safety budda baker gannon was hired for his defensive prowess coordinating the philadelphia eagles now his arizona d is finally stocked up at least on paper it s added some experienced talent and two high profile rookies in defensive lineman walter nolen first round no 16 overall and cornerback will johnson second no 47 johnson has the ceiling to become a massive draft steal how the cards defensive additions mesh with the starting staples begins this summer 3 james conner joined arizona in 2021 and has been a stellar fit who has exceeded his output and importance with the pittsburgh steelers for four years prior he s coming off career high tallies in carries 236 and rushing yards 1 094 but is entering his age 30 season 2024 third rounder trey benson 63 carries for 291 yards had a disappointing debut campaign but if he finds his footing could he push conner for touches it ll be interesting to see how camp develops in the arizona offensive backfield

news_mentions.headline: Chiefs acquire Colts WR Josh Downs ahead of trade deadline
news_mentions.description: The Chiefs are acquiring Josh Downs and a 2027 seventh-round pick from the Colts in exchange for a 2027 fourth-round selection and a 2027 fifth-rounder, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported on Tuesday.
news_mentions.body_text: josh downs wish has been granted and a need has been answered in kansas city the chiefs are acquiring the slot receiver in a trade with the colts nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported kansas city is sending fourth and fifth round picks in the 2027 draft to indianapolis in the deal while receiving a 2027 seventh round pick in exchange per rapoport and schefter indianapolis announced the trade shortly after downs becomes the fourth player traded by the colts prior to tuesday s deadline joining the likes of guard quenton nelson defensive tackle deforest buckner and fellow receiver keenan allen who was traded to san francisco earlier tuesday i am beyond grateful and blessed for my time in indy downs wrote on social media following news of the trade nothing but love for the shoe a third round pick out of north carolina in 2023 downs became a reliable secondary receiving option in indianapolis pairing with michael pittman and eventually alec pierce to form a quality pass catching tandem for the colts despite instability under center he posted a career high 803 receiving yards and five touchdowns in 14 games in 2024 but watched indianapolis trade pittman to pittsburgh and hand pierce the lucrative extension downs desired over the offseason leaving downs in an awkward spot entering a contract year that contract year became a nightmare for the colts prompting downs to request a trade following two deals that shipped nelson to seattle and buckner to san francisco indianapolis didn t initially adhere to his request and coach shane steichen convinced downs to continue participating following the receiver s ask to be dealt but after two games played the colts decided it was time to maximize whatever return was available for the receiver especially as free agency loomed in early 2027 downs heads to kansas city to join a receiver room that is headlined by rashee rice who returned from injury in week 8 and helped improve kansas city s passing attack but is short at the position following xavier worthy s hamstring injury suffered in the chiefs week 9 win over the new york jets and if we re being honest the chiefs have long needed help at receiver making them a likely candidate to swing a deal for a receiver even before worthy s latest injury with downs now in the mix patrick mahomes will have another option to turn to as he surveys the field indianapolis meanwhile concludes a remarkably active trade window in which they dealt four players but held onto the most recognizable one running back jonathan taylor when the colts fired general manager chris ballard and sent out expiring mainstays like nelson and buckner it was clear the organization was willing to engage in a fire sale in order to jump start a rebuild as a star runner at nearly 28 years old taylor was seen as the most valuable asset in such a teardown and was understandably attracting plenty of interest from rb needy contenders despite these market forces encouraging a blockbuster trade when the 4 p m et deadline passed on tuesday taylor remained a colt indianapolis will finish 2026 with taylor remaining at the center of its offense and perhaps entertain a trade following the conclusion of the current campaign
