hines allen and travon walker we ll get a better version maybe davis having heard all the negative chatter about how the jags overpaid for him will be motivated and bring a wrecking ball attitude to duval and storm his way through the postseason on a mission for me that s a lot of maybes to hang a first and second rounder on the jags are undoubtedly better today than they were yesterday davis fills a void left on the defense gladstone was fearless in filling the holes for that he deserves credit but going all in only works if it pays off with hardware i m not sure howie roseman wanted to move davis after just paying him but when you get a desperate trade partner offering the moon sometimes you just take their cash and hightail it out of there this feels akin to the reaction when the raiders initially got two first round picks from the ravens for maxx crosby before the trade was scuttled given the eagles were losers of seven straight games it makes sense for roseman to cash out on this season and keep stacking chips for the future hey he doesn t even have to wait an extra year on this first rounder the eagles coffers are now stocked with two first rounders in 2027 two first rounders and two second rounders in 2028 and two second rounders in 2029 giddyup jaguars go all in with trade for veteran safety date of trade nov 9 jacksonville receives s jessie bates grade b atlanta receives 2027 second round draft pick 2028 fifth round draft pick grade a the jags went all in following the season ending elbow injury to eric murray the back end of anthony campanile s defense needed aid like a heat seeking missile jessie bates comes flying into duval i absolutely love the fit in jacksonville bates is a ballhawk who fits into this scheme next to antonio johnson like a glove the 29 year old plays the back end with aplomb rarely getting out of position and has the range to make up ground he s also a speeding bullet when he reads the run or a quick screen when he arrives he can dish out punishment and attacks the ball three forced fumbles this season the price is high for a player slated for free agency it s high enough that i wonder despite next year s cap concerns whether jags general manager james gladstone has eyes on signing bates to an extension similar to last year s trade for jakobi meyers which helped stabilize the receiver room for the 2025 playoff run at worst bates walks in the offseason and the cap strapped jags get a fourth or fifth round compensatory pick given the market for veteran safeties ahead of the trade deadline the cost for a playmaker like bates probably increased credit gladstone for not shying away from improving his team the jags are in a win now mode they have a window to not just re capture the afc south and become a cute national story they can make a legit super bowl run with this squad the offense is clicking under liam coen and the defense has been stingy injuries to murray and dt davon hamilton threatened to limit the defense s upside jacksonville needed to make a move to ensure that didn t happen my grade reflects that guts yes the price is high for a shot at a ring worth it i m crediting the falcons for seeing the truth just because they re a half game back from the top of the division in a grotesque nfc south they re still in last place even a run to the postseason doesn t make them championship contenders that s just a recipe for a later draft pick i m not suggesting the falcons should go into full on tank mode but it s a good sign that the current front office understands that getting a second round pick and a fifth rounder in 2028 for a free agent safety who turns 30 in february is excellent business atl isn t a safety away from contending for a lombardi he s worth more to teams like the jags bills or bengals the falcons also couldn t count on a comp pick coming back their way if they let the season play out and watched bates walk with the most cap space next year atlanta is expected to be heavily involved in free agency which would have negated any compensatory selection trading bates for the balance of the season not only ensures they get picks but the reward is much better than any comp pick dealing bates hurts the falcons chances of taking the division down the stretch but it sets them up better to be actual contenders later jaguars make second deal for defensive help date of trade nov 9 jacksonville receives dt davon godchaux grade b new orleans receives 2028 conditional sixth round draft pick grade b the jags are replacing a davon with a davon after the season ending injury to stud dt davon hamilton jacksonville needed help in the middle of its defense snagging davon godchaux from the saints helps fill that void the jags run d which exited week 8 no 1 against the run with hamilton in the lineup slipped while allowing a season high 172 rush yards to the ravens last thursday night perhaps that was simply a product of the third string qb opponent and one massive 65 yard run but the jaguars weren t about to sit around and find out godchaux a former dolphin and patriot has spent 10 years in the league as a run stuffer in 2024 his last year in new england he finished third among dts in run stops 48 before signing with the saints in eight games in 2026 he has generated 15 tackles nine run stops and one stuff it s not a home run move like the acquisition of jessie bates but adding a veteran body in the middle of the defense for a relatively low cost fills a need for jacksonville the jags don t currently have a 2027 sixth round pick still they are unofficially projected to acquire a couple of sixth round compensatory picks per over the cap one of which would then go to new orleans comp picks can t be traded until they re officially awarded in the offseason under the reported terms of the trade jacksonville gm james gladstone headed toward the trade deadline aiming to upgrade safety and defensive tackle he s now done both the jags clearly are all in on making a january push for new orleans godchaux was set to be a free agent after the season so getting a draft pick is solid even an eventual day 3 selection moving the veteran should open up reps for second round pick christian miller who was a healthy scratch on sunday the saints now need the rookie to step up like the falcons the saints were smart to know there is little reason to keep a soon to be 32 year old around for the rest of a campaign when you have three wins halfway through the season even if you re still in the division race snagging a pick is the smart move detroit deals for defensive back date of trade nov 9 detroit receives s andre cisco grade c new york receives 2028 sixth round draft pick grade c the lions added a safety to help fortify the back end of the defense a day before the deadline a former third round pick by jacksonville cisco started 47 games over four seasons with the jags snagging eight ints 1 5 sacks and 154 tackles he signed a one year deal in new york in 2025 and started five games before suffering a torn pec that ended his season the 26 year old re signed with the jets and has started four games this season including a week 3 loss in detroit where he sacked jared goff cisco mostly played a supporting role for the jets this season and has seen his time on defense plummet after week 3 he played zero defensive snaps in sunday s loss in kansas city malachi moore took over in three safety sets making cico expendable a 2028 sixth rounder for a player not in your plans is better than nothing but no one is getting star grades for this bland swap the veteran brings experience to a lions secondary that recently got brian branch back and is still hoping kerby joseph can return from a knee injury that cut short his 2025 season it s not a splash play for brad holmes but it gives detroit another body to throw at the situation for a secondary that has cycled through defenders this season ravens add journeyman qb after jackson huntley injured date of trade nov 6 baltimore receives qb jacoby brissett 2027 fifth round draft pick grade b arizona receives 2027 fourth round draft pick 2028 seventh round draft pick grade b sometimes even in the nfl trades make too much sense not to happen when the ravens lost both lamar jackson and tyler huntley to injury all eyes turned to jacoby brissett whom the arizona cardinals had just benched days later we get a trade baltimore had to make a move jesse minters squad found itself floating up the creek without either paddle forced to steer with a soup spoon it would have been unfair to joe fagnano and the rest of the team to ride the undrafted rookie the rest of the way as we saw thursday night fagnano is simply outmatched right now the free agent options offered little better enter brissett the 33 year old journeyman joins his seventh team in seven seasons he should be able to get up to speed quickly having his former qb coach israel woolfork in baltimore makes the transition easier after sitting out the offseason in an effort to get a reworked contract brissett struggled to fit into mike lafleur s offense he s been a bottom quarter passer this season ranking 18th of 23 qbs in epa per dropback at 0 11 min 200 attempts his stats are down across the board from last season when he finished with 3 366 yards a 23 8 td int ratio a 94 1 passer rating and a 0 05 epa per dropback there is a reason brissett has bounced around there is also a reason he keeps winding up a starter brissett s not the ideal franchise setter but he s a solid addition to a floundering ravens squad that has lost four straight games the hope is that he fits in declan doyle s offense better and gets back to the distributing ways we saw last season the price is about right for a player who was benched the ravens don t currently own any non compensatory fifth or sixth round picks in 2027 so a middle round swap with a 2028 final round sweetener was about as best as they could do it s not great to spend assets to solve a problem on a sinking ship but baltimore couldn t move forward with what it had on the slim chance brissett turns things around and pushes the ravens to the playoffs it was worth the small price the cardinals paid a couple million dollars to move on from their third string qb for a day 3 draft swap and a 2028 dart throw it s not significant capital but it s better than nothing i wonder if they might have received more by waiting until monday to see if another club minnesota jumped into the fray but arizona couldn t let the deadline pass without moving the veteran it was clear brissett was done in the desert after sunday s comeback win from gardner minshew the presence of the mania inducing veteran along with rookie carson beck made brissett superfluous in hindsight arizona probably should have moved on from brissett in the offseason while he was seeking a pay bump i understand why they didn t but he was always going to be a stopgap having two bridges to some unknown land is hardly good asset usage in that view i can t give the cards a rave review but getting even a minor upgrade in the draft is positive and if the ravens continue to spiral even with brissett that fourth rounder could be better bears trade two first rounders for all pro dt date of trade oct 29 chicago receives dt jeffery simmons 2028 fifth round draft pick grade b tennessee receives 2027 first round draft pick 2027 fourth round draft pick 2028 first round draft pick grade a ryan poles finally upgraded the defensive line since may i ve been writing that the bears lack of action along the line whether adding a dt or pass rusher was head scratching the interior was particularly troubling as the bears have been counting on 33 year old grady jarrett and journeymen kentavius street neville gallimore and james lynch coordinator dennis allen has made it work but an upgrade was warranted before the operation collapsed poles never one to sit on his hands made a massive splash simmons is the type of game changing talent who could flip a playoff game in chicago s favor already an nfc favorite to make a postseason run the 5 2 bears have made a move that puts them squarely in the running to hoist a lombardi a beast among beasts simmons leads all defensive tackles with 28 quarterback pressures and is tied for second with four sacks notably he s racked up that production on a titans team that has been behind a lot this season imagine the numbers he d put up in game scripts that force more passes from the offense we re about to find out the 29 year old isn t just a get up the field fly wildly at the quarterback defensive tackle either no no no simmons is a wrecking ball to whatever unfortunate soul might be clutching the pigskin when he s on the warpath in addition to owning the most qb pressures among dts he also is tied for second with 21 run stops and tied for third with seven run stuffs per next gen stats there has been some chatter that his play has waned this season in tennessee i don t buy it if you haven t seen the man with the red armband manically flying around the field in tennessee this season you haven t been watching simmons has been every bit as good as any interior defender this season in the chicago spotlight he could push his way into the dpoy conversation the move could tip the balance of the nfc north and the entire conference in the bears favor that s how good simmons is from a pure player addition standpoint it s a home run for poles the issue is the compensation two first round picks and a fourth rounder is a massive haul it s also notable that the fifth round pick the bears got back with simmons is in 2028 not 2027 two first rounders for a non quarterback is a huge cost i understand why poles was willing to do it with most of his key players on rookie contracts now it was the time to strike however after he pays all those guys including quarterback caleb williams he ll need good players on cheap rookie deals to keep things rolling recent non quarterbacks traded for multiple first round picks include edge rusher micah parsons cornerback sauce gardner offensive tackle laremy tunsil safety jamal adams and edge khalil mack to chicago in 2018 that s a mixed bag of results if i m being kind and some outright cringey mistakes including gardner last year a d lineman isn t a cb but it s still a hefty price for anyone who doesn t sling the oblong the bears doing this twice is notable mack didn t bring the bears a super bowl two playoff appearances however the situation feels different this time chicago has a clear franchise difference maker at quarterback the other recent comparable trade was the dallas cowboys sending a first and second rounder for interior defensive lineman quinnen williams at the deadline last season i should note that simmons is older than every single player i mentioned above was at the time of their trade how the dt ages will factor into what this trade looks like three years from now if there was a parade in downtown chicago before then the locals won t care about the cost of two firsts this was a no brainer for the titans two firsts for a non qb for a team that isn t one player away from contending in a heartbeat simmons was a leader and the squad s pulse but when you have that kind of offer you have to pull the trigger tennessee isn t a jeffery simmons away from being a perennial contender his next few years would have been spent withering away during yet another rebuild and he d have lost trade value it s going to stink for the rest of the locker room this year as robert saleh s team figures to continue struggling however that would be the case with or without simmons until second year qb cam ward morphs into a consistent difference maker not just a sometimes player the titans won t take a step forward if that doesn t happen tennessee will need all the first round picks it can get to find the next guy and give him the best chance to succeed colts part with another pro bowler get pick from 49ers date of trade oct 27 san francisco receives dl deforest buckner grade a indianapolis receives 2027 fourth round draft pick grade b we didn t have to wait long to find out how others in the nfc west would react to the seahawks splash move for quenton nelson hours later the 49ers bolstered their defensive interior by bringing back buckner whom they traded to indy in 2020 the reunion was telegraphed for weeks buckner clearly fed up with the mounting losses in indianapolis began voicing his displeasure couple that with the 49ers need along the defensive line and the move made almost too much sense the niners have the cap space to cover the remainder of buckner s contract assuming it s not adjusted and are all in after their first loss of the season buckner has 47 0 sacks since 2020 tied for second among defensive tackles behind only chris jones 55 122 qb hits 420 tackles and 312 qb pressures the big man can still be a people mover on the interior however the 32 year old is showing some signs of a slide he generated four sacks in 10 games in 2025 his fewest since 2017 his pass rush percentages are also down a tick from the past couple of years he s generated an 8 3 qb pressure rate through seven games buckner was at 10 3 in 2025 and 11 7 in 2024 similarly his run stop rates have dipped as well going from 15 7 in 2024 to 15 6 in 2025 to 12 4 in 2026 is it age or can we just chalk the dips up to playing in a struggling defense for a losing team regardless of whether he s on the downturn buckner represents an upgrade in the middle of the 49ers battered defensive line paired with osa odighizuwa the niners now have two players who can push the pocket if buckner also boosts the interior run d probably the 49ers weakest spot at this point it will be a clear win for the niners the cost might be a tad much for an 11 year pro on the back nine of his career who could be a short term rental but a fourth rounder isn t exorbitant by any stretch it s the type of move a team like the 49ers in a super bowl window should make i ll reward aggression with day 3 draft picks when it nets a good player who can make a difference in a playoff run buckner was probably the most obvious asset the colts had that was going to be moved he was in the final year of his contract clearly unhappy and any compensatory pick they could have received back would have been at most a fifth rounder in 2028 due to how long he s been in the league if he even signs a deal big enough to qualify in 2027 getting a fourth rounder in 2027 out of that is a win for indy the colts need as many lotto tickets as possible for the next general manager i d expect ed dodds to listen to offers on any of his pending free agents and potentially others under contract beyond 2027 the only real issue with the oct 27 deal is that as with nelson the colts might have gotten more for buckner possibly a late round sweetener by shopping him around for another two weeks even with that qualification i still like the return indy got in this swap seahawks acquire eight time pro bowl guard from colts date of trade oct 27 seattle receives g quenton nelson grade a indianapolis receives 2027 third round draft pick 2028 fifth round draft pick grade b the seahawks had some sneaky issues along the offensive line despite entering the season with the same five that helped win a super bowl while the run game concerns have mostly been pinned on the running backs the blocking has struggled to open holes on 184 rb carries the seahawks have just 92 yards before contact this season per next gen stats and they ve been stuffed 37 times that s not the type of offense mike macdonald wants to employ yes getting zach charbonnet and jadarian price back healthy could have helped but general manager john schneider went to cure the root cause nelson is an eight time pro bowl guard who is still playing at a hall of fame level the 30 year old can open holes in the run game is a weapon as a puller and is superior as a pass protector in eight seasons in indy he allowed no more than eight qb hits in a single season per pff the seahawks just added the nfl s most complete guard how will the rest of the nfc west respond the addition will immediately help sam darnold keeping the qb clean will go a long way toward negating some of the wayward interceptions adding nelson also aids whoever lines up at left tackle where starter charles cross is expected to miss a week or two with a high ankle sprain importing the left guard will bump second year player grey zabel to right guard where he played in college and where seattle has had trouble for a while anthony bradford struggled even during the super bowl run the price for seattle is excellent given that it s expected to get a slew of compensatory picks in 2027 nelson being on an expiring deal also helps if he leaves for a big deal the seahawks would be in line for another comp pick in 2028 we ve seen schneider re sign players acquired in season as well leonard williams and rashid shaheed so it s not guaranteed to be a rental for the seahawks either it s not every day you can snag a future hall of famer to fill a significant hole without giving up a pick in the top two rounds i was somewhat surprised indy couldn t get a second round pick back given the overwhelming need across the league along the offensive line but we know that gms are stingier in season then become drunken sailors on draft day so maybe i shouldn t be so amazed i can t blame the colts for moving any and all assets to recoup chris ballard s mistakes but i wonder if they d have gotten more by waiting until closer to the deadline without a first round pick which right now would be in the top 10 and a roster riddled with holes the next general manager needs as much ammo as possible stripping down the roster will only make the sauce gardner trade sting even more given nelson s status as a pending free agent the colts could have waited and let him walk in free agency but the compensation would have been a third round pick max in 2028 this trade allows them to get the pick a year earlier and adds a fifth round sweetener trading away their best player two weeks before the trade deadline suggests a teardown is in play indy should be very active over the next fortnight and you can bet any gm with a need is going to put in a call to colts interim gm ed dodds cards deal former no 4 pick to texans date of trade oct 12 houston receives wr marvin harrison 2027 sixth round draft pick grade c arizona receives 2027 second round draft pick 2027 seventh round draft pick grade b when the trade details came through i assumed it was a typo that the texans shipped a 2027 second round pick for a player who was clearly out of the rotation in arizona my brain rationalized it as a 2028 second rounder or a 2027 fourth rounder nope the texans paid a premium pick in the upcoming draft for a shot at revitalizing harrison s career the cards reportedly had made it known they were holding out for a second round pick the moment the texans upped their bid to a second in 2027 they pounced i don t fault arizona for moving on right now in four games in 2026 harrison caught five passes on 13 targets for 85 yards and one touchdown that s like a half of one game for the upper echelon of wrs harrison has generated 0 6 yards per route run this year the third lowest among players with at least 100 routes per next gen stats basically harrison has been doing little more than a cardio workout on sundays getting a second rounder is solid work the grade isn t higher because the same brass that acquired that asset used the no 4 overall pick on harrison in 2024 monti ossenfort still gets docked for whiffing on a prime selection i understand why the texans would take a swing on harrison like most of the league they probably gave the ohio state product a very high pre draft grade reuniting him with former buckeyes teammate c j stroud could bring out the best in the wideout the texans have struggled mightily to move the ball when nico collins has been injured and given collins history and the hard hits he takes he s not guaranteed to make it through the rest of the season without missing time after laying an egg for four weeks the 1 4 texans don t have any more wiggle room harrison s contract isn t onerous giving houston some insurance if tank dell never returns to form or jayden higgins is delayed next year coming off a season ending injury in the short term this trade is somewhat duplicative of the much cheaper deal in which it acquired kayshon boutte it s more costly but gives the club more control of the future mostly i don t love the price tag for a player who hasn t been who we thought he was for it to make sense to give up a day 2 pick the texans need harrison to finally break out after two mediocre seasons perhaps in improved surroundings and on a team that clearly wants him with a qb he knows and trusts harrison can blossom frankly i probably like many scouts can t figure out the disconnect between a player who looked as polished and well rounded as harrison did at osu and the one we ve seen lope about for two plus years the question is whether you believe the scouting or the two separate coaching staffs who haven t found much use for him the texans are betting on their scouting eagles send pro bowl ol to ravens date of trade oct 7 baltimore receives c cam jurgens 2027 seventh round draft pick grade b philadelphia receives 2027 fifth round draft pick 2028 second round draft pick grade a we should start with the obvious the two time pro bowler was available for a reason especially after the same offensive line saw a future hall of famer lane johnson retire the day prior jurgens is currently a pro bowler in name only after battling through a back injury in 2024 to help the eagles net a super bowl ring jurgens has not been the same player he struggled through last season and has been a liability through four games this year his pass blocking has never been otherworldly but it s particularly crumbled after he was asked to move to left guard the past three weeks blame the previous injuries or the ill fit in the eagles new blocking scheme but jurgens has been borderline unplayable the past few weeks drew kendall played better than jurgens at center in sean mannion s scheme so a move back wasn t in the cards it got so bad that nick sirianni was fending off questions about potentially benching the guard instead philly shipped him out of town we know that howie roseman doesn t care what year he gets his picks famously saying a first round pick is a first round pick regarding the a j brown trade this offseason when philly netted a 28 first however we can dock him ever so slightly for delayed satisfaction otherwise getting a second rounder for a struggling player who was not a fit is a home run in the short term the eagles offensive line is in flux with willie lampkin in line to take over at guard the hope is that landon dickerson returns to form when he eventually comes off injured reserve the trade is jarring coming right after johnson s retirement but getting a significant draft pick back for a player who was on the verge of being benched makes sense philly is now loaded in the 2028 draft with two firsts and two seconds even acknowledging jurgens significant struggles the play makes sense for the ravens the plans to replace tyler linderbaum who signed with the raiders in free agency this summer were wobbly from the start the ones they rode with danny pinter jovaughn gwyn and ethan pocic have all landed on injured reserve counting on pocic coming off injury was always a gamble the ravens crapped out instead of sticking with rookie olaivavega ioane out of position at center baltimore will take a roll of the dice that jurgens can get back to form it s not a terrible gamble and it s conceivable the 27 year old can bounce back with a return to center in a different scheme jurgens contract which has him under team control through 2029 for relatively cheap is also desirable for baltimore injury is always part of the equation and jurgens enters his time in baltimore in the league s concussion protocol nfl network s mike garafolo reported if he s healthy and returns to form this will be an excellent move for baltimore if he continues to struggle or misses a ton of time it will be the latest swing and miss in trying to replace linderbaum porter drama ends in trade to dallas date of trade oct 1 dallas receives cb joey porter grade a pittsburgh receives 2027 sixth round draft pick 2028 second round draft pick grade c the cowboys desperately needed corner help for a defense that has floundered despite the offseason upgrades i ll credit jerry jones for not sitting on his hands instead doing what we have been asking general managers to do for years be bold make moves and don t overvalue your own picks during a season we won t know if the trade pays off in the long term but the cowboys certainly improved in 2026 at his peak porter is a physical cover man who can be sticky on the outside and mirror top receivers he ll slide well into christian parker s scheme allowing dallas to play man coverage on the outside with more physicality than in the first three weeks sure he racks up some penalties but so do most cbs you ll live with the trade off for a corner with jpj s skill set that dallas didn t have to give up a premier pick until 2028 also improved its grade assuming that porter plays the cowboys get a top shelf cb for a relatively cheap up front cost jones seems to be hoping he can copy the success he had with the george pickens trade pushing off the long term talks until down the road it s a needle threading but one that could work if porter plays well dallas could extend him in the offseason use the franchise tag on the cb or let him walk and recoup a potential third round compensatory pick in 2028 possibly moving down one round in 28 and giving up a sixth rounder for a potential pro bowl player in a year when you re all in is a stellar move if porter delivers 14 games of high level play it s worth it of course if porter gets hurt or implodes this all goes for naught however if he continues on this track it is a short term win for the cowboys the long term question can be shelved i don t fault the steelers for not wanting to pay porter top cb money if he were seeking a 30 million type deal in line with christian gonzalez or devon witherspoon i would have balked too jpj is good he s not at that level trading him away relieved pittsburgh of that problem the issue i have is that it appears steelers gm omar khan either overplayed his hand or didn t anticipate porter s gumption when it came to a new deal if khan had never planned to meet the corner s contract demands he should have made a move in the spring or early summer a player of porter s caliber is worth more than a second round pick two drafts down the road the timing of the impasse reduced the compensation now the steelers are without a top corner and find themselves thin and young at the position not a good combo if things spiral in pittsburgh it s fair to wonder if khan will even be around to make that second round pick in 2028 the gm took over in 2022 and received early praise for fleecing the bears in the chase claypool trade that brought back a second rounder that pick became porter khan has now moved him for pennies on the dollar add in a string of so so drafts the pickens trade and other questionable moves and the seat in pittsburgh could get hot for khan if the steelers flounder giants trade for mccarthy after dart injury date of trade sept 28 new york receives qb j j mccarthy grade c minnesota receives 2027 fifth round draft pick grade c minnesota signaled its intent to move on from the former no 10 overall pick by inking kyler murray and bringing back carson wentz in the offseason mccarthy got a slim shot at the starting job during training camp but he couldn t even fend off wentz for the primary backup role a former first rounder turned clipboard holder is a bad look all around had another club made an offer of substance before the season i believe the vikings would have moved on then given mccarthy s rough preseason however it s no surprise it took an injury to a starting qb to move the needle a fifth rounder isn t nothing and the vikings save a few pennies however the reality is they turned a first fourth and late round pick swap into 10 starts and a future fifth rounder that math isn t mathing mccarthy s poor play and injury history left the vikings with no good options for a team in win now mode minnesota didn t have time to let the 23 year old develop on his terms moving on makes sense but the vikings can t get a high grade for the compensation new york took a shot that in a new setting and in an offense keyed on the ground attack john harbaugh and his staff can do what kevin o connell couldn t i don t hate the price for a former first round quarterback who even the stingiest draft graders pegged as a day 2 selection teams use fifth rounders and later as qb dart throws all the time the giants lack of 2027 picks is of concern but they can deal with that later with jaxson dart out for the regular season after knee surgery the giants needed to make some sort of move jameis winston has shown he can hold the fort for a spell but it s a serious question if harbaugh will give the boom or bust passer enough leash for a 15 game run bringing in mccarthy at least gives the giants another alternative if winston crumbles at this stage there aren t a whole lot of other options i m not optimistic that mccarthy can turn his career around but for a fifth round pick it s worth a shot for new york

news_mentions.headline: Week 10 NFL MVP tracker: Bengals' Joe Burrow leads race at midpoint of 2026 season
news_mentions.description: We've reached the midway point of the 2026 NFL season and with it comes a No. 1 in Kevin Patra's weekly MVP tracker. Who surpasses Josh Allen at the top?
news_mentions.body_text: we ve passed the halfway mark of the 2026 campaign and quarterbacks have officially fully taken over the mvp discussion we ve seen some ridiculously high level quarterback play recently from joe burrow dicing up defenses like a top chef on deadline to jordan love dive bombing opponents into oblivion this week i wanted to do something different with our mvp tracker we re going to highlight one play that illustrates why each qb is an mvp candidate sidenote before y all get madonline it s not necessarily the qb s best play of the season beyond that being wholly subjective i wanted to highlight traits that were indicative of their otherworldly play now let s get to the rankings mvp rankings note up down arrows below reflect movement from the week 9 edition next in line seahawks wr jaxon smith njigba bears qb caleb williams lions rb jahmyr gibbs chiefs rb kenneth walker lions qb jared goff voting for the 2026 nfl channel midseason awards is open viewers can scan the qr code displayed daily on nfl channel to access the voting page and make their selections

news_mentions.headline: Colts trade WR Keenan Allen to 49ers for 2027 sixth-round pick
news_mentions.description: The San Francisco 49ers are acquiring veteran wide receiver Keenan Allen from the Indianapolis Colts in exchange for a 2027 sixth-round draft pick, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported on Tuesday.
news_mentions.body_text: the san francisco 49ers have added another veteran for their ailing wide receiver room the niners acquired keenan allen from the colts in exchange for a 2027 sixth round pick indianapolis announced tuesday ahead of the trade deadline nfl network and espn first reported the news allen signed in indy in august to help a banged up receiver corps now he s being shipped west to aid another the first of two wideouts indy dealt on tuesday as josh downs was later sent to kansas city in eight games this season allen has generated 40 catches for 351 yards and a touchdown the longtime los angeles chargers star who earned six pro bowls in l a isn t as steady as he once was but the 34 year old still knows how to run a route and can be counted on for third downs allen has become something of a nomad in the past few years after his pro bowl 2023 season he was traded to chicago for a fourth round pick he then returned to l a in 2025 this year deep into the summer he latched onto shane steichen s squad in 14 seasons allen has generated 12 402 yards on 1 095 catches with 71 tds he might not be the allen of old but he brings reliability to a decimated 49ers wr room still without mike evans rib achilles and deebo samuel hamstring jordan watkins was brock purdy s top target last week and the niners have been seeing significant snaps from demarcus robinson brandin cooks and jacob cowing the addition of allen gives the 49ers the nfl s active leader in wr receptions allen the nfl s active leader in wr receiving yards evans 13 472 yards the nfl s active leader in rb receptions receiving yards and receiving tds christian mccaffrey 662 catches for 5 660 yards and 37 tds and the second ranked active te in receiving touchdowns george kittle 57 behind only travis kelce 84 per nfl research

news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top

news_mentions.headline: San Francisco 49ers training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With the start of NFL training camps just around the corner, Grant Gordon provides a refresher on the San Francisco 49ers' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc west catch up on the san francisco 49ers offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 15 rookies july 22 veterans location sap performance facility santa clara california fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs denver broncos 8 30 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 at las vegas raiders 4 p m et on saturday aug 16 nfl network week 3 vs los angeles chargers 8 30 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note san francisco doesn t face a team that made the 2024 playoffs in the final eight weeks of the upcoming season nfl research what you need to know 1 after a four year sojourn in jersey as the new york jets head coach robert saleh has returned to the bay as defensive coordinator but his house isn t as he left it the 49ers were fifth in yards allowed and 17th in points in 2020 saleh s last with the squad in 2024 they were still eighth in yards but an awful 29th in points given up san francisco underwent myriad roster changes with plenty of departures on the defensive side dre greenlaw talanoa hufanga and charvarius ward among them the cupboard is hardly bare though as saleh can rely on dominant mainstays nick bosa and fred warner among the big questions to be answered this summer is how his ex jets pass rusher bryce huff acclimates out west after a trying 2024 with the philadelphia eagles and how fast no 11 overall pick mykel williams gets going there are plenty more quandaries for saleh to address though williams is likely to be among three rookie starters along with defensive tackle alfred collins and linebacker nick martin and the 49ers produced just 37 sacks a season ago tied for 23rd in the nfl saleh s got plenty of reconstruction at hand amid his return 2 unlike last summer christian mccaffrey is set for training camp and set to be all systems go originally thought to be precautionary mccaffrey missed camp last year with an achilles and calf injury that extended to him missing the first eight games of the season after finally getting back on the field mccaffrey s campaign concluded with a pcl injury in total he played only four games during a disastrous 2024 season cmc has proclaimed himself healthy from his pcl and had no restrictions during offseason workouts his health will remain a concern though it s a given following the third season in his eight year career in which he played seven games or less due to injury the coming weeks will also be worth seeing if mccaffrey 29 resembles his 2023 rushing champion self since he was traded from the panthers whom he s slated to face for the first time in week 12 to the 49ers mccaffrey has propelled san francisco to a 23 8 record when he s on the field the niners are 8 12 without him plain and simple mccaffrey is one of the nfl s elite when he s healthful and so are the 49ers 3 finally the 49ers were in line for a drama less training camp then reports surfaced that wide receiver jauan jennings was disenchanted with his contract a two year 15 39 million pact signed in the spring of 2024 brock purdy george kittle and fred warner each worked out lengthy and lucrative new deals already in a stark contrast from past offseasons when brandon aiyuk and trent williams 2024 nick bosa 2023 and deebo samuel 2022 had dilemmas dominate summer headlines just how large jennings contract dismay looms over camp remains to be seen regardless it illuminates an already existing concern for the 49ers their wide receiver corps samuel was one of plenty notable departures for the team the wideback s trade to washington coupled with aiyuk s recovery from a 2024 knee injury put the position in question jennings stepped up and into the wr1 role last season and will likely get tabbed as such again but there s now a wrinkle to those best laid plans 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall has a big camp ahead and a larger role to take after that ex los angeles ram demarcus robinson second year wideout jacob cowing and rookies jordan watkins and junior bergen will be vying to make contributions

news_mentions.headline: AFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Colts, Jaguars, Texans, Titans
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top AFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Houston Texans, Indianapolis Colts, Jacksonville Jaguars and Tennessee Titans.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars and tennessee titans catch up on each afc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars tennessee titans three key storylines 1 another o line overhaul the most glaring weakness of the 2025 texans will take center stage during training camp as houston once again undergoes an offensive line revamp demeco ryans crew re upped right guard ed ingram and left tackle aireontae ersery showed glimpses of promise during his up and down rookie campaign the texans drafted center guard keylan rutledge in the first round they inked guard wyatt teller and right tackle braden smith both solid veterans when healthy in free agency veteran trent brown and 2024 second rounder blake fisher will battle for reps and or the swing tackle gig and evan brown and fourth round rookie febechi nwaiwu provide depth inside on paper it s a significantly improved group from the one that got bowled over a year ago however we ve said that before paper can get shredded just like last year s o line in houston how the crew shakes out will be the key to camp and how the texans season unfolds 2 can stroud offense get back on track tied to the first point is the play of c j stroud who has seen his production dip the past two seasons after a sensational rookie campaign in 2023 stroud s collapse reached a low with his ghastly performance see four interceptions 42 6 completion rate in the playoff loss to the new england patriots stroud has been scattershot behind a woeful offensive line at times last year he trusted his blocking so little that even when he had time he d rush decisions and make panicked throws the qb s play has been so incongruous to the poise and calm he displayed as a rookie that it s maddening for the offense to get back in gear and stop wasting a championship worthy defense stroud must be more consistent in the pocket an improved offensive line will certainly help but the qb must raise all boats even when the situation isn t perfect getting better run production with the import of david montgomery should improve the offensive efficiency monty rarely gets stuffed for negative gains solving a problem we saw far too often from houston s ground game a year ago he should keep the offense in better down and distances one other key player to track during camp is receiver tank dell who has been out since late in the 2024 season due to a severe knee injury the difference in stroud s production with and without dell in the lineup is stark what sort of shape will the receiver be in after so much time away and can he stay healthy 3 rich defense gets richer can the most ferocious defense in the league actually be better in 2026 edge monsters will anderson and danielle hunter are still in their primes derek stingley kamari lassiter jalen pitre and calen bullock form a lockdown backend and azeez al shaair still patrols the middle the texans upgraded a safety spot with veteran reed blankenship after shuffling through others at the position second round pick kayden mcdonald could play a significant role out of the gate alongside sheldon rankins and tommy togiai in the middle of the d line if mcdonald turns out to be a steal this defense will have zero weaknesses back to top three key storylines 1 how will jones look in return from injury daniel jones progress is the no 1 topic in indianapolis entering camp the colts predictably held the starter out of team drills during offseason workouts but expect him to be full go sometime during camp the focus will be on how many reps he can take and how he looks indy was a wonder early last season when jones was on his game making plays and looking at home in shane steichen s offense it fell apart when the qb got hurt the colts put all their eggs in the basket of jones returning healthy this offseason achilles injuries however can be a slog to return from yes jones is younger than kirk cousins but we saw how long it took for the latter to return to anything close to what he was before such an injury and cousins never relied on his mobility like jones does if jones is stuck in the pocket or struggles to push off the injured leg leading to limp passes will the colts offense wither how he looks early in camp won t say everything but it will give a strong indication of what to expect for the first quarter of the season in concert the colts will conduct a backup qb competition between anthony richardson and riley leonard barring richardson s trade request being granted of course given jones injury history the winner could see reps this season 2 overall roster health health is the main storyline throughout the colts roster from jones to alec pierce on offense to key defenders like deforest buckner and sauce gardner on defense buckner is one to track on d the colts have no replacement for the star dt who underwent neck surgery last winter he could be ready for week 1 but at this point it remains an unknown he was noncommittal when asked this offseason given how much of the summer months are filled with players dismissing injury and assuming they ll be ready it s a red flag when a veteran is evasive if buckner misses the start of the season or sees his play dip it could be devastating for indy s defense how much he participates in camp if at all will be closely tracked there isn t the same concern with gardner who missed significant time last season with a lingering calf injury but the star s status is worth keeping an eye on we also aren t sure what charvarius ward will look like after deciding against retiring following last year s concussion issues outside of injury questions what will the pass rush look like is laiatu latu ready to make a leap how much does arden key still have left is jt tuimoloau ready for a bigger role do the colts need to bring in another veteran edge 3 taylor s future in indy outside of health concerns hovering over colts camp the future of jonathan taylor is an interesting question the 27 year old running back is in the final year of his contract the situation is far less contentious than the last time he sought a new pact which saw him conduct a hold in until he got paid when asked about his contract this summer taylor was cordial about the state of affairs but made it known he d like to continue getting paid in indy could the situation turn sour again will the rb decide to ratchet things up if no extension comes before camp perhaps he s waiting for bijan robinson and jahmyr gibbs to reset the market again before making his next play we saw the offense s struggles when jones was out as defenses could sell out to stop jt it wasn t pretty if taylor is going to be asked to keep carrying a hefty load with little aid he might want commensurate compensation into the future back to top three key storylines 1 backfield shakeup when travis etienne signed in new orleans it opened up a swath of carries bhayshul tuten who has impressed this offseason is expected to have a hefty role but it s still unclear how big that part might be as free agent addition chris rodriguez was unable to participate in offseason workouts following a surgical procedure on his left foot the veteran is expected to be good to go for training camp which will give us a better idea of how liam coen might divvy up his rb reps last year etienne took the overwhelming majority of carries 260 to tuten s 83 will coen slice up the pie more or ride tuten at least to start the season a lot might have to do with rodriguez s health 2 what will hunter s role be when it was reported that the jags planned for the former no 2 overall pick to be a primary corner and part time receiver travis hunter didn t seem to take too kindly to that plan we won t know the truth until hunter is on the field for a significant amount of time how much he participates early in camp and where that participation takes place will indicate the club s intentions if the second year dual threat player is the lockdown corner most believe he s capable of being and continues to make plays at receiver the jags could have trouble taking him off the gridiron the rest of the offensive playmakers could have some say in how much time hunter sees at wr after a disappointing second season brian thomas has received glowing reviews this offseason parker washington soared to close last season and jakobi meyers remains a consistent professional if btj gets back on track there could be less of a reason to use hunter in a ton of offensive sets 3 lloyd s replacement the jags saw devin lloyd leave in free agency and didn t replace his production in anthony campanile s defense via free agency or early in the draft the decision puts 2023 fourth rounder ventrell miller in line to take over the role next to foye oluokun miller showed spunk this offseason but won t be handed the starting gig 2025 undrafted lb branson combs and 2026 seventh rounder parker hughes could have a shot to push miller for the starting gig if no one comes to the forefront the jags d could be in a rough spot lloyd shined last year under campanile who unleashed the linebacker s athleticism in a second team all pro campaign lacking playmaking in the middle would highlight some of the questions up front where there wasn t always consistent pressure from the front four back to top three key storylines 1 cam ward cam ward cam ward when discussing critical elements for the 2026 tennessee titans point nos 1 through 50 could all be about cam ward that s how vital his development is to any success in nashville robert saleh brings a professional coach to the head chair and did well to import brian daboll to nurture the young quarterback perhaps daboll wasn t meant for the head coaching gig in new york but he s proven he can help grow a qb josh allen daniel jones and jaxson dart all improved under daboll ward offers enticing upside while his accuracy came and went last year when he was in a groove the titans qb showcased a laser arm and the ability to find the range deep he needs to calibrate his short to mid area throws at times but the alluring positives pop off the page he doesn t need to live in the acrobatic athletic plays but they can add an indefensible element to tennessee s offense improving his mental processing particularly against man coverage where he struggled is one of the early steps ward has to make this season the titans must see significant strides forward from their qb in year 2 after the club improved his surroundings 2 better receiving corps in attempting to make life easier for ward tennessee upgraded the wr room first they inked wan 39 dale robinson from new york the slot maven excelled in daboll s offense and can help teach a young wideout room the ropes robinson is coming off a 1 014 yard season and generated a career high 11 yards per catch in 2025 the veteran will be particularly helpful to ward on third downs when he can win from the slot and make himself available to the quarterback then the titans used the no 4 overall pick on ohio state wr carnell tate who provides a vertical threat and heady playmaking tate s ability to make catches in close knit areas will be a boon for his new qb second year wrs elic ayomanor and chimere dike both showed glimmers of promise during their rookie campaigns if they take a step forward this could be an enticing group the lingering question is what role calvin ridley will play the veteran struggled on the field and missed the bulk of the season due to injury in seven tilts he had just 303 yards on 17 catches with zero tds his 11 1 drop rate last season was fifth worst in the nfl minimum 25 targets per next gen stats the titans eschewed cutting ridley believing he can still aid ward and the offense what that role is will be determined during camp 3 will improved d on paper translate to field the titans sported a woeful defense last season with saleh taking over the club the unit was completely revamped on paper it s much improved but how will all the new pieces mesh i love adding a penetrating john franklin myers next to all world dt jeffery simmons however is there enough on the edges jermaine johnson had his best years under saleh but hasn t been a consistent force first round rookie keldric faulk boasts talent but will he be a day 1 difference maker will second round rookie linebacker anthony hill immediately step into the middle of the defense next to the underrated cedric gray the secondary was horrendous last season tennessee responded by signing cordale flott alontae taylor and joshua williams all have had moments in their careers when they ve been stellar but there is also a reason each was available namely inconsistency i trust saleh to know how he wants his d to run and to get the most out of his players there is no question this crew is significantly improved on paper but questions remain particularly with all the free agent veteran additions back to top
