news_mentions.headline: NFL QB rankings, Week 10: Joe Burrow climbs to No. 1; Caleb Williams slides
news_mentions.description: Who joins Joe Burrow as a riser in Nick Shook's QB rankings at midseason? Check out the updated pecking order, 1-32, heading into Week 10.
news_mentions.body_text: notes up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 9 qb index stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl tier 1 it s time we insert joe burrow into the mvp conversation he s an outrageously efficient and daring quarterback who is powering one of the most explosive offenses in the nfl if the bengals mount a deep playoff run he ll be the face of it he might also become the face of the league s quarterbacks the one spot drop is no knock on josh allen whose ability to win in the margins enabled buffalo to leave minneapolis with a major victory on monday night allen did the special things he usually does to help the bills survive the brian flores defense and should be proud of the performance even if it wasn t his most statistically impressive game of the season no quarterback in the nfl is currently more in sync with his receivers than jordan love it makes sense green bay has asked him to carry the offense all season long that s bad for opponents because the additional reps have helped love settle into a rhythm that makes for appointment viewing each week christian watson s career best pace isn t happening by accident the texans were able to enjoy a spectacular c j stroud performance in week 9 he s produced plenty of them this season and could find himself in the mvp conversation if houston can turn around its season brock purdy has thrown three interceptions in his last two games but his positive contributions vastly outweigh the negative he s becoming an entertaining quarterback when operating out of structure like when he scrambled for a touchdown largely because the raiders apparently decided they d rather prevent a pass than tackle him purdy happily took that gift and will have yet another new receiver trade acquisition keenan allen to learn this week trevor lawrence started last thursday night on a heater throwing a beautiful seam ball to parker washington for a touchdown lawrence didn t need to do much else for the jaguars to cruise to victory he s in command of the offense and should be expected to remain in this tier for the foreseeable future as part of one of the nfl s best squads next gen stats insights via nfl pro c j stroud completed 10 of 16 passes between 10 and 19 yards downfield for 254 yards five touchdowns and an interception in week 9 against the chargers it s the only game in which a quarterback has thrown five touchdowns targeting the intermediate level since at least 2016 and the third most yards recorded by a quarterback on such throws in that span tier 2 detroit s win in miami was ugly and made for an unexpectedly difficult outing for jared goff who had a hard time finding open windows against miami s scrappy defense he threw an interception on a play in which his arm was hit as he released the ball narrowly missed being responsible for an earlier turnover and threw for just 170 yards in the low scoring triumph i m not ready to say he s developing a turnover issue he had not thrown a pick prior to week 8 but as head coach dan campbell intimated at halftime on sunday the lions need to get going offensively what happens when you throw four interceptions in a prime time game you fall a tier in the qb index that s what caleb williams did on sunday night struggling against tampa bay s relentless blitzes it s not all on him chicago s running game has largely disappeared of late but after looking superhuman at times in 2026 williams was very mortal on sunday patrick mahomes on the other hand might actually be superhuman a gruesome hit to his throwing arm sent every chiefs fan into panic mode but somehow mahomes shook it off and calmly led the chiefs to a runaway win by completing 23 of 31 passes for 242 yards and two touchdowns against the jets he s also welcoming slot receiver josh downs via trade this week i m eager to see how downs improves kansas city s passing attack the cowboys escaped indianapolis with a win in a weird game that saw dak prescott do what he does best air it out his 335 yard two touchdown performance was crucial to dallas winning efforts they ll need that and more against san francisco this week matthew stafford isn t playing anywhere near the caliber of his mvp 2025 season and still makes a head scratching throw or two per game he s just not as sharp as he s been in the past but he s also a primary reason the rams have stacked a few wins i worry about how he ll fare without the injured puka nacua going forward though next gen stats insights via nfl pro dak prescott completed 8 of 11 passes against man coverage for a season high 181 yards and two touchdowns in week 9 against the colts prescott connected with ceedee lamb on four passes for 95 yards and a touchdown against man coverage the fourth most yards the duo has recorded against man in a single game prescott completed 13 of 23 passes for 154 yards against zone coverage in the game tier 3 drake maye has a turnover problem again spending sunday throwing a couple of meatball subs to packers defenders and burying his team he s trusting his arm too much at times and looks uncomfortable in other instances but he s also playing without a couple of top pass catching options it s been an up and down year for maye no doubt bryce young the most volatile member of the qb index in 2026 is back on the rise after entering a flow state that powered a panthers comeback against the broncos he nearly positioned carolina to take an eight point second half lead before fate had different ideas young threw a wacky interception that was more a result of the defensive play made and the spheroid that is a football than a mistake by young the turnover stopped the panthers momentum in its tracks though young did his best to throw them back into the game in the fourth quarter but fumbled away their last chance ending a roller coaster of a day that fits his season kirk cousins swan song with the raiders wasn t quite as bad as the final stat line suggested yes he threw three interceptions and yes he appeared to lack the arm strength to complete a couple of highly ambitious attempts but he also played well enough to help the raiders momentarily climb back into a chaotic affair versus the niners now that he s a viking he s moving back to minneapolis with expectations of becoming a hero for the dreadful minnesota offense raiders fans will remember him as the capable veteran who guided the offense admirably in the first nine weeks under head coach klint kubiak geno smith helped the jets battle with the chiefs for a half on sunday before succumbing to steve spagnuolo s defense which feels appropriate given how gang green s season is going can cam ward build on his excellent week 8 showing following tennessee s bye will aaron rodgers be needed to power the steelers offense beyond a few key completions each week the second half should answer both of these questions for us next gen stats insights via nfl pro bryce young completed 28 of 39 passes for 276 yards with three touchdowns and an interception in week 9 against the broncos young went 13 of 14 for 152 yards and a touchdown on throws targeting in breaking routes young has thrown for 1 127 yards on in breaking routes this season the most among all quarterbacks tier 4 the buccaneers finally needed baker mayfield to throw the ball on sunday night a responsibility he embraced by launching a beautiful strike to tez johnson as part of tampa bay s comeback efforts unfortunately mayfield also threw two interceptions illustrating how his return from injury hasn t exactly been the smoothest experience tyler shough represented one half of a low output afternoon in the superdome on sunday until desperation set in against cleveland shough rediscovered his clutch gene at the perfect time and dropped a collection of dimes on the likes of chris olave and juwan johnson in the saints overtime win i ll be tracking him closely to see how he continues to develop a rapport with rookie jordyn tyson jayden daniels still makes plays that remind us of why he became an instant star as a rookie but he s also struggling with game management he doesn t seem to understand that he can t afford to throw the ball in the middle of the field with mere seconds remaining in a comeback effort and his offensive line didn t make matters any easier for him against a rams front that finally enjoyed the combined efforts of myles garrett three sacks and aaron donald bo nix is crawling yes crawling back toward where he was last season on sunday he included a few rollouts and throws across his body he fired a dart to courtland sutton for a first quarter score and calmly led two fourth quarter touchdown drives in the broncos road win over the panthers i want to believe it s a sign of better things to come but it sure feels like i ve been asked to watch grass grow michael penix s good doesn t outweigh his bad results right now an unfortunate reality for a quarterback whose successes have led me to believe he could grow into a star next gen stats insights via nfl pro tyler shough completed all three of his downfield attempts in the first half for 99 yards against the browns he doubled his downfield attempts to six in the second half and added two more in overtime completing two of those eight for 48 yards and a touchdown to clinch the win shough also recorded 51 rushing yards on 10 rushes including five scrambles for a career high 41 yards tier 5 drew lock s second start of the season ended in another win but he s dealing with elbow and oblique injuries leaving the seahawks qb situation in a somewhat tenuous state even though he s expected to play in week 10 it s not the best sign when j j mccarthy s exit and jameis winston s insertion into the game provides the giants with the spark they need to win i d like to chalk it up to the matchup with the eagles but i ll withhold harsher judgment on mccarthy for now nobody remembers the beginning when the ending is gripping but i refuse to allow a desperate final few minutes to occlude the fact that shedeur sanders was ineffective through the first three quarters of his start on sunday it was bad enough to wonder if backup dillon gabriel might be the better option until cleveland had no choice but to ask sanders to chuck it deep i ll credit sanders for hitting a few key passes in the final few minutes and overtime but those who believe that performance should inspire a quarterback controversy are simply clickbaiting gardner minshew s magic ran out in seattle on sunday he couldn t get anything going nor could the cardinals finish off a must have goal to go situation in the fourth quarter minshew might be out for the season with the elbow injury he suffered in the game setting up rookie carson beck s first start daniel jones made enough plays to help the colts climb back into sunday s contest against the cowboys he also ended indianapolis chances with yet another turnover next gen stats insights via nfl pro shedeur sanders completed three of his six downfield attempts for 154 yards and a touchdown against the saints with all six attempts occurring in the second half and overtime sanders fourth quarter deep pass to jerry jeudy set up a field goal attempt that sent the game to overtime sanders added 55 5 win probability on downfield attempts a career high mark tier 6 justin herbert ended his streak after going two games without a touchdown pass but he threw yet another interception against the texans malik willis best throw was wiped out on sunday by a holding penalty on rookie tight end will kacmarek it was a rough day for the quarterback who threw an interception and suffered a core muscle injury that landed him on injured reserve joe milton scrambled more often than i expected against the giants but largely looked like the inexperienced quarterback i expected to see joe fagnano s first start commanded attention on thursday night but he was no match for the jaguars defense baltimore s quick trade for jacoby brissett said everything we needed to know about the undrafted rookie like baltimore s move for brissett minnesota s trade for kirk cousins was entirely expected because of how poorly carson wentz played on monday night at one point in the second half he couldn t even complete simple passes on slants and out routes hopefully cousins can save this unit because wentz certainly wasn t up to the challenge next gen stats insights via nfl pro justin herbert completed 2 of 11 downfield passes 10 air yards for 66 yards and an interception in week 9 against the texans the fewest yards he has recorded on such throws in a game this season his 18 2 completion percentage on downfield passes is the second lowest of his career and he has now thrown an interception on a downfield pass in every game this season

news_mentions.headline: Notable injuries, news from Sunday's Week 9 games: Rams WR Puka Nacua to undergo testing on knee injury
news_mentions.description: Here are the injuries and news developments we're monitoring around the league on this Week 9 Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: here are the injuries and news developments we re monitoring around the league on this week 9 sunday arizona cardinals defensive lineman roy lopez toe was ruled out of sunday s loss to seattle chicago bears defensive back tyrique stevenson hand did not return to sunday s win against the buccaneers wide receiver luther burden suffered a concussion late in sunday s loss dallas cowboys safety p j locke suffered a concussion in sunday s win over the colts head coach brian schottenheimer said tight end jake ferguson will undergo tests on his knee on monday per schottenheimer denver broncos wide receiver jaylen waddle and cornerback riley moss were ruled out after suffering concussions in the first half of sunday s win over carolina green bay packers running back josh jacobs hand suffered a fractured finger in the first quarter of sunday s win over new england head coach matt lafleur said jacobs did not return to the game but lafleur told reporters the team is hoping to find a way for him to play through the broken finger in the future linebacker ty 39 ron hopper chest was ruled out indianapolis colts linebacker jaylon carlies neck and offensive tackle jalen travis knee were ruled out of sunday s loss to dallas kansas city chiefs quarterback patrick mahomes suffered an elbow sprain in sunday s win over the jets but an mri did not reveal a major injury per nfl network insider ian rapoport who added mahomes elbow will be monitored over the next few days for pain and swelling mahomes was able to re enter the game following the injury which took place in the second quarter wide receiver xavier worthy hamstring was ruled out offensive tackle jaylon moore ankle did not return las vegas raiders guard trey zuhn concussion was ruled out of sunday s loss to san francisco los angeles chargers quarterback justin herbert injured the middle finger on his left hand in sunday s loss to houston head coach jim harbaugh said herbert who was removed from the game while trailing 41 15 told reporters he doesn t expect his finger to cause an issue moving forward wide receiver ladd mcconkey experienced back spasms during pregame warmups and did not play cornerback isas waxter ankle was ruled out cornerback cam hart ankle and defensive lineman justin eboigbe ankle did not return los angeles rams wide receiver puka nacua suffered a knee injury on the team s final offensive snap of sunday s win over washington and will undergo testing on monday to determine the injury s severity nfl network insider mike garafolo and espn s adam schefter reported the rams do not believe nacua suffered a torn acl per garafolo and schefter offensive lineman steve avila hamstring was ruled out miami dolphins quarterback malik willis told reporters after sunday s loss to detroit he was dealing with groin tightness new england patriots running back rhamondre stevenson knee offensive lineman ben brown knee and safety brenden schooler hamstring were ruled out of sunday s loss to green bay cornerback carlton davis knee and offensive tackle will campbell knee did not return new orleans saints center erik mccoy bicep did not return to sunday s win over cleveland philadelphia eagles linebacker zack baun back did not return to sunday s loss to the giants san francisco 49ers defensive lineman gracen halton suffered a fractured ankle in sunday s win over las vegas and is out for the season head coach kyle shanahan said halton was carted off the field wearing an air cast late in the fourth quarter cornerbacks renardo green back and deommodore lenoir foot did not return seattle seahawks quarterback drew lock suffered an oblique injury in sunday s win over arizona and his availability is up in the air for week 10 head coach mike macdonald said tampa bay buccaneers safety antoine winfield ankle was ruled out of sunday night s loss against the bears washington commanders center lucas patrick concussion was ruled out of sunday s loss to the rams

news_mentions.description: Here are the injuries and news developments we're monitoring around the league on this Week 8 Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: here are the injuries and news developments we re monitoring around the league on this week 8 sunday arizona cardinals quarterback gardner minshew replaced jacoby brissettin the second half of sunday s win over dallas brissett was 10 of 23 for 119 yards and an interception at the time of his benching with arizona trailing 17 3 running back jeremiyah love ankle left early and did not return running back bam knight concussion and wide receiver kendrick bourne ankle were ruled out baltimore ravens quarterback lamar jackson right thumb was ruled out from sunday s game against buffalo jackson needs surgery on his injured thumb and will be placed on injured reserve coach jesse minter said after the game qb tyler huntley was also ruled out and suffered what is thought to be a turf toe injury per espn s adam schefter huntley is expected to undergo an mri on monday schefter reported buffalo bills wide receiver josh palmer hamstring was ruled out of sunday s win over baltimore chicago bears linebackers coach richard smith will not travel with the team to seattle for monday s game against the seahawks due to a health issue the team announced assistant linebackers cornerback joey porter ankle did not return while safety caleb downs was evaluated for a concussion and ruled out detroit lions linebacker jack campbell was transported to a local hospital to be evaluated for a neck injury suffered in the second half of sunday s win over minnesota the team announced campbell is resting and will remain in the hospital on sunday night for continued evaluation quad was ruled out of sunday s loss to detroit philadelphia eagles defensive back michael carter abdomen did not return to sunday night s loss against the commanders tampa bay buccaneers linebacker news_mentions.headline: Notable injuries, news from Sunday's Week 7 games: Giants' Tyrone Tracy Jr. injures  hamstring
news_mentions.description: Here are the injuries and news developments we're monitoring around the league on this Week 7 Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: here are the injuries and news developments we re monitoring around the league on this week 7 sunday baltimore ravens guard olaivavega ioane knee was ruled out of sunday s loss to cincinnati carolina panthers offensive tackle taylor moton suffered a fractured fibula in sunday s loss to tampa bay and will be out for a while head coach dave canales said cincinnati bengals tight end erick all knee and safety kyle dugger quadricep were ruled out of sunday s win over baltimore cleveland browns cornerback myles harden hamstring did not return to sunday s win over tennessee detroit lions cornerback ennis rakestraw ankle did not return to sunday s win over the packers green bay packers center sean rhyan ankle and offensive lineman jacob monk quad did not return to sunday s loss to the lions houston texans wide receiver jaylin noel has a turf toe injury head coach demeco ryans told reporters after sunday s loss to the giants las vegas raiders defensive end patrick johnson stinger neck did not return to sunday s loss to the rams miami dolphins cornerback julius brents stinger did not return to sunday s win over the jets minnesota vikings running back aaron jones knee did not return to sunday s win over indianapolis new orleans saints safety justin reid concussion and running back cj donaldson shoulder were ruled out of sunday s loss to pittsburgh in paris new york giants running back tyrone tracy hamstring did not return to sunday s win over houston running back cam skattebo said after the game that he felt something in his hamstring on his 42 yard run in overtime skattebo added that he did not slide on purpose on the play per espn new york jets defensive tackle t 39 vondre sweat knee was ruled out of sunday s loss to miami seattle seahawks wide receiver rashid shaheed knee was ruled out against the chiefs rb velus jones hamstring was also ruled out

news_mentions.headline: AFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Broncos, Chargers, Chiefs, Raiders
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Bobby Kownack breaks down the top AFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Denver Broncos, Kansas City Chiefs, Las Vegas Raiders and Los Angeles Chargers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams bobby kownack has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders and los angeles chargers catch up on each afc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders los angeles chargers three key storylines 1 nix s health receiving corps bo nix should be full go for training camp after suffering a broken ankle in last season s divisional round win but every step in the process bears watching when someone this important to a franchise is returning from injury once nix is out there eyes will also be glued to his pass catching group denver gifted its qb with a second no 1 wideout by trading for jaylen waddle to pair with courtland sutton and camp should provide the first hints as to whether the broncos will employ them as a 1a 1b combo or settle into a more defined pecking order plus can anyone from a proven supporting cast of troy franklin marvin mims and pat bryant emerge as the clear third option 2 denver has a new play caller reaching the doorstep of the super bowl didn t prevent sean payton from enacting sizable changes to the offensive staff he fired offensive coordinator joe lombardi two days after denver s afc title game loss and bumped davis webb up to replace him a month later payton publicly transferred play calling duties to the 31 year old former quarterback it s been a meteoric rise for webb who entered the coaching ranks as payton s qbs coach in 2023 webb has been learning under payton since then so nothing will be unrecognizable but nix still will need to get used to a new voice in his helmet any improvement for a 14th ranked scoring offense on a team that already won 14 games last season would be massive in the afc race 3 broncos are largely running it back roster wise the 2026 broncos are the personification of if it ain t broke don t fix it they took the big swing for waddle but barely signed any outside free agents denver instead focused on retaining talent losing defensive lineman john franklin myers and releasing linebacker dre greenlaw but basically keeping the band together even in the draft the club didn t make a pick until the third round apart from working waddle into the mix with webb now calling the shots the broncos can hit the ground running while many other contenders must start off with finding chemistry that s huge considering how unfriendly the first month and a half of denver s schedule appears at chiefs vs jaguars vs rams at 49ers at chargers and vs seahawks back to top three key storylines 1 when will mahomes be fully healthy patrick mahomes said during the offseason program that he s in a good spot in his acl lcl recovery and hopes to play in week 1 while andy reid told reporters the quarterback should be able to do some things at the start of training camp so how much will mahomes take on when the chiefs report and how quickly will he ramp up activity those questions don t have answers at the moment the chiefs hopes of returning to contention in 2026 and beyond rely heavily on the two time most valuable player so they ll be smart with him justin fields now on his fourth team in as many years could be one of the league s most intensely scrutinized backups as mahomes return timeline takes shape 2 kansas city s cb room begins anew again the chiefs have a habit of maximizing young cornerbacks talent and moving on before the bill comes due most recently they traded two time all pro trent mcduffie and let jaylen watson walk in free agency with both cover men going to the rams kansas city will call on 2025 third rounder nohl williams and mansoor delane this year s no 6 overall pick to fill the void fourth round rookie jadon canady should also be in competition for playing time with free agent signees kader kohou and l 39 jarius sneed the latter of whom returns to kansas city a couple of years after the team traded him to tennessee defensive coordinator steve spagnuolo s track record which includes three straight top six defenses in points allowed suggests things will work out just fine 3 bieniemy s back kansas city s offensive coordinator position has been devalued for years overshadowed by the prowess of patrick mahomes and andy reid perhaps it shouldn t have been during eric bieniemy s five years as the team s oc from 2018 through 2022 the chiefs never finished worse than sixth in the league in points or yards twice tallied the most points and three times amassed the most yards in the last three years without bieniemy the chiefs have ranked at average 17th in scoring and 15th in yardage there were obviously other factors in the decline such as tyreek hill exiting in a trade and travis kelce aging out of his prime but bieniemy returning still bodes well back to top three key storylines 1 mendoza s first camp the future of the raiders now rests on no 1 pick fernando mendoza s shoulders even if he isn t destined to start right away new head coach klint kubiak has communicated that his ideal scenario is to avoid putting a rookie under center in week 1 and by signing veteran kirk cousins las vegas essentially ensured mendoza s starting debut will come via choice rather than need still mendoza is coming off a perfect 16 0 season in which he took home the heisman trophy and led indiana to a national championship he s going to show up for the competition and all the buzz at raiders camp will revolve around him when he does 2 who steps up at wr las vegas has some starry names on offense quarterback fernando mendoza running back ashton jeanty and tight end brock bowers at wide receiver though there s work to do tre tucker was easily the team s most trustworthy wideout last year but he doesn t really profile as a wr1 jack bech and dont 39 e thornton 2025 second and fourth round picks respectively are looking to rebound from underwhelming rookie seasons free agent addition jalen nailor has a chance to show staying power in a larger role after flashing promise with 858 yards and 10 tds on 57 catches over the past two years with the vikings those are likely las vegas top four in some order but there s still a lot to shake out during the preseason 3 crosby s defense 2 0 in the four days between the raiders agreeing to send maxx crosby to the ravens and baltimore backing out of the trade las vegas spent a whole lot of dough rebuilding its defense for what was supposed to be the post crosby era now thanks to the blockbuster deal falling apart crosby is very much a part of the present the five time pro bowler returned to possibly the most talented unit the raiders have had during his career the linebacking corps has been rebuilt with nakobe dean and quay walker taron johnson brings more legitimacy to the cornerback room and kwity paye is set to line up on the edge opposite crosby reason for excitement in sin city extends far beyond the team s top picked qb back to top three key storylines 1 mcdaniel effect it was time for a change after the chargers scored 15 combined points in their last two wild card exits jim harbaugh fired offensive coordinator greg roman a longtime collaborator and replaced him with mike mcdaniel to hopefully supercharge the offense as the former dolphins coach did in his first couple years with miami mcdaniel s arrival as a quarterback whisperer is good news for justin herbert who already plays at a pro bowl level but the impact of his high octane system should be felt everywhere from the promising tight end trio of oronde gadsden david njoku and charlie kolar to omarion hampton in the backfield 2 fingers crossed for l a s o line los angeles offensive line should be a strength of the team in 2026 after disaster struck last season left tackle rashawn slater suffered a season ending patellar tendon tear in august while right tackle joe alt played just six games before requiring season ending ankle surgery herbert took a career high 54 sacks behind a patchwork offensive line leading the league with 268 pressures taken and a 43 3 pressure rate slater and alt are back but they ll also be joined on the line by free agent signings tyler biadasz and cole strange as well as second round rookie jake slaughter assuming the group stays healthy herbert should be well protected first though the bolts blockers have to jell together as a unit in august 3 chargers hope they have an edge rushing duo to build around the offseason didn t bring any sweeping changes for the chargers defense dalvin tomlinson 32 was their most notable signing to bulk up the interior and they lost a few pass rushers odafe oweh and da 39 shawn hand but largely maintained the status quo los angeles did however spend a first round pick on akheem mesidor the acc sack leader in 2025 with 12 5 there s enough pass rushing depth that mesidor won t have to take on too much too soon more importantly he has some stellar mentors in tuli tuipulotu who was sixth in the nfl last season with 13 sacks and nine time pro bowler khalil mack the hope is for a seamless transition from mack to mesidor alongside tuipulotu as the leaders of the l a edge rush back to top

news_mentions.body_text: week 9 wasn t the same thrill ride that week 8 was but it did provide us with some insight as we clear the halfway point of the regular season the cincinnati bengals own one of the most explosive offenses in the nfl the green bay packers can and will win by relying heavily on the passing game and a defense that is blossoming at the perfect time and the los angeles chargers remain a directionless outfit have we begun to witness some much needed separation between contenders and pretenders could the houston texans use week 9 as a launch pad we better rank these teams before the answers arrive note up down arrows below reflect movement from the week 9 edition of the power rankings

news_mentions.body_text: the 2026 nfl trade deadline has come and gone nfl com s kevin patra breaks down every trade made since the start of the regular season downs gets his trade looks to bolster chiefs date of trade nov 10 kansas city receives wr josh downs 2027 seventh round draft pick grade b indianapolis receives 2027 fourth round draft pick 2027 fifth round draft pick grade b the chiefs needed wide receiver aid with zero wideouts hitting the 300 yard mark yet this season a 37 year old travis kelce still leads k c pass catchers no offense to the future hall of famer but that shouldn t 2028 this trade allows them to get the pick a year earlier and adds a fifth round sweetener trading away their best player two weeks before the trade deadline suggests a teardown is in play indy should be very active over the next fortnight and you can bet any gm with a need is going to put in a call to colts interim gm ed dodds cards deal former no 4 pick to texans date of trade oct 12 houston receives wr marvin harrison 2027 sixth round draft pick grade c arizona receives 2027 second round draft pick 2027 seventh round draft pick grade b when the trade details came through i assumed it was a typo that the texans shipped a 2027 second round pick for a player who was clearly out of the rotation in arizona my brain rationalized it as a 2028 second rounder or a 2027 fourth rounder nope the texans paid a premium pick in the upcoming draft for a shot at revitalizing harrison s career the cards reportedly had made it known they were holding out for a second round pick the moment the texans upped their bid to a second in 2027 they pounced i don t fault arizona for moving on right now in four games in 2026 harrison caught five passes on 13 targets for 85 yards and one touchdown that s like a half of one game for the upper echelon of wrs harrison has generated 0 6 yards per route run this year the third lowest among players with at least 100 routes per next gen stats basically harrison has been doing little more than a cardio workout on sundays getting a second rounder is solid work the grade isn t higher because the same brass that acquired that asset used the no 4 overall pick on harrison in 2024 monti ossenfort still gets docked for whiffing on a prime selection i understand why the texans would take a swing on harrison like most of the league they probably gave the ohio state product a very high pre draft grade reuniting him with former buckeyes teammate c j stroud could bring out the best in the wideout the texans have struggled mightily to move the ball when nico collins has been injured and given collins history and the hard hits he takes he s not guaranteed to make it through the rest of the season without missing time after laying an egg for four weeks the 1 4 texans don t have any more wiggle room harrison s contract isn t onerous giving houston some insurance if tank dell never returns to form or jayden higgins is delayed next year coming off a season ending injury in the short term this trade is somewhat duplicative of the much cheaper deal in which it acquired kayshon boutte it s more costly but gives the club more control of the future mostly i don t love the price tag for a player who hasn t been who we thought he was for it to make sense to give up a day 2 pick the texans need harrison to finally break out after two mediocre seasons perhaps in improved surroundings and on a team that clearly wants him with a qb he knows and trusts harrison can blossom frankly i probably like many scouts can t figure out the disconnect between a player who looked as polished and well rounded as harrison did at osu and the one we ve seen lope about for two plus years the question is whether you believe the scouting or the two separate coaching staffs who haven t found much use for him the texans are betting on their scouting eagles send pro bowl ol to ravens date of trade oct 7 baltimore receives c cam jurgens 2027 seventh round draft pick grade b philadelphia receives 2027 fifth round draft pick 2028 second round draft pick grade a we should start with the obvious the two time pro bowler was available for a reason especially after the same offensive line saw a future hall of famer lane johnson retire the day prior jurgens is currently a pro bowler in name only after battling through a back injury in 2024 to help the eagles net a super bowl ring jurgens has not been the same player he struggled through last season and has been a liability through four games this year his pass blocking has never been otherworldly but it s particularly crumbled after he was asked to move to left guard the past three weeks blame the previous injuries or the ill fit in the eagles new blocking scheme but jurgens has been borderline unplayable the past few weeks drew kendall played better than jurgens at center in sean mannion s scheme so a move back wasn t in the cards it got so bad that nick sirianni was fending off questions about potentially benching the guard instead philly shipped him out of town we know that howie roseman doesn t care what year he gets his picks famously saying a first round pick is a first round pick regarding the a j brown trade this offseason when philly netted a 28 first however we can dock him ever so slightly for delayed satisfaction otherwise getting a second rounder for a struggling player who was not a fit is a home run in the short term the eagles offensive line is in flux with willie lampkin in line to take over at guard the hope is that landon dickerson returns to form when he eventually comes off injured reserve the trade is jarring coming right after johnson s retirement but getting a significant draft pick back for a player who was on the verge of being benched makes sense philly is now loaded in the 2028 draft with two firsts and two seconds even acknowledging jurgens significant struggles the play makes sense for the ravens the plans to replace tyler linderbaum who signed with the raiders in free agency this summer were wobbly from the start the ones they rode with danny pinter jovaughn gwyn and ethan pocic have all landed on injured reserve counting on pocic coming off injury was always a gamble the ravens crapped out instead of sticking with rookie olaivavega ioane out of position at center baltimore will take a roll of the dice that jurgens can get back to form it s not a terrible gamble and it s conceivable the 27 year old can bounce back with a return to center in a different scheme jurgens contract which has him under team control through 2029 for relatively cheap is also desirable for baltimore injury is always part of the equation and jurgens enters his time in baltimore in the league s concussion protocol nfl network s mike garafolo reported if he s healthy and returns to form this will be an excellent move for baltimore if he continues to struggle or misses a ton of time it will be the latest swing and miss in trying to replace linderbaum porter drama ends in trade to dallas date of trade oct 1 dallas receives cb joey porter grade a pittsburgh receives 2027 sixth round draft pick 2028 second round draft pick grade c the cowboys desperately needed corner help for a defense that has floundered despite the offseason upgrades i ll credit jerry jones for not sitting on his hands instead doing what we have been asking general managers to do for years be bold make moves and don t overvalue your own picks during a season we won t know if the trade pays off in the long term but the cowboys certainly improved in 2026 at his peak porter is a physical cover man who can be sticky on the outside and mirror top receivers he ll slide well into christian parker s scheme allowing dallas to play man coverage on the outside with more physicality than in the first three weeks sure he racks up some penalties but so do most cbs you ll live with the trade off for a corner with jpj s skill set that dallas didn t have to give up a premier pick until 2028 also improved its grade assuming that porter plays the cowboys get a top shelf cb for a relatively cheap up front cost jones seems to be hoping he can copy the success he had with the george pickens trade pushing off the long term talks until down the road it s a needle threading but one that could work if porter plays well dallas could extend him in the offseason use the franchise tag on the cb or let him walk and recoup a potential third round compensatory pick in 2028 possibly moving down one round in 28 and giving up a sixth rounder for a potential pro bowl player in a year when you re all in is a stellar move if porter delivers 14 games of high level play it s worth it of course if porter gets hurt or implodes this all goes for naught however if he continues on this track it is a short term win for the cowboys the long term question can be shelved i don t fault the steelers for not wanting to pay porter top cb money if he were seeking a 30 million type deal in line with christian gonzalez or devon witherspoon i would have balked too jpj is good he s not at that level trading him away relieved pittsburgh of that problem the issue i have is that it appears steelers gm omar khan either overplayed his hand or didn t anticipate porter s gumption when it came to a new deal if khan had never planned to meet the corner s contract demands he should have made a move in the spring or early summer a player of porter s caliber is worth more than a second round pick two drafts down the road the timing of the impasse reduced the compensation now the steelers are without a top corner and find themselves thin and young at the position not a good combo if things spiral in pittsburgh it s fair to wonder if khan will even be around to make that second round pick in 2028 the gm took over in 2022 and received early praise for fleecing the bears in the chase claypool trade that brought back a second rounder that pick became porter khan has now moved him for pennies on the dollar add in a string of so so drafts the pickens trade and other questionable moves and the seat in pittsburgh could get hot for khan if the steelers flounder giants trade for mccarthy after dart injury date of trade sept 28 new york receives qb j j mccarthy grade c minnesota receives 2027 fifth round draft pick grade c minnesota signaled its intent to move on from the former no 10 overall pick by inking kyler murray and bringing back carson wentz in the offseason mccarthy got a slim shot at the starting job during training camp but he couldn t even fend off wentz for the primary backup role a former first rounder turned clipboard holder is a bad look all around had another club made an offer of substance before the season i believe the vikings would have moved on then given mccarthy s rough preseason however it s no surprise it took an injury to a starting qb to move the needle a fifth rounder isn t nothing and the vikings save a few pennies however the reality is they turned a first fourth and late round pick swap into 10 starts and a future fifth rounder that math isn t mathing mccarthy s poor play and injury history left the vikings with no good options for a team in win now mode minnesota didn t have time to let the 23 year old develop on his terms moving on makes sense but the vikings can t get a high grade for the compensation new york took a shot that in a new setting and in an offense keyed on the ground attack john harbaugh and his staff can do what kevin o connell couldn t i don t hate the price for a former first round quarterback who even the stingiest draft graders pegged as a day 2 selection teams use fifth rounders and later as qb dart throws all the time the giants lack of 2027 picks is of concern but they can deal with that later with jaxson dart out for the regular season after knee surgery the giants needed to make some sort of move jameis winston has shown he can hold the fort for a spell but it s a serious question if harbaugh will give the boom or bust passer enough leash for a 15 game run bringing in mccarthy at least gives the giants another alternative if winston crumbles at this stage there aren t a whole lot of other options i m not optimistic that mccarthy can turn his career around but for a fifth round pick it s worth a shot for new york

news_mentions.headline: Week 10 NFL MVP tracker: Bengals' Joe Burrow leads race at midpoint of 2026 season
news_mentions.description: We've reached the midway point of the 2026 NFL season and with it comes a No. 1 in Kevin Patra's weekly MVP tracker. Who surpasses Josh Allen at the top?
news_mentions.body_text: we ve passed the halfway mark of the 2026 campaign and quarterbacks have officially fully taken over the mvp discussion we ve seen some ridiculously high level quarterback play recently from joe burrow dicing up defenses like a top chef on deadline to jordan love dive bombing opponents into oblivion this week i wanted to do something different with our mvp tracker we re going to highlight one play that illustrates why each qb is an mvp candidate sidenote before y all get madonline it s not necessarily the qb s best play of the season beyond that being wholly subjective i wanted to highlight traits that were indicative of their otherworldly play now let s get to the rankings mvp rankings note up down arrows below reflect movement from the week 9 edition next in line seahawks wr jaxon smith njigba bears qb caleb williams lions rb jahmyr gibbs chiefs rb kenneth walker lions qb jared goff voting for the 2026 nfl channel midseason awards is open viewers can scan the qr code displayed daily on nfl channel to access the voting page and make their selections

news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top

news_mentions.headline: AFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Broncos, Chargers, Chiefs, Raiders
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Bobby Kownack breaks down the top AFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Denver Broncos, Kansas City Chiefs, Las Vegas Raiders and Los Angeles Chargers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams bobby kownack has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders and los angeles chargers catch up on each afc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders los angeles chargers three key storylines 1 nix s health receiving corps bo nix should be full go for training camp after suffering a broken ankle in last season s divisional round win but every step in the process bears watching when someone this important to a franchise is returning from injury once nix is out there eyes will also be glued to his pass catching group denver gifted its qb with a second no 1 wideout by trading for jaylen waddle to pair with courtland sutton and camp should provide the first hints as to whether the broncos will employ them as a 1a 1b combo or settle into a more defined pecking order plus can anyone from a proven supporting cast of troy franklin marvin mims and pat bryant emerge as the clear third option 2 denver has a new play caller reaching the doorstep of the super bowl didn t prevent sean payton from enacting sizable changes to the offensive staff he fired offensive coordinator joe lombardi two days after denver s afc title game loss and bumped davis webb up to replace him a month later payton publicly transferred play calling duties to the 31 year old former quarterback it s been a meteoric rise for webb who entered the coaching ranks as payton s qbs coach in 2023 webb has been learning under payton since then so nothing will be unrecognizable but nix still will need to get used to a new voice in his helmet any improvement for a 14th ranked scoring offense on a team that already won 14 games last season would be massive in the afc race 3 broncos are largely running it back roster wise the 2026 broncos are the personification of if it ain t broke don t fix it they took the big swing for waddle but barely signed any outside free agents denver instead focused on retaining talent losing defensive lineman john franklin myers and releasing linebacker dre greenlaw but basically keeping the band together even in the draft the club didn t make a pick until the third round apart from working waddle into the mix with webb now calling the shots the broncos can hit the ground running while many other contenders must start off with finding chemistry that s huge considering how unfriendly the first month and a half of denver s schedule appears at chiefs vs jaguars vs rams at 49ers at chargers and vs seahawks back to top three key storylines 1 when will mahomes be fully healthy patrick mahomes said during the offseason program that he s in a good spot in his acl lcl recovery and hopes to play in week 1 while andy reid told reporters the quarterback should be able to do some things at the start of training camp so how much will mahomes take on when the chiefs report and how quickly will he ramp up activity those questions don t have answers at the moment the chiefs hopes of returning to contention in 2026 and beyond rely heavily on the two time most valuable player so they ll be smart with him justin fields now on his fourth team in as many years could be one of the league s most intensely scrutinized backups as mahomes return timeline takes shape 2 kansas city s cb room begins anew again the chiefs have a habit of maximizing young cornerbacks talent and moving on before the bill comes due most recently they traded two time all pro trent mcduffie and let jaylen watson walk in free agency with both cover men going to the rams kansas city will call on 2025 third rounder nohl williams and mansoor delane this year s no 6 overall pick to fill the void fourth round rookie jadon canady should also be in competition for playing time with free agent signees kader kohou and l 39 jarius sneed the latter of whom returns to kansas city a couple of years after the team traded him to tennessee defensive coordinator steve spagnuolo s track record which includes three straight top six defenses in points allowed suggests things will work out just fine 3 bieniemy s back kansas city s offensive coordinator position has been devalued for years overshadowed by the prowess of patrick mahomes and andy reid perhaps it shouldn t have been during eric bieniemy s five years as the team s oc from 2018 through 2022 the chiefs never finished worse than sixth in the league in points or yards twice tallied the most points and three times amassed the most yards in the last three years without bieniemy the chiefs have ranked at average 17th in scoring and 15th in yardage there were obviously other factors in the decline such as tyreek hill exiting in a trade and travis kelce aging out of his prime but bieniemy returning still bodes well back to top three key storylines 1 mendoza s first camp the future of the raiders now rests on no 1 pick fernando mendoza s shoulders even if he isn t destined to start right away new head coach klint kubiak has communicated that his ideal scenario is to avoid putting a rookie under center in week 1 and by signing veteran kirk cousins las vegas essentially ensured mendoza s starting debut will come via choice rather than need still mendoza is coming off a perfect 16 0 season in which he took home the heisman trophy and led indiana to a national championship he s going to show up for the competition and all the buzz at raiders camp will revolve around him when he does 2 who steps up at wr las vegas has some starry names on offense quarterback fernando mendoza running back ashton jeanty and tight end brock bowers at wide receiver though there s work to do tre tucker was easily the team s most trustworthy wideout last year but he doesn t really profile as a wr1 jack bech and dont 39 e thornton 2025 second and fourth round picks respectively are looking to rebound from underwhelming rookie seasons free agent addition jalen nailor has a chance to show staying power in a larger role after flashing promise with 858 yards and 10 tds on 57 catches over the past two years with the vikings those are likely las vegas top four in some order but there s still a lot to shake out during the preseason 3 crosby s defense 2 0 in the four days between the raiders agreeing to send maxx crosby to the ravens and baltimore backing out of the trade las vegas spent a whole lot of dough rebuilding its defense for what was supposed to be the post crosby era now thanks to the blockbuster deal falling apart crosby is very much a part of the present the five time pro bowler returned to possibly the most talented unit the raiders have had during his career the linebacking corps has been rebuilt with nakobe dean and quay walker taron johnson brings more legitimacy to the cornerback room and kwity paye is set to line up on the edge opposite crosby reason for excitement in sin city extends far beyond the team s top picked qb back to top three key storylines 1 mcdaniel effect it was time for a change after the chargers scored 15 combined points in their last two wild card exits jim harbaugh fired offensive coordinator greg roman a longtime collaborator and replaced him with mike mcdaniel to hopefully supercharge the offense as the former dolphins coach did in his first couple years with miami mcdaniel s arrival as a quarterback whisperer is good news for justin herbert who already plays at a pro bowl level but the impact of his high octane system should be felt everywhere from the promising tight end trio of oronde gadsden david njoku and charlie kolar to omarion hampton in the backfield 2 fingers crossed for l a s o line los angeles offensive line should be a strength of the team in 2026 after disaster struck last season left tackle rashawn slater suffered a season ending patellar tendon tear in august while right tackle joe alt played just six games before requiring season ending ankle surgery herbert took a career high 54 sacks behind a patchwork offensive line leading the league with 268 pressures taken and a 43 3 pressure rate slater and alt are back but they ll also be joined on the line by free agent signings tyler biadasz and cole strange as well as second round rookie jake slaughter assuming the group stays healthy herbert should be well protected first though the bolts blockers have to jell together as a unit in august 3 chargers hope they have an edge rushing duo to build around the offseason didn t bring any sweeping changes for the chargers defense dalvin tomlinson 32 was their most notable signing to bulk up the interior and they lost a few pass rushers odafe oweh and da 39 shawn hand but largely maintained the status quo los angeles did however spend a first round pick on akheem mesidor the acc sack leader in 2025 with 12 5 there s enough pass rushing depth that mesidor won t have to take on too much too soon more importantly he has some stellar mentors in tuli tuipulotu who was sixth in the nfl last season with 13 sacks and nine time pro bowler khalil mack the hope is for a seamless transition from mack to mesidor alongside tuipulotu as the leaders of the l a edge rush back to top

news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc west catch up on the arizona cardinals offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 22 rookies and veterans location state farm stadium glendale ariz fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs kansas city chiefs 8 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 at denver broncos 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 vs las vegas raiders 4 30 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note arizona plays san francisco and seattle in back to back weeks twice weeks 3 4 weeks 10 11 but doesn t play los angeles the reigning nfc west champion until week 14 and then again in week 18 nfl research what you need to know 1 beneficiaries of two first round draft picks in 2024 the cardinals were left wanting much more from marvin harrison and darius robinson in total harrison s 62 receptions for 885 yards and eight touchdowns as a rookie are pretty solid but many thought the no 4 overall selection would be a superstar out of the gate harrison and quarterback kyler murray furthering their chemistry could well be the team s prevailing storyline this season and that will get going in earnest during camp robinson picked 23 slots after harrison last year played in just six games because of a calf injury this will be a pivotal camp for him especially amid a revamped defensive front one that will offer him veterans to learn from and new faces to compete against for snaps 2 one of the easiest players in the nfl to root for calais campbell 38 returning to the team he began his illustrious career with in 2008 is more than just a feel great story campbell s leadership is just as important an addition as his talent to a club looking for its first winning season since 2021 this is a pivotal season for the monti ossenfort jonathan gannon regime and campbell pass rusher josh sweat and defensive tackle dalvin tomlinson should add some veteran moxie to a team lacking it outside of star safety budda baker gannon was hired for his defensive prowess coordinating the philadelphia eagles now his arizona d is finally stocked up at least on paper it s added some experienced talent and two high profile rookies in defensive lineman walter nolen first round no 16 overall and cornerback will johnson second no 47 johnson has the ceiling to become a massive draft steal how the cards defensive additions mesh with the starting staples begins this summer 3 james conner joined arizona in 2021 and has been a stellar fit who has exceeded his output and importance with the pittsburgh steelers for four years prior he s coming off career high tallies in carries 236 and rushing yards 1 094 but is entering his age 30 season 2024 third rounder trey benson 63 carries for 291 yards had a disappointing debut campaign but if he finds his footing could he push conner for touches it ll be interesting to see how camp develops in the arizona offensive backfield

across the nfc north catch up on the green bay packers offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 18 rookies july 22 veterans location lambeau field green bay wisconsin fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs new york jets saturday aug 9 at 8 p m et nfl network week 2 at indianapolis colts saturday aug 16 at 1 p m et week 3 vs seattle seahawks saturday aug 23 at 4 p m et nfl network 2025 schedule note the packers will play back to back road games three times in 2025 the most they ve played in one season since matt lafleur s first year as head coach in 2019 excluding international games they went 4 2 in those six games nfl research what you need to know 1 the packers made it clear that jordan morgan will battle incumbent rasheed walker for the left tackle spot during camp the 2024 first round pick didn t play a single snap at tackle during his rookie season he played 185 snaps at guard right and left while missing the final nine games of the regular season due to injury walker has been solid at left tackle particularly in pass protection but has struggled at times in the run game if walker wins the gig morgan could remain a backup unless he shifts inside and beats out sean rhyan for the right guard job whom he couldn t unseat a year ago with elgton jenkins sliding over to center stalwart right tackle zach tom and free agent addition aaron banks at left guard three of the five spots in front of jordan love are spoken for how the other two shake out will largely depend on how morgan performs during camp it could sting if the former first rounder can t find a spot in the starting rotation heading into year 2 2 the packers spoke confidently about their secondary pieces following the release of jaire alexander who swiftly signed in baltimore following an elongated contract standoff keisean nixon sits as the no 1 corner veteran addition nate hobbs could play inside or outside where he slots is one thing to watch during camp carrington valentine took a stride forward in year 2 at a position known for unpredictability from year to year how jeff hafley utilizes his safeties could determine the pecking order at corner opposite xavier mckinney we could see a battle between evan williams and javon bullard bullard could be a movable chess piece who can drop down to play nickel hafley will get his best five dbs on the field each week and who plays more could depend on matchups how the backup crew sorts itself out will be determined during camp 3 what would a packers training camp discussion be without talking about the receiver room the addition of first round pick matthew golden injects playmaking into a group that had a trove of b players but couldn t find consistency or stay healthy in 2024 jayden reed has proven he can win consistently from the slot but is coming off a drop filled season romeo doubs also had a rocky campaign playing just 13 games christian watson hasn t been able to stay healthy but is ahead of schedule in his return from an acl tear if he s able to avoid starting the season on the pup list it would make the packers receiver decision extremely interesting savion williams a third round pick is a wild card to carve out a role green bay also brought in gadget speedster mecole hardman reed and golden should be assured of their spots the rest feels up in the air competition across the board is needed for a crew that disappointed last season and injected two rookies into the fray
