news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc north catch up on the chicago bears offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 19 rookies july 22 veterans location halas hall lake forest illinois fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 at miami dolphins sunday aug 10 at 1 p m et nfl network week 2 vs buffalo bills sunday aug 17 at 8 p m fox week 3 at kansas city chiefs thursday aug 22 at 8 20 p m et 2025 schedule note the bears are one of just seven teams that are not scheduled to play on a thursday this season however they will play the eagles on black friday nfl research what you need to know 1 a new hope wafts through chicago like a dense fog rolling in off lake michigan the arrival of ben johnson created a palpable buzz around the bears that an offense perpetually stuck in the mud might finally take flight johnson proved in his three seasons calling plays in detroit that he can manufacture explosives on the ground and through the air it was more than just the gadget or trick plays johnson s intelligence and play sequencing are some of the best in the nfl like a good boxer who can set up a knockout punch johnson knows how to counter a defense the bears stealing johnson from a division rival is the most significant coup for quarterback caleb williams who experienced a rollercoaster rookie season it s been an incredible offseason for williams his new coach and offense are a massive improvement the offensive line was dramatically rebuilt and should be the most improved blocking group in the league the additions of tight end colston loveland and wide receiver luther burden provide dynamic playmaking to grow with the young signal caller everything is built for williams to thrive in 2025 hey maybe the bears will finally join modern football with a qb throwing for 4 000 yards for the first time in club history one question entering camp is the running back rotation chicago didn t add a back until kyle monangai in the seventh round will d 39 andre swift bounce back behind a better offensive line will roschon johnson play the david montgomery role in johnson s offense we know the new coach wants to lean on the ground game to springboard the passing attack but does he have the horses in chicago 2 the bears drafted three second rounders in 2025 normally that s not a notable fact in mid july however this season there is a holdup on second round picks signing their contracts as of publication 30 remain unsigned the delay stems from the top two second rounders receiving fully guaranteed contracts the first in nfl history to do so for the bears the standoff is significant with receiver luther burden offensive tackle ozzy trapilo and defensive tackle shemar turner all in line for prominent roles out of the gate editor s note turner agreed to his rookie contract on thursday after this story was published if the issue remains unresolved pushing into august we could see the rookies presence early in the season curtailed bears fans will remember roquan smith starting his rookie season on a pitch count after an elongated contract dispute missed time in camp is significant for first year players we haven t seen burden on the field since he suffered a soft tissue injury in rookie minicamp trapilo could be in a position to battle for the left tackle gig if braxton jones isn t healthy 3 the biggest camp battle in chicago could be the left tackle job braxton jones fractured his ankle in december and didn t participate this offseason jones was solid in 2024 allowing 26 pressures in 12 games the injury could open the door for ozzy trapilo to swipe the gig particularly if jones isn t healthy to open the season obviously if the second rounder remains unsigned and jones can t practice the lt gig becomes an even bigger question 2024 third round pick kiran amegadjie struggled mightily when tossed into the fire last season but should get a clean slate under ben johnson another competition to keep an eye on is at the corner position where tyrique stevenson will attempt to avoid being unseated by terell smith and rookie zah frazier for the starting gig opposite jaylon johnson and nickel back kyler gordon

across the nfc south catch up on the tampa bay buccaneers offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 21 rookies july 22 veterans location adventhealth training center tampa florida fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs tennessee titans 7 30 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 at pittsburgh steelers 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 vs buffalo bills 7 30 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note the buccaneers who won six of their final seven regular season games in 2024 end the 2025 campaign with six consecutive games against teams that missed the playoffs nfl research what you need to know 1 a new challenge has reared its head just ahead of buccaneers training camp find an early season replacement for tristan wirfs the all pro left tackle underwent knee surgery on july 8 and is likely to begin the season on the physically unable to perform list which would sideline him at least four games there s no replacing the only player in nfl history who has earned all pro honors at both tackle positions but the silver lining is there s plenty of time to prepare currently on the left tackle depth chart are veteran charlie heck a newcomer and undrafted rookie benjamin chukwuma but perhaps a temporary reshuffling is in order will luke goedeke try his hand at a tackle switch or will left guard ben bredeson another newcomer man the position it s too early to tell now but figuring it out will be a camp priority tampa begins the 2025 season with two road games and hosts the defending super bowl champions in week 4 with wirfs likely out 2 the buccaneers surged toward their fourth consecutive nfc title last season thanks to balanced offense that consistently put up points the unit returns in 2025 largely unchanged barring the availability of wirfs but one other facet of the offense that could be interesting over the next few months is how the depth chart shakes out at wide receiver with mike evans leading the way chris godwin s health and potential return to form is the first item to monitor the bucs are hopeful the veteran wr will be ready for week 1 after a brutal ankle dislocation disrupted a fantastic season in 2024 but the club seems to be prepared either way that s where the head scratching begins tampa selected emeka egbuka with the 19th overall pick and the ohio state product seems poised for the slot role especially with godwin s guidance jalen mcmillan came on strong late last season and is in line for more playing time in year 2 add in veteran sterling shepard trey palmer and seventh rounder tez johnson to the mix and therein lies a good problem to have for the bucs 3 haason reddick was the biggest offseason addition for a buccaneers team that is in need of pressure off the edges defensive tackles vita vea and calijah kancey led the team in sacks in 2024 following a lengthy contract squabble that spilled into the regular season reddick s lone campaign with the jets was one to forget but a new beginning in tampa bay could be what the two time pro bowler needs reddick who previously had four consecutive 10 plus sack seasons before 2024 joins an aggressive todd bowles scheme that will lean on his pass rushing talents and bring him opportunity to cash in on his one year deal there s also a fourth round pick to watch david walker the highest nfl draftee ever from central arkansas had coaches buzzing after rookie minicamp

news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams michael baca has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc south catch up on the atlanta falcons offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 23 rookie veterans location ibm performance field flowery branch georgia fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs detroit lions 7 p m et on friday aug 8 week 2 vs tennessee titans 7 p m et nfl network on friday aug 15 week 3 at dallas cowboys 8 p m et nfl network on friday aug 22 2025 schedule note for the second consecutive season the falcons will open the campaign with four of their first five games against teams that made the playoffs the year before nfl research what you need to know 1 following a dramatic and underwhelming season at quarterback which saw kirk cousins lose his job to michael penix the falcons will put their best foot forward in order to achieve harmony under center penix this season s unquestioned starting qb looks to finely tune his role after showing flashes along his three starts as a rookie entering his second training camp the strong armed lefty now has ample time to establish a rapport with a pass catching corps that remains largely unchanged and to grow into his role as the offense s leading voice over the summer cousins meanwhile appears to have accepted his fate as a backup at this juncture making for what could be a peculiar scene if the high priced qb sees plenty of action in the preseason moreover if cousins 36 looks improved another year removed from a torn achilles could other teams reignite a trade discussion 2 atlanta s mission to improve its pass rush continued with a splashy first round in april s draft selecting jalon walker at no 15 overall before trading back into round 1 to take james pearce 10 picks later walker a product of georgia and last year s butkus award winner was seen as one of top pass rushing prospects but pearce s selection one achieved by trading away next year s first round pick was one of the more surprising developments of the 2025 nfl draft walker and pearce s progression throughout training camp and in the preseason ought to be keenly observed considering the heavy investment the falcons who hired jeff ulbrich as their new defensive coordinator also signed leonard floyd this offseason as part of revamping a pass rush that finished 31st in the league in sacks 31 last season 3 training camp and preseason is where kicking competitions thrive and there s a compelling one brewing in atlanta following younghoe koo s down season the falcons signed german born kicker lenny krieg to a three year deal that includes a signing bonus and a base salary guarantee that kind of contract doesn t come often in the international market but it came after krieg impressed at the international player pathway program s pro day koo who s held the job the past six seasons generated a career low 73 5 field goal percentage and his struggles cost the falcons a game down the stretch with three missed kicks in a three point loss koo and krieg s battle over the next two months could provide the scintillating moments we look for as we prepare for the oncoming season

news_mentions.headline: NFL QB rankings, Week 10: Joe Burrow climbs to No. 1; Caleb Williams slides
news_mentions.description: Who joins Joe Burrow as a riser in Nick Shook's QB rankings at midseason? Check out the updated pecking order, 1-32, heading into Week 10.
news_mentions.body_text: notes up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 9 qb index stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl tier 1 it s time we insert joe burrow into the mvp conversation he s an outrageously efficient and daring quarterback who is powering one of the most explosive offenses in the nfl if the bengals mount a deep playoff run he ll be the face of it he might also become the face of the league s quarterbacks the one spot drop is no knock on josh allen whose ability to win in the margins enabled buffalo to leave minneapolis with a major victory on monday night allen did the special things he usually does to help the bills survive the brian flores defense and should be proud of the performance even if it wasn t his most statistically impressive game of the season no quarterback in the nfl is currently more in sync with his receivers than jordan love it makes sense green bay has asked him to carry the offense all season long that s bad for opponents because the additional reps have helped love settle into a rhythm that makes for appointment viewing each week christian watson s career best pace isn t happening by accident the texans were able to enjoy a spectacular c j stroud performance in week 9 he s produced plenty of them this season and could find himself in the mvp conversation if houston can turn around its season brock purdy has thrown three interceptions in his last two games but his positive contributions vastly outweigh the negative he s becoming an entertaining quarterback when operating out of structure like when he scrambled for a touchdown largely because the raiders apparently decided they d rather prevent a pass than tackle him purdy happily took that gift and will have yet another new receiver trade acquisition keenan allen to learn this week trevor lawrence started last thursday night on a heater throwing a beautiful seam ball to parker washington for a touchdown lawrence didn t need to do much else for the jaguars to cruise to victory he s in command of the offense and should be expected to remain in this tier for the foreseeable future as part of one of the nfl s best squads next gen stats insights via nfl pro c j stroud completed 10 of 16 passes between 10 and 19 yards downfield for 254 yards five touchdowns and an interception in week 9 against the chargers it s the only game in which a quarterback has thrown five touchdowns targeting the intermediate level since at least 2016 and the third most yards recorded by a quarterback on such throws in that span tier 2 detroit s win in miami was ugly and made for an unexpectedly difficult outing for jared goff who had a hard time finding open windows against miami s scrappy defense he threw an interception on a play in which his arm was hit as he released the ball narrowly missed being responsible for an earlier turnover and threw for just 170 yards in the low scoring triumph i m not ready to say he s developing a turnover issue he had not thrown a pick prior to week 8 but as head coach dan campbell intimated at halftime on sunday the lions need to get going offensively what happens when you throw four interceptions in a prime time game you fall a tier in the qb index that s what caleb williams did on sunday night struggling against tampa bay s relentless blitzes it s not all on him chicago s running game has largely disappeared of late but after looking superhuman at times in 2026 williams was very mortal on sunday patrick mahomes on the other hand might actually be superhuman a gruesome hit to his throwing arm sent every chiefs fan into panic mode but somehow mahomes shook it off and calmly led the chiefs to a runaway win by completing 23 of 31 passes for 242 yards and two touchdowns against the jets he s also welcoming slot receiver josh downs via trade this week i m eager to see how downs improves kansas city s passing attack the cowboys escaped indianapolis with a win in a weird game that saw dak prescott do what he does best air it out his 335 yard two touchdown performance was crucial to dallas winning efforts they ll need that and more against san francisco this week matthew stafford isn t playing anywhere near the caliber of his mvp 2025 season and still makes a head scratching throw or two per game he s just not as sharp as he s been in the past but he s also a primary reason the rams have stacked a few wins i worry about how he ll fare without the injured puka nacua going forward though next gen stats insights via nfl pro dak prescott completed 8 of 11 passes against man coverage for a season high 181 yards and two touchdowns in week 9 against the colts prescott connected with ceedee lamb on four passes for 95 yards and a touchdown against man coverage the fourth most yards the duo has recorded against man in a single game prescott completed 13 of 23 passes for 154 yards against zone coverage in the game tier 3 drake maye has a turnover problem again spending sunday throwing a couple of meatball subs to packers defenders and burying his team he s trusting his arm too much at times and looks uncomfortable in other instances but he s also playing without a couple of top pass catching options it s been an up and down year for maye no doubt bryce young the most volatile member of the qb index in 2026 is back on the rise after entering a flow state that powered a panthers comeback against the broncos he nearly positioned carolina to take an eight point second half lead before fate had different ideas young threw a wacky interception that was more a result of the defensive play made and the spheroid that is a football than a mistake by young the turnover stopped the panthers momentum in its tracks though young did his best to throw them back into the game in the fourth quarter but fumbled away their last chance ending a roller coaster of a day that fits his season kirk cousins swan song with the raiders wasn t quite as bad as the final stat line suggested yes he threw three interceptions and yes he appeared to lack the arm strength to complete a couple of highly ambitious attempts but he also played well enough to help the raiders momentarily climb back into a chaotic affair versus the niners now that he s a viking he s moving back to minneapolis with expectations of becoming a hero for the dreadful minnesota offense raiders fans will remember him as the capable veteran who guided the offense admirably in the first nine weeks under head coach klint kubiak geno smith helped the jets battle with the chiefs for a half on sunday before succumbing to steve spagnuolo s defense which feels appropriate given how gang green s season is going can cam ward build on his excellent week 8 showing following tennessee s bye will aaron rodgers be needed to power the steelers offense beyond a few key completions each week the second half should answer both of these questions for us next gen stats insights via nfl pro bryce young completed 28 of 39 passes for 276 yards with three touchdowns and an interception in week 9 against the broncos young went 13 of 14 for 152 yards and a touchdown on throws targeting in breaking routes young has thrown for 1 127 yards on in breaking routes this season the most among all quarterbacks tier 4 the buccaneers finally needed baker mayfield to throw the ball on sunday night a responsibility he embraced by launching a beautiful strike to tez johnson as part of tampa bay s comeback efforts unfortunately mayfield also threw two interceptions illustrating how his return from injury hasn t exactly been the smoothest experience tyler shough represented one half of a low output afternoon in the superdome on sunday until desperation set in against cleveland shough rediscovered his clutch gene at the perfect time and dropped a collection of dimes on the likes of chris olave and juwan johnson in the saints overtime win i ll be tracking him closely to see how he continues to develop a rapport with rookie jordyn tyson jayden daniels still makes plays that remind us of why he became an instant star as a rookie but he s also struggling with game management he doesn t seem to understand that he can t afford to throw the ball in the middle of the field with mere seconds remaining in a comeback effort and his offensive line didn t make matters any easier for him against a rams front that finally enjoyed the combined efforts of myles garrett three sacks and aaron donald bo nix is crawling yes crawling back toward where he was last season on sunday he included a few rollouts and throws across his body he fired a dart to courtland sutton for a first quarter score and calmly led two fourth quarter touchdown drives in the broncos road win over the panthers i want to believe it s a sign of better things to come but it sure feels like i ve been asked to watch grass grow michael penix s good doesn t outweigh his bad results right now an unfortunate reality for a quarterback whose successes have led me to believe he could grow into a star next gen stats insights via nfl pro tyler shough completed all three of his downfield attempts in the first half for 99 yards against the browns he doubled his downfield attempts to six in the second half and added two more in overtime completing two of those eight for 48 yards and a touchdown to clinch the win shough also recorded 51 rushing yards on 10 rushes including five scrambles for a career high 41 yards tier 5 drew lock s second start of the season ended in another win but he s dealing with elbow and oblique injuries leaving the seahawks qb situation in a somewhat tenuous state even though he s expected to play in week 10 it s not the best sign when j j mccarthy s exit and jameis winston s insertion into the game provides the giants with the spark they need to win i d like to chalk it up to the matchup with the eagles but i ll withhold harsher judgment on mccarthy for now nobody remembers the beginning when the ending is gripping but i refuse to allow a desperate final few minutes to occlude the fact that shedeur sanders was ineffective through the first three quarters of his start on sunday it was bad enough to wonder if backup dillon gabriel might be the better option until cleveland had no choice but to ask sanders to chuck it deep i ll credit sanders for hitting a few key passes in the final few minutes and overtime but those who believe that performance should inspire a quarterback controversy are simply clickbaiting gardner minshew s magic ran out in seattle on sunday he couldn t get anything going nor could the cardinals finish off a must have goal to go situation in the fourth quarter minshew might be out for the season with the elbow injury he suffered in the game setting up rookie carson beck s first start daniel jones made enough plays to help the colts climb back into sunday s contest against the cowboys he also ended indianapolis chances with yet another turnover next gen stats insights via nfl pro shedeur sanders completed three of his six downfield attempts for 154 yards and a touchdown against the saints with all six attempts occurring in the second half and overtime sanders fourth quarter deep pass to jerry jeudy set up a field goal attempt that sent the game to overtime sanders added 55 5 win probability on downfield attempts a career high mark tier 6 justin herbert ended his streak after going two games without a touchdown pass but he threw yet another interception against the texans malik willis best throw was wiped out on sunday by a holding penalty on rookie tight end will kacmarek it was a rough day for the quarterback who threw an interception and suffered a core muscle injury that landed him on injured reserve joe milton scrambled more often than i expected against the giants but largely looked like the inexperienced quarterback i expected to see joe fagnano s first start commanded attention on thursday night but he was no match for the jaguars defense baltimore s quick trade for jacoby brissett said everything we needed to know about the undrafted rookie like baltimore s move for brissett minnesota s trade for kirk cousins was entirely expected because of how poorly carson wentz played on monday night at one point in the second half he couldn t even complete simple passes on slants and out routes hopefully cousins can save this unit because wentz certainly wasn t up to the challenge next gen stats insights via nfl pro justin herbert completed 2 of 11 downfield passes 10 air yards for 66 yards and an interception in week 9 against the texans the fewest yards he has recorded on such throws in a game this season his 18 2 completion percentage on downfield passes is the second lowest of his career and he has now thrown an interception on a downfield pass in every game this season

news_mentions.headline: NFL trade grades: Evaluating every deal made ahead of the 2026 deadline
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Kevin Patra grades every trade made since the start of the 2026 regular season until Tuesday's trade deadline.
news_mentions.body_text: the 2026 nfl trade deadline has come and gone nfl com s kevin patra breaks down every trade made since the start of the regular season downs gets his trade looks to bolster chiefs date of trade nov 10 kansas city receives wr josh downs 2027 seventh round draft pick grade b indianapolis receives 2027 fourth round draft pick 2027 fifth round draft pick grade b the chiefs needed wide receiver aid with zero wideouts hitting the 300 yard mark yet this season a 37 year old travis kelce still leads k c pass catchers no offense to the future hall of famer but that shouldn t happen rashee rice is a roller coaster and xavier worthy is inefficient to put it nicely and dealing with a hamstring injury tyquan thornton was their most explosive receiver until he suffered a gruesome dislocation a title contender couldn t continue with their bb style passing offense in comes downs who is better than his numbers 33 receptions for 354 yards touchdown this year suggest he can create separation out of the slot and provide run after catch the switch from daniel jones to patrick mahomes could unlock downs ability even more he should slide right in as a slot weapon for the chiefs and give mahomes a third down target when downs gets hot he s liable to gobble up catches in bunches it s been a frustrating season in indy for the receiver and a fresh start could boost his production heading into free agency it s not a game changing move but downs brings upside to a passing offense that lacks any mid range threat two mid round picks isn t nothing for a potential rental but it s the going rate for no 2 receivers seattle paid the same price for rashid shaheed last year depending on how the rest of the season goes the chiefs could re sign downs in the offseason or he could be a potential comp pick candidate in free agency the colts fire sale ended with the disgruntled receiver who wanted out moving both downs and keenan allen leaves indy with an ultra thin wr room picking up a fourth and fifth rounder for a player who wanted out is a fine haul however this season s roster gutting underscores the danger of trading away first round picks as the colts did last season the colts former 2027 choice is destined to be a top 10 selection with top pick potential eek jets fans have to love these moves falcons ravens swap o linemen date of trade nov 10 baltimore the no 4 overall pick on harrison in 2024 monti ossenfort still gets docked for whiffing on a prime selection i understand why the texans would take a swing on harrison like most of the league they probably gave the ohio state product a very high pre draft grade reuniting him with former buckeyes teammate c j stroud could bring out the best in the wideout the texans have struggled mightily to move the ball when nico collins has been injured and given collins history and the hard hits he takes he s not guaranteed to make it through the rest of the season without missing time after laying an egg for four weeks the 1 4 texans don t have any more wiggle room harrison s contract isn t onerous giving houston some insurance if tank dell never returns to form or jayden higgins is delayed next year coming off a season ending injury in the short term this trade is somewhat duplicative of the much cheaper deal in which it acquired kayshon boutte it s more costly but gives the club more control of the future mostly i don t love the price tag for a player who hasn t been who we thought he was for it to make sense to give up a day 2 pick the texans need harrison to finally break out after two mediocre seasons perhaps in improved surroundings and on a team that clearly wants him with a qb he knows and trusts harrison can blossom frankly i probably like many scouts can t figure out the disconnect between a player who looked as polished and well rounded as harrison did at osu and the one we ve seen lope about for two plus years the question is whether you believe the scouting or the two separate coaching staffs who haven t found much use for him the texans are betting on their scouting eagles send pro bowl ol to ravens date of trade oct 7 baltimore receives c cam jurgens 2027 seventh round draft pick grade b philadelphia receives 2027 fifth round draft pick 2028 second round draft pick grade a we should start with the obvious the two time pro bowler was available for a reason especially after the same offensive line saw a future hall of famer lane johnson retire the day prior jurgens is currently a pro bowler in name only after battling through a back injury in 2024 to help the eagles net a super bowl ring jurgens has not been the same player he struggled through last season and has been a liability through four games this year his pass blocking has never been otherworldly but it s particularly crumbled after he was asked to move to left guard the past three weeks blame the previous injuries or the ill fit in the eagles new blocking scheme but jurgens has been borderline unplayable the past few weeks drew kendall played better than jurgens at center in sean mannion s scheme so a move back wasn t in the cards it got so bad that nick sirianni was fending off questions about potentially benching the guard instead philly shipped him out of town we know that howie roseman doesn t care what year he gets his picks famously saying a first round pick is a first round pick regarding the a j brown trade this offseason when philly netted a 28 first however we can dock him ever so slightly for delayed satisfaction otherwise getting a second rounder for a struggling player who was not a fit is a home run in the short term the eagles offensive line is in flux with willie lampkin in line to take over at guard the hope is that landon dickerson returns to form when he eventually comes off injured reserve the trade is jarring coming right after johnson s retirement but getting a significant draft pick back for a player who was on the verge of being benched makes sense philly is now loaded in the 2028 draft with two firsts and two seconds even acknowledging jurgens significant struggles the play makes sense for the ravens the plans to replace tyler linderbaum who signed with the raiders in free agency this summer were wobbly from the start the ones they rode with danny pinter jovaughn gwyn and ethan pocic have all landed on injured reserve counting on pocic coming off injury was always a gamble the ravens crapped out instead of sticking with rookie olaivavega ioane out of position at center baltimore will take a roll of the dice that jurgens can get back to form it s not a terrible gamble and it s conceivable the 27 year old can bounce back with a return to center in a different scheme jurgens contract which has him under team control through 2029 for relatively cheap is also desirable for baltimore injury is always part of the equation and jurgens enters his time in baltimore in the league s concussion protocol nfl network s mike garafolo reported if he s healthy and returns to form this will be an excellent move for baltimore if he continues to struggle or misses a ton of time it will be the latest swing and miss in trying to replace linderbaum porter drama ends in trade to dallas date of trade oct 1 dallas receives cb joey porter grade a pittsburgh receives 2027 sixth round draft pick 2028 second round draft pick grade c the cowboys desperately needed corner help for a defense that has floundered despite the offseason upgrades i ll credit jerry jones for not sitting on his hands instead doing what we have been asking general managers to do for years be bold make moves and don t overvalue your own picks during a season we won t know if the trade pays off in the long term but the cowboys certainly improved in 2026 at his peak porter is a physical cover man who can be sticky on the outside and mirror top receivers he ll slide well into christian parker s scheme allowing dallas to play man coverage on the outside with more physicality than in the first three weeks sure he racks up some penalties but so do most cbs you ll live with the trade off for a corner with jpj s skill set that dallas didn t have to give up a premier pick until 2028 also improved its grade assuming that porter plays the cowboys get a top shelf cb for a relatively cheap up front cost jones seems to be hoping he can copy the success he had with the george pickens trade pushing off the long term talks until down the road it s a needle threading but one that could work if porter plays well dallas could extend him in the offseason use the franchise tag on the cb or let him walk and recoup a potential third round compensatory pick in 2028 possibly moving down one round in 28 and giving up a sixth rounder for a potential pro bowl player in a year when you re all in is a stellar move if porter delivers 14 games of high level play it s worth it of course if porter gets hurt or implodes this all goes for naught however if he continues on this track it is a short term win for the cowboys the long term question can be shelved i don t fault the steelers for not wanting to pay porter top cb money if he were seeking a 30 million type deal in line with christian gonzalez or devon witherspoon i would have balked too jpj is good he s not at that level trading him away relieved pittsburgh of that problem the issue i have is that it appears steelers gm omar khan either overplayed his hand or didn t anticipate porter s gumption when it came to a new deal if khan had never planned to meet the corner s contract demands he should have made a move in the spring or early summer a player of porter s caliber is worth more than a second round pick two drafts down the road the timing of the impasse reduced the compensation now the steelers are without a top corner and find themselves thin and young at the position not a good combo if things spiral in pittsburgh it s fair to wonder if khan will even be around to make that second round pick in 2028 the gm took over in 2022 and received early praise for fleecing the bears in the chase claypool trade that brought back a second rounder that pick became porter khan has now moved him for pennies on the dollar add in a string of so so drafts the pickens trade and other questionable moves and the seat in pittsburgh could get hot for khan if the steelers flounder giants trade for mccarthy after dart injury date of trade sept 28 new york receives qb j j mccarthy grade c minnesota receives 2027 fifth round draft pick grade c minnesota signaled its intent to move on from the former no 10 overall pick by inking kyler murray and bringing back carson wentz in the offseason mccarthy got a slim shot at the starting job during training camp but he couldn t even fend off wentz for the primary backup role a former first rounder turned clipboard holder is a bad look all around had another club made an offer of substance before the season i believe the vikings would have moved on then given mccarthy s rough preseason however it s no surprise it took an injury to a starting qb to move the needle a fifth rounder isn t nothing and the vikings save a few pennies however the reality is they turned a first fourth and late round pick swap into 10 starts and a future fifth rounder that math isn t mathing mccarthy s poor play and injury history left the vikings with no good options for a team in win now mode minnesota didn t have time to let the 23 year old develop on his terms moving on makes sense but the vikings can t get a high grade for the compensation new york took a shot that in a new setting and in an offense keyed on the ground attack john harbaugh and his staff can do what kevin o connell couldn t i don t hate the price for a former first round quarterback who even the stingiest draft graders pegged as a day 2 selection teams use fifth rounders and later as qb dart throws all the time the giants lack of 2027 picks is of concern but they can deal with that later with jaxson dart out for the regular season after knee surgery the giants needed to make some sort of move jameis winston has shown he can hold the fort for a spell but it s a serious question if harbaugh will give the boom or bust passer enough leash for a 15 game run bringing in mccarthy at least gives the giants another alternative if winston crumbles at this stage there aren t a whole lot of other options i m not optimistic that mccarthy can turn his career around but for a fifth round pick it s worth a shot for new york

news_mentions.headline: NFL trade deadline winners, losers: Vikings find QB, Jags go all-in, Jonathan Taylor stranded
news_mentions.body_text: the nfl 39 s trade deadline came and went with six deals unfolding tuesday those transactions brought this year 39 s total of in season trades to 18 a slight dip from last year 39 s 22 moves some teams bolstered their immediate outlook and enter the second half of the season with genuine playoff optimism others shifted focus toward the future stockpiling assets to reshape their rosters in the coming offseason a third group however watched opportunities pass them by destined to either suffer from their own inaction or the aggressiveness of their rivals here 39 s a look at some of the biggest winners and losers from the 2026 nfl trade deadline winners jacksonville jaguars jaguars brass approached the deadline determined to acquire defensive playmakers they emerged with massive defensive lineman jordan davis from the philadelphia eagles pro bowl safety jessie bates from the atlanta falcons and defensive tackle davon godchaux from the new orleans saints some questioned the price jacksonville paid for davis a 2027 first round pick and a 2029 second round selection but the jaguars believe they have a special team that additions like davis can elevate into legitimate super bowl contenders minnesota vikings the vikings have a championship caliber defense their offense however has fallen flat with kyler murray delivering subpar results and carson wentz proving disastrous now the vikings welcome back kirk cousins who posted a 50 37 1 record with two playoff appearances and three pro bowl nods during his first stint in minnesota from 2018 to 2023 all pro wide receiver justin jefferson goes from exasperated to optimistic as the signal caller who has thrown him 28 touchdowns returns if cousins can elevate an offense that ranked among the league 39 s worst despite boasting skill position talent minnesota could mount a super bowl charge chicago bears general manager ryan poles and coach ben johnson entered the season with a potent offense and an impactful defense landing defensive tackle jeffery simmons adds a difference maker to that unit and opens the door for all kinds of creativity under coordinator dennis allen philadelphia eagles general manager howie roseman began his wheeling and dealing last month nbsp by nbsp trading nbsp center cam jurgens to the baltimore ravens for a 2027 fifth round pick and a 2028 second round pick this week roseman couldn 39 t pass up the haul he received from the jaguars for davis the eagles now have 10 picks in the 2027 nfl draft highlighted by two first rounders a second a third a fourth three fifths a sixth and a seventh their 2028 haul features two firsts and seconds as well as philadelphia 39 s standard picks in rounds three through seven in 2029 they have eight selections a first rounder two seconds and one selection in each of the remaining rounds baltimore ravens the october acquisition of jurgens from the eagles met a need then last week baltimore filled a gaping hole at quarterback by trading for quarterback jacoby brissett they 39 re hoping the 11 year veteran can keep them afloat in case lamar jackson returns from thumb surgery in time for a late season playoff run kansas city chiefs wide receiver has ranked among the chiefs 39 weaknesses so former indianapolis colt josh downs should help improve that unit the fourth year man has 33 catches for 354 yards and a touchdown this season his best season came in 2024 when he had 72 catches for 803 yards and five touchdowns indianapolis colts owner carlie irsay gordon saw the writing on the wall and began dismantling this year 39 s team after firing general manager chris ballard she then directed the stockpiling of resources for a rebuild between the trades of guard quenton nelson seattle seahawks defensive tackle deforest buckner and wide receiver keenan allen san francisco 49ers and downs chiefs the colts added a third two fourths two fifths and a sixth for players on expiring deals san francisco 49ers the 49ers were already championship contenders but they used the trade window to fortify areas of weakness first they bolstered their defensive front by acquiring buckner from the colts last week they called indianapolis again in recent days orchestrating a deal for allen to join an injury ravaged wide receiver room fernando mendoza the no 1 pick in the 2026 nfl draft waited patiently as cousins led the las vegas raiders 4 5 to a more competitive start than many anticipated but with the vikings in desperate need of competent quarterback play the raiders couldn 39 t pass up a 2027 third round pick for the 38 year old las vegas now turns to mendoza for the second half of the season and beyond in one relief appearance mendoza completed six of eight passes for 48 yards he 39 ll aim to apply all of the lessons gained from watching cousins while attempting to keep the raiders 39 season alive losers nfc north foes despite the vikings 39 ferocious defense putrid quarterback play left the door open for the bears detroit lions and green bay packers to contend for division supremacy now that minnesota has reunited with cousins jefferson wide receiver jordan addison and tight end t j hockenson should go back to delivering game changing performances the run game should improve too the road to the nfc north crown just got more difficult los angeles chargers the winless chargers had a chance to unload veterans with expiring deals instead their only move was trading 26 year old linebacker daiyan henley to the denver broncos for a 2027 fourth round pick and a 2028 fifth round selection khalil mack could have helped a team in the postseason hunt not only did los angeles forfeit the chance to acquire draft capital but the 35 year old pass rusher also lost out on playing for a contender jonathan taylor amid another lost colts season it looked as though the team 39 s workhorse back would join a club with championship aspirations however indianapolis stood pat since none of the suitors were willing to meet its steep asking price though he 39 s been one of the most productive backs since entering the nfl in 2020 taylor has played in one playoff game 2020 over his seven year career kyler murray the former no 1 overall pick hoped a change of scenery and guidance from offensive minded coach kevin o 39 connell would rejuvenate his career murray 39 s starting quarterback tenure lasted just six games with injuries and an inability to adapt to o 39 connell 39 s system leading to poor production now murray will back up cousins who gives minnesota a pro bowl caliber quarterback and hope for a super bowl push washington commanders hope is fading fast for the 2 5 1 commanders and general manager adam peters opted against making any trades part of the problem was that washington had few bargaining chips after season ending injuries to wide receiver terry mclaurin and defensive tackle daron payne this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Cardinals' Gardner Minshew likely needs season-ending elbow surgery; Carson Beck in line to start
news_mentions.description: Cardinals quarterback Gardner Minshew is seeking additional medical opinions to confirm that he will likely need season-ending surgery on a torn UCL in his throwing arm, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported.
news_mentions.body_text: round and round the arizona cardinals quarterback carousel goes gardner minshew is seeking additional medical opinions to confirm that he will need season ending surgery on a torn ucl in his throwing arm nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported minshew appeared to suffer the injury on a strip sack by dante fowler in the closing moments of the second quarter during sunday s 17 3 loss to the seattle seahawks he stayed in to finish out the game with 166 yards on 21 of 30 passing should minshew require surgery that puts him on the bench for the duration of the 2026 campaign third round rookie carson beck would be in line to start in week 10 against the los angeles rams and moving forward arizona also signed veteran josh johnson off the cincinnati bengals practice squad per schefter though two undrafted rookies have logged starts this season the tampa bay buccaneers jalon daniels and baltimore ravens joe fagnano beck would become the first signal caller from the 2026 draft class to make a start ahead of first rounders fernando mendoza las vegas raiders and ty simpson rams minshew s injury continues a period of constant change in arizona the cardinals completed a trade sending jacoby brissett the team s starter for the first eight games to the baltimore ravens on friday three days later they could be on to qb no 3 though it is a certainly an unorthodox path to giving the rookie a shot arizona currently sits at the bottom of the nfc west with a 3 6 record so it s beneficial at this point to see what the club has in beck who threw for 11 725 yards 88 touchdowns and 32 interceptions in a long college career that included five seasons at georgia and a final one with miami florida he appeared only in the pro football hall of fame game during the preseason due to injuries hampering him thereafter but he did shine in the one outing going 15 of 19 for 188 yards and a touchdown his next test will be far tougher perhaps the most unfriendly way one could be welcomed to the nfl with no 1 wide receiver michael wilson out for the rest of the season due to a neck injury beck will make his debut against the terrifying defensive line duo of aaron donald and myles garrett the latter of whom returned from injured reserve in week 9 with a three sack statement how he performs against l a and throughout the second half of the season could play a major factor in arizona s future qb plans

news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top

news_mentions.description: With the start of NFL training camps just around the corner, Grant Gordon provides a refresher on the Arizona Cardinals' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc west catch up on the arizona cardinals offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 22 rookies and veterans location state farm stadium glendale ariz fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs kansas city chiefs 8 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 at denver broncos 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 vs las vegas raiders 4 30 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note arizona plays san francisco and seattle in back to back weeks twice weeks 3 4 weeks 10 11 but doesn t play los angeles the reigning nfc west champion until week 14 and then again in week 18 nfl research what you need to know 1 beneficiaries of two first round draft picks in 2024 the cardinals were left wanting much more from marvin harrison and darius robinson in total harrison s 62 receptions for 885 yards and eight touchdowns as a rookie are pretty solid but many thought the no 4 overall selection would be a superstar out of the gate harrison and quarterback kyler murray furthering their chemistry could well be the team s prevailing storyline this season and that will get going in earnest during camp robinson picked 23 slots after harrison last year played in just six games because of a calf injury this will be a pivotal camp for him especially amid a revamped defensive front one that will offer him veterans to learn from and new faces to compete against for snaps 2 one of the easiest players in the nfl to root for calais campbell 38 returning to the team he began his illustrious career with in 2008 is more than just a feel great story campbell s leadership is just as important an addition as his talent to a club looking for its first winning season since 2021 this is a pivotal season for the monti ossenfort jonathan gannon regime and campbell pass rusher josh sweat and defensive tackle dalvin tomlinson should add some veteran moxie to a team lacking it outside of star safety budda baker gannon was hired for his defensive prowess coordinating the philadelphia eagles now his arizona d is finally stocked up at least on paper it s added some experienced talent and two high profile rookies in defensive lineman walter nolen first round no 16 overall and cornerback will johnson second no 47 johnson has the ceiling to become a massive draft steal how the cards defensive additions mesh with the starting staples begins this summer 3 james conner joined arizona in 2021 and has been a stellar fit who has exceeded his output and importance with the pittsburgh steelers for four years prior he s coming off career high tallies in carries 236 and rushing yards 1 094 but is entering his age 30 season 2024 third rounder trey benson 63 carries for 291 yards had a disappointing debut campaign but if he finds his footing could he push conner for touches it ll be interesting to see how camp develops in the arizona offensive backfield
