goes for naught however if he continues on this track it is a short term win for the cowboys the long term question can be shelved i don t fault the steelers for not wanting to pay porter top cb money if he were seeking a 30 million type deal in line with christian gonzalez or devon witherspoon i would have balked too jpj is good he s not at that level trading him away relieved pittsburgh of that problem the issue i have is that it appears steelers gm omar khan either overplayed his hand or didn t anticipate porter s gumption when it came to a new deal if khan had never planned to meet the corner s contract demands he should have made a move in the spring or early summer a player of porter s caliber is worth more than a second round pick two drafts down the road the timing of the impasse reduced the compensation now the steelers are without a top corner and find themselves thin and young at the position not a good combo if things spiral in pittsburgh it s fair to wonder if khan will even be around to make that second round pick in 2028 the gm took over in 2022 and received early praise for fleecing the bears in the chase claypool trade that brought back a second rounder that pick became porter khan has now moved him for pennies on the dollar add in a string of so so drafts the pickens trade and other questionable moves and the seat in pittsburgh could get hot for khan if the steelers flounder giants trade for mccarthy after dart injury date of trade sept 28 new york receives qb j j mccarthy grade c minnesota receives 2027 fifth round draft pick grade c minnesota signaled its intent to move on from the former no 10 overall pick by inking kyler murray and bringing back carson wentz in the offseason mccarthy got a slim shot at the starting job during training camp but he couldn t even fend off wentz for the primary backup role a former first rounder turned clipboard holder is a bad look all around had another club made an offer of substance before the season i believe the vikings would have moved on then given mccarthy s rough preseason however it s no surprise it took an injury to a starting qb to move the needle a fifth rounder isn t nothing and the vikings save a few pennies however the reality is they turned a first fourth and late round pick swap into 10 starts and a future fifth rounder that math isn t mathing mccarthy s poor play and injury history left the vikings with no good options for a team in win now mode minnesota didn t have time to let the 23 year old develop on his terms moving on makes sense but the vikings can t get a high grade for the compensation new york took a shot that in a new setting and in an offense keyed on the ground attack john harbaugh and his staff can do what kevin o connell couldn t i don t hate the price for a former first round quarterback who even the stingiest draft graders pegged as a day 2 selection teams use fifth rounders and later as qb dart throws all the time the giants lack of 2027 picks is of concern but they can deal with that later with jaxson dart out for the regular season after knee surgery the giants needed to make some sort of move jameis winston has shown he can hold the fort for a spell but it s a serious question if harbaugh will give the boom or bust passer enough leash for a 15 game run bringing in mccarthy at least gives the giants another alternative if winston crumbles at this stage there aren t a whole lot of other options i m not optimistic that mccarthy can turn his career around but for a fifth round pick it s worth a shot for new york

news_mentions.headline: NFL trade deadline winners, losers: Vikings find QB, Jags go all-in, Jonathan Taylor stranded
news_mentions.body_text: the nfl 39 s trade deadline came and went with six deals unfolding tuesday those transactions brought this year 39 s total of in season trades to 18 a slight dip from last year 39 s 22 moves some teams bolstered their immediate outlook and enter the second half of the season with genuine playoff optimism others shifted focus toward the future stockpiling assets to reshape their rosters in the coming offseason a third group however watched opportunities pass them by destined to either suffer from their own inaction or the aggressiveness of their rivals here 39 s a look at some of the biggest winners and losers from the 2026 nfl trade deadline winners jacksonville jaguars jaguars brass approached the deadline determined to acquire defensive playmakers they emerged with massive defensive lineman jordan davis from the philadelphia eagles pro bowl safety jessie bates from the atlanta falcons and defensive tackle davon godchaux from the new orleans saints some questioned the price jacksonville paid for davis a 2027 first round pick and a 2029 second round selection but the jaguars believe they have a special team that additions like davis can elevate into legitimate super bowl contenders minnesota vikings the vikings have a championship caliber defense their offense however has fallen flat with kyler murray delivering subpar results and carson wentz proving disastrous now the vikings welcome back kirk cousins who posted a 50 37 1 record with two playoff appearances and three pro bowl nods during his first stint in minnesota from 2018 to 2023 all pro wide receiver justin jefferson goes from exasperated to optimistic as the signal caller who has thrown him 28 touchdowns returns if cousins can elevate an offense that ranked among the league 39 s worst despite boasting skill position talent minnesota could mount a super bowl charge chicago bears general manager ryan poles and coach ben johnson entered the season with a potent offense and an impactful defense landing defensive tackle jeffery simmons adds a difference maker to that unit and opens the door for all kinds of creativity under coordinator dennis allen philadelphia eagles general manager howie roseman began his wheeling and dealing last month nbsp by nbsp trading nbsp center cam jurgens to the baltimore ravens for a 2027 fifth round pick and a 2028 second round pick this week roseman couldn 39 t pass up the haul he received from the jaguars for davis the eagles now have 10 picks in the 2027 nfl draft highlighted by two first rounders a second a third a fourth three fifths a sixth and a seventh their 2028 haul features two firsts and seconds as well as philadelphia 39 s standard picks in rounds three through seven in 2029 they have eight selections a first rounder two seconds and one selection in each of the remaining rounds baltimore ravens the october acquisition of jurgens from the eagles met a need then last week baltimore filled a gaping hole at quarterback by trading for quarterback jacoby brissett they 39 re hoping the 11 year veteran can keep them afloat in case lamar jackson returns from thumb surgery in time for a late season playoff run kansas city chiefs wide receiver has ranked among the chiefs 39 weaknesses so former indianapolis colt josh downs should help improve that unit the fourth year man has 33 catches for 354 yards and a touchdown this season his best season came in 2024 when he had 72 catches for 803 yards and five touchdowns indianapolis colts owner carlie irsay gordon saw the writing on the wall and began dismantling this year 39 s team after firing general manager chris ballard she then directed the stockpiling of resources for a rebuild between the trades of guard quenton nelson seattle seahawks defensive tackle deforest buckner and wide receiver keenan allen san francisco 49ers and downs chiefs the colts added a third two fourths two fifths and a sixth for players on expiring deals san francisco 49ers the 49ers were already championship contenders but they used the trade window to fortify areas of weakness first they bolstered their defensive front by acquiring buckner from the colts last week they called indianapolis again in recent days orchestrating a deal for allen to join an injury ravaged wide receiver room fernando mendoza the no 1 pick in the 2026 nfl draft waited patiently as cousins led the las vegas raiders 4 5 to a more competitive start than many anticipated but with the vikings in desperate need of competent quarterback play the raiders couldn 39 t pass up a 2027 third round pick for the 38 year old las vegas now turns to mendoza for the second half of the season and beyond in one relief appearance mendoza completed six of eight passes for 48 yards he 39 ll aim to apply all of the lessons gained from watching cousins while attempting to keep the raiders 39 season alive losers nfc north foes despite the vikings 39 ferocious defense putrid quarterback play left the door open for the bears detroit lions and green bay packers to contend for division supremacy now that minnesota has reunited with cousins jefferson wide receiver jordan addison and tight end t j hockenson should go back to delivering game changing performances the run game should improve too the road to the nfc north crown just got more difficult los angeles chargers the winless chargers had a chance to unload veterans with expiring deals instead their only move was trading 26 year old linebacker daiyan henley to the denver broncos for a 2027 fourth round pick and a 2028 fifth round selection khalil mack could have helped a team in the postseason hunt not only did los angeles forfeit the chance to acquire draft capital but the 35 year old pass rusher also lost out on playing for a contender jonathan taylor amid another lost colts season it looked as though the team 39 s workhorse back would join a club with championship aspirations however indianapolis stood pat since none of the suitors were willing to meet its steep asking price though he 39 s been one of the most productive backs since entering the nfl in 2020 taylor has played in one playoff game 2020 over his seven year career kyler murray the former no 1 overall pick hoped a change of scenery and guidance from offensive minded coach kevin o 39 connell would rejuvenate his career murray 39 s starting quarterback tenure lasted just six games with injuries and an inability to adapt to o 39 connell 39 s system leading to poor production now murray will back up cousins who gives minnesota a pro bowl caliber quarterback and hope for a super bowl push washington commanders hope is fading fast for the 2 5 1 commanders and general manager adam peters opted against making any trades part of the problem was that washington had few bargaining chips after season ending injuries to wide receiver terry mclaurin and defensive tackle daron payne this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Texans QB C.J. Stroud, Packers QB Jordan Love highlight Players of the Week
news_mentions.description: Green Bay quarterback Jordan Love and Houston signal-caller C.J. Stroud shined in Week 9 and earned top offensive accolades on Wednesday.
news_mentions.body_text: who were the nfl s top stars in week 9 each wednesday the league unveils its weekly honor roll see who the players of the week are below afc offensive player of the week stroud was a force on sunday lighting up the chargers during the texans runaway 44 22 victory the 2023 first rounder matched a career high set in his rookie campaign with five touchdown passes as he completed 21 of 35 throws 60 for 384 yards one interception and a 125 5 rating stroud earned his fifth career afc offensive player of the week with his first coming the first time he threw for five scores back in week 9 2023 nfc offensive player of the week love was outstanding in the packers 45 27 rout of the patriots rising into the mvp conversation love completed 79 3 of his 29 passes for 372 yards and three touchdowns he had four total tds adding a rushing score as well afc defensive player of the week the seven time pro bowler and now four time afc defensive player of the week awoke from a relatively quiet season with a stellar sunday in the chiefs 35 12 thumping of the jets jones posted four tackles two tackles for loss a pass breakup and two sacks prior to week 9 jones had half a sack on the season nfc defensive player of the week the no 5 overall pick in the 2026 nfl draft has been bestowed with his first accolade in what could be a first season filled with awards the ap nfl defensive rookie of the year contender piled up 12 tackles three sacks and a forced fumble as his giants delivered a 19 11 win sunday against the host eagles afc special teams player of the week owner of the two longest kicks in nfl history little didn t need to break out his big boot in thursday s win over the ravens however he braved the rainy elements to stack up 15 points in the 33 10 win little was perfect on seven kicks ending his busy night with three extra points in three tries and four field goals 36 yards 45 47 33 in just as many attempts this is little s second afc special teams player of the week honor his first was also in week 9 coming last year when he converted the longest field goal in league chronicle nfc special teams player of the week on an off day of sorts for the lions bates was perfectly efficient scoring 13 points in detroit s 19 9 win over the dolphins on sunday bates made his single extra point try and was good on each of his four field goal attempts

news_mentions.headline: Cam Skattebo reacts to Giants not trading for Jonathan Taylor: 'They know what I can do'
news_mentions.description: The Giants didn’t trade for Colts running back Jonathan Taylor by Tuesday's deadline, leaving Cam Skattebo, slated to return Thursday against the Commanders, as the lead back.
news_mentions.body_text: the new york giants didn t trade for indianapolis colts running back jonathan taylor by tuesday s deadline leaving cam skattebo slated to return thursday against the washington commanders as the lead back asked about big blue s lack of a move at running back skattebo reiterated his confidence you ve seen what i can do he said tuesday via nj com when i come out and i m ready to play football i can be one of the most dangerous backs in the league simple as that skattebo added that he understands why the giants poked around on taylor but the second year pro said that he s still growing as he enters his 16th nfl contest i would be skeptical too if my running back was going for 60 yards a game and not really exploding out he said but i m still getting comfortable man this is like my 13th game in the league i m not even through a full football season yet i m still learning how to play football in this league you obviously can see i m getting more comfortable as i play the game the last time we saw skattebo on the field in week 7 he generated a career best 124 rushing yards his bruising style is tough to tackle when he gets going but the engine doesn t always start and he s had bad injury luck he missed week 9 due to a hamstring injury when the giants last faced the commanders in week 5 skattebo had 59 rushing yards on 13 carries but lost an overtime fumble that cost big blue a potential victory i ve been that guy he said obviously we had that one week hiccup where i got in trouble and got benched against the saints that was it i came back that next week and handled business they know what i m capable of they know what i can do the giants running game is certainly better with skattebo blasting through holes to keep their place atop the nfc east they need the second year back to stay on the field

news_mentions.headline: Jaguars GM James Gladstone doesn't view trades as going 'all-in'
news_mentions.description: The Jacksonville Jaguars shipped out a host of draft picks to upgrade their defense ahead of Tuesday's trade deadline.
news_mentions.body_text: the jacksonville jaguars spent significant draft capital upgrading their defense ahead of tuesday s trade deadline general manager james gladstone shipped 2027 first and second rounders a 2028 fifth and sixth round pick conditional and a 2029 second round pick for safety jessie bates nose tackle jordan davis and defensive tackle davon godchaux outside duval the perception is that gladstone pushed all his chips into the center of the table going all in on the jags having a legit shot at a super bowl on tuesday the gm rejected that notion yeah i think the idea that this is an all in move isn t necessarily how i characterize it gladstone said i characterize it as getting better as a football team and prioritizing getting better as a football team i look forward to seeing it all come to life and being a part of bringing it to life here this week and beyond but really that s the intent behind any decision that we make is what s in the best interest of this team in particular and the organization as a whole moving forward there is no sugarcoating that the jags paid a hefty price for a safety and two interior defenders however those were jacksonville s biggest weaknesses after injuries hit the defense credit gladstone for being fearless in giving his team a chance to chase a ring sitting on his hands wouldn t have done much good in 2026 having spent time on les snead s staff in los angeles gladstone has a unique view of the proverbial eff them picks mantra that the rams have embraced for the jags gm it s more of a cute phrase than how l a actually operates i know the idea of eff them picks has kind of taken a hold and it s a headline it s really not the approach or the process he said as you think back to my experience in los angeles over the time that i was there from the 2017 draft to the 2024 draft we were able to have the third most selections in the nfl across all 32 teams but there was a narrative around eff them picks tied to us it s in the volume of picks that s important and it ties back to how we operated in free agency this past spring not signing external free agents is an important piece when you have internal free agents signing elsewhere that can earn you a compensatory pick thus supplementing the loss of any other draft selection that you may choose to use outside the three days that exist in april to make a selection it s a very symbiotic process that encompasses a lot of layers to it but it s certainly not eff them picks while that s been characterized as the approach it s not necessarily we actually value picks we don t always use them on the three days that exist in april isn t that a breath of fresh air yes draft picks are extremely valuable particularly with rookie contract ceilings however using those picks not just on one weekend in the spring is a strategy gms with guts can exploit in a league that far too often hoards those selections in the fall then trades them willy nilly come the spring the balance of when exactly to buy and when to hoard is a difficult skill to master and one far too many gms don t even attempt to grasp gladstone certainly took a couple gambles if the davis trade blows up he ll have egg on his face however it s undeniable that jacksonville is better today than it was on sunday if the jags have a parade in duval in february no one will be crying about how those draft picks were spent

news_mentions.headline: Dolphins place QB Malik Willis (groin) on injured reserve; Kyle McCord in line for first start
news_mentions.description: Miami Dolphins quarterback Malik Willis was placed on injured reserve Tuesday due to a groin injury. With Willis shelved, second-year QB Kyle McCord will fill in, beginning Sunday on the road against the Indianapolis Colts.
news_mentions.body_text: a noticeable problem for malik willis in a week 9 loss will be an obstacle for the miami dolphins for at least the next four weeks willis was placed on injured reserve tuesday due to a groin injury with willis shelved second year quarterback kyle mccord will fill in beginning sunday on the road against the indianapolis colts the 27 year old willis regarded as one of the best running quarterbacks in the nfl was noticeably hobbled in his team s week 9 defeat to the detroit lions a free agent signing after renewing his career and promise under the tutelage of matt lafleur with the green bay packers willis has shepherded a rebuilding fins squad to mixed results the dolphins are 1 7 and he s completed 58 2 of his passes for 174 5 yards per game six touchdowns six interceptions and rushed for 232 yards and three scores so far this season willis and punter bradley pinion 1 for 1 are the only miami players to have thrown passes that will almost certainly change sunday when mccord is poised to make his first nfl start mccord 24 was a 2025 sixth round choice of the philadelphia eagles who was traded to the packers and like willis received good reviews from his time with lafleur that led to green bay turning around and trading him this offseason to miami for a sixth round pick with miami realistically out of the playoff race some silver lining exists in mccord getting his chance to show what he can do going forward brady cook who filled in as a starter for the new york jets last season is currently on miami s practice squad he ll likely be elevated to be the backup willis will miss games at the colts at the buffalo bills versus the new york jets and at the denver broncos from weeks 10 13 he ll be eligible to return for his team s dec 13 home game against the chicago bears

news_mentions.headline: Chiefs acquire Colts WR Josh Downs ahead of trade deadline
news_mentions.description: The Chiefs are acquiring Josh Downs and a 2027 seventh-round pick from the Colts in exchange for a 2027 fourth-round selection and a 2027 fifth-rounder, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported on Tuesday.
news_mentions.body_text: josh downs wish has been granted and a need has been answered in kansas city the chiefs are acquiring the slot receiver in a trade with the colts nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported kansas city is sending fourth and fifth round picks in the 2027 draft to indianapolis in the deal while receiving a 2027 seventh round pick in exchange per rapoport and schefter indianapolis announced the trade shortly after downs becomes the fourth player traded by the colts prior to tuesday s deadline joining the likes of guard quenton nelson defensive tackle deforest buckner and fellow receiver keenan allen who was traded to san francisco earlier tuesday i am beyond grateful and blessed for my time in indy downs wrote on social media following news of the trade nothing but love for the shoe a third round pick out of north carolina in 2023 downs became a reliable secondary receiving option in indianapolis pairing with michael pittman and eventually alec pierce to form a quality pass catching tandem for the colts despite instability under center he posted a career high 803 receiving yards and five touchdowns in 14 games in 2024 but watched indianapolis trade pittman to pittsburgh and hand pierce the lucrative extension downs desired over the offseason leaving downs in an awkward spot entering a contract year that contract year became a nightmare for the colts prompting downs to request a trade following two deals that shipped nelson to seattle and buckner to san francisco indianapolis didn t initially adhere to his request and coach shane steichen convinced downs to continue participating following the receiver s ask to be dealt but after two games played the colts decided it was time to maximize whatever return was available for the receiver especially as free agency loomed in early 2027 downs heads to kansas city to join a receiver room that is headlined by rashee rice who returned from injury in week 8 and helped improve kansas city s passing attack but is short at the position following xavier worthy s hamstring injury suffered in the chiefs week 9 win over the new york jets and if we re being honest the chiefs have long needed help at receiver making them a likely candidate to swing a deal for a receiver even before worthy s latest injury with downs now in the mix patrick mahomes will have another option to turn to as he surveys the field indianapolis meanwhile concludes a remarkably active trade window in which they dealt four players but held onto the most recognizable one running back jonathan taylor when the colts fired general manager chris ballard and sent out expiring mainstays like nelson and buckner it was clear the organization was willing to engage in a fire sale in order to jump start a rebuild as a star runner at nearly 28 years old taylor was seen as the most valuable asset in such a teardown and was understandably attracting plenty of interest from rb needy contenders despite these market forces encouraging a blockbuster trade when the 4 p m et deadline passed on tuesday taylor remained a colt indianapolis will finish 2026 with taylor remaining at the center of its offense and perhaps entertain a trade following the conclusion of the current campaign

news_mentions.headline: Vikings trade for Raiders QB Kirk Cousins on deadline day
news_mentions.description: The Vikings are acquiring Kirk Cousins from the Las Vegas Raiders, NFL Network Insiders Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported on Tuesday.
news_mentions.body_text: minnesota has its new and old quarterback the vikings are acquiring kirk cousins from the las vegas raiders in exchange for a 2027 third round draft pick nfl network insiders ian rapoport and mike garafolo and espn s adam schefter reported on tuesday minnesota has since announced the trade the swap also begins the fernando mendoza era for the raiders as the 2026 nfl draft s no 1 overall pick will now take over as the team s starter raiders general manager john spytek told reporters that he didn t expect to trade cousins and didn t make calls to shop him before minnesota reached out tuesday morning this was a hard decision spytek said of moving cousins per team reporter paul gutierrez but we felt like we made the best decision for the raiders going forward the trade brings cousins 38 back to the club he played for from 2018 to 2023 and reunites him with head coach kevin o connell who was in charge for cousins final two years as a viking cousins first season under o connell was one of his finest as a pro as he threw for 4 547 yards 29 touchdowns and 14 interceptions while going 13 4 in 2022 minnesota will desperately be hoping for more of the same from cousins after its qb situation disintegrated to a point that it was threatening to tank the team s season despite the vikings boasting the top scoring defense in the league a relentless pressure machine that batters opponents and keeps them off the scoreboard the offense has been a travesty that unit ranks 27th in points 31st in yards and 31st in passing the vikings have scored 16 points or less in five of their eight games including the last three it hasn t mattered if kyler murray or carson wentz was under center and j j mccarthy drafted to take over for cousins in 2024 flunked out of o connell s quarterback school and was traded to the giants on sept 28 thus cousins returns to replace his replacement the four time pro bowler has played remarkably well for las vegas this season more than just a placeholder for mendoza he s thrown for 2 340 yards 20 touchdowns and eight interceptions while leading the raiders to a 4 5 record a much better spot than most would have predicted and on the playoff bubble midway through the season mendoza now takes over for the silver and black hoping to keep them competitive down the stretch and prove himself worthy of being the top pick in the 2026 draft a heisman trophy winner and national champion at indiana mendoza has made one prior appearance this season entering a blowout loss to the patriots and throwing for 48 yards on 6 of 8 passing he s shown us he s ready not only physically but mentally spytek said after officially naming mendoza as las vegas starter beginning with sunday s upcoming game versus a seahawks squad sporting a stingy defense raiders head coach klint kubiak added i anticipate it being a transition we re going to find out together the future is now for the raiders while a blast from the past returns to the vikings hoping to rescue an offense in dire need of saving if cousins proves ready to play in week 10 he ll face off against the packers at lambeau field just as he did in has last game with the vikings back in 2023

news_mentions.headline: Colts trade WR Keenan Allen to 49ers for 2027 sixth-round pick
news_mentions.description: The San Francisco 49ers are acquiring veteran wide receiver Keenan Allen from the Indianapolis Colts in exchange for a 2027 sixth-round draft pick, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported on Tuesday.
news_mentions.body_text: the san francisco 49ers have added another veteran for their ailing wide receiver room the niners acquired keenan allen from the colts in exchange for a 2027 sixth round pick indianapolis announced tuesday ahead of the trade deadline nfl network and espn first reported the news allen signed in indy in august to help a banged up receiver corps now he s being shipped west to aid another the first of two wideouts indy dealt on tuesday as josh downs was later sent to kansas city in eight games this season allen has generated 40 catches for 351 yards and a touchdown the longtime los angeles chargers star who earned six pro bowls in l a isn t as steady as he once was but the 34 year old still knows how to run a route and can be counted on for third downs allen has become something of a nomad in the past few years after his pro bowl 2023 season he was traded to chicago for a fourth round pick he then returned to l a in 2025 this year deep into the summer he latched onto shane steichen s squad in 14 seasons allen has generated 12 402 yards on 1 095 catches with 71 tds he might not be the allen of old but he brings reliability to a decimated 49ers wr room still without mike evans rib achilles and deebo samuel hamstring jordan watkins was brock purdy s top target last week and the niners have been seeing significant snaps from demarcus robinson brandin cooks and jacob cowing the addition of allen gives the 49ers the nfl s active leader in wr receptions allen the nfl s active leader in wr receiving yards evans 13 472 yards the nfl s active leader in rb receptions receiving yards and receiving tds christian mccaffrey 662 catches for 5 660 yards and 37 tds and the second ranked active te in receiving touchdowns george kittle 57 behind only travis kelce 84 per nfl research

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Bengals call off trade for Eagles' Arnold Ebiketie over compensatory pick formula
news_mentions.description: An agreed-upon trade between the Bengals and Eagles that would have sent pass rusher Arnold Ebiketie to Bengals was called off by Cincinnati over comp picks, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported on Tuesday
news_mentions.body_text: there is a first time for everything in the nfl an agreed upon trade between the bengals and eagles that would have sent pass rusher arnold ebiketie to cincinnati was called off by the bengals due to the team s compensatory picks formula nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported on tuesday the trade was scuttled it seems by a post on x from over the cap s compensatory picks guru nick korte multiple outlets reported that the bengals were set to acquire ebiketie from the eagles for a 2027 sixth round pick analysis was written grades were given the world was ready to move on to the next deal ahead of today s 4 p m et deadline then korte fired off this post essentially by acquiring ebiketie the bengals would have negated a compensatory third round pick in 2027 they were in line to earn from losing trey hendrickson to the baltimore ravens in free agency since ebiketie was a compensatory formula signing for the eagles trading that contract would cancel out a pick for the acquiring team the math on the trade went from the bengals sending a sixth round pick for a backup edge rusher to losing a sixth and a third round pick that would have been disastrous for cincinnati not long after korte s post which had many bengals fans freaking out cincinnati reportedly backed out on the trade nfl network insider mike garafolo reported that the eagles weren t thrilled after the trade was called off but because it was agreed to and not official there is nothing philadelphia general manager howie roseman can do about it and that is how a contract analyst helped save the bengals a third round draft pick they should thank korte by hiring him someone should

news_mentions.headline: Giants' John Harbaugh on trade deadline: 'The now weighs more important than the future'
news_mentions.description: The debate for Big Blue is whether to shell out to shore up deficiencies or stay the course, keep their draft assets and see how things work out in John Harbaugh’s first season.
news_mentions.body_text: the new york giants sit atop the nfc east with tuesday s trade deadline hours away the debate for big blue is whether to shell out to shore up deficiencies or stay the course keep their draft assets and see how things work out in john harbaugh s first season you want to do everything you can do to make your team as strong as you can right now because we re in the now and we re told to live in the moment be where our feet are planted concern ourselves with today harbaugh said monday but that s not at the expense of tomorrow or just prudent planning and all that i think we just have to look at each situation and just weigh it out in terms of ok what s the cost what s the benefit and is it worth it is it going to benefit us is it a good thing for the giants and for the organization and the team so i would say that the now weighs more important than the future if you re going to put it on a scale and kind of go from there the giants 5 2 1 lead the nfc east entering week 10 2 5 games ahead of the second place dallas cowboys injuries dot their squad including brian burns tremaine edmunds and cam skattebo who could return this week new york could seek an upgrade for the defensive interior though the price tag for top shelf dts is extraordinarily high right now ahead of schedule in harbaugh s first season the giants are in a good spot either path makes sense keeping their assets and continuing to build methodically for future success is prudent however the future is never promised so cashing in on a chance to make a run could also be in the cards in a few hours we ll see what path new york takes

news_mentions.headline: Vikings QB Carson Wentz on loss to Bills: 'This one felt pretty terrible'
news_mentions.description: Minnesota Vikings quarterback Carson Wentz threw for 81 yards, two interceptions and an 8.9 passer rating in a blowout loss to the Buffalo Bills.
news_mentions.body_text: carson wentz knows he had the worst night any quarterback can imagine in monday night s 23 6 loss to the buffalo bills i haven t had many starts over the last couple of years in general but this one felt pretty terrible wentz said this one wasn t my favorite that s for sure terrible only begins to describe it wentz completed 8 of 25 passes 32 for 81 yards 3 2 yards per attempt and two interceptions for an 8 9 passer rating an 8 9 that does not happen it s the lowest passer rating by any quarterback to attempt at least 25 passes in a game since sam darnold had a 3 6 passer rating in the seeing ghosts game with the new york jets against the new england patriots in 2019 also on monday night football per nfl research if you take every hike and spike the ball directly into the ground it s a 39 6 passer rating the vikings would have been better served doing that in no way shape or form was tonight acceptable coach kevin o connell said put tonight 100 percent on me that o connell kept calling passing plays for wentz was high comedy when it was clear the qb couldn t hit water standing in the middle of an ocean wentz missed wide open targets after wide open targets the bills defense might have entered playing slightly better on paper but still had the 30th ranked pass defense you would have thought they were the legion of boom on monday night i should have run the football more o connell said the vikings attempted just 11 runs with jordan mason and aaron jones despite the game being within one score for the majority of the contest after wentz s first interception o connell did call three straight runs successful ones of 8 11 and 5 yards then wentz promptly threw another interception directly to a defender it was tough sledding for us out there and i didn t help the cause by any means wentz said buddy you were the sled the quarterback situation has dragged down an epic brian flores defense minnesota had bamboozled mvp frontrunner josh allen early forcing an interception and three points on their first six possessions but as with last week in detroit the vikings defense wore down late no defense no matter how good can withstand being on the field for 42 minutes like the vikings were on monday night the losses sit squarely on o connell s offense and particularly with the quarterback play wentz was horrific monday kyler murray has been only slightly better when he s played still sitting in playoff position all eyes are on whether minnesota will find a solution kirk cousins daniel jones before tuesday s trade deadline passes

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Cardinals' Gardner Minshew likely needs season-ending elbow surgery; Carson Beck in line to start
news_mentions.description: Cardinals quarterback Gardner Minshew is seeking additional medical opinions to confirm that he will likely need season-ending surgery on a torn UCL in his throwing arm, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported.
news_mentions.body_text: round and round the arizona cardinals quarterback carousel goes gardner minshew is seeking additional medical opinions to confirm that he will need season ending surgery on a torn ucl in his throwing arm nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported minshew appeared to suffer the injury on a strip sack by dante fowler in the closing moments of the second quarter during sunday s 17 3 loss to the seattle seahawks he stayed in to finish out the game with 166 yards on 21 of 30 passing should minshew require surgery that puts him on the bench for the duration of the 2026 campaign third round rookie carson beck would be in line to start in week 10 against the los angeles rams and moving forward arizona also signed veteran josh johnson off the cincinnati bengals practice squad per schefter though two undrafted rookies have logged starts this season the tampa bay buccaneers jalon daniels and baltimore ravens joe fagnano beck would become the first signal caller from the 2026 draft class to make a start ahead of first rounders fernando mendoza las vegas raiders and ty simpson rams minshew s injury continues a period of constant change in arizona the cardinals completed a trade sending jacoby brissett the team s starter for the first eight games to the baltimore ravens on friday three days later they could be on to qb no 3 though it is a certainly an unorthodox path to giving the rookie a shot arizona currently sits at the bottom of the nfc west with a 3 6 record so it s beneficial at this point to see what the club has in beck who threw for 11 725 yards 88 touchdowns and 32 interceptions in a long college career that included five seasons at georgia and a final one with miami florida he appeared only in the pro football hall of fame game during the preseason due to injuries hampering him thereafter but he did shine in the one outing going 15 of 19 for 188 yards and a touchdown his next test will be far tougher perhaps the most unfriendly way one could be welcomed to the nfl with no 1 wide receiver michael wilson out for the rest of the season due to a neck injury beck will make his debut against the terrifying defensive line duo of aaron donald and myles garrett the latter of whom returned from injured reserve in week 9 with a three sack statement how he performs against l a and throughout the second half of the season could play a major factor in arizona s future qb plans

news_mentions.headline: Rams WR Puka Nacua likely to be placed on injured reserve with turf toe, sprained MCL and PCL
news_mentions.description: Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua is likely to be placed on injured reserve after suffering a turf toe injury and spraining his MCL and PCL in Sunday's 20-13 win over the Commanders, head coach Sean McVay said Monday.
news_mentions.body_text: the rams have lost another star to injury wide receiver puka nacua is likely to be placed on injured reserve after suffering a turf toe injury and spraining his mcl and pcl in sunday s 20 13 win over the commanders head coach sean mcvay said monday i m bummed for puka mcvay said i feel for him i feel for all of our players that are getting these kinds of injuries it s challenging but it s an opportunity for us to adjust and adapt the game s gonna be played but you feel for the players first and foremost nacua a two time pro bowler has 70 receptions for 715 yards and four touchdowns in seven games this season in the outing against washington he was targeted 19 times with 150 yards and a score on 14 catches this marks the latest in a lengthy list of ailments for nacua this season as he was affected by psoas soreness throughout training camp and sat weeks 2 and 3 due to a hip injury but the turf toe and knee sprain will lead to his longest absence yet nacua is set to join fellow star wideout davante adams hamstring on ir leaving the rams with a wr corps of tutu atwell konata mumpfield jordan whittington and cj daniels plus a tight end group of tyler higbee colby parkinson and davis allen that is frequently used in the passing attack it remains to be seen when tight end terrance ferguson might rejoin that group the most athletic with perhaps the highest ceiling of los angeles tight ends he initially was expected to come off ir for week 9 after recovering from an ankle injury only to hurt his hamstring during friday s practice though l a has dealt with the absence of many big names on both sides of the ball nacua missing extended time will prove especially detrimental to a rams offense that hasn t clicked at all times in 2026 over the past two games matthew stafford has thrown for 385 yards two touchdowns and two interceptions hardly looking like the mvp quarterback he was in 2025 and lacking other difference making pass catchers becoming laser focused on nacua to keep things moving nacua saw a 48 target share in week 8 against the chargers and a 44 2 share on sunday meaning the rams will have to compensate for nearly half of their recent passing offense now gone should nacua go on ir as mcvay expressed is likely he will miss the next four games plus a bye week against the cardinals packers chiefs and 49ers before being eligible to return in week 15 against the cowboys

news_mentions.headline: Jaguars acquire Eagles DT Jordan Davis in blockbuster trade
news_mentions.description: The Jaguars are trading for Eagles defensive tackle Jordan Davis, sending a 2027 first-round pick and a 2029 second-round pick to Philadelphia, the teams announced on Monday.
news_mentions.body_text: the jacksonville jaguars are going all in on a super bowl push the jags are trading for eagles defensive tackle jordan davis sending a 2027 first round pick and a 2029 second round selection to philadelphia the teams announced on monday the deal marks the third trade for a defensive player of the day for the jaguars after acquiring falcons safety jessie bates and saints defensive tackle davon godchaux it s a stunning flurry of moves from jaguars general manager james gladstone who surrendered tremendous draft capital five total picks including a first and two seconds to revamp his team s defense a day before the league s trade deadline the moves on monday were made to combat the season ending injuries to starting safety eric murray and defensive tackle davon hamilton with godchaux and davis providing a new interior tandem for defensive coordinator anthony campanile davis the no 12 overall pick in the 2022 draft has 31 tackles 1 5 sacks two tackles for loss and three qb hits in nine games this season davis excels as a dynamic space eater in the middle his 23 run stops are second in the league among dts and his 28 run tackles are tied for fourth per next gen stats in 2025 davis totaled 63 run tackles and 50 run stops which were both second among defensive tackles it shows that the jaguars 6 2 believe they are well positioned for a title run in an afc where they began monday jostling for playoff positioning with the one loss bills and a host of fellow two loss teams broncos chiefs steelers and bengals for the eagles the decision to move on from davis further underscores that it is a lost season in philly we are extremely grateful to jordan for his contributions to our team on the field and in the philadelphia community since we drafted him five years ago the eagles said in a statement he has been a key contributor to our team culture and on field success which included two super bowl appearances and a world championship in 2024 his growth and development as both a player and a leader are a testament to his hard work and character we wish jordan nothing but continued success the eagles lost 19 11 on sunday to the giants for their seventh consecutive loss to fall to 2 7 on the season four of those losses have come without jalen hurts who is expected to miss the rest of the season due to blood clots and third year signal caller joe milton took over starting duties in sunday s loss for tanner mckee

news_mentions.description: Here are the injuries and news developments we're monitoring around the league on this Week 7 Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: here are the injuries and news developments we re monitoring around the league on this week 7 sunday baltimore ravens guard olaivavega ioane knee was ruled out of sunday s loss to cincinnati carolina panthers offensive tackle taylor moton suffered a fractured fibula in sunday s loss to tampa bay and will be out for a while head coach dave canales said cincinnati bengals tight end erick all knee and safety kyle dugger quadricep were ruled out of sunday s win over baltimore cleveland browns cornerback myles harden hamstring did not return to sunday s win over tennessee detroit lions cornerback ennis rakestraw ankle did not return to sunday s win over the packers green bay packers center sean rhyan ankle and offensive lineman jacob monk quad did not return to sunday s loss to the lions houston texans wide receiver jaylin noel has a turf toe injury head coach demeco ryans told reporters after sunday s loss to the giants las vegas raiders defensive end patrick johnson stinger neck did not return to sunday s loss to the rams miami dolphins cornerback julius brents stinger did not return to sunday s win over the jets minnesota vikings running back aaron jones knee did not return to sunday s win over indianapolis new orleans saints safety justin reid concussion and running back cj donaldson shoulder were ruled out of sunday s loss to pittsburgh in paris new york giants running back tyrone tracy hamstring did not return to sunday s win over houston running back cam skattebo said after the game that he felt something in his hamstring on his 42 yard run in overtime skattebo added that he did not slide on purpose on the play per espn new york jets defensive tackle t 39 vondre sweat knee was ruled out of sunday s loss to miami seattle seahawks wide receiver rashid shaheed knee was ruled out against the chiefs rb velus jones hamstring was also ruled out

news_mentions.headline: Christian McCaffrey: Absence from practices was 'part of the plan from the jump'
news_mentions.description: San Francisco 49ers running back Christian McCaffrey returned to practice on Sunday for the first time since Aug. 8.
news_mentions.body_text: george kittle getting activated from the physically unable to perform list wasn t the only positive news from san francisco on sunday star 49ers running back christian mccaffrey also returned to the practice field cmc participated in team drills for the first time since aug 8 as he dealt with tightness for a fortnight the running back said that the time off was part of the plan to ensure he s ready for another long season obviously when you don t practice the way the media works now is a firestorm mccaffrey said via nbc sports bay area this was kind of part of the plan from the jump to ramp up pretty big get nine or 10 practices in kind of come back down and then ramp up again so we re fresh for the duration our staff has done a great job of coming up with specific plans and i feel great i feel fresh and it s great to get back out there with mccaffrey sitting out practices rumors began to fly from questions about his injury status to speculation that his absence was contract related interestingly the 49ers brass could have simply said the rb s absence was a plan of sorts from the beginning but did not mccaffrey dismissed the stories and noted that sometimes he needs to be protected from his own competitive nature sometimes i can probably be my own worst enemy in how much i love being out there mccaffrey said i want to run i want to go i want every play i m a competitor i love it and i think when you have people smarter than you that understand not just what you ve been through but what we plan on doing this season it s about being fresh for the duration and it s about 17 sundays and god willing more weeks after that following an injury plagued 2024 season in which he played just four games cmc touched the pigskin 413 times including 311 carries a career high last season managing the offseason makes sense for a player vital to the niners success in 2026

news_mentions.headline: AFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Colts, Jaguars, Texans, Titans
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top AFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Houston Texans, Indianapolis Colts, Jacksonville Jaguars and Tennessee Titans.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars and tennessee titans catch up on each afc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars tennessee titans three key storylines 1 another o line overhaul the most glaring weakness of the 2025 texans will take center stage during training camp as houston once again undergoes an offensive line revamp demeco ryans crew re upped right guard ed ingram and left tackle aireontae ersery showed glimpses of promise during his up and down rookie campaign the texans drafted center guard keylan rutledge in the first round they inked guard wyatt teller and right tackle braden smith both solid veterans when healthy in free agency veteran trent brown and 2024 second rounder blake fisher will battle for reps and or the swing tackle gig and evan brown and fourth round rookie febechi nwaiwu provide depth inside on paper it s a significantly improved group from the one that got bowled over a year ago however we ve said that before paper can get shredded just like last year s o line in houston how the crew shakes out will be the key to camp and how the texans season unfolds 2 can stroud offense get back on track tied to the first point is the play of c j stroud who has seen his production dip the past two seasons after a sensational rookie campaign in 2023 stroud s collapse reached a low with his ghastly performance see four interceptions 42 6 completion rate in the playoff loss to the new england patriots stroud has been scattershot behind a woeful offensive line at times last year he trusted his blocking so little that even when he had time he d rush decisions and make panicked throws the qb s play has been so incongruous to the poise and calm he displayed as a rookie that it s maddening for the offense to get back in gear and stop wasting a championship worthy defense stroud must be more consistent in the pocket an improved offensive line will certainly help but the qb must raise all boats even when the situation isn t perfect getting better run production with the import of david montgomery should improve the offensive efficiency monty rarely gets stuffed for negative gains solving a problem we saw far too often from houston s ground game a year ago he should keep the offense in better down and distances one other key player to track during camp is receiver tank dell who has been out since late in the 2024 season due to a severe knee injury the difference in stroud s production with and without dell in the lineup is stark what sort of shape will the receiver be in after so much time away and can he stay healthy 3 rich defense gets richer can the most ferocious defense in the league actually be better in 2026 edge monsters will anderson and danielle hunter are still in their primes derek stingley kamari lassiter jalen pitre and calen bullock form a lockdown backend and azeez al shaair still patrols the middle the texans upgraded a safety spot with veteran reed blankenship after shuffling through others at the position second round pick kayden mcdonald could play a significant role out of the gate alongside sheldon rankins and tommy togiai in the middle of the d line if mcdonald turns out to be a steal this defense will have zero weaknesses back to top three key storylines 1 how will jones look in return from injury daniel jones progress is the no 1 topic in indianapolis entering camp the colts predictably held the starter out of team drills during offseason workouts but expect him to be full go sometime during camp the focus will be on how many reps he can take and how he looks indy was a wonder early last season when jones was on his game making plays and looking at home in shane steichen s offense it fell apart when the qb got hurt the colts put all their eggs in the basket of jones returning healthy this offseason achilles injuries however can be a slog to return from yes jones is younger than kirk cousins but we saw how long it took for the latter to return to anything close to what he was before such an injury and cousins never relied on his mobility like jones does if jones is stuck in the pocket or struggles to push off the injured leg leading to limp passes will the colts offense wither how he looks early in camp won t say everything but it will give a strong indication of what to expect for the first quarter of the season in concert the colts will conduct a backup qb competition between anthony richardson and riley leonard barring richardson s trade request being granted of course given jones injury history the winner could see reps this season 2 overall roster health health is the main storyline throughout the colts roster from jones to alec pierce on offense to key defenders like deforest buckner and sauce gardner on defense buckner is one to track on d the colts have no replacement for the star dt who underwent neck surgery last winter he could be ready for week 1 but at this point it remains an unknown he was noncommittal when asked this offseason given how much of the summer months are filled with players dismissing injury and assuming they ll be ready it s a red flag when a veteran is evasive if buckner misses the start of the season or sees his play dip it could be devastating for indy s defense how much he participates in camp if at all will be closely tracked there isn t the same concern with gardner who missed significant time last season with a lingering calf injury but the star s status is worth keeping an eye on we also aren t sure what charvarius ward will look like after deciding against retiring following last year s concussion issues outside of injury questions what will the pass rush look like is laiatu latu ready to make a leap how much does arden key still have left is jt tuimoloau ready for a bigger role do the colts need to bring in another veteran edge 3 taylor s future in indy outside of health concerns hovering over colts camp the future of jonathan taylor is an interesting question the 27 year old running back is in the final year of his contract the situation is far less contentious than the last time he sought a new pact which saw him conduct a hold in until he got paid when asked about his contract this summer taylor was cordial about the state of affairs but made it known he d like to continue getting paid in indy could the situation turn sour again will the rb decide to ratchet things up if no extension comes before camp perhaps he s waiting for bijan robinson and jahmyr gibbs to reset the market again before making his next play we saw the offense s struggles when jones was out as defenses could sell out to stop jt it wasn t pretty if taylor is going to be asked to keep carrying a hefty load with little aid he might want commensurate compensation into the future back to top three key storylines 1 backfield shakeup when travis etienne signed in new orleans it opened up a swath of carries bhayshul tuten who has impressed this offseason is expected to have a hefty role but it s still unclear how big that part might be as free agent addition chris rodriguez was unable to participate in offseason workouts following a surgical procedure on his left foot the veteran is expected to be good to go for training camp which will give us a better idea of how liam coen might divvy up his rb reps last year etienne took the overwhelming majority of carries 260 to tuten s 83 will coen slice up the pie more or ride tuten at least to start the season a lot might have to do with rodriguez s health 2 what will hunter s role be when it was reported that the jags planned for the former no 2 overall pick to be a primary corner and part time receiver travis hunter didn t seem to take too kindly to that plan we won t know the truth until hunter is on the field for a significant amount of time how much he participates early in camp and where that participation takes place will indicate the club s intentions if the second year dual threat player is the lockdown corner most believe he s capable of being and continues to make plays at receiver the jags could have trouble taking him off the gridiron the rest of the offensive playmakers could have some say in how much time hunter sees at wr after a disappointing second season brian thomas has received glowing reviews this offseason parker washington soared to close last season and jakobi meyers remains a consistent professional if btj gets back on track there could be less of a reason to use hunter in a ton of offensive sets 3 lloyd s replacement the jags saw devin lloyd leave in free agency and didn t replace his production in anthony campanile s defense via free agency or early in the draft the decision puts 2023 fourth rounder ventrell miller in line to take over the role next to foye oluokun miller showed spunk this offseason but won t be handed the starting gig 2025 undrafted lb branson combs and 2026 seventh rounder parker hughes could have a shot to push miller for the starting gig if no one comes to the forefront the jags d could be in a rough spot lloyd shined last year under campanile who unleashed the linebacker s athleticism in a second team all pro campaign lacking playmaking in the middle would highlight some of the questions up front where there wasn t always consistent pressure from the front four back to top three key storylines 1 cam ward cam ward cam ward when discussing critical elements for the 2026 tennessee titans point nos 1 through 50 could all be about cam ward that s how vital his development is to any success in nashville robert saleh brings a professional coach to the head chair and did well to import brian daboll to nurture the young quarterback perhaps daboll wasn t meant for the head coaching gig in new york but he s proven he can help grow a qb josh allen daniel jones and jaxson dart all improved under daboll ward offers enticing upside while his accuracy came and went last year when he was in a groove the titans qb showcased a laser arm and the ability to find the range deep he needs to calibrate his short to mid area throws at times but the alluring positives pop off the page he doesn t need to live in the acrobatic athletic plays but they can add an indefensible element to tennessee s offense improving his mental processing particularly against man coverage where he struggled is one of the early steps ward has to make this season the titans must see significant strides forward from their qb in year 2 after the club improved his surroundings 2 better receiving corps in attempting to make life easier for ward tennessee upgraded the wr room first they inked wan 39 dale robinson from new york the slot maven excelled in daboll s offense and can help teach a young wideout room the ropes robinson is coming off a 1 014 yard season and generated a career high 11 yards per catch in 2025 the veteran will be particularly helpful to ward on third downs when he can win from the slot and make himself available to the quarterback then the titans used the no 4 overall pick on ohio state wr carnell tate who provides a vertical threat and heady playmaking tate s ability to make catches in close knit areas will be a boon for his new qb second year wrs elic ayomanor and chimere dike both showed glimmers of promise during their rookie campaigns if they take a step forward this could be an enticing group the lingering question is what role calvin ridley will play the veteran struggled on the field and missed the bulk of the season due to injury in seven tilts he had just 303 yards on 17 catches with zero tds his 11 1 drop rate last season was fifth worst in the nfl minimum 25 targets per next gen stats the titans eschewed cutting ridley believing he can still aid ward and the offense what that role is will be determined during camp 3 will improved d on paper translate to field the titans sported a woeful defense last season with saleh taking over the club the unit was completely revamped on paper it s much improved but how will all the new pieces mesh i love adding a penetrating john franklin myers next to all world dt jeffery simmons however is there enough on the edges jermaine johnson had his best years under saleh but hasn t been a consistent force first round rookie keldric faulk boasts talent but will he be a day 1 difference maker will second round rookie linebacker anthony hill immediately step into the middle of the defense next to the underrated cedric gray the secondary was horrendous last season tennessee responded by signing cordale flott alontae taylor and joshua williams all have had moments in their careers when they ve been stellar but there is also a reason each was available namely inconsistency i trust saleh to know how he wants his d to run and to get the most out of his players there is no question this crew is significantly improved on paper but questions remain particularly with all the free agent veteran additions back to top

news_mentions.headline: AFC North training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bengals, Browns, Ravens, Steelers
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Nick Shook breaks down the top AFC North training camp storylines to monitor for the Baltimore Ravens, Cincinnati Bengals, Cleveland Browns and Pittsburgh Steelers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams nick shook has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the baltimore ravens cincinnati bengals cleveland browns and pittsburgh steelers catch up on each afc north team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below baltimore ravens cincinnati bengals cleveland browns pittsburgh steelers three key storylines 1 minter era begins john harbaugh is gone and in steps rookie head coach jesse minter to replace him baltimore needed a fresh start minter is the face of it but with a fresh start comes uncertainty is minter capable of preparing and directing his team toward the super bowl contention that has become the standard expectation in the charm city will the shift from harbaugh to minter a product of the harbaugh family coaching tree be enough to push the ravens back into the postseason or is the similarity between the two too close to produce meaningful change it s not often a team changes coaches and is still expected to compete for division titles and more but that s where the ravens find themselves and as is always the case with rookie coaches there s plenty of learning ahead for better or worse does this move boost baltimore back to the top of the division or will the ravens suffer another disappointing finish like in 2025 2 new oc for lamar with a new coaching staff in baltimore lamar jackson has a new offensive coordinator declan doyle is only 30 years old and less than a year older than jackson which could produce a deeper level of understanding between coach and quarterback but he s a largely unproven play caller doyle spent his first season as an oc under offensive mastermind ben johnson in chicago meaning he wasn t holding the play sheet now he will be jackson who is embracing the new system will need to adjust quickly and help the new coordinator establish a rapport with him in order to maximize the potential of the offense which returns derrick henry mark andrews zay flowers and rashod bateman among others baltimore must find a replacement for departed tight end isaiah likely but if doyle is anything like the coach he spent 2025 under the new oc should produce positive results even if it takes a bit to get going 3 a restored defense a hidden detail in the ravens 2025 struggles existed in their defense a unit that is traditionally a strength but was a sieve early in the campaign the main reason defensive lineman nnamdi madubuike went down with a serious neck injury exposing a weakness and lack of depth up front that rendered baltimore s d mostly ineffective except for the moments in which safety kyle hamilton played superhero to save the day that s not sustainable and the ravens acted accordingly this offseason signing trey hendrickson to restore a fearsome presence in the pass rushing unit madubuike could return in 2026 too and age defying defensive end calais campbell has rejoined the ravens to give them some much needed depth this is the group that minter will direct and regardless of what happens offensively this unit s performance will determine how far baltimore can go in 2026 back to top three key storylines 1 can defense finally deliver a year after navigating the choppy dramatic waters that came with trey hendrickson s holdout the bengals are in a much better place defensively they invested significantly in that side of the ball adding dt jonathan allen de boye mafe s bryan cook and s kyle dugger in free agency before swinging a major trade for dt dexter lawrence on paper cincinnati has finally upgraded defensively and appears poised to chase a super bowl but we all know depth charts only matter so much the bengals defensive inadequacies have led to great frustration in the midst of a third straight playoff less season last december joe burrow openly wondered about his football future largely because he was exasperated by the frequent challenges and predictable disappointments if the d is fixed there s reason to believe these bengals can return to the postseason and embark on a deep run 2 burrow s health can joe burrow stay healthy for once while most of the blame for this team s recent struggles has been rightfully pinned on the defense burrow s lack of availability has also been a near annual problem last season a toe injury required surgery and knocked him out for nine games sending the bengals into a crisis mode that prompted them to trade for joe flacco by the time burrow returned cincinnati needed to be nearly perfect to rescue its playoff hopes an impossible goal the flawed bengals failed to reach in 2023 a similar story played out when burrow missed cincinnati s final seven games due to a season ending wrist injury as is the case with every nfl franchise the bengals title hopes ride on the quarterback s availability that will continue to be true in 2026 3 taylor under major pressure the pressure is on cincinnati s head coach a defensible case could have been made for zac taylor s dismissal after 2025 instead he emerged as the only returning coach in the afc north entering 2026 this time around the usual excuses don t exist the defense is improved and if burrow stays healthy he has the pieces necessary to produce at an elite clip if cincy doesn t live up to the lofty expectations set by burrow the blame will fall on taylor s shoulders his team must succeed in 2026 there is no alternative three key storylines 1 new era begins under monken after six seasons the browns sent kevin stefanski packing terminating a two time nfl coach of the year who produced cleveland s only playoff win since the browns returned as an expansion franchise in 1999 in the same breath owner jimmy haslam opted to retain general manager andrew berry touting the personnel chief s strong 2025 draft class and strangely the improvement of kicker andre szmyt as justification for keeping him around berry responded by compiling another draft class that has plenty of potential in 2026 and continues to rebuild the franchise after overseeing the worst decision made by a gm in the last 25 years if not longer trading three first round picks for deshaun watson who also received a fully guaranteed 230 million contract berry replaced stefanski with veteran oc todd monken who makes his head coaching debut with a team that still isn t quite stocked for legitimate contention monken s arrival seems to have breathed new life into the young browns but with results pending that s all we know about the monken era as of now the most important lesson we could learn from the browns this year might be how much patience haslam possesses because it s unlikely this team will suddenly become a contender in 2026 it s up to monken to get the most out of his players in his first season at the helm 2 serious qb questions cleveland is revamping its offensive approach which had become rather stale under stefanski with monken in charge and travis switzer serving as a first time coordinator a new scheme can t cover for a lack of reliability at quarterback though the browns appear to be laying the groundwork for watson to emerge from irrelevance and regain the starting job while 2025 fifth round pick shedeur sanders lurks in the shadows how long watson holds on to the reins is another story but unless the 30 year old pulls off a miracle and returns to his houston form browns fans can prepare for another season filled with frustration under center which might play perfectly into a plan to select a top signal caller in 2027 s loaded draft 3 how will defense look without garrett and schwartz myles garrett reset the single season sack record in 2025 which proved to be his final campaign in brown and orange berry took a massive swing when he agreed to a forward thinking trade with the rams sending garrett to los angeles in exchange for young star edge rusher jared verse and a collection of picks that includes the rams 2027 first round selection garrett s departure means the browns lose 23 sacks worth of production from last season plus a persistent concern carried by every opposing offense add in the departure of respected coordinator jim schwartz and suddenly cleveland s defense its better side in the last two challenging seasons harbors plenty of questions fortunately the browns still have some studs on that side of the ball defensive rookie of the year carson schwesinger five time pro bowl corner denzel ward verse and promising sophomore defensive tackle mason graham but they re going to need to prove the personnel is strong enough to overcome a change in sideline leadership back to top three key storylines 1 no guarantees in life post tomlin mike mccarthy is back in the nfl having returned to his beloved hometown of pittsburgh to lead a steelers team that is taking on a much different appearance than usual instead of replacing one longtime coach with a young star the steelers opted for the veteran with super bowl experience in mccarthy a move some interpreted as a ploy to convince aaron rodgers to return for a 22nd nfl season if that was indeed the plan it worked whether it bears fruit however remains to be seen mccarthy s track record of directing explosive offenses should encourage steelers fans who have grown tired of watching low ceiling units struggle to compete so too should the acquisition of veteran receiver michael pittman but much of this feels like it s held together by chicken wire at least as of now pittsburgh s backup options behind rodgers are longtime reserve mason rudolph 2025 sixth round pick will howard and 2026 third rounder drew allar if crisis strikes at qb visions of a playoff victory something the steelers haven t achieved since the 2016 campaign will evaporate ideally the mccarthy rodgers partnership evokes memories of their days in green bay that s far from a guarantee along with the steelers annual assuredness to finish at or above 500 now that mike tomlin has left the coaching ranks for a job in television 2 run game concerns pittsburgh became one of the leaders in the nfl s sudden shift toward tight end reliant sets in 2025 leaning on the likes of darnell washington pat freiermuth jonnu smith and connor heyward to beef up and bulldoze opposing defenses though smith and heyward are no longer on the roster the first round selection of arizona state ot max iheanachor should help the ground game but is the backfield good enough jaylen warren is pittsburgh s lead back while rico dowdle arrives via free agency to give the steelers an explosive weapon capable of posting a few huge days as evidenced by his 389 yard outburst in weeks 5 and 6 for carolina last season kaleb johnson however remains a question mark the iowa product averaged just 2 5 yards per carry on 28 attempts as a rookie and hasn t yet proven he can be counted on as a rugged power back pittsburgh will have the hogs to move defenses and create rushing lanes but it will be up to mccarthy to deploy his personnel properly in order to stay on schedule and remain balanced especially with the largely immobile rodgers in the lineup 3 graham to get d back on track tomlin s departure meant the arrival of a new defensive coordinator and mccarthy selected the experienced patrick graham as his new director pittsburgh s defense is paid well but hasn t lived up to expectations of late finishing 26th in total d under former dc teryl austin in 2025 graham s track record isn t a slam dunk either in his last three stops dolphins giants raiders his defenses have hovered near league average peaking at 12th in 2020 with new york and bottoming out at 30th with miami in 2019 to his credit graham found some consistency amid dysfunction in las vegas over the last three seasons guiding the raiders to two 15th place finishes in 2023 and 24 before improving slightly to 14th but 25th in scoring d in 2025 he ll have better talent in pittsburgh which means the true test of his expertise should arrive in 2026 luckily he s working under a coach with a reputation for leading potent offenses if graham can prove himself to be a worthy dc then the steelers might actually be in business back to top
